tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 3 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ karma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang po/zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring chos sgron/ shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'brug rgyas/

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis he ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/dpe thum gsol/dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib la sdug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉 zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang /da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang /'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/nang don rig pa dang /gso ba rig pa/tshad ma rig pa/sgra rig pa/bzo rig pa/lo rgyus/rtsis rig ༈gas bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yan/ —1—

'ad 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las kya go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa na shan tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brjid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'chug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu skrungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / to wid lta bu yo rob dang / a ri sogs su grags chen gyi slob grwa wo mo —1 —

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod chen po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi bai ro ska cog zhung / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ /shangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/—2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang 6ngas cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phos te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go dzākhrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'khru / gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/ —3—

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhu/na mkhu/na/ /zhor 'phro/sa gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri rdzo las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyan1sa po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

bsdu sgrig gsal nga5/da/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+di dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod — 1 —

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras skrungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mchams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon to bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras skrungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan khu3la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3—

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bzhas mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras skrungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las g.yin gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rdza 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di( 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5 —

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song khin krin sogs kyi rgya'i spyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'gyung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon chen hūṃ pa rta sge 'byung gnas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / g.yin yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang sbyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis — 1 —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge spyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhus don la go ba rnyed wo blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gas yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud zugad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lto phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gshugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mi tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug da ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/ rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang / rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhud bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug pū hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rā pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lan+ta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591 )la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' —rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mang ri brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag chi po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/ dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bzhas gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab bshus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bshes bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bshes bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta ga rta nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni khyu ṇa shrī dang puṇ+ḍa badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang gzhan la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi bcu shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras sbungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635) la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/— 10—

rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i zhal gdams mgur 'bum gyi skor bzhugs/ 1dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa zab mo'i don mtha' dag gan/95 bar byed pa'i nyi ma/ 128dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos skor gyi byung khungs nyer mkho bzhugs/ 325

gdams pa phyag chen ngo sprod/na mo rat+na gu sa 'gran zla dang bral ba'i rin po che/ /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa can/ /phyi nang gi 'khrul pa rang sar zhig/ snying rje chen pos khyab pa'i thugs/ /gcam bu'i mdzes chos spangs nas ni//mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul la mnga' brnyes pas/ /lha 'dre mi gsum gyi 'gro don mdzad/ /drin can gyi bla ma byin rlabs can/ /lha dbang grags pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mgon des cung zad byin brlabs pa/ /mi ngas kyang gnas lugs tshig gsum 'di/ /bu khyod la 'di ltar snying gtam du gdams/ /nges 'byung gi dad pa so ma ste/ /chos brgyad kyi rlung gis ma khyer bar 'tshal/ /byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba mos gus la/ /gom 'dris dang log ltas ma khyer bar 'tshal/ /'dus byas skad cig gi rang bzhin la/ /rtag 'dzin gyi le lo mi 'tshal lo/ /sdug bsngal can 'khor ba'i gnas lugs la/ /skyid 'dod kyi zhen pa log pa zhig 'tshal/ /'gro drug drin can gyi pha ma la/ /byams pa dang snying rje sbyongs dus 'dir/ /gnod sems dang 'gran 'dod mi 'tshal lo/ /rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /snang stong lha skur rang shar gyi/ /dag snang gi 'khor lo skor rgyu la/ /brdos bos kyi zhen pa mi 'tshal lo/ /grags stong ngag gi rang bzhin de/ /brag ca lta bur sgom rgyu la/ /tha mal gyi long gtam sna tshogs kyis//chags sdang gi bkyed bed mi —1—

'tshal lo/ /sems gang shar chos sku'i yo langs la/ /ngo shes byar med kyis sgom rgyu la/ /rnam g.yeng phyi lta'i rnam rtog gis/ /'khor ba'i 'khor lo ma skor zhig /tha mal rlung sems kyi 'jug pa 'di/ /'khor 'das 'byed pa'i sa mtshams zhig lags/ /le lo dang bya ba la ma yengs par/ /rlud sems drag tu bcun pa zhu/ /sems kyi rtsa ba ma chod na/ /gting skyon mthon pa'i gnad ka des/ /gnyen po mang yang mi phan pas/ /rtsa bral thob phyir du 'bad pa 'tshal/ /yengs med du bsam gto sgom dus su/ /longs spyod dang bsod nams than thun de/ /bdud kyi pho nyar yong lags pas/ /ci dgar bor la sbyin par thong / /bar chad dngos grub tu 'khyar ba lags/ /nam zhig sgom nyams bzang bde na/ /zang 'dzin dang dga' grong bdud du 'ong / /nyams len gyi rgyal po zhen med yin/ /byar med du zhog cig gegs las grol/ /sems rig pa'i 'char sgo ma 'gags pa/ /thams cad chos sku'i rtsal yin yang / /gang shar rtsa ba ma chad par/ /'og 'gyur 'gro ba'i nyen gdog pas/ /rtse gcig dmigs pa la sgrim par 'tshal/ /zhi gnas tsam brtan brtan 'dra na yang / /ma rig gti mug tu byings dogs yod/ /gang shar ngo lta'i lud bshad kyis/ /'khrul pa rgya 'byams su shor gyis dogs/ /stong nyams tsam shar ba'i lta skad kyis/ /las 'bras la chud zos mi 'tshal lo/ /lar kun la mos gus gnad du che/ /de dngos grub kyi rtsa bar nges lags kyang / /thob 'dod kyi re dogs mi 'tshal lo/ /zhen med kyi sgo nas dge sbyor kun/ kha sngo bas rgyas thebs kyang gal re che/ /yang bla ma la gsol ba 'debs na/ mdun du rtsa ba'i bla ma bkrag mdangs gzi brjid ldan —2—

pa brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam chos skyongs mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi bskor ba/sprul pa'i pho nya mang po spro ba rang la dgyes bzhin pa byin gyis rlob rlob ltar bzhugs pa la mos gus dung ba byas te/ drin can bla ma rin po che/ /chos sku'i thugs la longs sku'i gsung / /sprul sku'i tshul gyis 'gro don mdzad/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi brjid 'bar ba la/ /gsung dbyangs yan lag rgya mtsho'i bka'/ /thugs ni bde gsal rgya mtsho 'dra/ /brgyud ldan bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /yi dam lha tshogs sprin ltar 'thibs/ /mkha' 'gro mang po'i tshogs dang bcas/ /chos skyong bsrung ma khrom ltar tshogs/ /sprul pa bu yug bzhin du 'tshubs/ /pho nya mang po glog ltar 'byug /rig 'dzin grub pa'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis 'dir byon la/ /da lta bdag la byin gyis slobs/ /myur ba nyid du byin gyis rlobs/ /gdan thog 'di ru byin gyis rlobs/ /lus la bde chen bskyed du gsol/ /ngag la nus pa bskyed du gsol/ /sems la ye shes dbab du gsol/ /dbang bzhi da lta bskur du gsol/ nyams dang rtogs pa bskyed du gsol/ /'ar ma 'ur mar byin gyis rlobs/ /ban ma bun mar byin gyis rlobs/ /chal ma chil mar byin gyis rlobs/ /rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /yi dam lha tshogs kyis byin gyis rlobs/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gros byin gyis rlobs/ /chos skyong bsrungs mas byin gyis rlobs/ kun 'dus bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /rje btsun bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /de nas bla ma'i sku las dbang bzhi blangs/ bla ma rang la thim/rang shar ngos bzung ngo / /zhes pa 'di yang mdo khams pa nang so kun —3—

dka' rin chen la/ tā ra nā thas gdams pa ste/ /rje btsun lha dbang grags pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa la brten nas phyag chen ngo sprod byas pa'i rjed thor byas pa'o// //maṅgal/༈dkon mchog rin chen la gdams pa'o/ / ༈ o khyu sti/ pha bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bu dkon mchog rin chen snyan gson dang / /mi nga la snying gtam tshig gsum yod/ /nyams len gyi rgyal po mos gus yin/ /da res bla ma dang mjal ba la/ /mos gus kyis gsol ba 'debs pa zhu/ /'chi ba 'di nam yong cha med pas/ /cho se dran ma thag tu lag tu long / /mi rtag 'phral 'phral du 'gyur lugs la/ /yid 'byung skyo shas kyis rgyud gcig bskul/ /'dir ltas 'dod yon gyi gdung sems 'di/ /las sla mor chod pa dka' bas na/ /snying rus dang zhe bcad drag po yis/ /tshe 'di'i legs nyes ci dgar bsgyur/ /zhen med du 'phang pa gdams ngag yin/ /tshe 'di la skyab kyi mi rnams dang / /blo sna mang du bstun dgos na/ /bya byed mi shes chos dang 'gal/ /mi ngan dang blo sna bstun pa bas/ /dam chos dang blo sna bstun na legs/ /yongs rang shar rang gi rang ngo la/ /bzo bcos med par lhod kyis klod/ /ched du bcos pa'i grim lhod kun/ /blos byas yin pas snying po med/ /so ma'i ngang nas rgya yan 'di/ /ci byas sgom du 'gro ba lags/ /rnam rtog skyes dang ma skyes 'dra/ /dran pa ngo shes 'di gal re che/ /yo byad dge ba'i phyogs su bsgyur/ /bya byed chos kyi phyogs su bsgyur/ /rig pa'i mda' rtse nang du bsgyur/ /'khrul snang —4—

dag pa'i snang bar bsgyur/ /bsgyur ba rnam bzhi nyams su long / /de kun yang gzhan phan du bsgyur bar bya/ /lag tu thebs na gdams ngag yin/ /yi ge tsam la ma lus pa 'tshal//zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas smras pa ste/ stag lung thang du'o// //dge legs 'phel/ /༈ rim gnyis lta spyod sgom pa kun ma tshang ba med pa'i gnad bsdus bzhugs/༈ oṃ snyu sti/ gang gi ye shes 'od brgya'i do shal ni/ /smon lam shar ri'i phrag par legs bkod nas/ /'gro ba'i mun sel rje btsun 'od stong can/khyab bdag khyod kyis ma lus 'gro 'di skyongs/ /de la dam pa'i chos rin po che rtog ge'i lam las 'das pa/ bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gis gsal bar gyur pa'i ye shes/ dad pa'i rtsa ba nyid las mngon par grub pa/ gang gi lam/ tha snyad spros pa'i tshig la ma yin par sgrub pa snying por byed pa la gnad rnams legs par shes pa gal che/ thams cad kyi thams cad du/ bla ma dam pa lus longs spyod sgrub pa sogs thams cad kyis mnyes par byas nas/ man ngag ma nor ba dag zhal las mnos te/ mdo rgyud zab mo rnams la thos pa dpyis phyin pas sgrub pa byas na ni ches mchog go /bla ma sangs rgyas kun las lhag pa'i mos gus kyis rtse gcig tu gsol ba 'debs pa rang gnad du che bar gda'/1) mtha' bral du mnyam par 'jog pa la/ gsal rig tsam la rang so 'jug —5—

pa yang thabs tsam yin mod/ ngo bo rig stong du 'jog pa gnad/ 2 mang du sgoms kyang nyon mongs tha mal par 'chor na/ sgom gnad du ma song ba yin de la yid la byed pa rnams dang / bden med kyi 'dun pa/ bla ma'i mos gus ngo bo la cer phog tu sgom pa rnam gzer bus 'debs pa gnad/ 3) spyod lam thams cad du sgo gsum skad cig kyang chos las mi 'da' zhing / las 'bras kyi blang dor la rdul tsam yang mi brnyas shing / bslab pa la gus pas tshul bzhin bsrung ba gnad/ 4) sgrub pa byed pa kun thog mar dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khordo ra ba'i sdug bsngal las 'bras mi bslu ba bsam pa sogs blo chos su 'gro ba'i thabs 'di dag bcos min rang rgyud la skyes skyes 'bad rtsol du byed pa gnad/ 5) gsang sngags sgom 'dod kun ye stong dang rang ngo shes na snang tshad bde stong rang yin pas/ gzhan gang yang mi dgos zer ba'i sdod bshad la klog nyan pa mi byed par/ bla ma mtshan ldan la bsten nas phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor rnams su cho ga mtshan nyid dang ldan pas dbang bskur thob par byed pa gnad/ 6) /bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor sbyang gzhi sbyong byed khyad par can gyi nyams len rang gal che ba/ lha'i rnal 'byor la gsal cha tshol ba gnad/ 7)gsal snang gi ngo bo rdul chos las 'das pa'i 'ja' tshon lta bu gnad/ shebazlas pa dmigs med ngang nas byed pa shin tu zab cing / dmigs bcas la yang dmigs pa rtse gcig pa gnad/ 9) bzlas pa'i gtso bo rdo rje'i bzlas pa yin pa don dam rdor bzlas ngag rlung gi dwangs ma mi shigs pa'i nā dar dngos su ngo sprod pa'i zab gnad phul phyin dang / spros bcas dmigs pa rdor bzlas —6—

sogs kyang shin tu zab pa'i gnad yod pas nan tan byed pa bzlas pa'i gnad/10) sems 'dzin thams cad kyi nang nas snying gi thig le sogs a ba dh+ra tī la gnad du bsnun pa rang gnad/ man ngag lugs kyi sbyor ba ha cang drag pas gegs byung na/ phyis thabs mkhas kyis sel ba las kyang / gegs chung la gting chod che ba/ tshad ldan gyi gsung bzhin ston na legs/ rlung sbyor gyi gtso bo rlung 'gog pa ste/ dbu mar thim pa yin/ de la bum can gnad du che ba las sngon du rtsa lam sbyong ba gnad/ 11) rlung dbu mar thim pas stong nyid tsam rtogs la thim pa des gtum mo 'bar bas bde ba drangs te/ bde stong zung du sbyor ba yin te/ rlung dang gtum mo'i 'bras bu drod sogs tsam la dmigs na mi rung pas/ 'di gnad du song ma song lta ba rang gi nyams myong dang / bla ma'i man ngag gi dngos sbyor ba gnad/ 12) ye shes lhan cig skyes pa ngo sprod pa ye rgya sogs gsungs pa'i nang nas/ stong nyid la sbyong ba kho na gnad do/ 13)bstan pa rdzogs ldan dus lta bur gang zag mchog la don du 'gyur nges na/las rgya gnang ba sogs shin tu gsang ba'i zab mo yin mod/ deng sang de la snyad nas spyod pa 'chol bar spyod pa dag dmyal ba'i rgyu yin pas/ rab byung sngags spyod pa phal cher dam chos 'dul ba rang dbang bzhag la brten dgos pa gnad/ 14) sa rdul chus sbyangs nas gser len pa ltar/ dga' bzhi skad cig so sor shar pa ngos zin pa'i sgo nas/ ngo bo rang bzhi stong pa la mnyam par 'jog pa gnad/ 15) 'dis rnam shes gsum dang rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog thams cad sbyong / ma dag tha mal pa'i snang ba stong par sbyangs pa las/—7—

bag chags kyi rang gdangs lha sku 'char ba bdag med du sbyong ba chags grol gang la brten kyang bde stong sbyor ba gnad/ 1na des phyag rgya chen po lha sku mngon du 'gyur/ 'khrul snang thams cad sdud rim khyad par can gyi stong par 'dus pas bde stong ye shes mngon du gyur pa'i rang bzhin 'od gsal mngon gyur gyi ye shes te/ phyag chen dang zung 'jug yin la rang bzhin rnam dag gi rang ngo'i 'char sgo rkyang 'dod tsam ni lta ba'i nyams len yin pas lta sgom shan phyed par bya ba sa/nad de bcu bdun no/ /spyir btang du nyams thams cad la byung rgyal gnad/ spros bcas thams cad mi rtog pas zin pa gnad/ spros med ji lta ba mngon du gyur na/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mtha' yas la 'jug pa gnad/ las dang po bas thun 'jug tu bsngo ba rnam dag gis rgyas thebs pa gnad de bzhi'o//bcu bdun dang bzhi ste/ nyer gcig po 'di rnal 'byor bla med kyi rim gnyis lta spyod sgom pa kun ma tshang ba med pa'i gnad bsdus lags pas/thugs la nges pas nyams len du mdzod/ /'di ru bdag gis gang smras pa/ /legs pa gang dag bla ma dang / /nyes pa gang yin bdag gis bzung /log smras dus gsum mgon la bshags/ /'di'i dge bas bdag gzhan thams cad rtag brtan zhi ba g.yung drung gi dpal la 'byor bar gyur cig /ces pa 'di stag lung lo tsā ba shākya bzang po'i sku'i rigs dang gdan sar gyur pa gang gi ngor//phyogs bral gyi rnal 'byor pa tā ra nā thas stag lung gi chos grwar ro/ rang lo nyi shu pa la'o// //—8—

༈ na mo gu ru khyu slob dpon rdo rje 'dzin pa ni/ /rin chen gsum bcas la phyag 'tshal/ /phan bde ma lus kun gyi gter/ /chos kyi snying po yang 'di rnyed/ /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor don mchog la/ sbyor zhing nam 'chi cha med bsam/ /'khor ra ba'i sdug bsngal nges shes nas/ /bsam pa dag pas skyabs 'gro bya/ /las 'bras yid ches blang dor bya/ /mnyam dang brje ba'i byang sems bsgom/ /pha rol phyin pa drug la bslab/ /chos spyod bcu po nyams su blang / /brgyad po de dang ldan gyur na/ /dam chos ma lus bsgrub pa yi/ /rnal 'byor can zhes bya ba ste/ /gzhan du bsgrub pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam/ khyad par nyes pa lnga spangs pa'i/ /zhi gnas sgom gyi rmang gzhi yin/ /ji lta'i gnas la mtha' bral tshul/ /rjes su dpag pas nges rnyed pa'i/ khres rab gnas cha dang bsres pa/ /lhag mthong lam gyi gtso bor snang / /gsal zhing ngar ba'i mdangs ldan pa/ /g.yo med lhan ner gnas pa na/ /bying rgod phra zhing phra ba yang bral phyir skyon rnams spangs zhes bya/ /rdo la brdar ba'i gser ris bzhin/ /zhi lhag zung du 'jug par mdzod/ /da ltar snang ba 'di dag kun/ /snang dus nyid nas rang bzhin med/ /stong bzhin du yang bya ba dang / /rten 'brel 'gag pa med pa yi/ /stong pa nyid la kun rung ba/ /nyid kyi thugs la sngar chud kyang / /da dung g.yo bar ma mdzad ces/ /bdag ni ring du sgrog par byed/ /da ni shin tu gsang ba yi/ /theg pa mchog gi man ngag ni/ /rgyud bzhi bla ma'i man ngag bzhin/ /cung zad tsam zhig zhu bgyid na/ /dbang bskur dam tshig ma nyams pas/ /bskyed rim yan lag tshang bar bsgom/ /'di la zhu bder gyur pa'i sems zab —9—

gsal gnyis med bsgom pa bsngags/ /de nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ /kun kyang kun 'dar nang du bsgom/ /lus gnad bum can rlung sbyor bcas/ /sor gcig yang na sor bzhi pa/ /mar me kho na rtag tu bsgom/ /nor bu snying gar 'od gsal dang / /gsang ba mgrin par rmi lam bzung / /spyi bo lte 'og sgyu ma'i lus/ /lte bar gtum mo sbar bar bya/ /de dag rtag tu bsgom pa las/ /sems dmigs bden gnyis zung 'jug sogs/ /bskyed tshul spyi dang mthun pa yin/ /skabs 'gar shin tu dpyad cing bsgom/ gzhan du rtse gcig sgrims la bzung / /la lar klod la ngal yang gso/ /rtag tu bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /gegs dang bar chad mi 'byung zhing / /yon tan gong du 'phel zhes gsungs/ /rlud sbyor bcu len la sogs pa/ /lag len 'ga' zhig 'dir ma bkod/ /de dag rnams kyi rgyu mtshan sogs/ /rlud rnams bsdud dang gnas dang thim/ /thim pa'i zhu bde 'dren tshul sogs/ /sde snod 'dzin pa khyed kyi ni//thugs la sngon nas gsal ba lags/ /'on kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i//zhib cha'i khyad par 'ga' zhig ni/ /mjal dus gleng ba'i legs smon zhu/ /dge bas sangs rgyas thob par shog /brgyud pa mi ldan dag mi 'gyur/ /de la brgyud pa 'di dag yin/ /dril bu pa dang lwa ba pa/ /zhing pa rdo rje chos myug dang / /ra hu la dang a ti sha /ḍi gi bhi klu'i zhal snga nas/ /bya rngon pa dang dkar min sprin//ye shes bzhes gnyen de bzhin du/ khrub thob shān+ti gup+ta las/ /sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po yis/ /legs gsan de la bdag gis thob/ /ces pa kun dga' snying pos smras/ /bshes gnyen r+ṣa po rgyang ro gser sdings kyi gdan sa yun ring du —10—

mdzad pa rin po che bkra shis rin chen pas/ mdo rgyud kun gyi yang snying yin pa/tshig nyung ba'i chos 'brel zhig bskur gsung pa'i don la tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer gsum pa la'o// //༈ yang zhal gdams/ ༈ na mo gu ru khyu pha rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal nas/ /'dir snying gtam tshig gsum smra ba ni/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba ni 'ja' tshon dang 'dra/ /'di yi rjes 'ded mi 'tshal lo/ /snang ba 'di rang sems kyi byed pa gcig lags/ /tha dad du 'dzin zhen mi 'tshal lo/ /rig pa zhen med du ma shar na/ /sgom byas tshad bzang rdzur 'gro nyer gda'/ /rang sems tshir gyis ma bzung na/ /don med kyi las la zad nyen gda'/ /rang don la hril gyis ma sgril na/ /gzhan don ltar snang gi mgo skor yong / /da res tsam ma gtogs mi lus ni/ /yang yang du thob pa shin tu dka'/ /ngan song gsum du skyes tsa na/ /dam chos kyi skal pa ni gcig kyang med/ /da res rdog sna gcig 'dren na ni/ /dmyal ba'i gting rdo gcig byed byed 'dra/ /phyi ma la phan pa'i dge ba dang //nyams len byas rjes ni 'di kar gda'/ /sdig pa dang nyes lhung ni char ltar 'bab/ /don 'di ltar bsam na chos la 'bungs/ /rgas pa'i sdug bsngal yang myur du 'ong / na tsha dang mi 'dod pa byung tsa na/ /sdug bsngal gyi gzir ba'i shes pa de/ /chos kyi lam du longs dka' bas/ /skyid dus nas chos la 'bungs pa zhu/ /re zhig rang cag tsho'i mi tshe la/ /rgyal khams yul phyogs kyi dar rgyud dang / /yar bla ma slob dpon gyi gnas lugs dang / /grwa rogs dang grogs mched kyi 'gyur lugs dang / /pha ma dang dgra gnyen gyi gnas lugs —11—

sogs/ /thams cad mi rtag pa'i rang 'tshang ston/ /'phral lo dang zla ba zhug re la/ /mi rtag pa ston pa'i slob dpon kun/ /skyo ba skyed byed kun gam na 'dug/nam yang tshe 'di'i bya ba kun/ /ji ltar byas kyang 'dor ba la/ /bu bya ba btang na sgrub pa 'tshal/ /lus mi rtag sha rus 'gyel 'gyel 'dra/ /gces gces mor byas pa'i lus 'di yang / /tha ma rus pa'i phung por gda' 'o/ /rang ser snas 'bad 'bungs bsags pa yi/ /nor kun yang sus thob dang bgo bshar byed/ /da lta zas gos kyi 'byor pa yang / /ro shun dang ro zas kham gcig yin/khong kha drag dpung pa 'dzom pa yang / /dus nges med 'chi ba byung ba'i tshe/ /nor mnga' thang longs spyod kun bor nas/ /slar ngan song gsum du 'grim pa mthong / lar mi rtag 'dus byas spyi lugs yin/ /don 'di la bsams nas chos la 'bungs/ /byams snying rje phyogs med du skyong ba dang / /'phral gang shar la zhen med du skyong ba dang / /tshe 'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum/ /dus gnas skabs kun tu rin po che/ /pha bla mar yid ches blos khel gyi/ /snying thag pas gsol ba 'debs par 'tshal/ /lar nam yang bslu pa med par nges/ /nges 'byung dang snying rje mos gus dang / /zhen med yengs med du skyong ba ste/ /don bzhi po 'di la 'bad gyur na/ /'dun ma rtse la phyin pa yin/ /zhes pa yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas/ dad ldan gyi slob ma nyi ma rnam rgyal la gdams pa ste/gong dkar du'o// //༈ yang zhal gdams gcig la/ ༈ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyams len snying por dril ba ni/ /kun rdzob snying rje chen po dang / /don dam spros —12—

dang bral ba yin/ /dag snang lha sku'i lam khyer ni/ /sngags kyi snying po'i nyams len yin/ /bde sdug 'phral rkyen zhig byung yang / lta/nga byung lam du 'khyer ba las/ /zab pa'i nyams len ci zhig yod/ /rab gsal rgyal po'i rnam 'phrul gyis/ /gnad 'di gzigs nas thugs kyi sras/ /byams pa'i dpal la gdams pa yin/ /bdag nyid bde zhing skyid pa na/ /mar gyur 'gro ba thams cad kyang / /skyid par 'dod pa kho na yin/ /bdag bde gcig pus mi phan gyi/ /'di kun bde ba thob na snyam/ /yang yang yid la bsam par zhu/ /skyid na bde ba tshogs su bsngo/ /phan bdes nam mkha' gang bar shog /ces pa ngag tu yang yang brjod/ /gal te bde ba 'dod na ni/ /dge ba'i las la brtson dgos pas/ /dge la 'bad par bya snyam dang / khams gsum 'gro ba 'di kun yang / /dge la 'khod par gyur cig ces/ /smon sems yang yang gtong bar zhu/ /rang gzhan dge la 'jug pa'i thabs/ /nan tan sgrub pa gal re che/ /skyid pa kun rdzob lam khyer yin/ /mi 'dod sdug bsngal byung ba'i tshe/ /sdug bsngal can la snying rje sgom/ /sdig pa'i las lam zlog par bya/ /skyid na byams pa'i lam 'byer dang / /sdug na snying rje lam du 'byer/ /skyid dang sdug par snang ba yang / /'khrul ngo tsam zhig ma gtogs pa/ yang dag don la grub pa med/ /lus ni bem po ro dang 'dra/ /'dod yon ji snyed stabs gyur kyang / /skyid pa'i tshor ba mi 'byung zhing / /dum bur gtung/sa sam mes bsregs kyang / /de la sdug bsngal ci yang med/ /lus med na ni sems de yang / /bstan du med cing thogs med phyir/ /yul dang 'brel ba'i bde sdug med/ /lus dang sems las gzhan pa —13—

zhig /sdug bsngal myong ba med pas na/ /skyid bya skyid byed 'khrul pa ste/ /sdug bya sdug byed yod ma yin/ /med pa'i ngang la mnyam par zhog /snang ngor bde sdug ma 'gags kyang / /de la 'dzin cen zlog pa yin/ /'dzin cen med na 'phral rkyen ni/ /ji tsam mang zhing bogs kyang che/ /nags kyi me la rlung byung na//me yi grogs su 'gyur ba yin/ /'dzin zhen can gyi gang zag de/ /skyid na chags cen dbang song nas/ chos min spyod pa sna tshogs 'ong/ /sdug na nyams thag sems 'phyo zhing / /nyams len chos la yi chad byed/ /nyin gcig na ba tsam la yang / /the tshom rnam rtog brgya phrag ldang / /nas bre gang gi phyogs su yang / g.yo sgyu mgo skor sna tshogs byed/ /nyin gcig skyid pa byung ba la'ang //chos min sna dgu sems la 'gyu/ /bde sdug phra mo tsam la yang / /nyams len dpyad thag yan nas mchi/ /zhen med lam 'khyer shes tsa na/ /rkyen ngan me ltar 'bar na yang / /nyams rtogs dbyar gyi mtsho ltar 'phel/ /bde sdug snang ba'i sems 'di yang / /snang ba tsam zhig ma gtogs pa/ /skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba yin/ /'das pa dang ni ma 'ongs pa/ /ri bong rwa ltar cang med yin/ /da ltar na yang ma dmigs pas/ /'khrul ngo ma gtogs don la med/ /de ltar rig pas dpyod pa 'tshal/ /dpyad pa tsam la ma bzhag par/ /rang bzhin ngang der mnyam par zhog /rang ngo shes pas tshir gyi zung / /bde sdug snang ba'i sems de yang / /lha skur lam gyis gsal btab nas/ /'gro ba kun la snying rje dang / /gang snang spyan ras gzigs su sgom/ /yi ge drug pa'i gsang sngags bzla/ /stong pa lha sku snying rje gsum/ /sku gsum lam 'byer ngo sprod yin/ /bab la 'dus —14—

pa'i gdams ngag 'di/ /nyams len mdzod cig stan gcig pa/ /zhes pa'ang stan gcig pa rab 'byams smra ba spyin pa rin chen dang //dpal 'byor rnam rgyal zhes pa gnyis kyi bskul nas tā ra nā thas gong dkar du smras pa'o// //dge legs 'phel/ /༈ bsod nams bu khrid la gdams pa'o// ༈ 'gro kun dga' ba'i 'phrin las kyis/ /snying po'i bstan pa rgyas byed cing / /thar pa'i lam ston mjal gyur nas/ khyod la phan bde rab rgyas shog /dad ldan mas nges 'tshal ba/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba bzhi po 'dir 'dus/ dad pa brtan pa/ bsam pa bzang ba/ las 'bras la rtsi ba/ nga rgyal spangs pa ste bzhi yi/ dang po dad pa ni/bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba/ mdzad spyod thams cad 'gro don du len pa/ gdung shugs drag po 'bral ba med pa rnams dgos/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs dang / gsung rab kyi po ti dang / /chos pa bzhir longs pa lta ci smos/chos pa'i gzugs tsam yod pa la yang / skur ba mi 'debs/ sdig mi gsog pa gcig 'tshal/ gnyis pa bsam pa bzang ba ni/ gal che gzhan la byed pa/gzhan la phan thogs na rang la gnod kyang bzod pa/ zhor thabs su yang gzhan la gnod pa gtan mi byed/ phan ci thogs thogs su sgrub/ dgra la zhe sdang drag po dang 'khon 'dzin mi bya/ gsum pa las 'bras la rtsi ba ni/ sdig pa che chung thams cad la 'dzem/ dge ba chung ba la brnyas bcos mi byed/ chen po la blor mi shong ba med pa/ 'phral nyin re bzhin phyag 'bul/ mchod pa/ bskor ba byed/—15—

smon lam 'debs/ zla re bzhin bsnyen gnas len/ lo dus su tsha tsha 'debs pa dang / dge 'dun dang / gtsug lag khang la mchodi pa byed/ bzhi pa nga rgyal spangs pa ni/ 'di tsho 'gangs chung / nga rang 'di tsam yin/ pho grung mo grung bya ba nga yin snyam nas gzhan la brnyas bcos byas na/ skyes bu dam pa gang na yod mi shes pas/ de 'dra la nga rgyal gyis brnyas na tshe 'di'i bsod nams nyams/ skye ba phyi ma yi dwags lba ba can du skye/ des na brnyas pa mi byed gus pa bya/ nga rgyal rang mthong che 'dod spangs na rigs mtho bar skye ba lags// //zhes pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas gdams pa'o/ /maṅgal// dge'o//༈ oṃ snya sti/ rgyal ba kun 'dus kyi ngo bo mtshan ldan bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir bu'i don po dge ba'i bzhes gnyen blo gros dpal bzang ba la/ nyams len gnad bskul gyi rim pa cung zad bri bar bya ste/ spyir chos thams cad kyi 'jug sgo nges 'byung dang sems bskyed gnyis yin/ dngos gzhi ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab gnyis yin/ mthar phyin byed rang don dang gas don gyi spyod pa phun sum tshogs pa yin/ 'bras bu chos sku dang gzugs sku gnyis yin/ de ltar don brgyad kyi chos spyi'i nyams len 'bras bu dang bcas pa bsdus pa lags so/ /de yang 'khor ba mtha' dag don dam par med bzhin du snang ba yin pas zhen pa'i yul stongs/ gnas skabs kun rdzob tu yang mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin yin pas zhen rin yang mi chog ci byas sdug bsngal gyi g.yos las ma 'das pas zhen pa'i rgyu med/ gal te zhen na sdug bsngal las thar dus —16—

med pa zhig yong bas nam yang zhen du mi rung / rgyu mtshan bzhi po 'di shes na nges 'byung snying thag pa nas skye ba yin/ kun rdzob rang bzhin med par shes pas/ /de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje bskyed/ don dam de bzhin gshegs pa'i khams 'gro ba thams cad la khyab par mthong bas/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la skye 'gro kun 'god pa'i snying stobs rgyas pa/ 'khrul snang gi sdug bsngal sna tshogs pas gces pa'i sems can rnams sgrol ba'i do gal rang la bab bar shes pa'i lhag bsam dang / phyogs cha nye ring spangs ba'i btang snyoms chen po ste/ bzhi po de 'dzom na sems bskyed rnam dag mi yong ba'i thabs med do/ /bying rgod dang bral ba'i sems dang ba dang / dmigs med du ci 'dod bzhag chog pa'i dbang sgyur pa dang / grim lhod ran pas lus sems mi bde ba med pa dang / dmigs med du shes pas ting 'dzin nyid la yang ma chags pa ste/ting nge 'dzin rnam dag tu 'gro ba la bzhi po de tshang dgos/ rgyu 'bras rten 'brel mi bslu bar shes pa dang / 'khor 'das kyi gnyis snang thams cad gdod ma nas stong par shes pa dang / chos kyi dbyings gang du yang dmigs su med pa la sems ro gcig tu thim pa'i nyams myong dang / nyams myong de'i rtsal cir yang 'char thub pa'i gsal stong zung 'jug ste/ bzhi po 'di dang ldan na/ theg chen gyi lta ba rnam par dag pa'i lhag mthong de yod pa lags/ spyir byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad gzhan don yin kyang / zhor la rang don rgya chen po gtso bor 'grub pa'i spyod pa rnams la rang don gyi spyod pa zhes bya ste/ de yang bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du shes pa dang / mthar thug sems can sgrol bar 'dod —17—

pas/ gnas skabs bdag nyid byang chub la 'dun pa drag po dang / mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs yon tan gyi khyad par mang po sgrub pa la brtson pa dang / rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pa dang 'brel ba ste/ bzhi po des phyin drug sogs byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa ci spyad kyang/ rang don rlabs po che yin la/ bdag pas gzhan gces kyi bsam pa dang / yi rang dang bsngo ba'i sbyor ba dang / chos dang zang zing dang / lus dang / bya rtsol gyi sgo nas dngos su sems can la phan 'dogs pa dang / ji ltar sgom pa thams cad gzhan don du dmigs shing / ting nge 'dzin gyis zhing sbyong ba dang / sems can smin par byed pa dang / brgyud nas sems can la phan 'dogs pa ste/ bzhi po 'di dang 'brel ba'i spyod pa thams cad gzhan don lags/ rang don gzhan don la ldog mas phye ba mang ngo nges 'byung dang / shes rab dang / rang don gyi spyod pa rnams kyi rang 'bras chos sku ste/de yang spros bral mkhyen pa dang / rten 'brel mkhyen pa dang / rang bzhin dbyings dang ye shes zung 'jug dang / 'phrin las lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i thugs rje dmigs pa med pa'i ngo bor gnas pa ste/ mtshan nyid bzhi ldan yin no/ /sems bskyed dang ting nge 'dzin dang gas don gyi spyod pa'i rang 'bras ni/gzugs sku yin te/ mdzad pa lhun gyis grub pa dang / ye shes dang smon lam gyi stobs las byung ba dang / gang la gang 'dul du snang bas gar yang phyin pa dang /yul dus thams cad du mdzad pa ma 'khrugs shing don med du mi 'gyur ba ste/mtshan nyid bzhi ldan yin no/ /lam des 'bras bu de 'grub pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/sems nyid gdod ma nas spros pa thams cad bral ba/ kun rdzob chos can —18—

'khrul pa'i snang ba thams cad dang / /don dam chos nyid ma 'khrul pa'i ye shes thams cad 'char ba'i nus pa can yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar 'grub pa yin no/ /de rnams blo yul du nges nas/ skabs kyi don cung zad brjod pa la/ bdag nyid kyi bstan pa'i bya ba rang gzhan tshul khrims rnam dag la 'god pa dang / nyan bshad la brten nas gdul bya spyod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / blo gros kyi snang ba ci rigs pa bskyed pa rnams kyang/ bsam pa zang zing med cing byang chub sems kyis zin na gzhan don rlabs po che yin/ gzhan gzhi tshul khrims la gnas pa'i sgo nas/ ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab dang sgom byung rnam par dag pa la 'god thub na/ gang dag gcig la stong nyid kyi lta ba rnam par dag pa skyes pas kyang thos bsam kho na can gyi sde snod 'dzin par grags pa brgya stong thon pa las gzhan don rlabs che ba yin/ ting nge 'dzin ltar snang skyes pa las ni/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab rnam par dag pa la thos bsam byung na brgya stong 'gyur gyi de rang dga'/ phugs kyi gzhan don de rang che/ brdzun kho nas bzang por 'chos pa'i sgom chen dang / las 'bras khyad du gsod pa'i stong nyid dang / blun sgom bying ba bsags pa'i zhi gnas te/ 'di gsum dam chos 'jig pa'i rgyu chen yin lags so/ /yang gnas skabs su bdag nyid la sgom byung gi mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan med bzhin du gzhan gyi bla ma ltar brdzu ba ni shin tu nyes pa che'am snyam na/ 'di la gnyis yod de/ rang gi rnyed bkur grags pa 'dod pa dang / rang gzhan la chags sdang gi dbang du song ba yin na/ ngan 'gro'i gting rdo yin/gcig tu bstan pa dang dge 'dun la phan pa'i bsam pa snying thag pa nas gzhan —19—

don skyong / dngos su yang phan thogs nges pa rnams bya/ dad rdzas la sogs pa longs spyod par mi 'os pa rnams la ci nus kyis 'dzem zhing / yo byad thams cad dge bar bsgyur ba dang / 'phran bu mi spyod ka med rnams gzhan la phan na bdag nyid nyes par gyur kyang sla snyam pa'i bdag gzhan brje ba dang / 'di ni mi 'os pa'i bya ba zhig go snyam pas bshags pa dang sgrib sbyong la 'bad par byas na/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa khyad par can du 'gro ba yin/ so so skye bo'i gzhan don phal cher don med du 'gro ba ma yin nam snyam na/ dngos su thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam la 'god thub pa nyung ba la dgongs pa yin gyi/de min chos kyi 'brel ba thogs phyin/ phugs don med du 'gro ba mi srid/ yang gzhan don gyi gnas skabs su rang la bzang 'dzin gyur na/ ting nge 'dzin mtho rab yod kyang phung 'gro na/ gzhan lta ci smos/ de 'joms pa la 'di ltar bsam dgos/ kun rdzob kyi dngos po thams cad med bzhin du snang ba la/ nga rgyal dang bzang 'dzin skye ba las g.yas chung ba ci yod/ rmi lam du rgyal srid thob pa la rgyal por rlom pa dang 'dra/ gal te bden par yod du chug kyang / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i mdzad pa sogs la brtags na/ khyod kyi 'di tsam gyi cir yang mi phyin/ gzhan don yin pa'i rgyu mtshan yang mi gda'/ 'phral gyi phun tshogs dang lang long ni/ mi sdig can dmyal bar 'gro kha ma 'dra la'ang gda' 'o/ /zhes rang gi rang la brda sbyor dgos/ yang nyams len dang gzhan don spyod pas ngal ba dang / sgyid lug par gyur na 'di ltar bsam ste/ rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyi/ gzhan don du sku dang / rgyal srid sbyin par btang ba la yang —20—

grangs med/ ting nge 'dzin gyi don du zhabs ya gcig btsugs te/ lo brgyad khrir bzhugs pa sogs mdzad snang / khyod kyis 'khos 'dis byang chub ta ga la thob/ lto gos dang nor dang gtam gyi phyir du ci yang zhig byed nus pa la/ chos phyir dka' ba cung zad zhig kyang spyod mi nus pa 'khos 'di 'dra'am/ zhes dran par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ ha cang skyo shas che na yi mug yin/ /des kyang mi phan spro ba skyed pa gces/ /mi lus thob cing dam pa'i chos dang mjal/ /bla mas rjes bzung 'di las skyid pa ci/ /ha cang spro na rnam g.yeng rgod bag yin/ /nges 'byung sgom pas de la gnya' gnon mdzod/ /zhus par gyur na gzengs bstod 'di ltar bsam/ /tshul bzhin bsgrubs na dud 'gro'i lus kyis kyang / /byang chub mchog gi lam du nges 'jug na/ /bdag gis ci phyir mi nus zhes su bsam/ dregs pa skyes na rang gi gnas tshul la/ /drang por bsams pa nyid kyis zhi bar 'gyur/ /kun kyang thams cad stong pa'i rang bzhin la/ /bzang ngan mtho dman bde sdug yod med pas/ /spros bral dbyings la mnyam par bzhag gyur na/ /gegs dang gol sa thams cad rang grol yin/ /zhes pa 'di ni rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nye bar gdams te/ ngo mtshar can gyi dam chos 'di/ khyod kyi thugs su son pa dang / shwakya'i mtshan 'chang rgyal des kyang / /nges par byin gyi rlobs par 'gyur/ khar phyogs yangs pa'i rgyal khams su/ /don gnyis rlabs chen 'grub pa dang / /myur du bla ma'i zhabs bsten nas/ /bstan la bya ba byed par shog /ma ṅga la// //—21—

༈ oṃ snya sti/ dgos 'dod kun 'byung bla ma la/ /lus ngag yid gsum phyag 'tshal nas/ /nyams len sgrub pa'i man ngag cig /mdo tsam bdag gis gsol bar bgyid/ /de la 'khor ba thams cad sdug bsngal yin pas/sems rgyud chos su song ba zhig ma byung na/ gzhan 'khor ba'i phun tshogs gang gis kyang phan med/ nam 'chi cha med mi lus rnyed dka' bas chos nyams len la phyi shol byed mi nyan/ rgyal srid kyi 'byor pa phun tshogs ci dgar bor ba ni snying stobs mchog tu gyur pa lags mod/ de nyid la dgos pa bla na med pa'i byang chub rang don/ chos kyi sku spros bral gyi dbyings rtogs pa dang / gzhan don 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du nam mkha'i mthas gas kas kyi 'gro ba thar par 'dren pa yin pas/ de gnyis la thugs gcig tu brnags par 'tshal/ srid pa snying po med pa la snying po'i don blang pa'i phyir/ rtse gcig tu sgrub tu yong zhes skal pa bzang / de yang tshe 'di phyi'i 'khor ba la zhen pa yod na chos rnam dag tu mi 'gyur/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems ma 'byongs na theg dman du gol/phyogs 'dzin dang chags sdang gi dbang las/ rang rgyud ma dul na chos kyi dgos pa stor/ snang grags la bden par 'dzin na gnas lugs kyi don mi rtogs/des na cis kyang dgos med kyi nges 'byung dang gcig bzod med kyi snying rje shugs drag dang gnyis/ dag snang gi 'khor lo bskor ba dang gsum/ a 'thas kyi zhabrul pa bzhig pa dang bzhi/ chos bzang po 'ong mi 'ong bzhi po 'di yod med la rag las/ khyad par dngos grub kyi rtsa ba bla ma dam pa yin/ blo rtse gnyis la byin rlabs mi 'byung bas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma gcig kho na la gsol ba —22—

btab pas/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yin tshad kyi byin rlabs 'jug mos gus de yang sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor shes pa'i ltag tshan che ba/ gdung shugs drag pos ngar rno ba/ ci mdzad gzhan don du mthong ba'i ngos rgyas pa/ gang la yang dpyad pa mi byed pa'i thag chod pa ste/ bzhi po de tshang na/ rtogs pa mi skye ba'i thabs med/ rtsa ba mos gus rang la 'dus/ gzhan yang deng sang gi sgom chen pa phal cher/ bskyed rim bzlas sgom la g.yas chung ngu byed/ yang stong nyid kho na la gdeng yod dam snyam na/ bsrung pa dang 'dre 'dul sogs sngags thu thu dang /gdams ngag sad sud cig la ka re ste/ de gnyis 'gal ba yin/ rdo rje 'chang gis rgyud thams cad du bskyed rim gal po cher gsungs/ dag snang gi 'khor lo bskor ba la shin tu zab/ des na lus la byin rlabs 'jug pa'i don du bskyed rim/ ngag la nus pa rnyed pa'i don du bzlas brjod la nan tan du zhu/bskyed rim rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum rang gi blo dang 'tsham par sgom pa las/khab mig tu mdzug gu 'jug pa bzhin mi dgos/ rlud sems kyi 'jug pa ma dag na sems kyi 'khrul pa mi zhig des na rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa rlung thig le'i rnal 'byor man ngag zhal shes dang byin rlabs kyi bka' babs su ldan pa la nan tan du sgrubs pas/ rlung sems la 'jur ba zhig dgos/ ri khrod du rdzogs rim sgom pa la/ lus sbyong kyang gegs sel dang bogs 'don du gal che ba zhig 'dug de thams cad kyi snying po phyag rgya chen po gnas lugs kyi don rtogs pa la 'gril ba yin/ 'di'i man ngag ni sems ma bcos so mar 'jog pa kho nar 'dug rang rig rang gsal rjen ne ba la gnas pa 'di zhi gnas skyon med pa —23—

yin/ de la brten te rang sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i thabs la 'bad dgos pa yin la/ sems kyi gnas lugs de ni gzhi gdod ma nas cir yang ma grub kyang 'dug pa de'i rang zhal lta shes na sgom chen du sleb pa yin/ de nyid rtag tu 'khyongs na sgom lam du longs pa yin/ sgom yang ma dgos na gnas lugs lhod du gyur pa yin pas/ de srid du nan tan 'tshal/ des na da ltar thun gyi gnas skabs su bla ma'i mos gus la gzhi byas/ phyag rgya chen po la mthil du byas/ bskyed rdzogs gzhan rnams la bogs 'byin du byas nyams su bzhes pa dang / thun mtshams su phyag dang mchod pa smon lam klog pa sogs chos spyod kyi rim pa la yang gang 'grus su 'tshal zhing / dge sbyor thams cad bzang 'dzin dang chen pas ma bcings pa'i ngang nas spyod pa zhu/ dam pa rnams kyis gcig nas gcig /'bad pas gdams pa'i snying gtam yang / /'di las g.yin na yod min pas/ /thugs la chongs shig skal ldan mchog/ // ces pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas gdams pa'o/ /maṅgal//༄༅shā/ /o snyu sti/ bla ma rnams la gus btud nas/ /nyams len gdams pa mdo tsam zhig /bu yi don po khyod la gdams/ khyod kyi thugs dang 'phrod par smon/ /da res rten mi lus khyad par can thob pa la nyams len sgrub pa snying por byed pa gal che zhing / de yang gang sne zin zin nas sgom pas kyang /don chen po 'grub pa srin mod kyi/ 'on kyang nyams len la rkang sgril rgyu yod pa gal che/ des na re zhig rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i drod ma thob kyi bar du nyams —24—

len khrigs chags lam gyi lus tshang ba zhig nges par dgos/ drod thob pa yan chad nyams len la rkang grangs med/ khrigs chags thams cad zhig pa yin mod kyi/ grub pa'i spyod pa yin pas/ rang cag las dang po pas de mi 'chun/ 'dir lam cha tshang ba'i tshad kyang gang yin snyam na/ tshe 'di lta ci smos/ 'khor ba mtha' dag la blo gting nas log pa'i nges 'byung / ci byed gzhan don du 'gyur ba'i byang sems dang / blang dor 'gal 'khrul med pa'i spyod pa rnams lam gyi gzhi rten shin tu gal che/ lam gyi dngos gzhi dbang gis rgyud smin pa dang / bskyed rim lha sgom sngags bzlas kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa dang / rdzogs rim rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i bde gsal gyi nyams shar ba dang / de thams cad 'dzin zhen dang bral ba'i lta bas rgyas thebs pa ste bzhi po de rnams tshang dgos/de kun yang chos rgyud tha dad pa sna tshogs kyi 'kho 'kho bsdus pa tsam ma yin pa/bka' babs kyi chu bo gcig las byung ba gal che/ snying po lag len du dril ba la thun bzhir dge sbyor gang byed kyang thog mar nges 'gyung dang / byang chub kyi sems yid 'gyur ba thon nges pa dang / bar bar thams cad du nges 'byung dang snying rjes bskul ma 'debs pa gal che/ thun bzhir bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len cha tshang bar sgom zhing / gtum mo sogs rdzogs rim la gnad du bsnun pa ste/ lam myur khyad zab cing gal che ba zhig lags na'ang / rang re na tsho de bag tsam kyang song / nyams myong can gyi bla ma dang yang thag ring pas/ gegs sel bogs 'don sogs ji bzhin yong ba dka' ba'i phyir/ rdzogs rim thun ma chag tsam la chog shes bya zhing / bcur bcur ma yin pa'i ngos nas/ lha sgom sngags —25—

bzlas gang 'grub dang / thun mtshams su chos spyod dge sbyor yang ma sun pa'i ngos nas ci 'grub bya/ thun thun mtshams dge sbyor spyod lam thams cad du gang shar ngos gzung thams cad bral ba la ma bcos so ma klong yangs su skyong ba gal che/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i mnyam ba theg skyong thub na rtag 'grus su 'tshal zhing / khyad par bla ma'i mos gus drag po rtse gcig tu gsol ba 'debs pa rnam pa kun gal che/ mdo 'don pa dang / gtor ma gtong ba dang / phyag mchod swasmo gdab pa sogs kyang nus na gang 'grub bya zhing / dge ba thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rgyur bsngo bas rgyas thebs pa la gcig tu nan tan 'tshal/ tshe spel ba sogs 'dod lha 'phran bu'i bsnyen bsgrub/ bskyed rdzogs dngos gzhi tshar re song ba'i gzhug tu/ sngar gyi de kha'i rtsis zin pa'i khog nas byed pa gal che/ rang gi dge sbyor ma chags pa'i ngos nas gzhan phan cung zad 'grub na'ang 'gal ba med pas 'tshams par re mdzad par zhu/ snying po rang re'i mi tshe 'phro ci yod dam pa'i chos la chig 'gril du 'khyol pa zhig ma byung na/ cis kyang mi phan pa la blo che gtod dgos pa lags so/ khyed la gdams pa ji bzhin du/ kho bo'ang de ltar smon pa lags/ /'o skol spyod tshul gcig gyur pas/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par shog /ces pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas don ldan gyi slob bu dge 'dun dpal 'phel la gdams pa'o// //bkra shis/༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ mtha' bzhi'i spros pa las grol ba/ /gnyis med ye shes bde chen dngos/ /bla ma rdo rje can zhabs 'dud/ /gdams ngag mdo tsam —26—

bshad par bya/ /rnyed dka'i mi lus thob dus su/ /don yod kyi thabs la 'bad par 'tshal/ /mtshan ldan rje dang mjal dus 'dir/ /mos gus rgyun chad med par 'tshal/ /gdams ngag zab mo thob dus 'dir/ /rtse gcig tu 'bad pas nyams len 'tshal/ /nges don snying po dang mjal dus 'dir/ /drang don gyi mgo bskor la ma zhen zhig /mthun rkyen 'bad med du 'dzom dus 'dir/ /'dod yon gyi g.yeng bas ma 'byer zhig /nam 'chi cha med kyi don bsam nas/ /nges 'byung gi skyo shas bskyed mod kyi/ /chu bur chu la thim pa bzhin/ /snang stong sgyu ma'i blo brid tsam/ /yi mug gi sdug bsngal mi dgos kyi/ /chos nyid du shes pas skyo se zhog /rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'di/ /rmi lam du na bar snang ba dang 'dra/ /thar 'dod kyi bsam pa bskyed dgos kyang / /bden zhen gyi 'jigs skrag mi 'tshal lo/ /dge sdig gi 'bras bu smin pa 'di/ /sgyu mas snyu ma bskyed pa dang 'dra/ /bden med kyi cho 'phrul tsam lags mod/ /kun rdzob kyi 'khrul snang ma 'gags par/ /rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel mi bslu pas/ /spang blang la phra zhib mdzad pa zhu/ /'gro drug drin can gyi pha ma rnams/ /rang ngo ma shes pas 'khor bar 'khyams/ /rang sems kyis rang nyid bcings tshul la/ /bsam bzhin du snying rje 'bad med du 'char/ /byams snying rje'i rang ngo bltas pa'i tshe/ /snying rje bya rje byed dbyings su yal/ /dbyings de las snying rjer lam lam pa/ /dmigs med kyi snying rje chos kyi mchog /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos thams cad/ /gdod nas skye ba med pa la/ /blos byas kyi bcas bcos mi dgos pas//ci yang ma yin lta ba'i mchog khugs 'byung gi spyod pa 'gag med la/ kun —27—

brtags kyis spang blang mi dgos pas/ /rang grol rgya 'byam gyi rnal 'byor la/ /tho cor ma song ba spyod pa'i gnad/ /gnas lugs cir yang med pa la/ /sgom med yengs med du mnyam par zhog /snang ba ci shar 'gag pa med/ /du ma ro gcig bsgom pa'i gnad/ /re dogs kyi zhags pas ma bcings bar/ /sku gsum lhun grub rang rdzogs 'di/ /rang sems las gzhan du med lags pas/ /rtsol bral byar med 'bras bu'i gnad/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma la mos gus dang / /dag snang phyogs med kyi bskyed rim dang / /rlung sems la gzhur ba'i rdzogs rim gsum/ /sgom nyams len pa la gnad du che/ /zhes pa nges med kyi rgyal khams pa/ /tā ra nā tha zhes bya bas/ /rtse gcig tu sgrub pa la gzhol ba yi/ /mdo khams pa shes rab dpal la gdams pa'o// //dge'o/ /༄༅rti/ /o rdza sti/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bu snang ba sems la khyad par med/ /gang shar bzo bcos med par zhog /snying rje dang stong nyid 'gro ldog gcig /snying rje 'dzin par ma shor zhing / /stong nyid chad stong du ma lus pa'i/ /zung 'jug nyams len gal re che/ /las 'bras kyi blang dor phyin ci log /cis kyang dgos med kyi nges 'byung stor/ /gzhan phan mkha' khyab kyi sems bral pa'i/ /stong skad sbad kham gyi phyag chen dang / /mu stegs pa'i lugs kyi rtsa rlung la/ /blo rtse gtod pa'i sgom wo te/ /blo chung gi mgo bskor mkhas srid kyang / /sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i lam las gol/ /bu sangs rgyas gsung bzhin sgrubs gyur na/ /sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu yin pas/ /bzang 'dod kyi —28—

tsab tsob ma mang bar/ /lus ngag yid gsum chos dang bstun/ /lta ba mtho la yangs pa dang / /spyod pa zhib tig skabs su babs/ /sgom pa yengs med rgyun chad med/ /de gsum 'dzom na 'bras bu smin/ /bza' btung don gnyer gyi kha spyang can/ /rgyal khams bskor ba'i zog po la/ /sgom r+ṣa gyi dri yang mi yong bas/ /dben pa'i ri la tshugs par 'tshal/ /long gtam la chags shing zhen pa des/ /ngag gi bden tshig ga la 'grub/ /nus na gsang sngags kyi bzlas brjod gyis/ /min na'ang smra ba bcad na legs/ /mthun 'jug dang mi dga'i ngos bsrungs kyis/ /sems bzhag kyang chags sdang 'phel ba'i ngang / /'di spangs kyang 'phongs pa dka' ba'i phyir/ /pad kyis chod la rgyangs kyi bskyur/ /nyams myong cung zad skyes skabs su/ /bzang 'dzin skyes na bdud kyis khyer/ /dpe ri la 'dzems pas g.yang la lhung / /mtho ru song gin sgrim pa gces/ /bla ma'i zhal lung gi gdams ngag rnams/ /chud zos med par nyams su long / /ham pa dang 'ud gog ma che bar/ /tsu gcig tu sgoms na 'tshed pa yin// //zhes pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas/ rgyal bzang rtogs ldan rin bkras la gdams pa ste/ dar yul brag nag du'o// maṅgal//༄༅/ na mo gu sa pha gcig chog rgyal po bla ma la/ /dus rgyun chad med par gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag bu slob kyi blo sna chos la bsgyur/ /sems mkha' khyab rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /dus da res mthun rkyen kun 'dzom zhing / /mtshan ldan rje dang mjal ba dang / gdams ngag zab dgu thob dus —29—

'dir/ /don med du ma lus pa cis kyang 'tshal/ /lus sha khrag 'dus pa'i phung po la/ /rtag 'dzin gyi yid brtan mi rung bas/ /dge sbyor phyi shol ma byed par//'phral 'phral du lag len la thebs par mdzod/ /nyams su ma myong ba'i stong shob can/ /stong nyid kyi rbad gog khar khyer nas/ /nag po kha 'byams su song nyen gdog /las 'bras la zhib tig gal re che/ /mos gus gdung ba rgyun chad med/ /bla ma'i gsol 'debs la nan tan mdzod/ /de la'ang bden zhen mi 'tshal te/ /bla ma'ang rang sems las logs na med/ /rang ngo ma shes pas 'khor bar 'khyams/ /tshugs med kyi snying rje gal re che/ /bden med kyi 'khrul pas bslus pa yi/ /bde sdug kun rmi lam lta bur ltos/ /rang sems tha mal gyi shes pa 'di/ /bcas bcos mi dgos chos sku yin/ /rnam rtog gi 'char sgo ci shar yang / chu dang rlabs bzhin go bar gyis/ /spyod pa zhib rtsing ji ltar yang / /ngo lkog gi rdzun rib mi 'tshal te/ /de yang chos dang mthun pa gces/ /chos 'gal gyi sgom chen phaṭa tshar re/ /sgom pa 'khor yug rgyun chags te/ /byar med las med gal re che/ /de yang rtsol med kyi dran pas bzung mun thom du lus na the le le/ /'bras bu rang sems sangs rgyas 'di/ /gzhi thog tu zob stong lam las shing / /re dogs kyi g.yang sar ma lhung pa/ /thag chod kyi shes pa'i nges shes dgos/ /gang snang thams cad chos sku la/ /phyogs 'dzin gyi dbye ba med lags mod/ /gcam bu'i dag snang 'dis rang tshugs skyel/ /bla ma'i brgyud pa zin par mdzod// //ces pa 'di ni rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa ste/ las stod spa lung gi rnal 'byor pa 'ga' la gdams pa'o// //—30—

༄༅/ /mnga' ris se ri ba phyogs su sems ma lha lha tshe ring la mya ngan bsal ba'i don du bskur ba'o// ༈ oṃ rdza sti/ 'du byed ston ka'i sprin bzhin g.yo ba dang / /tshe srog nam mkha'i glog ltar mi brtan zhing / /las ni grib ma bzhin du rjes su 'gro/ /lang tsho ldan pa'i lus kyang 'jig 'gyur bas/ /'jig rten 'di dang gzhan du phan nges pa'i/ /dge ba'i las la rtse gcig 'grus par 'tshal/ /las ni chung yang 'bras bu rgya che na/ /dge sdig chen po bsags la smos ci dgos/ /nam zhig sha khrag phung po 'gyes pa dang / /sems nyid skye ba gzhan du 'pho ba'i tshe/ /dam pa'i chos las skyabs gzhan ma mchis shing / /sdig las gzhan du dgra yang ma mchis so/ /'dus rtsi tha ma 'bral pa chos nyid lags/ /bslang ba'i mtha' ni 'gyel bar 'gyur ba dang / /bsags pa'i tha ma ring por mi thogs 'dzad/ /gson mtha' 'chi ba yin zhes rgyal bas gsungs//'dren pa rdo rje'i sku yang mi brtan na/ /so so'i skye bo rnams ni smos ci 'tshal/ /ri rab gling bzhir bcas pra'i 'jig rten 'di'ang / /thal ba tsam yang mi lus 'jig par gsungs/ /de bas rang nyid skye ba dpag med du/ /rab drag dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba dang / /lha mi'i dpal gyi bde skyid nyams pa sogs/ /sdug bsngal mya ngan 'khrug dang yid mi bde/ /grangs med tshad med myong zhing dus 'das kyang / /da dung sdug bsngal 'khor lo bskor ba 'di/ /chu gnyer grangs bzhin zin pa mi gda' bas/ /tshul 'di dgongs la mya ngan mi 'tshal te/ /sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i sems bskyed dang / /gzhan la phan par bsam pa'i snying rje yis/ /dge ba'i las la rgya cher 'bad par —31—

'tshal//'bras bu'i don chen mchog la som nyi med/ /lo zla mang por sdug bsngal rgyur 'gyur na/ /nyin gcig skyid pas skyid go mi chod ltar/ /tshe rabs kun tu sdug bsngal rgyur 'gyur ba'i/ /sdig pas tshe 'dir bde na'ang de dang 'dra//tshe 'di yun thung lo zla 'ga' zhig yin/ /'jig rten pha rol tshad bzung med pa'i phyir/ /skye ba gzhan du sdug bsngal mi 'byung zhing / /dge ba'i thabs su dge sdig blang dor bya/ /tshe 'di'i grogs po ji ltar bzang yang 'bral/ /dam chos sgoms na nam yang 'bral mi srid/ /'khor ba'i dpon 'di ji ltar bzang yang bslu/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la bslu ba med/ /zas nor longs spyod 'dzom yang shul du lus/ /bsags pa'i las ni nam yang 'bor mi srid/ /lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa'ang rgas pas 'joms/ /dam pa'i chos la nam yang rgas pa med/ /'jig rten bya ba 'grub kyang zin pa dkon/ /chos la 'bad na las stabs myur du zin/ /'khor ba'i bya ba legs pa'ang tha mar brlag /dam pa'i chos kyi 'bras bu nyams sri srid/ /de ltar lags pas tshul 'dis kyang / /nges par thugs ni rab bskul te/ /bdag nyid dge la gnas pa dang / /sems can bde ba'i thabs kyang 'tshal// // ༄༅/ /na mo gu ra we/ mtshan ldan bla ma rje la 'dud/ /dad ldan mos pa'i slob ma la/ /don ldan gdams pa cung zad tsam/ /chos ldan bya ba'i ngang nas bsrings/ /nges med 'jig rten gyi bya bzhag 'di/ /rmi lam dus kyi longs spyod bzhin/ /bden bden 'dra yang snying po med/ /bden 'dzin gyi zhen pa mi —32—

'tshal lo/ /rnyed dka' mi lus kyi rin chen la/ /dge legs kyi khye phogs ma thon na/ /dud 'gro'i 'gro ba dang khyad ma mchis/ /sgo gsum dge phyogs la 'bung ba zhu/ /mnga' thang dang longs spyod cher mchis kyang / /tshe phyi mar phan pa mi gdog cing / /'chi ba yang nam yong cha med pas/ /'phral 'phral du dkar phyogs la 'bad pa zhu/ /rang gzhan gyis gces par bzung pa yi/ /lus 'di yang nam zhig nges par 'jig /gnyen bu rta sogs lta smos ci dgos/ /tshe 'di la ma chags zab don bsgoms/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ni pha mtha' med/ /gar skyel rang dbang ma mchis shing / /phyi ma'i bde sdug ni las la rag /sdig las la cis kyang 'jom par zhu/ /gzhan gang gi phyir du sdig bsags kyang / /ngan song la bgo bsha' byed thabs med/ /rnam smin rang nyid kyis 'khur dgos pas/ /gzhan phyir du sdig gsog mi 'tshal lo/ /snang tshad rang sems kyi snang ba yin/ /gang shar la dran pa'i so bas zung / /byar med kyi ngang du lhod kyi klong / /rang grol gyi rtogs pa nang nas 'char/ /'gro drug drin can gyi pha ma la/ /byams snying rje phyogs dus med par bsgom/ /rang 'dod kyi ngan sems shig gis bzhag /phan sems bde 'byam gyi ngang la bzhag /mdza' bshes kyi phyi rjes mthar thug kyang / /phyi nas dge ba la 'bad pa dkon/ /gzhan byas kyi dge bas kyang mi phan pas/ /dge ba bdag nyid kyis sgrub par zhu//'phral dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa dang / /lus yi dam lha skur bsgom pa dang / /ngag 'khyal pas mi 'da' gzungs sngags bgrang / /yid phyag chen dang snying rje zung 'jug sgom/ /'phral lo dus su spyin pa rgya chen gtong / /dus zla —33—
