rer bsnyen gnas yang yang len/ /gzhan nyin zhag so sor phyag mchod brtson//tshe 'di phyi gnyis kar bde ba lags/ /de kun gyi rtsa ba mos gus yin//mtshan ldan bla ma rin chen la/ /blo lings kyi bkal la gsol ba thob the tshom gyi rtog dpyod mi 'tshal lo/ /chos thams cad rang gi blos byas yin/ /mos gus kyi snang ba dang ma bral na/ /rtag tu bla ma dang 'grogs pa lags/ /nye ring gi dpyad pa mi 'tshal lo/ /thugs yid dbyer med du gsol ba btab/ /rang sems dang bla ma dbyer med pa/ /'du 'bral med par rtogs tsa na/ /mthar thug gi rtogs pa ngang gis 'a myong// //zhes pa rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas/ /dad ldan bde skyid dpal 'dzom la gdams pa'o// dge'o//༄༅/ /drung pa'o pa la gdams pa'o/ /༈ kho bo rje btsun bla ma yis/ /rjes su bzung la nyer brten nas/ /snyan pa'i tshig la ma ltos par/ /ma sgribs gnyug/ ma khong nas gsal/ khyed kyang bla ma rin chen la/ /gus pas gsol ba 'debs par zhu/ /'dod dgu thams cad char ltar 'bab/ /gegs dang gol sa bar chad gsum/ /nam gzhug chad kha'i sprin ltar dengs/ /yon tan thams cad rang shar 'byung / /tha snyad tshig gi brjod pa la/ /zhen med ngos nas bslab par zhu/ /tshogs kyi gtso bo byed pa la/ /tshogs la dag dang ma dag gnyis/ /rang sems rtogs pa'i khyad par gnyis/ /so so'i spang blang ma 'dres 'tshal/ /dag pa'i 'khor kyang 'dus pa dang / /rang nyid rtogs pa 'gyur med na/ /gnas lugs rjen par ston pa las/ /lus ngag spyod la khyad par —34—

med/ /ma dag 'khor tshogs 'dus pa'am/ /rang nyid rtogs pa mi brtan na/ /tshogs kyi gtso bo byed pa la/ /gtso bo'i chos bzhi dgos pa lags/ /'khrul 'khor sngags dang ting 'dzin dang / /cho ga rnam par dag pa 'tshal/ /'khrul 'khor spyod pa btsun pa yin/ /sngags ni smra tshod zin pa yin/ /ting 'dzin grim la bsam pa bzang / /cho ga 'khor tshogs skyong ba la/ /snyoms shing 'jam pos skyong ba yin//'gro don gtso bor byed pa'i tshe/ shwakya thub pa'i 'grul 'khor dgos//nyams len gtso bor byed pa'i tshe/ /drang srong chen po'i 'khrul 'khor 'tshal/ /nyams rtogs phyogs bcur skyong ba'i tshe/ /mkha' lding chen po'i 'khrul 'khor gces/ /nges med spyod la gnas pa'i tshe/ /he ru ka'i 'khrul 'khor mdzod/ /dang po shāka thub 'khrul 'khor ni/ /btsun tshugs zin la ltag tshugs bzang / kha ngan 'khrug long mi byed cing / /spyod pa bde la khog yangs pa/kha lag byed pa bzang po yis/ /spyi snyoms byed pa gal re che/ /rtsa ba'i blo gtad ma 'gyur bar/ /phyi nang spang blang ma 'dres 'tshal/ /drag srong chen po'i 'khrul 'khor ni/ /'chi ba snying la zug pa yin/ /bde skyid gtam la ma chags par/ /dka' spyad zhe rus byed pa yin/ /mkha' lding chen po'i 'khrul 'khor ni/ /'dab chags mkha' lding rgyal po de/ /mkha' la 'gro sdod ci byed kyang / /sa la mi bog rang dbang yod/ /spyod lam bya ba ci byed kyang / /'gyur med klongs su gyur pa na/ /ci byas rang shar rang grol yin/ /nyams rtogs longs spyod rgya cher spel/ /he ru ka'i zhakhrul 'khor ni/ /nges med spyod pa skyong ba yang chal chol tsam la ma song bar/ /nyams len gnas la 'chug med —35—

dgos/ /'khrul 'khor kun gyi spang bya ni/ /grags 'dod g.yo sgyu yin pas spang / /'khrul 'khor spyi'i chos gcig ni/ /drang po lags pas bskyang bar sdo kyi// //༄༅/ /ngam ring su'o// ༈ bla ma rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la bdud bzhi bcom pa'i dpal/ /zas gtsang sras kyis 'di skad ces/ /bag yod bdud rtsi'i gnas yin te/ /bag med pa ni 'chi ba'i gnas/ /dregs ldan dbang gis phyug pa yang / /mi rtag gdon gyis zin pa na/ /mgon med gyur pa'i gnas skabs la/ /chos las gzhan pa'i skyabs ma mchis/ /gang zhig 'byor par ldan pa la/ /nor dang dbyig gis ci zhig 'tshal/ /legs par bshad pa'i tshig gcig la'ang / khams gsum nor gyis char mi phod/ /chos med dbang phyug phun tshogs kyang / /dug can kha zas bzang po bzhin/ /'byor pa nyams pa chos ldan yang / khun par bcas pa'i nor bu bzhin/ /gang la gnyis ka ldan gyur pa/ /des ni don kun 'grub par mthong / /kun spangs kyis ni 'byor ldan kun/ /zil gyis gnon pa rab byung yin/ /mi yi mchog gyur 'bras yod dang / /dpal dang ldan pa don yod phyir//sku tshe 'di dang pha rol kun/ /bde 'gyur chos la 'bad par 'tshal/ /nyi zla lhun po rgya mtsho sogs/ /nam zhig gzhan du 'gyur ba na/ /'tshe ba rlud ltar g.yo ba yi/ /mir gyur pa lta smos ci dgos/ /ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal 'di'i/ /cha la'ang bzod par dka' ba dang / /mtho ris gnas kyi 'byor pa yang / /chu bur bzhin du g.yo bar —36—

'gyur/ /skye rga na 'chi 'jigs dang dbul/ /sdug bsngal mang pos nye bar gces/ /srid gsum 'gro ba 'di kun ni//'du byed kyis ni rnam par 'khyams/ /nyon mongs ldan pa'i dge ba yang //'khor bar mtho ris 'grub 'gyur bas/ /nyon mongs las dang sdug bsngal gyi/ /'khor lo 'di ni zlog par 'tshal/ /phan bde 'di ni dkon mchog mthu/ /gnas skabs yab yum sogs kyi drin/ /yab mes sogs kyi drin bsab la'ang / /dge ba rgya chen sgrub par 'tshal/ /bkur 'os bkur bas bdag nyid la/ /bkur bsti rgya chen thob par 'gyur/ /mchod 'os mchod cing bstod 'os bstod/ /gus dang drin du bzo ba'ang mtshungs/ /kun la'ang brtse bar rigs lags na/ /rang la brten pa lta ci smos/ /bde 'dod sdug bsngal spong 'dod par/ /rang gzhan thams cad mtshungs par gzigs/ /gzhan gyi srog dang nor phrogs nas/ /gzhan dag tshim byed lugs bzang min/ /lha khang gi ni rdzas la sogs/ /gzhan la stsal ba lta ci smos/ /lha khang mchod pa dge 'dun dang / / dge 'dun mchod pa lha khang la/ /sgyur ba'ang nyes pa cher gsungs la/ /dkon mchog gsum la yongs dmigs pa'i/ /mar me'i 'od la 'dug pa yang / /srog chags phal pa bkum pa bas/ /las de sbyang dka' yin zhes gsungs/ /rang gi nongs la gzhan dag gis/ /smad kyang khro bar mi 'tshal te/ /de yang rang gi skyon lags pas/ /skyon ni 'bad pas spang bar 'tshal/ /nga rgyal mi bya rang mi bstod//tshe dang dpal dang chos 'phel na/ /dka' ba'ang dang du len par mdzod//lan 'ga' grub par ma gyur kyang / /don chen sgrub la thugs mi zlog/zhing pa snang pa la sogs bzhin/ /dus —37—

gzhan zhig na lan mang dang / /'gru/ba par 'gyu/ra ba ma yin nam/ /'gal bgyid gcig kyang mangs ba'i skyon/ /phan bgyid byed pa'ang mi spang ngo / /bram pa'i rdo bzhin 'bad pa yis/ /bsal yang gnod byed 'phel bar 'gyur/ /rigs dang mi rigs tshar bcad dang / /rjes bzung nad dang zungs bzhin 'tshal/ /gzi lum spyad par mi bgyid cing / /gzhan gyi srog la'ang 'tshe mi bgyid/ /dri ma bkrus pa rab mdzes kyi/ /gos dag sreg pa ga la 'dzangs/ /chos don phyin ci log bzung na/ /sman ma zhu ba'i nad dang mtshungs/ /longs spyod 'ga' zhig dgra dang gnyen/ /don med don ldan rnams su dgongs/ /gal te gtam de dag la ni/ /dgyes na slar yang gsol bar bgyid/ /'on te thugs kyis bas gyur na/ /mchid 'di btang pas bde bar 'gyur// //dge'o//༄༅/ /dpon mo nam mkha' rgyal mo la chos kyi 'phrin du bskur ba'o//༈ oṃ snyu sti/ shin tu rnyed par dka' ba ni/ /mi lus shing rta la zhon nas/ /thar pa'i grong khyer 'jug 'dod pas/ khren tu 'bad pas brtson par rigs/ /brtson 'grus dpung dang bral ba rnams/ /bar chad chom pos bcom zhing brlag /'khor ba'i zam stegs dal 'byor 'di/ /'chi bdag chu bos ma khyer ba/ /de srid 'bad pa cis mi rtsom/ /'bum phrag dpung gi rdul tshub can/ /bang mdzod stong phrag mang 'byor zhing / /nad med dregs ldan rgyal po yang / /mi bzad gshin rje'i khar chud na/ /dpa' bo'i dmag gis mi phan —38—

zhing / /g.yog dang nor gyis mi bzlog la/ /gzugs dang lang tshos bslu bar 'gyur/ khren tu gces shing phangs pa dag /cis kyang ma phan 'das gyur na/ /sems ni zug rjas 'joms 'gyur gyi/ /bdag la phan pa gang yang med/ /'gro ba drug po 'di dag tu/ /byis pa so so'i skye bo 'khums/ /bum par sbrang bu 'khor ba dang / /mtshungs zhes nyi ma'i gnyen gyi gsungs/ /nam yang 'khor ba bde med pas/ /de las nges par thar 'dod na/ /dngos por 'dzin pa bzlog pa'i phyir/ /yang dag don la gnas par 'tshal/ /sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /da lta'i bar gyi mi dge ba/ /stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags sdams 'tshal/ /gzhan gyi chos ldan bya ba gang / /mthong thos kun la yi rang na/ /de las rang la dge ba ni/ khren tu rgya chen thob par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid nga rgyal mi 'tshal zhing / /gzhan gyi phun tshogs la mi sdang / /ngan pa rnams la brnyas mi bgyid/ /mchod dang sbyin pa rgya cher btang / /slob dpon gang la mnyes 'gyur ba/ /de yis bkur bsti mchod pa bya/ /dge ba gang byas sems can dang / /lhan cig sangs rgyas rgyu ru bsngo/ /chos tshul mu mtha' ma mchis pas/ /mtha' dag su zhig brjod par byed/ /gang las thabs mkhas thob 'gyur ba/ /de 'dra bdag gis brjod pa lags/ /zhes pa tshig bcad bcu gnyis pa ste/ /tā ra nā thas gtam du brjod pa'o// ma ṅga la//༄༅/ /o snya sti/ gang zhig srid zhi'i phun tshogs bdud rtsi'i 'bras//dal 'byor dpag bsam ljon pa'i rtser chags pa/ /'di las 'dod —39—

dgu ci yang blang bar rigs/ /gzhan du 'di 'dra rnyed pa brgya la zhig /ha ri tsan+dan dris rgyas sum rtsen nags/ /ci 'dod dga' bas rol pa'i rtse sa yang / /dbang med bor te lo ma ral gri'i tshal/ /bskal par bsten pa 'di ni las kyi mthu/ /rab 'bar gser gyi spo la gnas bcas pa'i/ /rnam thos bu dang dbang po'i 'byor pa yang / /dus kyi dbang gis ston ka'i chu 'dzin bzhin/ /dengs par 'gyur ba 'di la su yis bzlog /rig 'dzin dga' ma'i lag pad kyis btud pa'i/ /'chi med sbrang rtsi'i dog pas mi spogs pa/ /bsam btan bdud rtsi'i dga' ston longs spyod can/ /de dag g.yung drung dpal la bde bar rol/ /'jig rten chos brgyad sgyu ma'i skyed tshal na/ /ngur smrig skru sdug rgyas pa'i ko ki la/ /dam chos snyan sgrogs srid pa'i snye ma la/ /ci dgar chags mod dus gzhan bsam par rigs/ /tshig 'phreng 'dab shog rgyas pa'i rkang drug pa/ /rang bzo dpal 'bras smin pa'i tshogs la 'khrul/ /'dab brgya'i tshal zhes rings par rgyug byed kyi/ /zab don ro mchog nam yang thob pa med/ /rgyu 'bras rten 'brel ri mo bkra ba 'di/ /rang bzhin gdod nas rnam par dag pa'i rtsal/ /sa gzhi ri bcas nags tshal ji snyed gzugs/ /ci yang 'char mod rab dwangs mtsho yi ngang / /mtshan ldan bla mar mos gus yid bzhin gyi/ /nor bu 'di las legs byas ci yang 'byung / khren tu stobs ldan bya ba'i mthu las ni//mtha' dag phra mo 'grub pa dngos po'i gshis/ /rang bzhin gdod ma'i sems 'di sangs rgyas te/ /dbul po'i khyim 'og rin chen 'byung khungs ltar//thabs gzhan cis kyang mtshon par mi nus pa/ /mtshon 'di byin rlabs stobs kyi mthu dpal yin/ /de —40—

skad smra pa tā ra nā tha yis/ /blo ldan karma chos bzang zhes bya ba/ /de la dam pa'i chos las brtsams pa yi/ /bka' mchid nyung ngu tsam zhig smras pa lags// //maṅgal bistu ra ku mā dge'o//༄༅/ /grags pa bzang po la'o// ༈ oṃ sma sti/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde sdug chags sdang gi rnam rtog de/ /rang sems gsal stong las gzhan du med/ blo bde dang mi bde 'char sgo kun/ /gang shar la bzo bcos mi 'tshal zhing / /rang ngo shes kyis la mnyam par bzhag /dbyings rig dbyer med sprul pa'i sku/ /dus da lta chos sku'i yo langs yin/ /'pho na chos sku'i dbyings su 'pho/ /bla ma sangs rgyas rin chen gyi/ /thugs yid dang rang sems bsres la zhog /bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med la/ /bzo bcos med pas ngo shes 'tshal/ /nged bla ma skye med du ngo shes 'tshal/ khyed rang sems chos skur rtogs nas 'ong / /mos gus 'dun pa'i rgyab rten gces/ /yar bla ma'i thugs su 'pho 'dun mdzod/ /zan lhag gi lugs kyi mi che zhing / /gdams ngag gi lugs kyi mi mang bas/ /tshig 'di bzhin thugs la nan tan mdzod/ /bu grags bzang gi blo la de ltar zhog/ // maṅgal//༄༅/ /na mo gu sa bla ma mchog gi zhabs pad la btud nas/ /mdor bsdus snyan bskul bgyid par 'tshal ba la/ khren tu rnyed dka' bsnyen par dka' ba yi/ /bzhes gnyen dam pa 'bad pas bsten par zhu/ /'jig rten —41—

'jig rten 'das pa'i phun tshogs kun/ /bla ma dam pa bsten las 'byung zhes gsungs/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i 'jigs pa las sgrol ba'i/ /gru chen 'di ni phyi nas thob dka' bas/ /da lta rtse gcig 'bad par ma byas na/ /'bad par bya ba'i dus ni nam zhig yin/ /sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po las/ /dam chos ma gtogs gzhan gyis mi grol bas/ /nyin mtshan tshad med dam pa'i chos la 'bad/ /'dun ma thams cad rtse la phyin par gda'/ /sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro sems bskyed maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ /dngos gzhi nyams len gnad kyi snying por bsgril/ /thun 'jug bsngo bas rgyas 'debs rgya cher spel/ /thun mtshams kun tu snying rje'i 'khor lo bskor/ /lam gyi ngo bo gnad gsum rig par bya/ /gang snang dag pa'i 'khor lor spyod pa dang / rang bzhin rtsa bral lhun grub mnyam bzhag dang / /rdzogs rim zab mo'i gnad dang ldan pa'o/ /dge sbyor kun la gcig tu gal che ba/ /bla ma'i mos gus lags pas 'bad de sgoms/ /mkha' lding rgyal po'i 'dab gshog ji bzhin du/ /gang la'ang zhen pa med dang snying rje gnyis/ /brtson 'grus dag snang snying stobs brtan pa gsum/ /'jig rten gsum na rin chen gsum dang mtshungs/ /dad pa ngo tsha shes dang khrel yod dang /dge sdig blang dor gnas la gzab pa ni/ /nyams len rgyal po'i dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi/ /mi mthun dgra 'joms dpa' bo mtshungs pa med/ /drang po'i yid dad bden par smra ba'i ngag /chog shes dang ni chags med dam chos mnyan/ /lnga po 'di dag yon tan sa gzhi lags/ /mtha' bzhi las rgyal dbus su brtan par byed/ /phyogs kun bde bar skyong ba'i dpal ldan pa/ /rgyal po'i —42—

bu 'dzom pha rol phyin pa drug /rin chen bdun mtshungs 'phags pa'i nor bdun te/ /yan lag brgyad ldan 'phags pa'i lam kun las/ /gsung rab dgu yi 'khor tshogs bde bar rgyu/ /dge bcu'i khrims kyi bde bar 'tsho ba ni/ /dam chos 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dpal 'byor lags/ /de skad smra ba'ang tā ra nā tha yin/ /mi mchog thugs mtsho rnam par gang te 'ong / /thub gsung sprin las dam chos chu char 'di/ /skal ldan re ba'i zhing sar 'bab min nam/ zhes pa'ang chos rje karma bstan 'dzin la dge bar gdams pa/ dge legs 'phel// shu bha ma stu sarba dzā ga ta// //༄༅/ /na mo gu sa mdzu gu gtad sa med pa'i chos dbyings la/ /ci yin med pa'i bla ma bzhugs/ /ti gtad med pa'i mos gus sgoms/ /ngos gzung med pa'i byin rlabs zhu/ /nam zhig rgyun du mos gus sgoms/ /thun 'gor skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang / /thun gzhug tu bsngo bas rgyas 'debs sgoms/ /rtag tu bsam pa bzang po bya/ /sdig pa la shi 'dzem ro 'dzem gyis/ /yong na dge ba ci 'grub gyis/ /lha khang dang dge 'dun bla ma'i rdzas/ /dug nag po ha la ha la yin/ /'bru gcig kyang kha la ma 'i khyer zhig /skud gcig kyang a phrag tu ma 'jug cig /'jig rten gyi kha drag dpung 'dzom la/ /yid smon gyi re ba ma gtod cig /dgon pa sde gog gi 'go mi dang / /sdig can gyi dpon po'i thugs zin dang / /chos la sdig gsog gi btsun pa gsum//dmyal ba'i gting rdo zhig lags pas spong ba zhu/ /rang rgyud se rengs ye rengs 'di dang —43—

gcig /chos la nya dred chu dred 'di nga/nga gnyis/ /nyon mongs me dar chu dar 'di dang gsum/ /bslab sdom kha ral sna ral 'di dang bzhi/ /'phral spyod mi rtsing dgu rtsing 'di dang lnga/ /dam tshig gar nyams 'dir nyams med dang drug /dge sbyor rgya yengs dgu yengs 'di dang bdun/ /'di bdun rang skyon lags pas mtshang nas brus/ /lar la thang med pas ca re sdod//ham pa ma che cum me gyis/ /'gro lugs wa ltar 'dzem pa cig /sdod lugs ri bong ltar bzo ba cig /lab lugs zhus bu ltar snyam pa cig/ rang sems bu chung ltar bzo mod cig /lag len rtsi ltar zhib pa cig /'di lnga lag thog la longs pa cig gyis/ /lus ngag gi spyod pa rtsing pa 'di/ /dam chos 'dul ba dang rgyab 'gal yin/ /bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kyi gdug sems 'dis/ /theg chen gyi khyu nas 'bud pa lags/ /nyams len med pa'i tha mal pa/ /dag snang chung la rang 'dod che/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan bshig yin/ /'o skol chos gzugs su sgyur phyin chad/ /chos kun dang mthun pa zhig ma byung kyang //sna gcig dang ma mthun na ci rang ba kha/ /'di snying gto gyi nang nas nying khu yin/ /snying dmar por bton kyang 'di las med/ /chos gzugs kyi dkor zan bstan pa'i dgra /tshig 'di la ma mgu yang bya thabs med/ /a la la mdo rgyud thang mar brdal na yang / /'gag dril rgyu 'di las 'dug ri shi/ nged rtogs ldan gyi kha nas de ltar thal/ /bu sems la phan na sems la zhog/ sems tshig pa za na chu la skyur/ /bstod ra la dga' na bstod pas chog/ ces kun dga' grags pa la tā ra nā thas gdams pa'o// //—44—

༄༅/ /na mo gu ra we/ pha bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ khyed mos ldan gyi blo sna chos la bsgyur/ /dus da res dal 'byor thob dus 'dir/ /chos nyams len byed pa'i dus la bab/ /las byas kyin slar yang byed dgos mang / /don chung gi bya ba phyi la skyur/ /dgra btul kyin rting la 'dul dgos mang / /slar yang sems 'dul ba'i dus la bab/ /gnyen mgu pa las kyang zhabang ba mang / /'jig rten gyi gnyen kun sdug bsngal gyi rgyu/ /nor gsogs pa las kyang bsag dgos mang / /cen pa gting nas log pa'i dus la bab/ /sems zin pa las kyang bzung dgos mang / /ngo srungs bshol ba kun blo re bde/ /chos bslabs pa las kyang slob dgos mang / /don nyams len byed pa khye re che/ /don spyad pa las kyang spyod dgos mang / /dal 'byor don med du 'chor nyen gda'/ /'jig rten gyi blo gtad mthong tsa na/ /lha chos kyi skyabs gnas bka' drin re che/ /mkhar kun zhig pa mthong tsa na/ /lus gnad kyi mkhar 'di don re che/ /gang smras mdo med 'di mthong tsa na/ /ngag bzlas brjod byed pa don re che/ /ci bsam sems kyi tsher ma la/ /'dzin med du 'jog pa gnad re zab/ /tshe 'di'i gto grogs 'bor tsa na/ /nyams rtogs kyi grogs 'di brtan re thub/ /nam yang rgas pa 'dis mi bslu bas/ /de tshun chad chos la bsgyur na bzang / /nam yang sdug bsngal 'dis mi slu bas/ /chos phyir dka' ba spyad na bzang / /nam yang na ba 'dis mi slu bas/ /na tsha lam du khyer na bzang / /nam yang 'chi ba 'dis mi slu bas/ /chos phyir du nongs na go yang chod/ /nam yang dam chos 'dis mi slu bas/ /blo gtad bcas na don re che/ /tshe —45—

'di las phyi ma don che bas/ /phyi ma'i grabs shom sems la dris/ /tshig slob pa las kyang sgoms na legs/ /sgom tshul bla ma'i zhal nas dris/ /don mang ba las kyang 'dril ba bzang / /don snying por 'dril ba zhig cis kyang 'tshal// //zhes pa'ang kun dga' bde legs 'dzom la gdams pa tā ra nā thas so//dge'o/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu sa rgyal ba sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /mtshan ldan rje la gus pas 'dud/ /bdag cag slob mar bcas pa la/ /da lta byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mtha' gshugs pa'i/ /'gro drug drin can pha ma la/ /byas pa shes bzhin drin bzo ba'i/ /byams dang snying rje 'bad de sgoms/ /dam chos spyod pa'i mthu ldan pa/ /rnyed dka' mi lus rin chen 'di/ /ston ka'i sprin bzhin yid brtan med/ /nam 'chi cha med bsam par 'tshal/ khren tu 'bad pa'i longs spyod dang / /'bral thabs med pa'i bdog pa kun/ /dbang med du 'jog pa mthong tsa na/ /rtag 'dzin can rnams yi re mug /dam chos nyams len ma gtogs pa/ /las thabs thams cad mdo med yin/ /mtshan ldan bla ma las gzhan pa'i/ /blo gtad thams cad slu rdo yin/ /da res tshe thung 'di 'dra la/ /tshe 'di'i ched kar gtong gtong nas/ /ngan song gi sdug bsngal mi zad rgyu/ /chos min gyi bya ba byed khom mam/ /dam chos su ming btags mi chos dang / /gas don du ming ba khas kyi rang 'dod dang / /chos gzugs su byas pa'i chos med gsum/ /sems can slu ba'i brdzun khrigs —46—

yin/ /blo snying nas chos su song ba 'tshal/ /byams snying rje gting nas 'byongs pa 'tshal/ /dbyings spros med la mnyam par 'jog pa 'tshal/ /don de tsam thugs la 'jog pa zhu// //zhes pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas tshogs bye rdzings kyi gtan gcig pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan la gdams pa'o// maṅgal//༈ chos rje rin po che spa lung pa la'o/ / ༈ gang snang mnyam nyid ngo bo'i rtsal/ /nam mkha' bzhin du phyogs lhung med/ /gang byung de la bcos mi 'tshal/ /lhun grub de la cham gyi bzhag /btsir thag med pa'i rang gi sems/ /gu yangs po 'di rgya re che/ /btson du bcug pa'i mi 'ga' zhig /'bad rtsol dka' spyad chen po yi/ /btson las thar par gyur pa na/ /rtsol ba med par ngang gi bde/ /dang po 'bad rtsol dgos dus su/ /ji ltar 'bad kyang skyon dang 'dre/ /'bad rtsol med par shes tsa na/ /skyon rnams thams cad yon tan yin/ /zhes pa'ang sngar goms nyams len la/ /gsal 'debs tsam du smras pa yin// //ma ṅga la// dge'o//༈ las stod kyi gnas skor ba 'dra la gdams pa'o/ /༈ oṃ khyu sti/ ngo mtshar can gyi bla ma la/ /gdung ba drag pos gsol ba 'debs/ khyed rgyal khams bskor ba'i rnal 'byor kun/ /don 'di bzhin thugs la bzhag pa zhu/ /da res chos dang mjal ba dang / /dgos su bla ma mchog la bsten/ /lar skal pa bzang ste a la la/ /dus yun ring dge ba —47—

bsags gyur na/ /gnad mchog gyur bla ma'i byin rlabs rnyed/ /bskyed rdzogs dang bzlas brjod la sogs pa/ /rlabs chen gyi dge ba phyogs bcur spel/ /dge ba la 'dzin zhen mi 'tshal bar/ /lhug pa'i ngang nas dge rtsa bsogs/ /dmigs med kyi tshul du smon lam thob/ /zhing gnas chen rnams su 'gro ba na/ /tho co dang 'khrug long mi 'tshal zhing / /nyams len gyi rten 'brel sgrig pa zhu/ /gang snang lha sku'i nyams len mdzod/ /dag snang phyogs med du 'char ba'i rten 'brel yod/ /sngags kyi bzlas brjod kyang ci nus 'tshal/ /ngag bden tshig 'grub pa'i rten 'brel yod/ /gang dgos kyi 'dun pa dung nge ba/ /phaṭa ces rang sar bzhag las zhog/ snang ba dbang du 'du ba'i rten 'brel yod/ /rang 'dod med pa'i smon lam thob//'gro don phyogs med du 'char ba'i rten 'brel yod/ /gang snang rang sems kyi ngo bo la dran pa skyongs/ /rtogs pa mngon 'gyur gyi rten 'brel yod/ /nyon mongs gang skyes la ngo shes 'tshal/ /nyon mongs can chos la 'dzad pa'i rten 'brel yod/ /rtsa rlung thig le'i rnal 'byor sgom/ /ma mkha' 'gros byin rlob kyi rten 'brel yod/ /gang sdod du mchod gtor la brtson pa zhu/ /bar chad bzlog pa'i rten 'brel yod/ /mos gus kyi gsol 'debs yang yang bya/ /chos brgyud 'phel ba'i rten 'brel yod/ /don de dag mtshon byed tsam yin pas/ /rten 'brel sgrig lugs shes te 'tshal/ /phyi nang gi rten 'brel sgrig shes na/ /dgos 'dod dngos grub char ltar 'bab// //ces pa'ang tā ra nā thas nye bar gdams pa'o/ /dge legs 'phel/ /—48—

༄༅rti/ /zhal gdams dpe rgyan gsal ba bzhugs/o snya sti/ bdag lta so ldan dregs pa'i dgra/ /rgyal ba ri dwags dbang po gang / /dpag yas yon tan 'byor pa yis/ khengs pas sesgo'i sgra bsgrags bzhin/ /gnyis med gsung ba'i bstan pa la/ /gus pas blo ldan phyag 'tshal te/ /gdams pa'i sgron me rab sbar bas/ /snyan tshig ri mo'ang gsal bar bya/ /'byor pa bcu dang ldan pa'i lus/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bur dkon/ /mi zad gter chen dam pa ltar/ /phun tshogs thams cad 'di las thob ces pa 'di ni chos kyi dpe/ /lus 'di chu yi sbu ba 'dra/ /dbugs kyang ston ka'i na bun bzhin/ /mtho ris 'byor pa'i dpal 'di yang / /rmi lam ltad mo ji bzhi no/ /zhes pa 'di ni dngos po'i dpe/ /sa mar zad pa'i sgron me 'di/ /'chi bdag gnas su chas pa yi/ /skyes bu'i srog ltar rkyen gzhan la/ /ltos pa med par 'jig pa nyid/ /ces pa 'di ni bzlog pa'i dpe/ /lang tsho dar ba'i lus 'di ni/ /mdzes kyang mi brtan 'ja' tshon bzhin/ /'ja' tshon 'di yang lus bzhin du/ /'dus byas rnams kyi ngang tshul ston/ /zhes pa 'di ni phan tshun dpe/ /'dod yon ri mo rab bkra bar/ /sems 'di rnam par g.yo ba ni/ /bung ba dug gi me tog la/ /rgyug par mtshungs kyi gzhan dang min/ /zhes pa 'di ni nges pa'i dpe/ /rtswa ltar g.yo ba'i sems pa gang / /glog ltar bzung du med pa ste/ 'bab chu la sogs rab g.yo ba/ /gzhan yang yod na 'di dang mtshungs/ /zhes pa 'di ni nges med dpe/ /ngan 'gro'i tshor ba mi bzad pa/ /rno ba kho nas sbu —49—

gri dang / /mtshungs pa ma yin 'gro sems la/ /'jigs pa skyed byed kyis kyang ngo / /zhes pa 'di ni bsdus pa'i dpe/ /dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba po/ /kun gyis sdug bsngal drag por shes/ /mtho ris 'byor pa sdug bsngal du/ /'phags pas mkhyen pa 'di gnyis khyad/ /ces pa 'di ni khyad par dpe//mtho ris sgeg mo'i bzhin gyi dpal/ /yod ces pad dkar snyems mi 'tshal rab 'bar sha lpa li nags kyi/ /sring mo la yang de yod phyir/ /zhes pa 'di ni rab btags dpe/ /tshangs gnas bsam gtan bde ba 'di/ /rtag brtan g.yung drung dpal 'dzin na/ /zag med bde bas mngon mtho ba'i/ /thar pa'i gnas dang mtshungs pa nyid/ /ces pa 'di ni rmad byung dpe/ /yid ni rab tu chags bral bas/ /lang tsho rgyas pa'i gzugs sdug dang / /dur khrod bor ba'i rus gong ni/khyad par 'byed la rmongs par gyur/ /zhes pa 'di ni rmongs pa'i dpe/ /ci 'di shing lo'i rtser chags pa'i/ /chu thigs rab tu g.yo ba'am/ /rab tu sred pa'i dbang gyur pa'i/ /mi lus yin zhes the tshom skyed/ /ces pa 'di ni the tshom dpe/ /'jo sgeg tshul gyis 'gro ba dang / /sred ldan mgu ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ /ngan skyugs phung bo ma yin gyi/ /ri dwags mig can yin par shes//zhes pa 'di ni rtogs pa'i dpe/ /rtag tu rab 'bar sems gdungs shing / /snyen ra bar spyod pa rnams kyi gnas/ /nyon mongs 'phel ba'i khyim 'di ni/ /lo ma ral gri'i tshal dang mtshungs/ /zhes pa 'di ni sbyar ba'i dpe/ /nga rgyal spangs pa'i dge sgrub dang / /spyin la dga' ba'i mkhas rnams ni/ /gter gyi bdag po ji bzhin du/ /su waṇi yi dpal gyis phyug /ces pa 'di ni mnyam nyid dpe/ /rab tu dben —50—

pa'i bsam gtan 'di/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i bka' khrims dang / /dge chos spel bar mtshungs mod kyi/ /rnam g.yeng yid dang bral bas 'phags/ /zhes pa 'di ni smad pa'i dpe/ /ma lā ya yi nags klung gi /ser bu 'di yis bde bskyed pa/ /bsod nams yongs su smin gyur pas/ /chos thos pa yang de dang mtshungs/ / zhes pa 'di ni bstod pa'i dpe/ /bde ba'am sdug bsngal 'di bskyed ces/ /so sor nges par brjod mi byed/ /'dod pa lnga yi longs spyod 'di/ /sbu gri'i so 'dra zhes rtog go /zhes pa 'di ni rtog pa'i dpe/ /dri med lhag bsam dag pa dang / /tshul khrims yon tan bzhi ldan 'di/ /dam pa'i lam du mtshungs mod kyi/ /phan tshun 'gran pa'i 'gal zla nyid/ /ces pa 'di ni 'gal ba'i dpe/ /rang bzhin spros bral ye shes gang //yon tan ldan yang 'bad rtsol can/ /'khru / la pas bslad pa'i bsod nams tshogs/ /tshe gang 'bad pas ga la 'gran/ /zhes pa 'di ni dgag pa'i dpe/ /lhun po nor bu'i 'od kyis mdzes/ /tshangs spyod dul ba'i dpal gyis phyug /gzi brjid ldan par mtshungs mod kyang / /ri bo de ltar lhag pa min/ /zhes 'di mdzes pa'am ngo bstod dpe/ /blo gros rnam par 'phel byed 'di/ /dbyangs can ma yin thos pa nyid/ /lus la sim pa bskyed 'di yang / /reg min shin tu sbyangs pa nyid/ /ces 'di de nyid brjod pa'i dpe/ /gzugs mdzes sogs dang bsam gtan las/ /skyes pa'i bde ba de kun gyis/ /zhi ba'i bde la skrun tu med/ /de phyir mya ngan 'das nyid dpe/ /zhes 'di thun mong min pa'i dpe/ /srid zhi'i legs lam ma lus pa/ /byed pos gcig tu bsdus 'dra ba'i/ /dge ba'i bzhas —51—

gnyen mchog de dag /blo ldan kun gyis brten par byed/ /ces pa 'di ni 'gyung min dpe/ /rtsod pa'i dus 'dir mang thos 'ga'/ /ngur smrig 'dzin yang g.yo sgyu dang / /gdug sems rtag tu 'chang ba 'di/ /bdud rtsi'i 'od las tsha gdung bzhin/ /zhes pa 'di ni srid min dpe/ /bdud rtsi'i bum pa de bzhin du/ /grub pa'i bcud len nor bu dang / /dpag bsam shing ltar dge ba ni/ /bsten pa tsam gyis 'bras rab ster/ /zhes pa 'di ni mang po'i dpe/ /dge bas 'tsho ba'i longs spyod 'di/ /yongs 'du'i tshal tu rnam rol pa'i/ /mtho ris dbang po'i 'byor pa la/ /yang yang longs spyod byed pa bzhin/ /zhes pa 'di ni rnam 'gyur dpe/ /nyin byed 'od kyis mtshan mo dang / /sman gyi dbang pos tsha gdung dang / /dbang pos da nu'i bu bzhin du/ /chos kyis sdig pa 'joms par byed/ /ces pa 'di ni phreng ba'i dpe/ /chos dang 'khor ba de nas gzhan/ /skye bo sdig pa myang 'das rnams/ /bdud rtsi'i 'khor lo spre'u dang / /dug dang dga' tshal dag tu ma sdongs/ /zhes 'di dag don gsal byed kyi/ /dpe rgyan gsal byed sgra gcig pa'o/ /rgya mtsho bzhin du srid pa dang / /'dzin khri bzhin du nyon mongs te/ /gru bo che bzhin chos kyi lam/ /ded dpon mkhas ltar ston pa'o//zhes 'di gsal byed du ma can/ /chu klung bye ba phrag brgya yang / /chu yi gter du gzhol zhing 'bab/ /theg pa sna tshogs tha dad don/ /kun kyang chos kyi dbyings su gzhol/ /zhes 'di zla bo'i dngos po'i dpe/ /byang chub sems las sangs rgyas dang / /sgo nga'i sbubs las byed po skrun/ /rgyal ba yang dag lam ston zhing / /gzhan gyis lta ba'i thibs por khrid/ /ces pa 'di ni mtshungs sbyor —52—

dpe/ /'dren pa bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs/ /rnam mi rtog la sems can don/ /lhun grub spyod phyir yid bzhin gyi/ /nor bu rin chen mchog dang mtshungs/ /zhes pa 'di ni rgyu yi dpe/ /de ltar dpe rgyan so gnyis so/ /dpe rgyan gyi ni skyon rnam gsum/ /pho mo ma ning rtags 'dres dang / /dpe don mchog dman ches pa dang / /mang nyung tshig tshogs 'khrugs pa'o/ /de dag rnams la rim pa bzhin/ /mes po dran pa drang srong gtso/ /bud med g.yo skyu 'dzin ma bzhin/ /gcam bu'i tshig gi rjes 'jug ste/ /lcags phye gser ldan ma bzhin no/ / bde sogs bdag po'i khang bzang yang / /me tog bkram pa'i phyugs lhas bzhin/ /mgo bregs dal bus gom pa 'god/ /'di dag bde gshegs ji bzhin no/ /grogs med rgyu ba'i rnam shes 'di/ /tshong pa rnams kyi ded dpon mtshungs/ /'du byed rnams ni bse ru ltar/ /gcig tu sdug bsngal gcig pu bskyed/ /de dag skyon med dmigs gsal dpe/ /chos bzhin spyod na bud med kyang / /skyes bu snying stobs mchog ldan ltar/ /nges par byang chub bgrod pa nyid/ /'di la dpyad pa yongs med do/ /g.yul las rgyal ba'i dpa' bo ltar/ /mkhas pa dge sbyong mchog tu bde/ /rims nad shin tu byang ba ltar/ /spangs pa slar yang bzlog pa med/ /ji tsam srid par gyur pa'i tshogs/ /me yi rang bzhin tsha ba ltar/ /sdug bsngal kho nar zad pa ste/ /blo ldan thar phyir 'bad par byos/ /de ltar rjes gdams cung zad tsam/ /dpe rgyan tshul gyis brjod pa ste/ /ngo mtshar bskyed pa'i tshig dang don/ /'ga' yang bdag gis brjod ma nus/ /'on kyang chos kyi tshul bzhin te/ /mi bdag khyod kyis brtag —53—

pa'i 'os/ /zhes pa tā ra nā thas smras pa ste/ nor gyi sde dang 'dod pa'i sde snying pos dben par shes nas/ chos kyi sde dang thar pa'i sde kho na'i dbang du byas te snyan tshig cung zad spel ba ngam rings su'o// // bkra shis/༄༅/ /lcam kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo la gdams pa'o/ /nged bla ma dam pa'i thugs rje yis/ /phyi bde sdug chags sdang mtho dman kun/nang chos kyi dbyings su ro mnyam tsam/ /yid ngal gso'i blo gto 'cha' ba las/ /lar g.ya' gong gangs khrod kyi dben gnas su/ /lus sems gnyis rdul du brlags brlags par/ /sems nyams len gyi 'dun pa yod mod kyi/ /sngar phan chad g.yeng ba'i bdud kyis khyer/ /sngon bsags pa'i las kyi rang gzugs las/ /tshe phyi ma blos btang gi 'go dpon bab/ /'phral chags sdang zur mgo su bas rags/ /las sdig dang 'dres pa'i 'chol bar shor/ /da sngar byas kyi las la khag mi gtong / /mi dad ldan kun g.yang la mi 'bor ba/ /tshe sgrub pa snyoms pa'i nyams len zhig /dus myur du 'grub par smon pa lags/ /rang kha ba tha/da lag len 'dzol pa yi/ /mi gzhan la zhal ta ji ltar 'jug /khyed lhag bsam shin tu dag pas na/ /gtam nang ma'i tshul du gleng ba ni/ /gnas pha yul spangs pa'i ri khrod dang / /zas dkor dang ma 'dres longs spyod dang / /chos sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i nyams len gsum/ /lar shin tu dkon te da res 'dzom/ /spang dka' ba'i 'jig rten khyim so dang / /brgal dka' ba'i nor rdzas yul phyogs dang / /bcad dka' ba'i dgra gnyen 'brel ba —54—

gsum/ /dbyings thar pa'i lam 'gegs kyi chu bo lags/ /de rang sar grol pa dkon mchog dang / /pha bla ma'i thugs rje ma lags sam/ /da bsams na gtan gyi bde ba'i phul/ /'go tshugs pa 'dun ma'i yang rtse yin/ /sngon 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /nyin de ring yan chad nor bsags sam/ /dgra btul/ zhing gnyen skyong la 'bad kyang / /rang ngal ba tsam zhig ma gtogs pa/ /las byas pa thams cad mdo don stor/ /mi dgra gnyen mi rtag tshong 'dus mgron/ /don gnas skabs kyi 'brel ba yad yud la/ /las chags sdang gi 'khor lo skor bas ci/ /gnas yid 'ong bsam gtan khang bu mā /lus g.yo med dal ba'i bde skyid dang / /yid sems khral med pa'i ngal gso 'di/ khong brgya byin la yang yod re kan/ /yongs 'jig rten 'gro ba'i snang tshul 'di/ /mar ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal dang / /gnas mtho ris 'byor rgud 'gyur lugs la/ /dus cung zad bde ba'i go skabs med/ khong dbang chen du btags pa'i nga rgyal can/ /nyin mtshan med las kyis brel ba la/ /sems bde skabs med cing gzhan gyis 'phya/ /de 'dun ma legs snyam 'khrul tshabs la/ /sems stong nyid snying rje'i gnad spyor dang / /rkyen mos gus gsol 'debs kyi nan to dang / /'phral dge sbyor 'phel ba'i don can 'di/ /thugs yengs med lam du sgrub pa zhu// //bkra shis//༄༅/ /oṃ rdza sti/ bla ma mchog dang dus gsum rgyal ba yi/ /zhabs pad dam pa spyi bos bsad byas te/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho las brtsams —55—

nas/ /zab mo'i bka' mchid cung zad bgyid la spro/ /de la ston pa de bzhin gshegs pas/ /dam pa'i chos kyi sgo mtha' yas pa zhig bka' stsal pa ni/gzhan gyi tshig sna bstung ba dang / /pha rol zil gyis gnon pa dang / bdag nyid sgrog pa dang / rang gi phyogs yongs su spel ba'i phyir gsungs pa ma yin te/ /dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po'i rang bzhin las/ 'gro ba thams cad la mnyam par brtse bas/ de rnams rang gis brnyes pa'i byang chub dam pa de la dgod pa'i phyir gsungs pa yin no/ /de'i phyir chos byed par 'dod pa rnams kyang rang dang gzhan bla na med pa'i byang chub sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba'i thabs kho na la gtso bor dmigs pa zhig nges par dgos pa yin no/de yang dang por chos sgrub cing nyams su blang ba'i gzhi gang la dmigs te bsgom par bya ba ni/ gnas lugs kyi de kho na nyid yin la/ de yang 'di ltar nges dgos te/ sems ma rig pa'i 'khrul pas yongs su bskyed de/ rmi lam bzhin du snang ba'i kun rdzob khams gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos 'di dag thams cad/ dngos po'i gnas tshul la gdod nas yod ma myong zhing / 'khrul pa'i sems kyi snang ba la ni/ rang rang gi rgyu rkyen tshogs pa las 'bras bu bslu ba med par 'byung ste/ kun rdzob gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus pa'i chos rnams 'khrul snang tsam ma gtogs/ gdod ma nas yod ma myong ba yin la/ de ltar med kyang / ji srid 'khrul pa'i snang ba ma dag gi bar du/ 'khrul ngo nyid du rgyu 'bras phra zhing phra ba rnams kyang ma 'khrugs par 'byung ba 'di ni/ dang po nyid du yang dag pa'i lta ba bskyed pa'i dmigs pa yin te/ rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa la —56—

nges shes skyes nas/ spangs blang ji lta ba bzhin du spyad pas/ 'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba la gnas/ ngan song gi sgo khegs/ mtho ris kyi sgo phyed par 'gyur zhing / snang ba 'di dag 'khrul pa tsam ma gtogs/ gdod ma nas yod ma myong par rtogs pas/ dngos por 'dzin pa dang / mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dbyings su dag ste/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes yang dag par skye bar 'gyur zhing / nyon mongs pa'i sa bon rnams kyang spong bar byed do/ /de ltar na/kun rdzob gzung 'dzin gyi chos thams cad gdod ma nas ma grub kyang / don dam yang dag pa'i dbyings chos nyid rang rig rang gsal spros pa dang bral ba'i ye shes 'di ni/ yang dag pa'i stong pa nyid dang / shes bya thams cad kyi gnas lugs dang / rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba dang / bde gshegs snying po zhes bya ba yin te/ 'di ni chos thams cad kyi chos nyid du gdod ma nas grub cing /'phags pa rnams kyi ye shes kyi nyams su myong bya yin pa'i phyir/ bden pa yin la/ 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir rtag cing brtan pa dang / gnas lugs phyin ci ma log pa yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhi nyid dang / ma nor ba de bawo nyid do/ /de ltar gnas lugs da ni/ bden grub dang / rtag brtan g.yung drung yin kyang/spros pa thams cad dang bral ba yin zhing / tshig gis brjod du med/ blos bzung du med pa yin pas/ mnyam bzhag gi tshe/ 'di bden pa yin no rtag pa yin no zhes blos brtags nas ni mi sgom ste/ mnyam bzhag rnam par mi rtog pa gang du yang 'dzin pa med pa/ bzo bcos med pa'i tshul gyis 'jog dgos pas so/ /gzhi shes bya'i gnas lugs de ltar chos nyid yongs grub de bzhin —57—

gshegs pa'i snying po sems can thams cad la gnas shing / de nyid sems kyis rang bzhin yin la/ de kho na dngos po'i gnas tshul la zhugs shing yod pa yin/ de las gzhan 'khor ba pa la ji ltar snang zhing / grags pa 'di dag thams cad dang / lam gyi chos thams cad dngos po'i gnas tshul la ma grub pa glo bur ba yin no/ /gzhi de ltar yin pa'i gnad kyis/ lam nyams su len pa'i tshe/ re zhig 'khrul ngo dang bstun te/ khams gsum 'khor ba thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can mi rtag cing mi brtan la 'jig pa/ nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa'i yul bdag ces bya ba grub pa med pa/ chos 'di rnams la byed pos stong pa/ rgyu rkyen sna tshogs pa 'phrad pa las 'byung bar shes nas/ de nyid kyi don yang yang bsgoms pas/ 'khor ba'i bde ba thams cad snying po med pas/'khor ba las nges par 'byung 'dod kyi bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa skye bar 'gyur zhing / de'i rjes su de ltar mi rtag cing sdug bsngal la snying po med pa'i 'khor ba las bdag nyid gcig pur ma zad sems can thams cad kyang 'don dgos pa'i bsam pa khyad par can bskyed nas/ byams snying rje dang 'brel bar de nyid yang yang bsgoms pas/ bsam pa byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa rgyud la skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar sems can sdug bsngal myong ba la snying rje dang / bde ba la 'god 'dod kyi byams pa dang / /de lta bu'i sems can gyi don de yang bdag nyid gcig pus khur du blangs nas sgrub 'dod kyi snying stobs dang / gzhan don 'ba' zhig gi snying khongs su bcug nas/ sangs rgyas sgrub 'dod kyi byang chub kyi sems te/ de dag stobs dang ldan par gyur pa na/ theg —58—

chen gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i chos rgyud la skyes pa'i/ lam 'go zin pa yin no/ /de nas de lta bu'i gang du sdug bsngal myong ba'i sa phyogs 'jig rten gyi khams dang / su zhig sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can rnams dang / rgyu gang gis sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ba'i las dang nyon mongs rnams dang / ji ltar sdug bsngal myong ba'i tshul skye rga na 'chi dang / 'gro drug so so'i sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin de thams cad/ so so'i sems rgyud la ma rig pa'i bag chags yod pas/'khrul ba'i snang bar shar ba ma gtogs/ dngos po'i gnas tshul la grub pa med pas/ rmi lam gyi snang ba bzhin du shes pa na/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal de yang bden med sgyu ma lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ rang nyid de la mi skrag cing / gnas lugs la sdug bsngal med kyang / yod par 'khrul nas sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can rnams la lhag par yang snying rje skye bar 'gyur zhing / sems can dang sdug bsngal rang bzhin med par mthong bas de dag dngos por 'dzin pa dang yang bral ba/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can zhes bya ba rim gyis rgyud la skyes par gyur na/ mdo sngags gang gis lam la zhugs kyang rung / theg pa chen po'i lam gyi snying po rgyud la skyes pa yin no/ khyad par du/ spros pa dang bral ba'i dbyings la rnam par mi rtog pa nyid du bzhag pa dang / rnam par rtog pa'i tshogs mtha' dag rang bzhin gyis stong par mthong zhing / sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba ni nam du yang 'gyur ba med par mthong ba de'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po la yid ches dam pa rnyed par 'gyur te/ de las sems can thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po can du shes shing / de phyir —59—

sems can la mi brnyas pa dang / sems can bdag dang mtshungs pa'i byams pa dang / sems can gyi rang bzhin dang / sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin gcig par shes pas gus pa khyad par can dang / 'gro kun bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god thub pa shes pa'i snying stobs dang / sems can rnams nyid sangs rgyas rang la yod kyang de ltar ma shes pa la snying rje chen po yang lhag par 'jug cing /bdag gzhan 'khor 'das bde sdug sogs chos thams cad kyi snang tshul rnams la mngon par zhen pa bzlog rang bzhin ma nyam pa nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog nus pa na/ mdo dang sngags kyi lam gang la zhugs pa yin kyang rung ste/ theg pa chen po'i lam khyad par can zab mo ches phul du phyin pa la reg pa yin no/ /phyi ma 'di ni/ mdo rnams las/ phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo'i gtam la dga' ba/ zhes gsungs pa dang / don dam rnam par nges pa'i lam la zhugs pa dang / theg pa thams cad la yang dag par zhugs pa dang / 'khor lo tha ma'i ched du bya ba'i gdul byar gyur pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' dbang po rnon po zhes bya ba'i gnas thob pa yin no/ /de dag ni lam gyi gzhi yin pas mdo sngags gnyis char la dgos shing / sngags kyi theg pa la brten nas/ chos nyid kyi gnas lugs myur du rtogs par 'dod na ni/ yang dag pa'i dbang gis rgyu smin par byas shing / dbang po rtul po dang / rgyud sbyang dgos pa yin na/ bskyed pa'i rim pa yan lag bcas pa la yang legs par slob dgos shing / dbang po rnon po la ni/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa kho nas kyang don 'grub pa yod la/ gnyis kas kyang shin tu rnal 'byor phyag rgya chen po nyid don gyi gtso bo'i tshul du 'bad —60—

pas sgrub dgos so/ /de ni rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa sogs te/ bla ma dam pa'i man ngag dang / sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gsung las rtogs dgos mod/ don gyi snying po ni/ rnam par rtog pa thams cad yongs su spangs te/ g.yo ba med pa'i rnal 'byor gyis lus la gnad du bsnun pa na/sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal te rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po'i tshul du mthong ba na/ las rlung nyis khri chig stong drug brgya dbyings su thim pa'i thabs la 'bad pas/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po mngon du 'gyur te/ de ltar rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid dang / mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po zung du 'jug pa de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dngos yin zhing / de yang rang bzhin gdod ma nas sems can gyi sems rgyud la gnas pa yin kyang mngon du ni ma gyur pa yin la/ thabs rnam par mi rtog pa'i sgo nas lus la gnad du bsnun pa dang / las rlung dgag pa'i sbyor bas/ de dag sa 'og gi gter bton pa bzhin du mngon du 'gyur ba yin no/ /da ltar las dang po pa la yang / sems kyi gsal cha ma 'gags pa stong gzugs kyi snang ba rab 'jums su 'char ba ni/ sems nyid rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid 'khor 'das kyi khams gsum gyi gzugs brnyan can du gnas pa'i rtags yang dag pa yin pas/ de ltar nges shes bskyed pa dang / gang gzugs brnyan snang ba'i sems de ni spros pa dang bral zhing ngos bzung du med pa dang / sdug bsngal gyi snang ba nub cing nyams bde bar gnas pa de ni sems kyi rang bzhin mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen por gan snga pa'i rtags yang dag pa yin pas/ de ltar —61—

nges shes bskyed dgos pa yin no/ /don dam par sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rang sems kho na la lhun rdzogs su gnas pa yin zhing / de la sgrib g.yogs su yod pa'i glo bur gyi dri ma sbyang ba'i thabs la nan tan du 'bad pas/ myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la rang gis dbang bsgyur bar nus pa de 'gyung ba yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ shin tu rnyed dka'i mi lus rin chen rnyed/ /blang dor gnas kun gsal bar ston pa yi/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho dang 'phrad nas/ /don med stong log byed par cang bzod dam/ lo zla'i grangs kyis rim pas phri ba na/ /yun ring bskal pa'i dus kyang myur du 'dzad/ /rtsod dus mi yi tshe la smos ci dgos/ /phyi shol le lo'i dbang du ma gtong zhig khren tu gces pa'i lus kyang myur du 'bor/ /yul 'khor longs spyod la sogs smos ci dgos//bstod dbyangs gtam snyan brag cha'i dbyangs dang mtshungs/ /snying po med pa de la su zhig chags/ /dge sdig las ni sems kyi rjes su 'brang /'jig rten pha rol gar skye rang dbang med/ /'gro drug g.yang sar las kyis 'khrid pa'i tshe/ /chos las gzhan pa'i bya byed kun gyis bslu/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho chen bo bzhin/ /gting mtha' mi mngon rgal bar shin tu dka'/ /gcig rjes gcig zin chu yi rba rlabs bzhin/ /sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor 'di la zad pa med/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal zhes bya'i dngos gzhan zhig /bden grub rang dbang can du med lags te/ /sems nyid 'khrul pa'i gsal snang shar ba na/ /dngos su yod pa bzhin du sdug bsngal myong / /dper na mi zhig gnyid log rmi lam na/ /g.yang sar lhungs shing lus la bsnad pa —62—

rmi/ /g.yang sa med cing lhungs pa'i lus med kyang / /dngos su lhungs pa bzhin du sdug bsngal myong / bdag gzhan phyi nang snod bcud thams cad du/ /nga bdag ces bya nam yang grub pa med/ de phyir rang don sems pa 'khrul pa yin//mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad rang sems zhakhru/la/ /'khru / la pa'i rgya mtsho skems par bya ba'i phyir/ /rang sems brtson 'grus chen po brtsams gyur na/ /'khrul pa sangs nas gdod ma'i gnas lugs la/ /rtag tu bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur/ /ma dag snang ba gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i chos/ /yod par 'dzin rnams rtag par lta ba yin/ /don dam dbyings kyi ye shes snying po ste/ /med par 'dod na chad lta'i tha shal yin/ /gang zag la sogs 'dus byas dngos po rnams/ /mi 'jig rtag go snyam na rtag lta yin/ /rgyu 'bras rten 'brel 'gag med nam yang 'char/ /dge sdig las la skur 'debs chad lta yin//kun rdzob bden pa'ang rtag chad mtha' bral zhing / /don dam rtags tshul la yang mtha' gnyis spangs/ /de ltar shes na lta ba rnam dag yin/ /gzhan du rbad kham che yang dgos don stor/ /don dam rang rig bde gshegs snying po ni/ /rnam pa kun ldan rang bzhin 'gyur ba med/ /kun rdzob 'khor 'das chos kun yod ma myong / /rnam dag lta ba'i snying po de tsam lags/ /rtag tu lus ngag yid kyis sdig pa spangs/ /dge ba'i sems dang dge ba'i bya ba dang / /dge ba'i tshig dang gzhan la phan sems bskyed/ /theg pa spyi la dgos pa'i spyod pa yin/ /rig gnas kun dang dam chos kun la mkhas/ /yon tan kun thob ting 'dzin thams cad sgrub/ /nyes skyon kun spong theg pa kun la 'jug /thabs kun la brten —63—

sems can kun don byed/ /dge ba'i chos la mi sgrub gang yang med/ /bya ba thams cad sems can don du bsngo/ /gzhan gyi dge ba kun la dga' ba bsgom/ / 'di ni theg chen kun gyi spyod pa yin/ /spyod pa bzang yang bzang 'dzin med pa dang / /blang dor gnas la zhib tig che bzhin du/ /spyod pa thams cad sgyu ma lta bur shes/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyi tshul khrims rnam dag yin/ /snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dang / /grags tshad gsung dang sems nyid thugs rdo rje/ /lhag par mos shing mtshan 'dzin dang bral ba/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun 'dus ngo bor bsgom/ /gsang sngags lha la mi phyed dad pa yis/ /dam tshig srog las gcer par 'dzin pa dang / /sngags kyi spyod pa mchog la yid gus pa//'di ni rdo rje theg pa'i spyod pa yin/ /rang spyod phra mo nas brtsams spang blang dang //chen po rnams kyi thabs la mkhas pa yi/ /rmad byung spyod la'ang dad cing blor shong la/ /gang shar de la ro snyoms chen med mkhan/ /de ltar byas na log pa'i lam mi 'gro/ /rang 'dod 'khri ba gtan nas ma zhugs par/ /snying rje'i sems kyis gzhan phan kho na sgrub/ /'gro ba rang bzhin med kyang snying rje'i ngang //yang dag spyod pa thams cad 'di la 'dus/ /rtse gcig sgrub pa nyams su len pa la/ /tshe 'di don chung mi rtag yad yud tsam/ khams gsum sdug bsngal me'i 'obs dang 'dra/ /'di la nges 'byung shugs drag snying nas bskyed/ /sdug bsngal can gyi 'gro la snying rje dang / /byang chub sgrub pa'i lhag bsam khur chen bskyed/ /gnas lugs spros bral don dam stong pa nyid/ /legs par go nas mos pa mchog bskyed de/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong rim pas rtse gcig —64—

sgoms//rnam rtog rlung gis ma g.yos zhi gnas dang / /sems nyid gsal stong rig pa'i lhag mthong ste/ /zhi lhag zung 'jug rnal 'byor bsgoms gyur na//nyon mongs g.yul las myur du rgyal bar 'gyur/ /sngags bzlas dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom pa sogs/ /sna tshogs thabs kyang gzhan gyi don du sgrub/ /zab mo'i gnad la bla ma'i lung bzhin du/ /ye shes chen po'i rnal 'byor 'bad pas bsgom/ /rnam rtog thams cad sprin bzhin glo bur ba/ /sems nyid spros bral mkha' bzhin 'gyur ba med/ /dbyings rig tsam la g.yo ba med par bsgom//nyams len sgom pa'i snying po der 'dus so/ /lta sgom spyod pa ma nor nyams blangs na/ /'bras bu mchog la som nyi ga la yod/ /rgyu tshogs ma lus tshang zhing 'dzom pa la/ /'bras bu 'byung ba sus kyang bzlog tu med/ /rgyal bas sa lam rim pa mang gsungs na/ /sa lam rim pa 'gog pa gad mo'i gnas//de phyir rim pas lam rnams bgrod byas nas/ /mthar thug byang chub gnas su phyin par 'gyur/ /chos sku spros dang bral ba'i ye shes kyang / /snang med mun nag lta bu ma yin te/ /dus gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa'i/ /ji lta ji snyed gnas tshul gsal bar mkhyen/ /ye shes chen po'i rang snang 'gag med las/ /gzhan sems dag pa'i blo'i me long du/ /gzugs sku'i snang brnyan dpag med 'char ba yin/ /de las lhun grub 'bad rtsol med pa sa /dus gsum gdul bya 'gro ba mtha' dag la/ /gang la gang 'dul 'phrin las 'jug par 'gyur/ /de ltar mchog tu gdams pa zab mo 'di/ /dam pa khyed kyi thugs su byon gyur nas/ /dpag yas skal ldan gdul bya'i tshogs rnams la/ /dam —65—

chos bdud rtsi'i dga' ston 'gyed par shog/ // ces pa 'di yang mdo khams smad kyi rgyal khams nas dpal jo nang pa'i bstan 'dzin chen po/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i ring lugs pa/ bla ma ka bzhi pa kun dga' lhun grub zhes bya ba'i gsung gis bskul nas/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //༄༅/ /rgyal khams pa tā ra nā tha'i gtam/ ri khrod pa nam mkha'i seng ge la 'phrin du bskur ba/ sgrub pa 'phel bar yod 'dug pa yid spro/ nged kyang chos 'phel bar yod/ skabs kyi don/ gnas lugs dang rjes su 'brel ba'i gtam cung zad bshad na/ gnas lugs don gyi sangs rgyas phyi rol nas btsal ma dgos par/ rang la gdod ma nas yod pa der gda'/ rang du ma zad sems can thams cad la yod/ sems can du ma zad snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad 'di'i rang bzhin du 'dug /bla ma'i byin rlabs dang / gdams ngag gi gnad la brten nas rang zhal lta shes na/ ye nas chos sku yod pa des yod go bcad par gda'/ de bzhin ma yin pa la yod kyang ma phan/ de rtogs pa'i thabs ni/ dang por nang 'dzin pa'i sems rang dag tu byas pas/ 'dzin byed kho rang rang grol du thongs pa zhig dgos/ de byung na phyis gzung ba rang sar dag pa yin/ de yang rang ngo shes tsam la dran 'dzin gyi bcos bslad kyang med na/ /gzhan gyi lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ /rig tsam wal le khyug ge ba ni nam du yang 'gag rgyu mi 'dug /tshig gis 'di lta bu'o zhes rang myong dang mthun pa ni ji ltar byas kyang brjod mi shes/ 'gyu byed rnam rtog gi blos 'di 'dra zhig go zhes —66—

ji ltar byas kyang des thub rgyu med/ 'di yin 'di min/ yul phyogs dang phyogs kyi cha gang gis kyang ma bsdus/ rig pa dang shes pa'i ngo bor yod snyam na'ang /rang rig skad cig ma'i ngo bo ni/ shes pa 'di lta bu myong / rig pa 'di lta bur 'dug ces bya ba'i myong bya myong byed dang / rig bya rig byed gang yang yod ma myong ba 'di ka tha mal shes pa'i rang bzhin dang / chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs su gda' 'o/ /gsung rab kyi chos skad na mar/ sgra dang rtog pa'i yul las 'das pa zhes bya ba dang / brjod bral dang / spros bral dang / so sor rang gis rig pa'i ye shes dang / stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa sogs chos skad bzang bzang mo dang / ming snyan snyan mo dpag tu med pa zhig byung ba yin/ rang bzhin ngos bzung med pa de'i 'char sgo la/ dad pa dang snying rje sogs dge ba'i rnam rtog skyes sam 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs nyon mongs dug lnga shar ram/ sa rdo ri brag gi rnam rtog sogs lung ma bstan gyi 'char sgo yin yang rung ste/ gang skyes de ka skyes tsam nas ngos zin dgos/ ngos zin pa zer ba de yang skad cig dang por rnam rtog skyes pa la/ skad cig gnyis par rnam rtog skyes song snyam pa'i rjes bsnyegs te min/ dus mnyam yang rung / rnam rtog yin par 'dug snyam pa'i blos byas kyis kyang mi chog /rjes bsnyegs dang / blos byas kyi blo kho ras kho rang yang rang ngo ma shes na/ gzhan la kha rog 'dug zer nas/ rang skad chen po 'don pa dang 'dra ba zhig yong / ngo shes byed mkhan kho rang gis rang ngo ma shes pa la/ shes pa gzhan zhig gis ngo shes byed par rlom pa blos byas 'khrul ba'i mgo skor du gda' 'o/ /'o na rang ngo ngos zin pa rang ci la zer na/ 'char —67—

sgos rang shar tsam dus na/ skad cig ma gcig po de nyid la/ kho ras kho rang la bzo bcos med par rang so zin pa'i ming yin te/ 'gyu ba kho ras 'gyu ba kho rang shes tsa na bya lam rjes med/ 'gyu ba rang sangs/ nyon mongs rang grol yin/ 'di la yang / nyon mongs pa dang / rnam rtog dang / yul rkyen sogs shugs drag mi drag gi khyad par gyis/ rtog pa'i 'char sgo gsal gsal 'dra la ngos gzung med pa'i yul yul po chu la gzugs brnyan shar ba 'dra ba zhig dang /dbyings de la mdangs gcig gis khyab pa tsam 'dra ba ma gtogs/ 'char sgo rang yang 'di yin ngos gzung du med pa zhig ste/ 'char tshul mi 'dra ba de ltar yod yang ngo bo la khyad med/ blo dang bstun pa'i 'char tshul mi 'dra ba la grangs med cing zad pa'ang med la/ brjod kyis mi lang / de tsam na 'char sgo thams cad kyang gdod ma'i rtsal ba 'gags par shar ba tsam las gzhan med pas/rnam rtog rang mtshan pa btsal bas ma rnyed pa lags/ 'di byung tsa na don tshan rim pa gnyis pa phyi gzung ba'i yul dag pas/ snang ba rang sar grol ba zhes bya ba de zhor la 'ong ba yin te/ /sa rdo ri brag skye shing nags tshal/ dgra gnyen/'khor longs spyod/ 'grogs shes la sogs pa/ phyi nang ji ltar snang ba thams cad snang tsam de la yul gyi 'dzin pas ma bslad par snang tsam shar tsam de ka rang rig rang gsal/ shar ba'i dus/ gsal ba'i dus/ snang ba'i dus nyid na ka 'di yin 'di min ngos gzung bral ba/ de kho na snang ba rang sar grol ba zhes bya ste/ rmi lam gyi yul snang ngam me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bur shes pas dngos por 'dzin pa rang sangs pa yin no/ /de lhar phyi nang gnyis rang sar dag —68—

pa de ka gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi don yin/ ma 'gags pa'i shes pa dang sang nge ba/ gsal le hrig ge ba/ 'bol le shig ge ba/ rtsol med kyi rang rig pa yid ches la smra ru mi btub pa zhig 'dug pa 'di ka gdod ma'i chos nyid zer ba'i sgra bo che de yin mod/ sgom chen pa thams cad chos nyid ma bu 'phrod skad/ma 'phrod skad/ kha bsngags mang po zer te/ dngos gnas la gzung 'dzin dbyings su grol ba'i rang zhal lta ba gal che'o/ /yang da lta'i snang ba zang thal le ba 'di ka chos sku yin/ so so'i rgyud la rjen che re ba ma 'gags pa'i rig pa 'di ka ye shes yin zer te/ tshom 'jog la gtam 'ang lud re bshad/ tham thom la bzang brdzu'i rgyab skyor mkhan de kun la snying po med/ chos skad bzang la mdor te med pa zhig yong nyen yod/ dngos gnas la de ltar yin kyang / yin pas mi phan pa zhig kyang yong / 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i 'og gzhi chu 'ba' zhig la brten pa yin kyang / mya ngam gyi thang la skoms te shi ba'i mi mang po dang 'dra/ gong du bshad pa ltar gnas lugs la rdo rus thug pa zhig byung na/ 'khor 'das rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid yin pas/ snang bzang thal le ba 'di las logs su mya ngan las 'das pa btsal du med pa cis kyang yin mod/ 'char sgo ji tsam 'char ba 'di/ skye na'ang rang bzhin dbyings de las skye/ 'gag na'ang de'i ngang de kar 'gag /ma 'gag par gnas na'ang de ka'i rang bzhin las ma 'das par gda' na'ang / de 'dra zhig yin par 'dug snyam pa'i go bas nyams myong ma bslad rig thog tu rig pas gnad la 'byor pa gal che/ gnas lugs lta ba'i phyogs la 'di kas thag chod par 'ong / thabs spyod pa'i phyogs la/—69—

spyir tshogs bsog gi rim pa rnams rnam g.yeng gi rgyu mi 'gyur ba'i ngos nas/rang gi mos pa dang bstun pas khyab/ bla ma la mos gus dang / sems can la snying rje rgyun mi 'chad pa zhig med thabs med/ de yang gnas lugs kyi lta ba dang / thabs de nyid res 'jog tu ma song bar/ rang bzhin ngos gzung med pa'i rtsal mos gus dang snying rje 'char zhing / mos gus dang snying rje'i mdangs drag po de yang rang dus nas spros bral du rang ngo shes pa zhig dgos shing / dge sbyor ci byed sems can gyi don du bsngo bas rgyas thebs pa'ang gal che/ rten bdud rtsi ril bu dang / byin rlabs ril bu thum la rgya ldan/ stag lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bzang po la dge/ //bkra shis//༄༅/ /na mo gu sa lag len gnad la 'byor pa yi/ /zhal gdams gnad kyi tshig gsum la/ /dgos dus phan par nges pa yi/ /chos kyi gnad kun 'dus sam snyam/ /'phral gang shar sgyu ma lta bu la/ /gdangs snang cha mos gus su shar ba dang gcig /ma 'gro drug la snying rje'i gdung shugs te/ /don cen chags phyogs 'dzin spangs pa dang gnyis/ /sems rig pa'i rgyal po mtha' bral 'di/ /lar bzo med yengs med du skyong ba dang gsum/ /gnad gsum po gcig tu bsdus pa 'di/ /dus nam dgos su phan pa'i chos zhig lags/ /de yang bde ba dang sdug bsngal/ dga' ba dang mi dga' ba/ chags pa dang sdang ba'i rnam pa sogs/ mtho dman re dogs gang byung yang / med bzhin snang ba sgyu ma lta bur a 'thas bzhig pa'i/ dgag sgrub blang dor bral ba'i ngang de las/—70—

rig pa gsal stong 'dzin med kyi gdangs/ bla ma la mos gus dung re ba shar ba 'di kho nas kyang / bar do la sogs pa'i 'khrul pa chig chod du 'gro ba lags/yang gnas lugs nam mkha' lta bu dang / snang cha sgyu ma lta bur ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams snying re rje/ zhes nye ring phyogs cha dang bral ba'i snying rje lhang nge ba te/ kho rang gi rang zhal la bltas pas/ 'dzin med zhen med kyi ngang der cham mer 'dug pa/ 'di kho na sgoms pas kyang / sdug bsngal yul 'bud pa zhig lags/ sems gnas sam 'gyu yang / kho rang gi rang dus de na gang shar de la bzo bcos med par shig ge de kha'i ngang ngam rang shar de la yengs med du bzhag pas/ gang shar thams cad dbyings de khar 'dug pa 'di sgoms na nyon mongs thams cad kyi rang mtshang rdib pa lags/ gnad gsum po de re res kyang chog na/ gsum ka gcig tu dril bas lta mos kyang ci dgos/ bzo med kyi shes pa bskyangs pas/ de ltar ma rtogs pa la snying rje lhang nge/ snying rje de sgyu ma lta bur shar pas/ de ltar ston pa'i bla ma la mos gus dung nge ba de'o/ /gnad gsum byas kyang gnad gcig yin/ /'chi bar snang ba 'khrul snang yin/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba rmi lam yin/ /bar do byas kyang rnam rtog yin/ skye ba blangs kyang sgyu ma yin/ re dogs byung na phaṭa kyi thob/ /legs legs mdzes khrigs shig las thong / /rang shar de la cham gyis skyur/ /ma bcos ngang la 'jog dgos te/ /ji ltar byas kyang bcos mar song / /ma bcos pa gcig ngas ma rnyed/ /bcos ma kho ra'i rang bzhin ni/ /ma bcos pa der mi 'dug gam/ khres na de khas chog pa la/ /thag chod yod dus mi 'dug go /de bas byar med —71—

ngang la zhog /sems la 'phrod na gdams ngag yin/ kha chol tsam la ci bya yod/ / gang shar de khas go chod na/ /man ngag gi rgyal po de na 'dug// //ces pa tshogs pa'i mkhan chen shākya ri dbang gi thugs dam gsal 'debs su/ tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// bkra shis/༄༅/ /oṃ khyu sti/ sku bzhi'i bdag nyid kyi bla ma la/ /mi phyed dad pas gsol ba 'debs/ /gnad skul gyi gdams pa tshig gsum 'di/ /slob ma'i sems la 'phrod par shog /mi lus lan gcig thob pa 'di/ /sos dal du sdod pa cang khom mam/ rnam g.yeng la mi tshe ma skyel bar/ /rang gis rang sems 'chun pa zhig 'tshal/ /brtson 'grus kyi lcag gis ma 'khul na/ /mi gzhan gyi bskul 'debs re thag chad/ /yul mi dang dgra gnyen kun la ltos/ /dge sbyor gyi bskul 'debs gzhan mi 'tshal/ /chos gdams pa zab mo mjal dus su/ /nyams len gyi khye spogs la 'bad 'bungs mdzod/ /zong phan tshun du sgyur ba'i khye phogs te/ /sgom chen pa'i rkang chung gto nas 'dren/ /'dod yon gyi 'khri ba ma chod na/ /brgya brgya btang nas stong stong 'gugs/ /g.yo zol gyi rnam rtog la mi tshe skyel/ /bya btang gi ming btags ngo re tsha/ /tshe nges med nam 'chi cha med yin/ /sgom sgrub la ham rgyugs mi byed par/ /grags 'dod dang lo 'dod kyi kha la rgyug /chos brgyad kyi rlung pos 'byer nyen gda'/ /rang rgyud la phan pa'i dge sbyor te/ /mi gzhan gyis ma go yang a'u rtsi/ /'khor che dang ngo so ma 'dod ang / /nyams phran tshegs skyes pa rnams yal nyen gdog /nyams —72—

rtogs kyi nyi ma shar na yang / /nye ring dang bar ma'i mi kun gyis/ /ma go na gting nas 'tshengs pa yin/ /sgom nyams len gnad du mi 'gro ri/ /dgra gnyen sogs su la phan btags kyang / rgyud snying rjes brlan pa ma gtogs pa/ /ngo so skad cig kyang mi 'phyar na/ /byang chub kyi sa bon ma thebs ri lar bar chad kun mngon tshan can la 'jug/ gsangs te spyod pa 'di gal re che/ /rgyal khams kyi mi la phan btags kyang / khong yus kyis khyer na g.yin phan min/ /mi tshe sgrub pa la bskyal srid kyang / /rlo me sems kyis khyer na g.yang la lhung / /nyams myong dang yon tan shar skabs su/ /mi gzhan la ngoms na 'phral du 'grib/ /'gro don dang grags pa byung dus su/ /bdud kyis bar chad kun 'jug nyen che/ /bdud gzhan na yod pa ma yin no/ /chos spyod la g.yel ba de rang bdud/ /'grogs bzhes sogs gal che su yin kyang / /'jig rten gyi bya ba kho rang tshos shes/ /rang tshe 'di blos btang du khas blangs nas/ /'brel can gyi 'dun byus mi 'tshal lo/ /longs spyod dang snyen ra tshogs rnam g.yeng gi rgyu/ /de tshe 'gugs g.yang 'gugs mi dgos so//rang dbang ba'i yo byad 'ching ba'i gzhi/ /de ser snas shi sbar ma 'tham zhig/ 'phral zad med kyi long gtam dge sbyor gyi dgra/ /tshig mi smra ngag bcad gnad du che/ /ljongs grong kha nyul ba lang shor gyi rgyu/ /gnas lung stong du tshugs na dpa' ba yin/ /da nyams len gyi snying po gcig yin te/ /ltem 'gyang med pa'i mos gus bsgom/ /nyams len gyi rnam grangs gsum yin te/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal las 'bras soms/ /nyams len gyi rkang rtsa gnyis yin te/ /ma bcos so ma dang snying rje che/ /'chi ba mi rtag —73—

pas bskul ma btang/ /sdug bsngal du bsams na zhen chags spong / /las 'bras la bsams na spyod pa gtsang / /snying rje dang spros bral sgom gyi mthil/ /de kun gyi rtsa ba mos gus yin/ /ru nga dang 'gran sems dbyings su dag /dran 'khrul gyi gyab skor mi 'dug na/ /dge sbyor tsho gnad du song ba yin/ /lar chos zhig byed na chos bzhin gyis/ /mi tshe 'byid thabs kyi chos spyod de/ /thos bsam dang sgom sgrub ci yin rung / /gzhan mgo skor las lhag pa yod re kan/ / chos shes rgya tsam gyis mi phan te/ /rang rgyud tha mal par krongs se lus/ /nyams len gyi gnad dang mi ldan pa/ /blun sgom tsam gyis kyang mdo don stor/ /yid nges 'byung snying nas ma skyes pa'i//sgom chen de ri la lud bsog yin/ /las 'bras la mi rtsi ba'i bag med la/ /grub thob tu re ba dmyal ba'i rgyu/ /byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems med pa'i/ /stong skad kyi rbad kham chad lta rang / /nang rlung sems ye shes su ma thim pa'i/ /rtsa rlung gi rno khyad mu stegs pa'i chos/ /gsang sngags kyi dam tshig khrom la 'khyams//kun spang gyi rnal 'byor gdol bar song / /yang lta spyod bzang po'i 'dzin stangs can/ /gzhan khyad gsod kyi sdig pa bsog nyen gdog /nyin mtshan sgrub pa la rtsol na yang / /gol sa 'di rnams la bzab par zhu/ /chos kho na la blo sna 'jur te bsgrim/ /rgyud 'jam la ltag tshugs bzang ba dang / /tha mal du ma lus yengs med du 'tshal/ /dgos 'dod kyi 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur// //zhes pa'ang bya btang kun dga' dpal ldan la tā ra nā thas gdams pa'o// bkra shis//—74—

༄༅/ /o snya sti/ na mo gu sa skyabs gsum kun 'dus kyi bla ma la/ /thugs yid dbyer med kyi mchod pa 'bul/ /mnyam nyid kyi ngang du gsol ba 'debs/ /mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs/ /rang sems la shar ba'i tshig bcad 'ga'/ /go rim dang mdzes khrigs ma mchis kyang / /dad ldan gyi slob mas bskul ba'i ngor/ /thol byung du shar ba 'di ltar lags/ /chos mdo rgyud thang mar brdal ba nas/ /tshogs bsags thabs ji snyed cig gsung lags kyang / /pha bla ma bsten tshul du kun kyang 'dus/ /thabs mkhas kyi rgyal po mos gus yin/ /ltem 'gyang med pa zhig gal re che/ /gzhan zer gyi bstod smad phra ma mkhan/ /mdzad spyod 'di bzang ngan ci yin snyam/ /sems 'khu 'khrigs za na nyem 'gyang yin/ /gdung shugs dang thag chod gal re che/ /blo rtse gnyis med na thag chod yin/ /skyi sdug dang mtho dman la ma rag cing / /re dogs bral ba'i mos gus 'tshal/ /dus rgyun du gsol ba 'debs pa gces/ /sgom byed dam 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug byed/ /dus rtag tu bla ma brjed pa med/ /gdung shugs kyi tshad ni de la mdzod/ /gnas lugs kyi nyams myong bzang mi bzang //mos gus bzang ngan gyi rjes su 'gro/ /mos gus mtha' med du 'phel 'dug na/ /nyams rtogs mi skye ba'i rang dbang med/ /chos brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs gyur kyang / /don sems nyid gtan la 'bebs pa yin/ /sems gsal rig ma 'gags ngos gzung bral/ /de so mar bskyangs na rang so zin/ /dus rtag tu dran pa'i thag pas bzung / /rang rang nyid kyis rig na rang grol yin/ /sems bzung bas mi phan lhug par thong / /'gro 'ong gi rnam dbye —75—

dbyings su stor/ /dus re 'ga' bsgrim kyin gcun la zhog /spros bral kyi dbyings su phyin pa yin/ /yang re 'ga' klod la bskyur kyin zhog /gnyug ma'i rang so zin pa yin/ /lar gnas lugs byar med kyi rnal 'byor la/ /bsgrim dgos dang klod dgos mi 'dug mod/ /bsgrim klod kyi snang ba ci shar yang / /gnas lugs kyi dbyings su khyer na bde/ /mthong thos kyi yul la dgag rgyu med/ /snang tshad kun gsal stong zung 'jug yin/ /'gyu byed rnam rtog gi ri mo 'di/ /rang ngo shes na rig stong du gda'/ /me long la snod bcud kyi gzugs brnyan shar/ /shar tsam nyid nas ngos gzung dang bral/ /dpe de bzhin rig pa'i 'chad sgo kun/ /sems spros bral kho ra'i rang gzugs yin/ /chos sku nyag gcig gi klong yangs la/ /blang dor gyi spros pa dgos re kan/ /spang blang gi snang cha ci shar yang / /rang grol du 'dug na spang blang bral/ /nga 'gro 'am 'dug gam gang byed kyang / /gnyid log gam sad skabs yin yang rung / /sems gnas sam 'gyu ba ci shar yang / /rang dus nas rang tsho thub pa zhig 'tshal/ /sems rang tsho thub na ngos gzung bral/ /gnyis med kyi rig pa 'di rtsal ma 'gags/ /'khor 'das kyi snang ba la mi 'char med/ khar grol gyi rnal 'byor blo re bde/ /yengs med rnal 'byor brjid re chags/ /las med kyi rnal 'byor zhe re gtsang / /rgyu yan gyi rnal 'byor gu re yangs/ /gang shar la lam khyer rtsal re che/ khyed nyams len gyi snying po de la mdzod/ /gnas lugs nam mkha' ltar spros bral mod/ /spyod pa las 'bras kyi blang dor zab/ /stong nyid kyi rang mdangs snying rjer shar/ /chos lta spyod 'dzom pa sangs rgyas kyi lam//spyod pa la —76—

mtshan mar ma zhen zhing / /stong rkyang la kha lta mi 'thag par/ /rang rgyud la gnad du 'gro ba gces/ /spyi 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin dang / /'dus byas la rtag pa'i go skabs med/ /sgos 'chi ba nam yong cha med pas/ /gzhan cis kyang mi phan chos la 'bungs/ /ngan song gi sdug bsngal myong dus na/ /pha ma dang nye dus 'khyobs pa med/ /sngar byas kyi sdig pa bshags pa dang / /phyin chad mi byed pa gal re che/ /zas nor dang longs spyod kha drag kun/ /tshe brjes pa phan chad gar song med/ /las dkar po dag la 'bad gyur na/ /phyogs gang du skyes kyang bde ba yin/ /da mos gus la thabs kyi gtso bor mdzod/ /sems nyid la lta ba nyams len mthil/ /mi rtag skyo shas dran bskul gyi lcag /las 'bras kyi khi tig spyod pa'i phul/ /don 'di bzhi chos kyi snying po lags/ /mi khyed kyi thugs la 'phrod par smon/ /dgung mkha' la nyi ma shar ba bzhin/ /don gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa 'char bar shog/ //ces pa'ang tā ra nā thas dpon blo gros nam mkha' la gdams pa'o//༄༅/ /o snya sti/ bla ma dam pa rtogs pa dang thugs rje can rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba bla ma'i mos gus yin te/dngos grub yong du re nas mos gus byas na rang 'dod phugs su bcug pa yin/bla ma skyabs gnas kun 'dus su shes pa gal che ste/ bla ma rang gis ma chog par yar la bteg nas sangs rgyas su skyel na mos gus kyi gnad 'chugamadzad pa gang shar de ka chos sku'i rnam rol sems can gang la gang 'dul du shes dgos te/ mdzad pa nyes pa zhig yod pa la rang res bzang por bsgyur —77—

nas lta dgos na snang ba ma dag pa yin/ mos gus kyi gdung shugs tshugs pa med pa 'dra ba zhig med kha med yin na'ang / zhen med kyi mos gus rang shar rang grol du ma song na bzang rtog phal pa yin/ des na re dogs dang bral ba'i mos gus dang gsol 'debs dgos pa lags so/ /bla ma dam pa gcig la gsol ba btab pas thams cad kyi byin rlabs 'jug pa gcig dgos/ de yang gcig la thams cad stim pa la sogs pa'i dmigs pa byed pa'i srol ltar byas kyang chog ma byas kyang rung ste/ ngo bo bla ma thams cad kyang thugs nam mkha' ltar ngos gzung med pa'i gsal stong du ro gcig /de'i mdangs snying rjer shar bar yang gcig /de'i mthu las 'phrin las sems can gyi don mdzad par yang gcig /rang gi ngos nas kyang / dang po klog slob pa'i slob dpon nas gzung ba'i bla ma kun gyis dge ba la bskul bar yang gcig /thabs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs dang / ston lugs dang 'khrid lugs mi 'dra ba byung yang / dus tshod gnas skabs dang / gang la gang 'dul tsam yin/ ngo bo sgrib gnyis spyod du bcug /tshogs gnyis rdzogs su bcug nas/ mthar thug sangs rgyas su 'khrid par yang gcig /rang gsol ba 'debs/ mos gus sgom pa'i skabs yin la wal wal 'char ba'i bla ma de rnams rang sems kyi 'char sgo yin pas sems gcig gi rang ngor yang ro gcig pa lags so/ /de ltar shes nas gsol ba 'di ltar 'debs so/ /oṃ snang stong dbyer med sku yi rdo rje ni/ /srid zhi'i snang ba kun la khyab par bzhugs/ /ā grags stong dbyer med gsung gi rdo rje ni/ /brjod rtsol bral yang ming tshig kun tu 'char/ /hu bde stong dbyer med thugs —78—

kyi rdo rje ni/ /'bad rtsol med kyang shes bya thams cad mkhyen/ /hoXrnam pa kun ldan ye shes rdo rje ni/ /'gyur ba med kyang 'khor 'das kun tu snang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi khyab bdag rdo rje bzhi/ /kun 'dus bla ma khyed la skyabs su mchi/ /dam chos kun 'dus khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /dge 'dun kun 'dus khyod kyis byin gyis rlobs/ /yi dam kun 'dus khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstan bsrung kun 'dus khyod kyi mgon skyabs mdzod/ /mgon po khyod dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing / khyod nyid dges pa'i 'phrin las sgrub par shog/ mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /gdung ba drag pos gsol 'debs na/ /bdag sogs sems can thams cad la/ /byin gyis brlob phyir 'dir byon bzhugs//sku la mtshan dpe 'od du 'bar/ /sprul pa yang sprul grangs las 'das/ /mkha' dbyings gang ba'i sangs rgyas dang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar gtibs/ /'od dang 'od zer 'ja' 'od zhabrug /nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can/ /chos kyi sgra dbyangs 'brug ltar sgrog /bde chen nyams myong 'ar ma 'ur/ /da lta byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /gto thog 'di ru byin gyi rlobs/ /thugs yid dbyer med rtogs nas kyang / /rje btsun khyed dang mnyam par shog /bdag lus nam mkha' mnyam gyur nas/ /sku yi 'phrin las sgrub par shog /ngag kyang shes bya kun khyab nas/ khyod gsung ma lus sgrub par shog /sems can kun yid ro gcig pas/ /thugs kyi 'phrin las kun 'grub shog /dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du/ khyod kyi zhabs pad bsten pa dang / khyod gsung ji bzhin 'dzin par shog /ji srid gnas lugs ma rtogs shing / /brtan pa ma thob bar du —79—

yang / /ci gsung gus pas sgrub pa dang / /mos gus ltem 'gyang med pa dang /brdeg brdung bka' bkyon ci mdzad kyang / /yid chad dad log mi skye bar/ /mos gus ches cher 'phel bar shog /khyim gyi las dang sdig spyod sogs/ /mdzad spyod ci 'dra mthong gyur kyang / /gang 'dul thabs mkhas 'phrin las su/ /rtogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ pha bla ma/ pha bla ma/ pha bla ma/pha bla ma rang mkhyen/ rje btsun bla ma mkhyen/ /thabs mkhas 'gro don mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /brjod bral chos sku khyod la gsol ba 'debs//dus gsum sangs rgyas khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /mthu stobs nus ldan khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /ye shes mkha' khyab khyod kyi thugs rjes gzigs/ /brtse ba'i rang bzhin khyod kyi thugs rjes gzigs/ /'phrin las lhun grub khyod kyi thugs rjes gzigs/ /sgyu ma'i gar mkhan khyod kyi thugs rjes gzigs/ /'khor bar 'khyams pa bdag la thugs rjes gzigs/ /nyon mongs me ltar 'bar la thugs rjes gzigs/ /las ngan chu bos khyer la thugs rjes gzigs/ /sdug bsngal 'dam du bying la thugs rjes gzigs/ chos brgyad rlud gis khyer la thugs rjes gzigs/ /tshe 'di blos ma thongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /rang rgyud shing ltar rengs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /gdengs med chod yod mkhan la thugs rjes gzigs/ /zog po mgo skor mkhan la thugs rjes gzigs/ /sgyid snyoms rnam g.yengs can la thugs rjes gzigs/ /ngo dga' mthun 'jug mkhan la thugs rjes gzigs/ /snying nas chos ma nus la thugs rjes gzigs/ /re sa gzhan na med do thugs rjes gzigs/ /skyabs —80—

gnas gzhan na med do thugs rjes gzigs/ /blo gtad gzhan na med do thugs rjes gzigs/ kha tsam tshig tsam min no thugs rjes gzigs/ /sgrub la bar chad med pa dang / /chos kun nyams su longs pa dang / zhe bcang snying rus rgyun mi 'chad/ /nyams rtog rtsol med 'char bar shog /bla ma kun gyi thugs rjes 'dzin pa dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung bzhin 'grub pa dang //dam chos kun gyi dgongs pa longs pa dang / 'phags tshogs kun gyi zhabs rjes zin par shog /sems can thams cad 'khor ba las sgrol zhing / nyon mongs thams cad dbyings su dag pa dang / /las rnams thams cad sprin bzhin dengs pa dang / /sdug bsngal thams cad bde bar thim par shog/ drin can pha ma 'gro drug sems can rnams/ /rje btsun khyed kyi go 'phang thob par shog /de srid rgyal khyod thugs rjes gzigs pa yis/ /nam yang 'bral ba med par skyong gyur cig /ces gsol ba drag tu btab nas/ mos gus gang skyes de la bzo bcos med pa'i tshul du trig ge bzhag /gzhan yang phyag 'bul/ bskor ba mchod pa sogs dge ba ci byas thams cad bsngo ba'i skabs dang / byang chub sems dpar grags pa'i bla ma rnams sam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs dang / gsung gi glegs bam sogs kyi drung du yang / sems can thams cad 'khor ba las thar pa dang / gnas lugs rtogs pa dang / mos gus tshad du phyin pa skye bar smon lam 'debs/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong la yang de ltar gsol ba thob bla ma'i mos gus tshad du phyin na mos gus gcig chog rgyal po bya ba lags so/ /da ni gdams pa gzhan yang bshad par bya ste/ sangs rgyas chos dang —81—

dge 'dun dang / /yi dam mkha' 'gro kun 'dus pa'i/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma thugs rje can/ /rgyud pa kun dngos de la 'dud/ /mchog tu gus pa'i slob ma la/ /sems yid chos su sgyur ba'i phyir/ nyams len gnad bskul gdams ngag ni/ /blo dang 'tsham pa 'di ltar lags/ /chos kun snying po lag len kun bsdus na/ /dkar nag las 'bras bslu ba med pa la/ /yid ches dad pas spang blang 'dzol med dang / /cis kyang dgos med dran pa'i nges 'byung dang / /phyogs ris zhen chags med pa'i snying rje dang / /gang shar rang sar grol ba'i lha sgom ste/ /bzhi po 'di la ma 'dus gang yang med/ /gal po che 'di blo la nges par mdzod/ /rang nyid nyams rtogs mtho dman ci 'dra yang / /dge ba'i bya ba lcogs tshad byed pa gces/ /dge sbyor bzang por yod na bogs 'don yin/ /dge sbyor ngan na bsags sbyang gal re che/ /rtogs pa mthon po nyams myong brtan po dang //phyogs re'i bstan pa'i kha so 'dzin pa'i phyir/ /sdig pa bsog cing khyim pa'i mthun 'jug ni/ /byas kyang nyes pa med par 'dod pa mang / /de dag bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yin/ /rtogs pa mthong na sdig pa byed don med/ /'khrul pa zhig na mi ngo 'dzin don med/ /bstan pa phyogs re'i zhen gyis bstan pa dkrug/chos kyi phyir du'ang chos 'gal byed mi rung / /rang dang dgra gnyen nor phyi lta ci smos/ /dge sdig bya ba che chung ci byas kyang / /de yi 'bras bu bde sdug bslu ba med/ /sems can gzhan la phan tshad dge ba yin/ /'gro la gnod tshad sdig pa kho na yin/ /tshe 'di'i phan pa tsam la snying po med/ /phyi mar phan na phan tshabs che ba yin/ /tshe 'dir phan med gnod med yin snyam la/ /phyi mar gnod pa —82—

sbongs la phan pa sgrubs/ /'di phyi kun tu phan na thams cad bya/ /'di phyi kun tu gnod na nam yang spang / /tshe 'dir gnod kyang phyi mar phan na ni/ /skabs su gang bab brtags la nges par sgrubs/ /rgyal srid spangs nas dka' spyad chos sgrubs na/ /'phral du sdug kyang phugs su 'tsheng ba bzhin/ /tshe 'dir skyid kyang phyi mar gnod pa ni/ /zas mchog dug gis sbags pa bzhin du spang / /dkon mchog mchod pa'i rdzas la longs spyod na/ /lto ba 'grangs kyang dmyal bar 'gro ba bzhin/ /rig pa rkyang 'ded byas pa kho nas chog /las 'bras cha med zer pa log lta yin/ kha skad tsam gyis lta ba mtho mtho mos/ /g.yang sar lhung ba mang gi zhe zon 'tshal/ /zhes pa ni las 'bras la yid ches pa'i dad pa'i gtam ste dang po'o// //da lta'i snang ba chags sdang skye ba'i yul/ /'di dag yad yud tsam yin rtag mi thub/ /'bral bar phangs pa'i grogs ni rmi lam 'dra/ /gces pa'i khang zhing nor yang wu ba bzhin/ /mdza' ba kun yang gtan gyi mdza' ba min/ /dgra bo kun yang gtan gyi dgra bo min/ kha nas 'khor ba'i gnas su 'khyams pa'i tshe/ /pha bos ma bos byas kyang khu stong tsam/ /ngan song 'grim dus ci yang mi phan zhing / /dge sbyor gcog pa'i gnyen gyis ci zhig bya/ /nam zhig nges par 'brel ba mnyam po la/ /da lta nyid nas zhen pa med na legs/ /zhen pa med na bral kyang sdug bsngal med/ khre sbar 'thams na mya ngan drag pos 'joms//gar skyes nges med skyid sdug rang dbang med/ /gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal kho na'i dang / /dpal 'byor can gyi skye bo 'di rnams blun/ /'das pa'i sdug bsngal —83—

mang pos skyel ma dang / /ma 'ongs sdug bsngal mang pos bsu ma dang / da lta'i sdug bsngal dbus na 'dre zhing ldog/ sdig pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal rgyun mi 'chad/ /sdug bsngal ma bzod da dung sdig la 'jug /sdug la skyid por 'khrul nas nga rgyal byed/ /mi chen blo ldan rnams kyi 'dun gros yin/ /da lta'i skye bo kun gyi spyod tshul yin/ /dbang thang che yin dmyal bar sdod yun ring / /'byor ba che yin yi dwags 'phongs pa'i rgyu/ /blo gros che bar rlom yang phyugs nyid de//bu khyod de 'dra'i phyogs la re smon spongs/ /sa chen dbang ba'i sde dpon stobs ldan dang / /srog chags phra mo grog sbur nyams chung gnyis/ /skye ba phyi ma'i gdengs la khyad par med/ /gang la'ang yid brtan thub pa ci yang med//bde ba'i go skabs ci yang ma mthong bas/ /'khor ba snying po med par shes nas ni/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan snying por mdzod/ /ces pa ni/ mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal las brtsams pa'i nges 'byung gi gtam ste gnyis pa'o// //nyams rtogs mthon por grags pa mang po yang / /snying rje med pas ngan pa'i lam du gol/ /theg chen zer yang—theg pa dman par lhung / /rang don gzhan phan gnyis ka shor ba mang / /bdag pas gzhan gces snying rje'i bsam pa can/ /thabs la mkhas pa theg pa chen po'i cho se/ /theg pa che chung lha bas khyad mi 'byed/ /byang chub sems dang snying rje spyod pa'i khyad/ /phrag dog che zhing kha rgod bsam pa ngan/ /chos rgyud bu rgyud bzang yang ga la phan/ /dka' spyad 'dug tshul bzang yang bslu rdo yin/ /bya btang dam bca' che yang tshig skam yin/khyod ni gnas lugs rtogs pa yin no zhes/ /kha 'jam zhe gdug bla ma g.yo —84—

can gyis/ /bstod ra btang bas rang rgyud ma thul pa'i/ /blun po phal cher blun dad skyed du 'jug /rmongs pa phal cher rang la bstod na dga'/ /dam pa rnams ni drang por smras na mgu/ /phyogs zhen ko long dam la bzang 'dod can//rang rgyud ma thul sgrub pa'i dgos pa stor/ /rang nyid bzang 'dod gzhan las ngan mi 'dod/ /lkog tu chos min spyod pa sna tshogs byed/ /ri khrod 'grims na grags pa che ru re/ /'du 'dzi sbangs kyin dad can 'du la re/ /bya btang byas kyin zas nor yong du re/ /pham kha blang gin phugs su rgyal 'dod cig/ gzhan la bstod na rang la byams su re/ /dag snang byas nas dbang du bsdu 'dod dang //gzhan phyogs nub cing rang phyogs dar phyir ram/ /grags pa sgrog phyir chos rdzu byed pa ni/ /sems can thams cad bslu ba'i sdig po che/ /de phyir rdzun med phyi nang med par gces/ /snyan grags 'dod pas slob ma bslu ba dang //rnyed bkur 'dod pas dad can bslu ba dang / /ma rtogs bzhin du gnas lugs rtogs so zhes/ /nga rgyal byed pa snying rje'i 'gal zla yin/ /bden pa'i ngag dang drang po'i bsam pa dang / /nga rgyal spangs nas 'gro kun gong du 'khur/ /gzhan skyon mi bsam rang gi skyon la rtog /byang chub sems dang snying rje rgyas par 'gyur/ /dgra gnyen tshe 'dir blo yis btags pa yin/ /nye ring med par phan sems snying rje sgoms/ /thams cad 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying rje bas/ /de rnams thar thabs rang res 'tshol bar bya/ /da lta'ang dngos su phan na gang phan dang / /phan sems bsam pa bzang po 'bral med dang / /gtso bor rang nyid chos la gang 'bad pa/ /de dag gzhan la phan pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes pa —85—

phyogs zhen med pa'i snying rje las brtsams pa'i gtam ste gsum pa'o// //zab mo gnas lugs myur du rtogs 'dod na/ /skyo shas snying rus 'dzom pa'i nges 'byung gis/ /dben pa'i gnas su sdod tshugs thub pa gces/ /lkog nyal le lo'i dbang du mi gtong zhing / /dran pas nam sleb nyams su len pa la/ /phyi bshol med par 'phral du sbyor ba dgos/ /nyams len thun sgom skabs su yid sun nas/ /nyal lam 'chag 'dod skyo sangs byed 'dod dam/ /bya ba gzhan zhig byed 'dod skyes pa'i tshe/ /dge sbyor yong dang mi yong sa mtshams ni/ /'di skabs yin snyam bya byed gzhan bor nas/ /sgom 'jug 'thud nas rnam g.yengs spong bar byos/ /skyo sangs yin kyang rnam g.yengs dbang song na/ /de la yengs nas don med yun ring 'da'/ /nad mang las nyams chung zhing khams dub na/ /ngal bso dgos mod de skabs sems klong nas/ /bzo bcos mi bya dran pas zin tsam dgos/ /rnam rtog gya gyu'i dbang du ma shor bar/ /na tsha la sogs gang shar de la ltos/ /thun dang thun mtshams dbyer med mtshungs par 'gyur/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal dran pa'i skyo shas dang / snying rje mkha' khyab bcos ma min pa dang / nam yang brjed med bla ma'i mos gus te/ /'di gsum med mi rung ba'i yan lag yin/ /sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi/ /dngos gzhi lta ba dang ni bskyed rdzogs sgom/ /yi rang bsngo dang dam ca' rjes kyi gnad/ /'di rnams mdo rgyud kun gyi snying po yin/ /'gyu byed phyi ma ma skyes snga ma 'gags/ /de gnyis bar na gang yang mi mno yang / /gsal rig 'gag pa med —86—

pa de ka skyong / /de la ngos gzung gang yang yod pa min/ /dga' dang mi dga' bde sdug chags sdang dang / /snying la 'bab dang zhe la 'phog pa'i gtam/ /thos sogs sems kyi 'gyu ba gang byung yang / /rang zhal bltas nas bzo bcos med par zhog /rang ngo ma shes sems rtsa sbun po te/ /de ltar brtags na nga po rjes med cig /rang rig dmigs gtad bral ba kho na yin//rnam rtog ma spangs rang sar dag ces gags/ /'dod chags zhe sdang la sogs rnam rtog gang / / nyon mongs skyes na gang shar ngos gzung la/ /sgo gsum de yi dbang du mi gtong bar/ /skyon du blta ba'ang mi bya thad sor bzhag/ thog ma nyon mongs lhang nger snang tsam na'ang / /rig tsam brjod bral rjen ne gsal ler 'char/ /de nas nyon mongs tsam gyi snang ba de/ /rang sar log ste ye shes chen po lags/ /de rjes snying rjes zin pa gal re che/ /de bzhin dge ba'i rnam rtog sogs la'ang sbyar/ /sems nyid gnas sam yang na 'gyu yang rung / /spros bral gshis kyi rgya las mi 'da' 'o/ /zhes pa gang shar rang grol gyi lta sgom las brtsams pa'i gtam ste bzhi pa'o// //'du 'dzi mang sar dge sbyor skye ba dkon/ /rang dang 'tsham pa'i dben pa bsten pa legs/ /brtan pa ma thob bar du rgyal khams kun/ /yang yang 'grims na lang shor dge sbyor 'chag /ri la ma tshugs yang yang klung la 'bab/ /bzang rdzu dgos pas yang yang ri la 'gro/ /blo sna mang zhing chos khyad rlung gis 'byer/ /de ltar mi bya blo rtse 'gyur med gces/ /smon lam bzang po'i mthu can ma gtogs pa/ /sde dpon bsten pa chos pa'i bdud du che/ khyad par bya —87—
