btang spros pa spong ba dang / /pho brang 'grim pa 'gal ba ltag sprod yin/ /ha cang dag snang ches na bcol chung yin/ /tshod rgyag skur 'debs log lta'ang mi bya ste//rang la nga rgyal gzhan la khyad gsod spang / kha spyad ngos 'dzin thal ba'ang mi 'tshal lo/ /sad ser bsrung dang grong 'dre 'dul ba dang / /mo rtsis sngags dang sman dpyad glud gtor dang / /mngon shes brdzus mas gzhan mgo ma skor zhig /sgom chen rnams la 'di rnams bar chad mang / /don med bshags 'byed mang na mi rnams sdang / /lkog lab mang na ngan pa'i gral du 'gro/ /phra ma mu skyo mang na gzhan sems dkru/ga /de bas smra ba spangs na legs pa yin/ /mi sems khrid phyir rdzun ni dmyal ba'i rgyu/ /bden par smras na mi rnams sems khong 'khrug /long gtam dge sbyor gcog pa'i phung 'dre yin/ /chags sdang smras na ngag gi sdig par 'gro/ /nyin mtshan dge sbyor kho nar brtson dgos kyang / /mi mang 'dus sar gsol 'debs skad rgyang dang / /skye bo'i mdun du lta stangs 'dug tshul sogs/ /chos brgyad dbang gis gsang sgrogs byar mi rung / /mngon tshan chung la sa chod che ba dgos/ /mi nag grong pa'i skye bo pho mo rnams/ /dad pa skye phyir rang rgyud grol mdog dang / /bya ba btang tshul snying rje che mdog dang / /nyams rtogs skyes pa'i chos skad rbad kham dang / /rtsa rlung ngom ngom byed pa de mi rung / / skye bo bslus pas chos pa'i khyu nas bud/ /gsang sgrogs rtsa lhung 'byung bas dam tshig nyams/ /rang re spyod pa ngo lkog mi bya ste/ /gsus pa 'gengs phyir dmyal bar 'gro nus sam/ /tshul 'chos g.yo sgyu spong ba shin tu gces/ /'on kyang ngo lkog med pa yin zer nas/ /rtsing chos phaṭa ral dran tshad byed pa —88—

ni/ /bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren che zhig rang yang lhung / /sgo gsum bya ba rnam dag kho na byed/ /ngan pas gos na 'phral du bshags pa 'bul/ /yo byad kun spangs ri la sdong tshugs shing / /ri pa bya btang zhes bya'i ming med par/ / gnod pa byed la lan du phan 'dogs kyang / /nga ni bsam sbyor bzang zhes mi ngom la/ /dam chos min pa byed rgyu med pa la/ /chos pa bzang snyam rlo me sems mi byed na/ /sgom chen bzang ba'i tshad du phyin pa yin/ /yul dang bzang 'dzin che zhing yon tan ngom/ /yon to gzhan kun 'dzom yang khong rul lags/ /bya byed thams cad phan sems kho nas bya/ /gnyid dang zas dang spyod lam gtor ma sogs/ /so so'i rnal 'byor rnams kyang rel med dang / gang shar dran 'dzin bla ma'i mos gus dang / /nges 'byung dad pa rnams dang 'bral med gces/ /lta sgom spyod pa cha lugs la sogs pa/ /gzhan rnams kun dang ha cang 'gal ba spang / /kun dang mthun yang rang lugs tshugs par 'tshal/ /phan sems che yang grong kha mi 'grim zhing / /ltag tshugs bzang yang ko long mi dam pa/ /'di dag cis kyang lag tu longs par mdzod/ /ces pa ni chos nyams len gnad du 'gro ba'i spyod pa las brtsams pa'i gtam ste lnga pa'o// //gzhan yang rang gi dge ba rnams byang chub tu bsngo ba ni/ bsngo bya dge rtsa yang sgyu ma lta bu/ bsngo byed rang nyid kyang sgyu ma lta bu/ bsngo ba'i ngo bo 'bras bu la 'dun zhing sems pa bsngo ba'i tshig dang bcas pa yang sgyu ma lta bu/ bsngo ba'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang kyang sgyu ma lta bu/ thams cad snang stong gnyis su med par shes pa dang / kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i yid ches kyi smon —89—

lam 'debs pa ste/ dang por bzang spyod sogs rgyal ba'i bka' rnams kyi thog drangs nas/ rjes su 'di skad ces bya'o/ /bdag gis dad pa nges 'byung snying rje dang / /byang chub sems dang gnas lugs sgom pa dang / /phyag 'tshal mchod dang bsags pa yi rang dang / /lha sgoms sngags bzlas dge rtsa gang bgyis dang /khyad par sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje lha mo dang / /skyes mchog bla ma dam pa'i sku gzugs rnams/ /zhig pa gsos shing gsar du bzhengs pa dang / /gtsug lag khang gi bya ba byas pa sogs/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba gang yod rnams/ /'gro kun dge dang sras bcas rgyal ba yi/ /rnam dkar 'phrin las rgya mtshor zhugs pa'i mthus/ /bdag sogs mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa/ /sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas pa gtan spangs nas/ /bla med byang chub myur du thob pa dang / /de srid gegs med bde ba'i rgyur gyur cig /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi bgrod gcig lam/ /stong nyid snying rje gnyis su med pa yi/ /ye shes dam pa mngon du gyur nas kyang / /lhun gyi grub pa'i gas don 'byung gyur cig /nad gdon bar go thams cad rab zhi zhing / /gegs dang gol sa kun las rang grol nas/ /chos dbyings sems nyid rang ngo rtogs nas kyang / /dag pa'i snang ba rab 'byams mchid gyur cig /bdag nyid mthong thos reg dang dran pa rnams/ /sngon du 'gro ba'i sems can bgrang las kun/ /las nyon sdug bsngal ma lus myur zhi nas//bde dge phun tshogs thams cad rgyas gyur cig /bla ma chos skur mthong ba'i mos gus dang / /gang shar ma bcos rang sar grol pa dang / sgrub la bar —90—

chad rnam g.yeng med pa dang / /lhag bsam dag pas gzhan rgyud grol gyur cig/bla ma mchog dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing / /yi dam kun gyi byin gyis brlobs pa dang / /bstan bsrung thams cad bran du khol ba dang / /'brel can thams cad don chen 'grub gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni bzo gnas legs shes shing //sgrub la mos pa de dang grogs dag gis/ /yang yang bskul nas jo nang dpal gyi rir/ /tā ra nā tha zhes byas sbyar ba yin// //zhes pa 'di ni lha bzo ba bod mkhas pa don grub rgyal mtshan dang / rang gi lhan cig spyod pa gtsang ba kun dga' dpal bzang gis bskul nas smras pa'o// bkra shis//༄༅/ /na mo gu ra we/ dri bral mkha' la nyin byed shar ba ltar/ /sgrib bral ye shes shes bya kun khyab de/ /spros bral thugs rje'i rol par rtag shar ba/ /mtshungs bral rje btsun bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ khres bya'i mtshan nyid bsam gyis mi khyab cing / /tha snyad brjod pa zad med dpag tu med/ /lam gyi ston tshul rnam pa mang na yang / /snying po gnad nas bzung na 'di ltar lags//dad pa can la sdig pa'i go skabs med/ /nges 'byung can la zhen chags le lo med/ /mos gus can la dkon mchog 'du 'bral med/ /snying rje can la rang 'dod khong sran med/ /dkar nag las 'bras mi slu nges shes bskyed//tshig bshad mkhas shing kha lta mtho ba dang / /'dug tshugs bzang yang sdig la ma 'dzems na/ /ngan song gsum gyi gting rdo thang ma yin/ kha drag dpung 'dzom longs spyod ldan pa yang / /lo zla zhug 'ga' tsam gyi pho so yin/ /pha rol 'gro —91—

tshe dbang med las kyis 'khrid/ /rlom sems can la kha nyen skabs der 'bab/ /dgra gnyen nor khang g.yog 'khor la sogs pa/ /rang dbang 'byor skabs dag la sbyar na legs/ /nges par 'bral la myur du 'ong nges pas/ /dbang med rje bral de la phan yon ci/ /lha mi'i dpal 'byor thob kyang tshim pa med/ /nyon mongs dug gsum rgyas pas las ngan bsog /mtho ris thob dus dmyal ba'i bre kha 'gengs/ /bde ba chung pus sdug bsngal chen po bsgrub/ /e ma 'khor ba'i rang bzhin de 'dra la/ /legs par bsams na su zhig chags par 'gyur/ /grogs dang nye dus phan pa'i re med kyis/ /skyabs su bzang ba bla ma dkon mchog yin/ /mos gus zhan rnams rang blo'i mun pas bsgribs/ /yid ches mos gus snyems 'khrigs bral ba bsgom/ /de las phun tshogs 'bras bu kun 'byung ste/ /chos kun rang gi bsam pa'i rang gzugs yin/ /chos kyi rtsa ba bsam pa'i 'gro ldog lags/ /sgo gsum chos la 'bad par rlom na yang / /'jig rten 'phral bde'i rang 'dod mun nag na/ /phyogs zhen chos kyi chags sdang 'byung po rol/ /rang sems gnas lugs ma rtogs nyon mongs 'khrugs/ /las ngan dbang gis 'gro drug srid par 'khyams/ /sgyu ma'i 'khrul bas sems can 'di rnams bslus/ /nga rgyal khengs pa mi bya snying rje sgoms/ /da ni snying po'i gnad la gdams par bya/ /rang sems spros bral bya ba logs na med/ /tha mal shes pa bzo bcos med par skyongs/ /gang shar rjen pa de la rang so tshugs/ /ched du bcos pa'i lta sgom bzang bzang po/ /blo yis bris pa'i ri mo zar zir yin/ /rang gi sdod lugs sgom du ma shar na/ /logs nas nyams —92—

len tshol ba dbul shing 'phongs/ /rang dus nyid du rang grol ma shes na/ /rjes 'ded skyel ma tsam te byed skad yin/ /'char sgo stong pa'i rtsal du ma rig na/ /rgyas 'debs tsam gyi thal g.yogs de yis ci/ /ma rtogs kha yan spyon pa'i rnam thar la/ /ma bcos so mar 'khrul na rtsa ba 'byug /ngos gzung med pa'i rang ngo ma mthong na/ /gnas pa bzang yang gti mug mun 'thoms yin//brjod bral sems kyi rang rtsal 'gag med de/ /phyir ltas ma shor rang gsal ngang la zhog /gang shar de kas chog na sgom gyi mchog /'on kyang don med lus na lung ma bstan/ /rang rig nam yang 'khrul tu ma 'jug cig/ 'khrul kyang chog na bde ba'i yang rtse yin/ /rtag tu bya byed bdag po med par zhog /byas kyang bya rgyu zad na spros bral yin/ /sgra phyir 'brangs pa'i rtog dpyod mi 'tshal te/ /byed blo rang sar grol na mtshan med yin/ /gzhag thabs rgyal po lhug pa rang dga' lags/ /dbyings nyid rtsol par rag na bzo med mchog /gnas sam 'gyu yang yengs med thabs kyi mchog /yengs pa'i rang mtshang rig na gnas pa'i mchog /dbyings las rang shar tsam gyi rnam rtog dang / /bya byed rtsol par shar nas rang sar thim/ /de ltar rtogs na ma bcos so ma yang rang sar sangs te bcos dang ma bcos med/ /bsgom bya sgom byed rang sar stong pa na/ /snang ba thams cad sgom du shar zhes grags/ /da ni de dag gnang du 'gro ba la'ang / /nyams len chos kyi bzo thabs legs par 'tshal/ /u tshugs 'a snang ba'i thag chod yus yus po/ /mdo med po gcig go lu sa'i g.yang la lhung / /tha mal lus la gces 'dzin spong ba dang / /snang ba kun la bden 'dzin bshig pa —93—

gces/ /bden zhen a mthas je dam gong 'phel zhig /gnas lugs rtogs par 'dod pa shin tu 'khrul/ /phyogs cha zad pa'i byams dang snying rje yis/ /ci byed gzhan gyi don du sbyar bar bya/ /'gal phyogs dgra la nyes 'dod ngan sems can/ /zhe sdang lam 'byer zer yang lud gog yin/ /'dod zhen nye ba'i sred pas mi 'ching bar/ /yid 'ong sems kyang rmi lam lta bur ltos/ /'di ni lha ste bdag la phan 'dogs pas/ khyed kyis skyobs zhes re ba dung dung dang / /'dre 'dis bdag la nges par gnod do snyam/ /gnod sems 'jigs skrag dogs pa'i 'dam du bying / /de dag sems kyi snang cha mnyam po la/ /blang dor dga' sdug rang gis rang nyid bslus/ /nad dang nyams nga chags che byung gin dogs/ /mi 'dod sdug bsngal sangs te 'gro la re/ /chos kyi 'bras bu tshe 'di'i bde skyid 'dod/ /'dod pa ma grub dkon mchog gsum la zhabang / /tshe 'di'i skyid sdug sngon gyi las las byung / /gang byung chog shes byas na zhe blo bde/ /phyin chad chos kyi phan yon bslu ba med/ /blo sna gcig tu dril la yid ches skyed/ /rang la nyams myong yon to cung zad tsam/ /skyes na nga rgyal 'gong po rjes su 'brang / /de la rang ngo shes pa'i thog rdzis dang / /nga rgyal yod don med pa'i rgyu mtshan bsam/ /sngon gyi sdig las zad par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /sdug bsngal byung na 'dod thog go bcad snyam/ /blos 'dis bcos pa ma gtogs sdug bsngal ni/ /dngos por ma grub rang la cher te ltos/ /don la sdug bsngal gzhi med rtsa bral yin/ /kun rdzob tu ni las snang gang shar 'di/ /bcas bcos mi bya re dogs med na bde/ /'on kyang drin can bla mar gsol ba thob/ / mdor na —94—

las 'bras chos la yid ches shing / /dkon mchog gsum la dad pa rgyun mi 'chad/ /gang la'ang ma chags rang ngo rang shes rtsal/ /sgo gsum longs spyod dge ba bsog rtsi zhing / /rtag tu gzhan phan bsam pa bzang po 'chang/ /lnga po de la chos kyi mdo kun 'dus/ /smon lam dag pas rtag tu mtshams sbyor zhing //re dogs spong dang skyabs gnas dam pa mchod/ /chos 'di gsum yang gnad kyi don chen yin/ /de ltar cha tsam gdams pa 'di dag kyang / /thugs su byon na gtan gyi 'dun gros yin/ /bas na blun po'i rang mtshang lags par dgongs/ /'di las ci ste dge bar gyur srid na/ /skye bo kun la thar pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /blo ldan dam pa khyed kyi thugs mtsho yang / /dam chos bdud rtsi'i chu brgyas gang bar shog/ // ces pa'ang rig sngags kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba/ sa skyong mi dbang chen po'i bkas bskul nas/ tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /dge legs 'phel //༄༅/ zab don sngags kyi lam dang 'brel ba gtso che ba'i mgur ma'i skor bzhugs/ /oṃ snyu sti/ na mo gu ra be/ rje mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rin po che/ /rigs kun gyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang / /thugs ye shes ngang du rnam rol yang / /'phral cir yang ston pa de la 'dud/ /rje rin chen sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje rin chen sku yis byin gyis rlobs/ /rje rin wo sku la skyabs su mchi/ /lus rdo rje'i sku ru byin gyis rlobs/ /rje rin chen gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje rin chen gsung —95—

gis byin gyis rlobs/ /rje rin chen gsung la skyabs su mchi/ /ngag grag stong rdo rje'i gsung du mdzod/ /rje rin chen thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje rin chen thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs/ /rje rin chen thugs la skyabs su mchi/ /thugs yid dbyer med 'dre bar byin gyis slobs/ /gnas yang dgon dpal gyi dgon pa sa /dus de ring bkra shis ya mtshan tshes/ /ma mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i tshogs mchog 'dir/ /sprang bdag gis nyams dbyangs glu ru len/ /mi bdag la yon tan ma mchis kyang / khong rtsa brgyud bla ma thugs rje can/ /byin rlabs nus mthu dpag med tshos/ /byin gyis rlabs pas skyid gcig shar/ /gang snang bde ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /de ring dga' ba'i glu gcig len/ /rje bla ma byin rlabs mi che sa /rang sems chos kyi sku dang mjal/ /nged slob bu mos gus mi che sa/sems can sangs rgyas dngos su btang / /sprang tha cung bdag sdug zhen mi che mā /rje khyod kyi bka' drin la 'khor thabs med/ /chos gdams ngag la yid ches mi skye sa /nyams dang myong ba 'phral du thon/ /don gnas lugs la nges shes mi skye sa /rang bzhin gshis la 'gyur ba med/ /bdag rgyud pa mi ngan rgyud pa bzang / /brgyud pa rdo rje 'chang la thug /ljongs 'phags pa'i yul na sgra che ba/khong grub pa'i dbang phyug nyi shu gsum/ /yongs shing rta chen po bcu drug sogs/ /byin rlabs kyi bka' babs chu bo'i rgyun/ /gcig tu 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho ste/ /dus deng sang sa gzhi'i steng 'di na/ /mtshan snyan grags srid pa gsum du khyab/ khong mkhas grub kun gyi gtsug rgyan te/ /lha 'byung po kun gyis zhabs la btud/ /rje zhi ba sbas pa ma lags sam/ /mgon de yi thugs kyi sras —96—

gcig pu/ /chos man ngag ma lus thugs su chud/ /sngon las 'phro sad pas grub chen mjal/ /don nyams su bzhes pas ye shes brnyes/ /spros med sprod pas 'gro don mdzad/ /rang rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang brnyes/ /phyogs ris med pa'i 'gro ba la/ /thugs snying rjes 'gro don rgyun chad med/ /yongs sangs rgyas zer na khyod la zer/ /mtshan burnya nā tha ma lags sam/ /nged gdams ngag mi ngan gdams ngag zab/ /gdams ngag rgyal ba'i dgongs don yin/ /lar rgyud sde bzhi yi khong snying te/ /skal ldan la la'i bsod nams las/ /gzhan nga rgyal can gyi spyod yul min/ /phyogs 'dzin can la ga la yod/ /mi kho bo'i bsod nams las 'phro la/ /sangs rgyas shong ba'i bsod nams byung / /bla ma sangs rgyas dang mjal ba'i bsod nams byung / /da lta snang ba snang stong la/ /rang bzhin med pa'i gu yangs po/ /lha sku rang snang 'gag pa med/ /gang shar dag pa'i snang ba zhig /'di nyin mtshan kun tu gnad du che/ /skyed rim thams cad spros med kyi ngang / /ming la spros bcas bya ba med/ /grags stong sngags kyi bzlas pa ste/ /'char sgo dmigs pa'i 'phrul gyi gnad/ /'phrin las lhun grub ngo mtshar che/ /gzhan mtshan bcas kyi bzlas pa ya re cha/ /rje sangs rgyas dngos kyi gdams ngag las/ /mi bdag gis rlud sems dbang du 'dus/ /'phral las rlung 'khor ba'i rgyu 'di nyid/ /dbyings mkha' dang mnyam pa'i ngang du thim/ /rlung dbu mar thim pa 'di la zer/ /rags pa ma dag 'khrul snang 'di/ /phra mo rang byung dbyings su thim/ khong skye bo gzhan la 'khrul snang 'di/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi snang ba 'di/ /sngar yang 'khrul la da yang —97—

'khrul/ /de nga la dag pa'i snang bar gda'/ /gnyis med zung 'jug snang bar gda'/ /sngon nas grol la da yang grol/ /gzhi 'gyur med dag snang lam me ba/ /gang shar rjen ne che re ba//nga rgya 'byams kyi rnal 'byor nyams re dga'/gu yangs rnal 'byor blo re bde/ khong sdug rtsir mkhan kun yi re mug /sems gnas kyang stong par lhan ne gda'/ /yid 'gyu yang stong par shar re gda'/ /phyogs su ma lhung rgyar ma chad/ /rnyi lwam 'khrul pa'i zar zir 'di/ /mi phal pa rnams la nyid 'khrul te/ /nged gdams ngag can la dngos grub gda'/ /sngags bye ba dung 'gyur bzlas brjod kyi/ /hu hu phaṭa phaṭa 'dre gdon 'dul/ /'dre rang la yod pa rtsad ma chod/ /rmi lam 'khrul pa la bden par 'dzin/ /rang sems rmi lam yul yul yong / /gnas skabs bar chad thams cad sel/ /rgyal ba'i lha skur rang shar 'di/ /rmi lam la 'dun pa gnad du che/ /gnyid 'thug po gti mug mun pa de/ khong phal pa la sgrib pa ru che ba de/ /nged gdams ngag can la 'od gsal du gda'/ /'od gsal chos sku'i ngo bor gda'/ /chos sku dngos po'i gshis su gda'/ /gshis lugs bde ba chen por gda'/ /rlud sems dbyer med nam mkha'i ngang / /lte ba'i dmar cha dbu mar 'bar/ /ha yig byang sems chad med 'bab/ /rtsol med dga' bzhi'i nyams myong 'di/ /rang byung thig le rang 'gags gcig /'di gsang sngags sgom na gnad du che/ /tshe gcig gi sangs rgyas la med thabs med/ /spyi phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor la gnad du che//dgos las rgya bsten na gnad du che/ khong gdams ngag med pa rdzas la re//nga phyi la sangs rgyas ga la re/ /gdams ngag —98—

med pa tsho snying re rje/ /rang che 'dod can la snying yang tshim/ /lam sgom pas nyon mongs phal par song / /ngan song du 'khyam dgos tshe snying re rje/ /mi bdag la thams cad bde ba'i ngang / /zhu bde dang rang bzhin dbyer med du 'dres/ /da gang ltar byas kyang lam du gda'/ /sems gnas lugs 'gyu/ra ba med pa dang / /yid bla ma'i mos gus 'gyur med dang / rten rang lus thig le 'gyur med de/ /'gyur med rnam gsum gyi rnal 'byor blo re bde// //zhes pa'ang bsam gtan sdings su tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i skabs su rdo rje'i glur blangs pa ste/rang lo nyer lngar nye ba tshes bcu bdun gyi mtshan mo'i thun dang po la ste/ maṅgal//༄༅/ /oṃ khyu sti/ rang bzhin gdod nas 'gyur med la/ /mkhyen rtogs kyi yon to phyogs bcur rgyas/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid/ /pha rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /phyos bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kun/ /dbyings ye shes chen por gcig bsdus pa/ /dpal drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen gyis/ /chos phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / /bka' gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi/ /don nges gsang snying por dril ba ni/ /sngags rgyu sde bzhi po gsungs so skad/ /mthar thug gi 'bras bu mngon byed pa/ /bla med kyi theg pa kho na lags/ /spyir rnal 'byor chen po rgya che zhing / /dgos rnal 'byor ma rgyud zab pa'i phul/ /yongs rgyal bas gsungs pa'i rgyud kun gyi/ /zab don gyi nges gsang mthar thug kun/ /gang sbas gsang med par gsal bar bstan/ /don khyad par bzhi pa'i ye shes de/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi bgrod gcig —99—

lam//de ji bzhin ma 'dres gsal bar gsungs/ /mtshan rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud rgyal po/ /'dus pa don dam zhes yongs su grags/ /sngon bskal pa dpag med sngon rol du/ /dbugs dbyung rnam gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor bstan/ /sgrol ma'i rgyud rgyal gsungs zhes bshad/ khyad par mi mjed kyi 'dren pa mchog/mtshan shākya seng ges zab pa'i don/ /chos rdo rje theg pa 'di gsungs nas/ /slar lha klu rig 'dzin kun la gtad/ /dus phyi mar sngags kyi gdul bya rnams/ /lho 'dzam bu gling du dar ba'i tshe/ /rgyu kun gyi rgyal po 'di yang phebs/ khyad par 'di nyid kyi dbang du na/ /sngon grub thob ti li chen po nas/ /mi kho'i bla ma yan chad du/ /grub thob 'ba' zhig ma gtogs pa/ /so so skye bos bar ma chod/ khyad par rtsod ldan phyi ma'i dus/ /mtha' dag 'gro ba'i 'dren pa ni/ /mashaṃ brjod par dka' ba zhi ba'i zhabs/ khong he ru ka dpal dngos su bzhugs/ /rje de nyid kyi thugs kyi gsang mdzod can/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi rdo rje 'chang / /mtshan snyan po sangs rgyas sbas pa ste/ /mi kho bo'i bsod nams dpal du byon/ /rgyud kun gyi nyams len mdor bsdu na/ /smin byed kyi dbang dang grol byed kyi lam/ /sems rang bzhin gdod ma'i sku bzhi po/ /thabs cho ga'i 'phrul gyis sgrib sbyangs te/ /mthar sku bzhi'i sa bon 'debs pa la/ /mtshan smin byed dbang bskur zhes pa yin/ /brda' rdul tshon la sogs dkyil 'khor dang / /don rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /gang shar rgyal ba rigs lnga ngo sprod pa/ /'di bum dbang gi gnad du kho bos 'khums/ /ngag tshig gi brjod pa sna tshogs 'di/ /don brjod bral dbyings su ngo sprad nas/ /gsung rdo rje'i sa bon —100—

'debs pa la/ /ming gsang ba'i dbang du btags pa lags/ /sems rang bzhin brjod bral mi 'gyur pa/ /gzhi gdod ma'i bde chen lhan cig skyes/ /de ji bzhin gsal bar ngo sprod pa/ /dbang gsum pa shes rab ye shes lags//sems brjod bral spros pa kun spangs pa/ /yod med dang blang dor kun las grol/ /gsal stong dang bde bas ma bcings pa/ /rang grol 'di bzhi pa'i ye shes lags/ /grol byed kyi nyams len rim pa gnyis/ /ming gzhan du rnal 'byor bzhi zhes grags/ /de sngags kyi spyod pas mtshams sbyar nas/ /mthar sku gsum ye shes lnga la sbyor/ /'khrul snang phung khams skye mched 'di/ /snang stong dbyer med lha yi sku/ /dag snang gi 'khor lo bsgyur pa la/ /rnal 'byor dang po zhes su btags pa yin/ /rang bzhin brjod bral lhun grub la/ /rkyen bla ma'i man ngag thabs mchog gis/ /don rtsa bral nyid du ston pa la/ /lam rjes su rnal 'byor zhes su btags/ /rtsa g.yas g.yon ro rkyang gi rgyu ba kun/ /nang a ba dh+ra tir legs bcings nas/ /rkyen las kyi phyag rgyas bde sgrub pa/ /ming shin tu rnel 'byor bya'o skad/ /dbyings mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba ltar/ /'phral snang ba ma 'gags ye shes sku/ /don thams cad stong pa 'od gsal dang / /mthar zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor la sbyar ba ni/ /yongs mthar thug rnal 'byor chen po ste/ /rkyen rtsa rlung thig le'i rten 'brel las/ /gzhi lus ngag yid gsum dag byed pa/ /'di gnas skabs rnal 'byor chen po yin/ /spyir gsang sngags 'dod yon lam byed dang / /dgos 'phral spyod chos brgyad ro snyoms pa/ /rkyen spyod pa gsum gyi rten 'brel las/ /mthar dngos grub mchog la bar —101—

med sbyar/ /lus gnas gyur gyi sprul sku dang / /ngag gnas gyur gyi longs sku dang / /rang sems gnas gyur chos kyi sku/ /dbyer med bde ba chen po'o//bka' mdo rgyud kyi gnad don ma lus pa/ /don snying por dril ba rgyud 'di yin/ /rgyud kun gyi don yang de tsam ste/ /de ltar thugs la gzhog par zhu// //bkra shis/ /༄༅/ /oṃ ya mā ri de ba maṇ+ḍal na ma stu khyuX/ bla ma gshin rje gshed po la/ /gus pas yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog med dus nas bgegs byed pa'i/ /nga bdag 'gong po rlag par mdzod/ /dus la bab po thugs brtser mdzode/ /gti mug mun pas sgribs pas na/ /sems ni 'dod chags rgya mtshor lhung / /nga rgyal rba rlabs shugs kyis g.yeng / ser sna'i mdud pas dam du bcings/ /zhe sdang drag po me ltar 'bar/ /phrag dog rlung gis phyogs kun khyer/ /dus dang gnas skabs 'di lta bur/ /gzhan ni su la ram mda' spron/ /bdag cag rang nyid brtson 'grus kyis/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa thob dus na/khyed kyi thugs rjes ci zhig 'tshal/ /las kyi shugs ni stobs ldan pa/ /rgyal bas skyob par mi 'tshal na/ /las ngan med par sdug bsngal ni/ /gang na su la'ang yod min pas/ /skyabs gnas kyis ni ci zhig bya/ /gzigs shig gzigs shig dus la bab/ /yal yol btang snyoms ma mdzad par/ /sdug bsngal sems can rnams la gzigs/ /mar gyur 'gro la gzigs su gsol/ /bskal pa'i bar du dmyal me tsha bas bsregs/ /da dung las ngan cha tsam ma zad par/ /sdug bsngal sdug bsngal rgyud mar myong ba yi/ /pha ma rnams la thugs rjes gzigs su gsol/ khyed kyi thugs rje'i 'od zer re res —102—

kyang / /sems can grangs med grol bar mdzad ces thos/ /bdag 'dzin gdon gyis rlams pa'i ma rgan rnams/ /da dung 'khor bar 'jog gam gzigs su gsol/ /lto kham tsam gyi phyir du pha ma'ang gsod/ /rang la khab tsam zug kyang mi bzod cing / /gzhan lus dum bur gtong ba'i phod kham can/ /gces 'dzin gdon gyis khyer rnams snying re rje/ /rang nor til 'bru tsam yang spyin mi phod/ /gzhan nor 'phrog la dga' ba'i blo nyes po/ /bzod bsran chung la ham pa che ba yi/ /skye bo rmongs pa 'di rnams snying re rje/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi nor rdzas 'phrog la dga'/ /'di phyi kun tu sdug bsngal kho na'i g.yos/ /'dun ma gting nas nyes kyang skyid por 'khrul/ /snyings dus skye bo rnams kyi 'khrul tshabs la/ /sku gzugs glegs bam bzhig pa'i longs spyod kyis/ /rang gzhan bsdebs nas dmyal bar 'gro ba la/ /pho grung mo grung yin snyam 'khrul tshabs la/ /snying med bdag kyang snying rje gting nas skyes/ kha tsam mdzes mdzes snyan snyan min par skyes/ /las ngan dbang gis sdug bsngal yod tshad myong / /sdug bsngal byung yang da dung sdig rang bsog /spyang por rlom pa'i glen pa snying re rje/ /de ltar nyes pa thams cad kyi/ /rtsa ba bdag 'dzin dam pas lan/ /gzhan la thes med bsam pa dang / /rang la gces 'dzin 'gong po 'di/ /da lta nyid du tshar chod cig /myur ba nyid du rlag par mdzad/ /de ring gto gyi dgra 'di thul/ /de ring gtan gyi gdon 'di thul/ /brtson 'grus bskyed la da lta thul/ /btang snyoms ma mdzad da lta choms// //zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas smras/ /bdag 'dzin dgra bgegs thul bar shog /maṅgal//—103—

༄༅/ /'brel med kyi glu bzhugs so/ /༈ 'brel med kyi glu zhes bya ba sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ chu bo rgyun mi 'chad 'bab pa/ /sems kyi chu 'di ngo mtshar che/ /bye ma'i phung po chen po ltar//reg la ma 'byar pa 'di ngo mtshar che/ /sems la 'brel ba med pa ngo mtshar che/ kha sang nga ni na'o zhes/ /rmongs pa rnams ni rtag par sgom/ /skad cig re res 'das pas na/ /sems la 'brel ba ma mthong ngo / /ri bo 'di yi bya ma rnams/ /chu 'gram 'di ru sleb po zhes/ /gzhan la gzhan du 'khrul pa yin/ /yang na thams cad 'brel med de/ /yang na thams can 'brel lo zhes/ /smyon pa tā ra nā tha smra/ /'di ni bdag gi bu dang pha/ /g.yog dang 'khor ni nga la yod/ /nga yi yul sar ma sdod zhes/ /gzhan la nga bdag byed pa 'khrul/ /'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /da lta'i bar du 'khyam pa la/ /thams cad pha yin thams cad bu/ /thams cad g.yog yin thams cad dpon/ /pha ma gsod la dpa' bor rtsi/ /nga la sems can thams cad pha/ /dgra ni ci yang yod ma yin/ /bu ru ma gyur cung zad med/ /rang gi bu ni mang po 'di/ /dgra ru bzung nas bu ngan zhig /nga yi bu zhes pang du len de 'khrul/ /da lta rang lus bor nas 'gro ba la/ /gcig la bdag gi bu zhes blun po 'khrul/ /de la chags pas 'khor bar bskyur ba 'dis/ /'di ni gtan gyi dgra bo ma yin nam/ /mi shes 'jig rten rmongs la kun kyang dgra/ /rnal 'byor de la snang ba thams cad grogs/ /'brel med rnal 'byor nga la dgra bo med/ /sems ni 'brel ba med par shes tsam na/ /snang ba 'di yang 'brel ba med par mthong / /rang lus thal —104—

bar song ba la/ /gnyen dang 'brel ba ga la yod/ /sems 'di skad cig re re las/ /gzhan ni 'brel ba ma mthong bas/ /lus sems 'brel ba ga la yod/ /nga la 'di yis bsnun no zhes/ /don med zhe sdang ma byed cig /sems kyi mgron po brel ba can/ /lus kyi mgron khang hrul po na/ /yud tsam ngal bso byed pa la/ /mkhar las byed pa las ro yin/ /mgron khang gi ni phyi 'khyams la/ /nga yi skyed mos tshal yin zhes/ /smyon pa rnams ni 'o dod 'bod/ /de rang mgron po spyo ba yin/ /gzhan 'ga' bdag la khro na yang / /nga la ci yang gnod pa med/ /nga la 'brel ba med pas na/ /bu yis rgyal srid thob pa la'ang / /dga' thag chad pa ga la yod/ /bdag nyid dmyal bar song na yang / /sdug thag chad pa nga la med/ /sdug dang 'brel rgyu mi 'dug pas/ /dmyal ba na yang bde ba can//bde dang 'brel rgyu mi 'dug pas/ /brgya byin la yang smon rgyu med/ /yul 'khor me yis tshig na yang / /nga la ci yang 'tshig rgyu med/ /'dod chags la sogs nyon mongs brgya/ /rang grol nyid du shes tsa na/ /dug rnams kho na bdud rtsir song / /sngon nas ye shes yin pa la/ /rang gis nyon mongs bcos 'di mtshar/ /sems las 'khor ba kun byung yang / /'khor ba sems la 'brel ba med/ /sangs rgyas sems kyi cho 'phrul yin/ /sangs rgyas la yang 'brel ba med/ /'brel med mnyam po yin pa la/ /ngas ni spangs blang ma shes so/ /bla ma dam pa'i bka' drin las/ /'brel med sems kyi tshul lugs shes/ /e ma ho 'di ni ngo mtshar che/ /nyes na 'di la mtshar kyi med/ /da ni zhen med glu gcig blang / /nye du rnams dang phrad na —105—

yang / /'dod pa'i gdung ba skyed par zad/ /mi mdza' rnams dang phrad na ni/ /zhe sdang me yis rang rgyud sreg /sngon ni khyim ni 'byor pa las/ /da lta shinartsatu rgud do zhes/ /rang gi rang sems sdug la 'dogs/ /yang na 'byor par gyur pa na/ /sa steng na ni dpa' bo nga / /ba min gzhan med bdag lhag zhes/ /yid kyi nga rgyal byed pa ni/ /nga rgyal byed kyin dmyal bar song / /rang nyid 'byor pa kun ldan yang / /da dung tshim pa med pas sdug /nor gyis dregs pa'i nga rgyal can/ /gcig kyang gtong ba mi phod par/ /'chi tshe mi 'dod bzhin du 'bul/ /dbang med 'khyams dgos byung gi dogs/ /nor rnams gzhan gyis phrogs kyi dogs/ /'ga' zhig rngan par sbyin snyam dang / /'khor g.yog skyong ngam bu smad gso/ /dpon gyi ngo 'dzin bya dgos sogs/ /nor ldan thams cad sdug bsngal yin/ /sred dang ldan na bde ba med//yid du sdug pa'i gnyen dang grogs/ /cis kyang ma phan shi ba'i tshe/ /mya ngan skyed pa ma gtogs pa/ /phan pa cung zad ma byung ngo / /da lta dbang phyug phun tshogs kyang / /gnyen gyis slus kyi dogs pa dang / /dgra bos bcom gyis dogs pa dang / /gzhan la ngan spyod ma song dogs/ /sems kyi sdug bsngal kho na yin/ /mthon po rnams la sems skyid med/ /dman pa'i lus ni sha thang bcad/ /rang la 'byor pa phun tshogs kyang / /gzhan la sbyin pa'i blo med par/ /dbul po 'ga' yi 'bul ba la/ /phul gang tsam zhig chung na yang / /rang rgyud 'khrug pa'i rgyud ngan po/ /skyid snyam mig dpangs mtho na yang / /tshe 'dir skyid pa'i skabs med par/ /sdig pa 'ba' zhig bsgrubs nas ni/ /dmyal bar pha yul byed pa 'di/ /'dir sdug phyi —106—

mar sdug par gda'/ /mthun rkyen cung zad med kyang rung / /zhen med skyid pa nang nas mtshar/ /'byor pa'i dus na kun kyang gnyen/ /rgud pa'i dus na kun kyang dgra/ /dgra gnyen phyogs zhen ma che bar/ /zas gos dman mas chog shes byas/ /grong dang 'du 'dzi mi brten par/ /rang gi pha yul spangs nas kyang / /gcig pu ri'am nags 'dabs su//mi smra g.yo med gnas pa'am/ /yang na nges med yul rgyus la/ /grong khyer yul 'khor so ma sa /yang yang sprad pa bde ba yin/ /dman pa'i gos kyis chog shes na/ /gos rus kun yang lha yi gos/ /dman pa'i zas kyis chog shes na/ /ngan ngan 'dra yang bdud rtsi yin/ /phul phyed ri ba'i nor med kyang / /nor ldan kun pas rang sems skyid/ /skyo na thang 'khyags ri sul sogs/ /zhen med dben pa'i bde ba 'di/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang la'ang / /smon sems skad cig mi skye'o/ /nang nas nyams len shes tsa na/ /gang snang thams cad sgom du gda'/ /ji ltar sgoms kyang spros bral yin/ /thams cad chos nyid kyi yo langs la ma bcos so ma'ang bzang 'dzin du gda'/ /lam la yang zhen pa da mi byed/ khyad gsod du byed na kun la sdig /gdod nas chos skur 'dug pa la/ /sangs rgyas la yang zhen rgyu med/ /de skad smra ba rnal 'byor pa/ /tā ra nā tha zhes bya bas/ /rang gi sems la shar ba'i tshul/ /'ga' zhig kha nas thal ba lags/ /'bral med kyi glu dge legs 'phel// //—107—

༈ na mo gu ra we/ rje bka' drin can gyi rin po che/ /mtshan thos 'khor ba'i gnas las 'dren/ khyod rdo rje 'chang chen mi gzugs can/ /pha bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /yul sa mtho rig pa dwangs pa zhig /ljongs gangs ri'i khrod kyi lte ba gcig /sngon dam pa mang po byon pa gcig /gangs dgung du nangs kyi mtho ba gcig /de ha bo gangs bzang ma lags sam/ /gnas de na rgyal khams kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /pha rtsa brgyud kyi bla mas byin brlabs pa/ /nang rig pa me ltar 'bar ba la/ /phyi chos brgyad kyi dbus na nyal ba zhig /dus do nub yar gyi tshes bzang po/ /'khor rnal 'byor pho mo'i dkyil 'khor na/ /yongs mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i tshogs kyi dbus/ /nyams dga' ba'i rgyang glu tshig gsum len/ /dus da res mi lus rin chen thob/ /'di thob par dka' ba zhig yin par gda'/ /'di thob pas kyang da res mdo don byung / /don 'di la bsams kyang nyams re dga'/ /bu chung gi dus nas chos dang mjal/ /nyin mtshan kun chos la skyel ba 'di byas/ /de tsam dus na mdo don yang byung / /don 'di la bsams kyang nyams re dga'/ /nga chung chung ma ṇi mi shes dus kyang / /dkon mchog la snying nas dad pa dang / /thar 'don mtshan nyid dang ldan pa yod/ /rgyu des kyang 'jig rten la blo ma song / /don 'di la bsams kyang nyams re dga'//bdag spyang rig 'dzom po gcig ma lags te/ /gsung rab la go ba lhug par chags/ /bdag las bla bzang po gcig ma lags kyang/ /chos phyogs su sdug kyang theg rab byung / /bdag rig pa 'char po gcig ma lags kyang //grub mtha' la cher gyi gting gcig lon/ /bdag bya —108—

byed brtson po gcig ma lags kyang / /sgom 'phral 'phral rgyun du nyams su blangs/ /mi chos la dgos pa kun med lags kyang / /lha chos la dgos pa kun phal cher tshang / /don 'di la bsams kyang nyams re dga'/ /bdag longs spyod la sgrub 'dod med lags te/ /sngon las kyis zang zing rjes la bsnyegs/ /mi gzhan ltas zhing ma dag par rtsi/ /gnad 'dis kyang re ltos 'cha' mkhan nyung / /stong zob kyi dad can bslu ma dgos/ /don 'di la bsams kyang nyams re dga'//chos sde snod mang du bslabs lags kyang / /skal ldan tshe gcig la sangs rgya ba/ /rdo rje'i theg pa la snying phur btab/ /don 'di la bsams kyang nyams re dga'/ /tha snyad la mi tshe ma skyel bar/ /gzhone nu nas snying po'i don la dril/ /bla ma'i man ngag la chig 'dril du byas/ /don 'di la bsams kyang nyams re dga'/ /sngags zhus kyi bla ma mang yod kyang /khong dgongs pa gtad pas don 'grub cing / /lhug pa rang grol gyi sangs rgyas te/ /rje grub chen rnam gnyis la gsol ba btab/ /don 'di la bsams kyang nyams re dga'/ nyams kyi rtsal ni phyogs med du shar/ /myong ba yang yang thon nas byung / /da ni rtogs pa 'gyur ba med/ /don 'di yang rje btsun bla ma'i drin/ /sngar yang bla ma la gsol ba btab/ /da dung yang pha rgod kyis byin gyis rlobs/ /dus bzhe ning mos gus la 'phel 'grib shor/ /der yang bla ma nyag gcig sgoms/ /yi mug byed kyin yang gsol ba btab/ /phung ngan pa'i lo de 'das phyin chad/ /mos gus sgom gyi rtsa ba chugs/ /don 'di yang bla ma'i thugs rje yin/ /sngar yang : da dung yang rgyo tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor la yid dga' —109—

dang / /'khor ba'i bde skyid la yid smon dang / /snyan grags kyi phye mthor len pa gsum/ /rmi lam gyi dus na yang yul nas bud/ /don 'di yang bla ma'i: sngar yang : da dung yang : da 'gro 'dug spyod lam thams cad du/ /snying rje dang byang sems ma chad tsam/ /don 'di yang : sngar yang : da dung yang : bya ba ci byed thams cad kyang / /ma bcos lhug pa'i ngang nas byed/ /gnyis med kyi ngang du rig pa 'phyo/ /don 'di yang zo sngar yang : da dung yang : nyon mongs kun ngo bo nyid kyis dag /nyes ltung gi tshogs rnams rag sar grol/ /rtsa bral ngang nas phyogs med du sbyangs/ don 'di yang : sngar yang jo da dung yang : dus da tsam re dogs zhig nas gda'//gnyen po yang rang sar zhig nas gda'/ /don 'di yang : sngar yang je da dung yang : rang ltogs sam 'khyags kyi dogs pa'am/ /mis kha ngan 'ja' smod byung dogs sam/ /don ma 'grub gnod pa byung dogs sogs/ /rang sdug rang gis 'chos rme de zhig nas gda'/ /don 'di yang : sngar yang je da dung yang : gtam snyan la re dang skyid la re/ /mi gzhan las lhag pa gcig yod la re/ /rang bzang 'dod bzang 'dzin gyis khog phug pa'i/ /chos dang 'jig rten gyi legs sgrigs sogs/ /re ba phung gi dkyil 'khor de zhig nas thal/ /don 'di yang : sngar yang : da dung yang : nang rtsa yi mdud pa lhod de shig /rten thig le bde ba rang gcig 'bar/ /las rlung gi 'gro 'ong dbang du 'dus/ /'phral bogs 'don phyogs med lhug par bskyangs/don 'di yang : sngar yang : da dung yang jo 'brog bas mtha' gangs kyi mgul pa 'di/ /gnas sman ljongs nyams dga' 'gol ba la/ /'phral 'du 'dzi lang —110—

long nyung ba gcig /bdag rgyal khams kyi rnal 'byor ldom bu pa'ang / /nang rang rig bde stong 'gyur med la/ /'phral mtshams tshig mi shes g.yas med gcig /mi bdag dang dben pa'i gangs khrod 'di/ /chos de gnyis dpe don 'dzom pa gcig gda'/ /sprang kho bo la byin rlabs med lags kyang / /rje bla ma thugs rje dang byin rlabs su che/ /tshig 'di la legs cha med 'dug kyang / /don 'di la nges pa'i gtad so yod/ /dbyangs 'di la glu rta ma mchis kyang / /ngag 'di la shugs 'gyung gi zhang gcig gda'//glu 'di la go rim ma mchis kyang / /sgra 'di la byin brlabs brjid gcig chags/ /zhes pa'ang ha bo gangs bzang gi mgul/ gu ru pad+mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ mkha' ro gangs sbug gi ri khrod du tshogs 'khor gyi gral du glur blangs pa'o// //dge'o//༄༅/ /oṃ snyu sti/ bdag phyogs ris bral ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /dus me tog ldan pa khyu mchog lo/ /yul bkra shis 'phel pa'i g.yo ru na/ /rje bla ma'i bka' drin snying la dran/ /sngon 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /mthar da lta'i bar du 'khyams pa lags/ /lar 'khor ba gting mtha' med pa 'dir/ /sems sangs rgyas su gtong ba'i rin po che/ /'gro drug pha ma drin can yang / /'khor bar bskyur rogs gcig ma lags pa/ /gtan gyi 'dun gros la sbyor mkhan med/ /snying gi 'dun gros de rjes la zhus/ /lus sha khrag 'dus pa'i phung po 'di/ /nam 'jig la nges pa cung zad med/ khre rjes su drod pa'i gdengs med kun/ /rig pa 'di nang du 'gugs par zhu/ /nga 'chi bas 'jigs nas bla —111—

ma btsal/ /nyams len kun rdo rus thug par 'bad/ /da tsam nas shi yang blo re bde/ /blo bde tshags su chug pa gcig mi dgos sam/ /nam zla dus bzhi'i 'gyur ba 'di dang gcig /mtho dman 'byor rgud kyi ri mo 'di dang gnyis//rgyal khams yul phyogs kyi 'gyur tshabs 'di dang gsum/ 'dus byas mi rtag pa ston pa'i slob dpon gcig gda'/ /byas kyang zin med kyi zhing las 'di dang gcig /bskyangs kyang drin med log sgrub kyi spyod pa dang gnyis//'thungs kyang ngoms med kyi lan tshwa'i chu dang gsum/ /las don med du ston pa'i slob dpon gcig mi gda'/ /grong khyer 'du 'dzi'i lang log 'di dang gcig /brel la don chung sbrang bu'i spyod pa 'di dang gnyis/ /sprin dkar ban bun gyi 'gyed 'khor 'di dang gsum/ /'khor ba gtad med du ston pa'i ngo sprod gcig gda'/ /snang la gzugs med kyi 'ja' tshon 'di dang gcig/ lhang lhang dmigs med kyi brag cha 'di dang gnyis/ /med kyang dga' sdug 'char ba'i rmi lam dang gsum/ /snang ba rang sems su ston pa'i slob dpon gcig gda'//phyi snang ba sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor dang gcig /nang rig pa sems kyi 'char sgo dang gnyis/ /dbyings ngos gzung bral ba'i stong nyid dang gsum/ /chu la chu bzhag bzhin du dbyer med gcig gda'/ /lar nyams myong cung zad gcig skyes tsa na/ /snang ba gang shar ci shar ngo sprod du 'dug /sgo gsum bya ba ci byas bogs 'don du gda'/ /don 'di la bsams na a la la/ /nga yang mi tshe'i lhag ma cung zad 'di/ /nyams len sgrub pa la skyel ba dang / /dben pa'i ri khrod zin pa dang / /gang shar lam du longs pa sa /drin can bla ma rin chen gyis/ /sngar —112—

tshad gzung med par byin brlabs mod/ /da yang byin gyis brlab tu gsol / /skyabs gzhan med do chos kyi rje/ /tā ra nā thas rgyal khams kyi 'gyur lugs 'dra mthong bas/ sems la ngo sprod pa ltar gyur pa'i skabs shin tu glur blangs pa'o// //bkra shis 'phel//༄༅/ /na mo mahā mu drwa ya/ dbyings bde ba chen po'i nam mkha' la/ /rig pa ye shes phyogs med kyi rtsal/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gza' skar bkra/ /rje dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /sprang gus pas khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /lar byin gyi rlobs shig thugs rje can/ /ya gi shed dag pa'i zhing khams na/ /sku mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i thugs/ khong rdo rje 'chang zhes grags pa ste/ /yongs dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yin no skad/ /de g.yin na yod pa ma yin te/ /pha rtsa ba'i bla ma gcig pu lags/ /rje khyed kyi thugs rje'i bka' drin gyis/ /mi nga yang brtan pa cung zad zin/ /gzhi ma bcos gnyug ma'i gnas lugs la/ /thag chod kyi gdeng 'di nyams su dga'/ /sems gsal la dwangs pa'i rang snang la/ /mi 'char bya ba ni gcig kyang med/ /de shar tsam nyid nas grol ba 'di/ /rang grol gyi rnal 'byor ma lags sam/ /yongs rang ngo shes pa'i g.yengs med 'di/ /zhi gnas kyi sgom zhes bya ba lags/ /rang bzhin ma rnyed pa'i rtsa bral 'di/ /lhag mthong shes rab ma lags sam/ /rje rang sems dang dbyer med du shes tsa na/ /chos sku zhal mjal la dka' rgyu med/ /rang zhal mthong ba'i rnal 'byor la/ /'du 'bral med pa'i mos gus bskyed/ /bdag —113—

dal 'byor mi lus thob pa dang / /spyir du chos dang mjal ba dang / /sgos su gsang sngags thob pa dang / /yang sgos zab don rig pa 'di/ /sngon cung zad bsod nams bsags pa'i rtags/ /blo cung zad chos la song ba dang / /rje mtshan ldan bla mas bskyangs pa dang / /chos mdo rgyud la nges pa rnyed pa dang //'phral chags sdang phyogs ris med pa 'di/ /yul gang du bsdad kyang skyid par gda'/ /tshe 'dir ltas kyi bde ba'i mgo bskor dag /gtam snyan gyi phye mthor ma blangs shing / /dbang thang la smon sems ma byas pas/ /dus nam yang blo sems bde mor byung / /phyi chos su brdzus pa'i 'jig rten dang / /nang khong du bzung ba'i ngag snyan dang / /phugs rang 'dod kha rgyal gyi gzhan don byed/ /don 'di gsum spangs pas chos su song / /tshul 'di yang dpal ldan bla ma'i drin/ /da dung yang gsol ba 'debs lags pas/ /byin gyis rlobs shig thugs rje can/ /rje khyed kyi thugs rje'i byin brlabs kyis/ /deng phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs par shog /ces pa'ang tā ra nā thas yar 'brog stag lung du tshogs kyi 'khor lor nges par brjod pa'i glu dbyangs so// //maṅgal bistur ku sa/༄༅/ /na mo gu ra we/ sems can gyi bsam pa ji bzhin du/ /'phrin las 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing / /thugs rnam par mi rtog thugs rje can/ /bla ma sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs bde chen ngag las ma g.yos kyang / /sku rlud sems tsam la mtshan dpes spras/ khong gdul bya dag pa'i 'gro —114—

don mdzad/ /rje longs spyod rdzogs skur gsol ba 'debs/ /dbyings rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi ngang / /ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i rtsal/ /gdod nas spros pa kun bral ba/ /bla ma chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /mi bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang / /sngon 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /phyi ma'i mu mthar thug pa li bar/ /dus gsum dge ba ci yod pa/ /rje bla ma khyed la mchod par 'bul//deng dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul/ /phyi 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs dang / /nang zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du sbrel/ /mchog bde stong dbyer med gsang pa'i 'phrul/ /de thams cad ma bcos ma 'gags rtsal/ /de nyid kyi mchod pa rgya cher 'bul/ /dus da lta byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rgyal pa la/ /mkhyen pa'i 'od stong phyogs bcur 'phro/ /gdul bya'i ma rig mun pa sel/ /pha bla ma nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dra/ /mi kho bo'i sems kyang nyi ma dang mtshungs/ /ngo bo 'phel 'grib med pa dang / /snang ba ma 'gags phyogs bcur 'char/ /rang bzhin sgrib med 'od du gsal/ /lhag bsam gyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba dang / /byams brtse'i 'od dkar 'phro ba dang / /nyon mongs kyi tsha gdung sel bas na/ /pha bla ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dra/ /mi kho bo'i sems kyang zla ba dang mtshungs/ /rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa dang //byang chub sems kyi 'od zer gyis/ /zhe sdang gi mun pa 'joms par mthong / /'khor 'das la yangs dog med pa dang / /chos kun la nye ring med par khyab/ /sprul pa kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/ /pha bla ma nam mkha'i dbyings dang 'dra/ /mi bdag gi sems kyang mkha' dang mtshungs/ /rang bzhin thogs rdugs —115—

med pa dang / /spyir yang 'char ba kun gyi rtsal/ /snang ba thams cad 'gag med du snang / 'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / /byams dang snying rjes brlan pa dang / /gdul bya'i dri ma 'khrud pa ste/ /pha bla ma chu bo'i rgyun dang 'dra/ /mi bdag gi sems kyang chu rgyun dang mtshungs/ /sngon thog ma med nas tha ma'i bar/ /rang bzhin mi 'gyur rgyun chad med/ /rang gi dri ma rang gis sbyong / /gting ye shes g.yo ba med pa la/ /'phral 'gro don rba rlabs phyogs bcur g.yo/ /gzhan phan rin chen kun gyi gnas/ /pha bla ma rgya mtsho chen por mtshungs/ /mi bdag gi sems kyang rgya mtsho dang 'dra/ /rang bzhin rnam rtog gi mi g.yo zhing / /nam yang rig pa'i rtsal ma 'gags/ /yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas yin/ /tshogs gnyis kyi gzhi la brten pa dang / /rim gnyis kyi bang rim mdzes pa dang / /thar 'dod kyi rten sa yin pa'i phyir/ /pha bla ma dang ri rgyal lhun po mtshungs/ /mi bdag gi sems kyang ri rab dang 'dra/ /rang bzhin gyi dag par zhabs brtan zhing / /nyams myong gi bang rim mdzes pa dang / /dngos grub gnyis kyi rten sar snang / /mi kho bo'i bla ma ci 'dra bar/ /'gro drug gi sems kyang de ltar lags/ /don de ltar lags pas dgongs par mdzod/ /mnyam nyid la zhog cig dam tshig can/ /dbyangs 'di yang bla ma la mchod pa 'bul/ /gnas 'dir yang bkra shis dge legs stsol// //zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas tshogs kyi 'khor lor glur blangs pa'o// bkra shis/ shu bha//—116—

༈ na mo gu ra be/ rje mi gzugs la rdo rje 'chang chen te/ /pha rtsa ba'i bla ma ma lags sam/ /gdul bya gang mos 'gro don mdzad/ /de brgyud pa'i bla ma ma lags sam/ /dbyings mkha' khyab kyi sgo nas 'gro ba 'dul/ /de rdo rje 'chang chen ma lags sam/ /sprul pa sna tshogs kyis don mdzad pa/ /yi dam gyi lha tshogs ma lags sam/ /nus mthu la thogs pa med pa ste/ /chos skyong bsrung ma ma lags sam/ khyed ye shes gcig gi cho 'phrul las/ /tshul cir yang ston pa ngo mtshar che/ /bdag snying gi khong nas gsol ba 'debs/ /dus da lta byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /deng 'dir dus kyi skal ldan pho mo kun/ /mi bdag gi tshig la snyan gson zhig /rnyed dka' 'jig sla'i mi lus la/ /mdo don 'byung ba'i thabs shig 'tshal/ /sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /cis kyang thar pa'i thabs shig 'tshal/ /chos kun gyi 'jug sgo lags pas na/ /tshe 'di blo yi btang yang 'tshal/ /dam chos kyi rtsa ba lags pas na/ /'khor ba las nges 'byung sems bskyed de/ /nyams len gyi snying po yin pas na/ /byams dang snying rje byang sems sgoms/ /chos kun gyi yang rtse yin pas na/ /mtha' bral stong nyid kyi ngang la zhog /rang bzhin ma bcos gsal bas na/ /ma bcos so ma'i ngang du zhog /'dzin pa rang sar bzhig nas kyang / /ched 'dzin med pa'i don de sgoms/ /rnam rtog brdzun gyi mgo bskor yin/ /lhug pa bzo med ngang du skyongs/ /phyi snang ba gang shar gyi ngo bo la/ /gsal la zhen pa med par zhog/nang rig pa sems kyi ngo bo la/ /rig stong dbyer med khrim mer sgrims/ /sems mnyam bzhag ngang du gnas pa'i tshe/ /lhun grub bzo bcos med par zhog/ rjes —117—

snang ba 'gags med shar ba'i tshe/ /gang shar rang zhal lta bar 'tshal/ /snang ba rang bzhin dag pa la/ /dag pa'i snang ba rgya cher spel/ /rang lus yi dam lha sku la/ /snang stong sgyu ma'i rtsis su zin/ /sems rang bzhin bde ba'i rang snang la/ /bogs 'don rtsas ni phyogs bcur spel/ /lus rtsa rlung thig le'i rang bzhin la/ /bla ma'i gsung bzhin gnad du bsnun/ /nyams sna tshogs 'char sgo ji snyed la/ /zhen chags med pa'i skyong lugs 'tshal/ /don de ltar thugs la zhog mdzod la/ /cis kyang gnad du bsnun par mdzod/ /bdag nges med kyi rnal 'byor rgyal khams pa/ /dbyangs 'di nyid bla ma la mchod par 'bul/ /tshig 'di la legs cha mi 'dug kyang / /don 'di la nges pa'i gtad so gdog/ // ces pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas chos 'khor sdings kyi gnas su tshes bcu'i mtshan mo'i thun dang po la byin pa'i dga' ston gyi tshe glur blangs pa'o//bkra shis//༄༅/ /na mo gu ra be/ dbyings skye ba med pa'i nam mkha' la/ /mdangs 'gag pa med pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /thugs rje'i 'od brgya 'gyed pa yi/ /pha bla ma rdo rje 'chang la 'dud/ /rje de nyid kyi thugs rje'i char sprin las/ /chos gdams ngag gi char rgyun phab pa de/ /mi kho bo'i sems kyi zhing sar babs/ /'bras bu nyams rtogs kyi lo tog rgyas/ khyed skal ldan yod na 'di las long / /dpal rdo rje 'chang chen skad pa des/ /rgyud mtha' yas gsungs pa'i snying po lnga/ /zab dgu bsdus pa'i nye lam zhig /ming ne gu chos drug zhes bya ba/ /ma mkha' 'gro kun gyi gsang tshig de/ /nges gsang bdud rtsi'i snying po —118—

de/ /pha bla ma'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi ste/ /dus de ring rgyal khams kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /phyogs med kyi ldum bur spyod pa zhig /nges med kyi tshul la spyod bzhin du/ /gnas ri gong dpal gyi gzhal yas 'dir/ /don snying po rdo rje'i glu ru len/ /gnas spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo las/ /brda skye med mtshon pa a yi gda'/ /'phrul bdud rtsi 'bab pa dmigs pa'i gnad/ /nyams sdig sgrib dag pa'i nges shes can/ /ming yang dag byed stod ra zer/ /'di sngon 'gro la gnad du che ba zhig gda'/ /rten rdo rje'i lus la rtsa thig gi 'gros/ /gzhi gnad du che ba 'khor lo bzhi/ /'phral 'bar 'dzag rang lus dga' bzhi'i 'gros/ /'di rgyud sde'i nges gsang gnad du che/ /rkyen thabs dang shes rab 'dzom pa las//gzhi rang sems gnyug ma ngo sprod pa/ /rten thig le dbab ldog dga' bzhi'i 'gros/ /de yin ni las kyi gtum mo yin/ /zer ni gzhan lus kyi gdams pa zer/ /'dod yon lam 'khyer la gnad du che/ /mi kho bos bde stong dbyer med du bsgoms/ khyed 'dir 'dus kyang bde stong dbyer med bsgrubs/ /tshe gcig gi sangs rgyas sgrub 'dod na/ /lam gzhan la med do skal ldan kun/ /bde drod rang 'bar zhig mdzad de 'tshal/ /phyi snang ba sgyu ma'i lam 'khyer te/ /lus rgyas kyang sems kyi rang snang tsam/ /rang snang lha sku rang shar la/ /sgyu ma ltar rang bzhin med pa zhig /sgyu lus kyi gdams pa'i snying po'i don/mi ngan kyang 'di la nyams len byas/ /chags sdang gi snang ba rang sar dag /a mthas sbrul gyi mdud pa zhig khyed 'dir 'dus kyang a mthas bshig pa zhig 'tshal/ /'phral 'dun pa sgyur pa'i gnad ka las/ /rig pa'i rang rtsal —119—

phyogs med kyi gdangs/ /dngos 'dzin gyi 'ching ba 'grol ba la//nges med du sbyong pa gnad du che/ /ming yang rmi lam gyi gdams ngag zer/ /sgyu lus pa rnams la mkho ba lags/ /gzhi gdod ma'i rang zhal lta ba dang / /rkyen mos gus gdung ba'i shugs drag dang / /gnad rlung sems 'dus pa'i rten 'brel las/ /sems rdo rje'i rang bzhin 'od gsal che/ /dus nyin par rtsol ba bskyed bskyed nas/ /mtshan mo rang shar gyi gsal snang can/ /gsal tsam nyid nas stong par shar/ /gsal stong dbyer med kyi 'od gsal zer/ /zhu bde dang gnyug ma 'dres pa las/ /nyams bde tsam nyid nas rang dag gcig /bde stong dbyer med kyi 'od gsal yin/ /sems rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa la/ /sgrib gnyis brdzun gyi stong zob yal/ /dag pa gnyis ldan gyi 'od gsal yin/ / 'od gsal lam gyi 'bras bu ste/ /rje rdo rje 'chang chen gyi spyan snga sa /gdams ngag rnams phu thag chod par zhus/ /zhus pa tsam la yang ma bzhag par/ /rang sems dang 'dres pa'i nyams len byas/ /ban bun nyams kyi 'char sgo dag /'gyur med rtogs pa'i gtan yul zin/ khyed 'dir 'dus kyang 'od gsal rtse gcig tu bsgoms/ /ngo mtshar rlud sems 'phrul gyi gnad/ /sems rtse gcig gyen du 'phang ba dang / /cir snang la bar do'i 'dun pa sbyongs/ /gang shar la dag snang lam 'byer bya/ /'pho ba dang bar do'i gdams ngag zer//las dang po pa la gnad du che/ /sems ma bcos gnyug ma'i rang ngo la/ /gang shar rjen cher gyi ngang la zhog /sgo gsum ma bcos so ma'i ngang / /rang babs lhug pa'i gdams pa zer/ /sal le dang sing nge'i ngang du sgoms/ /lhod de dang —120—

shigs se'i rgya yan gyi ngang / /sems gang shar ngo shes kyi rnal 'byor ba/ khar tsam nyid nas rang sar grol/ /ming yang rang grol gyi gdams ngag zer/ /gsal ba dang stong pa zung 'jug gsum/ /sems gnas sam 'gyu'am ji ltar rung / /gdod nas rang gnas kyi ngo shes la/ /sku gsum rang shar gyi gdams ngag zer/ /'gyu ba 'gyu stong gi ngang du thim/ /mnyam rjes kyi sa mtshams zhig nas thal/ /mdo rgyud kyi mkhyen rgya can mang lags shing / /gdams ngag gi bdag po mang mod kyang / /don 'di las med ces bya ba nyung / /rang grol phyag chen gyi rnal 'byor 'di/ /mdo rgyud kyi snying por lags par 'khums/ /mi kho bos de ltar nyams su blangs/ khyed 'dir 'dus kyang de ltar nyams len mdzod/ /rang shar phyogs med kyi dag snang gcig /gang snang mos gus kyi lam 'byer la/ /mos gus kyi rtsa ba bla mar shar/ /zla ma yi dam dbyer med kyi ngang / /yi dam de sgyu mar rang shar zhig /rang shar ma bcos lhug pa'i gdangs/ /yin ni dag snang phyogs med 'khrid/ /zer ni lam 'byer rnam gsum zer/ /mi kho bos kyang dag snang phyogs med du sbyangs/ khyed 'dir 'dus kyang dag snang phyogs med du sbyongs/ /thabs 'gag med kyi gnad de dag snang la gda'/ /sems gsal stong lha sku'i snang cha dang / /rang rig pa 'gyur med bde ba'i ngang / /de dang po nyid nas skye ba med/ /gang la ma skyes pa la 'gag pa med/ /sems skye 'chi med pa'i rang bzhin te/ /'phral drin can gyi bla mas ngo sprod pa/ /ming yang rang sems 'chi med zer/ /bskyed rdzogs snying por dril ba gcig na gda'/ /rlung dang rnam rtog sems gsum po/ /dbyings su bsdoms pa —121—

nyams len gyi gnad/ /'khrul 'khor gyi kha bsgyur nyams len gyi rtsal/ /gzhan lus la thogs pa med pa yi/ /thig le 'dzag med kyi rang grol las/ /dga' bzhi dbyings su ngo sprod pa/ /ming ni rang lus 'chi med zer/ /rlung sems rang dbang du chug gcig rnal 'byor pa/ /'phral 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i bsgrub pa'i gnad/ /pha drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /myur mdzad ye shes mgon po gnyis/ /mtshan tha dad don la khyad par med/ /mos gus nyag gcig gi rnal 'byor las/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis kyi klong brdol nas/ /'gro don lhun grub tu 'char ba lags/ /dbyangs mchod par 'bul lo mtshan ldan rje/ /dpal rdo rje 'a myong chen nas brtsams te/ /pha rtsa ba'i bla ma thams cad la/ /nyams dbyangs kyi glu 'di mchod par 'bul/ khyed 'dir 'dus kyi skal ldan pho mo la/ /nges gsang gi bdud rtsi ro mchog 'di/ /dga' don gyi tshul du byin pa lags/ /bdag phyogs ris med pa'i rgyal khams pa/ /ro snyoms kyi rnal 'byor gu yangs po/ /chos brgyad kyi dgra mkhar zhig pa zhig /gnyug ma'i gtan sa zin pa zhig /dngos kun gyi rang zhal lta ba po/ /chos tha snyad tshig la ma rmongs kyang / /mkhas 'dod kyi bzang 'dzin dbyings su grol/ /'phral lus sems tha mal du snang ba tsam/ /drin can gyi mkhan pos gnang pa'i ming / /kun dga' snying po zhes bya ba yin/ /rang sems kyi rang bzhin ngo sprod pa/ /mi sangs rgyas su gtong ba'i bka' drin can/ /pha bla mas bka' drin rtsal ba ni/ / ming tā ra nā tha zhes bya ba yin/ /deng snying gtam gyi tshul du smras pa yin// //zhes pa'ang rang lo nyer lnga pa la ri gong dpal gyi mgon po'i gnas/ rang byung —122—

mgon po'i drung du tshogs kyis 'khor lo'i tshe glur blangs pa rdzi// dge'o//༄༅/ /o snya sti/ na mo gu ra we/ dbyings spros dang bral ba'i ngang zhig nas/ /'phral gang la gang 'dul 'gro don mdzad/ /chos tshig spyi dang don spyir ma las par/ /don snying por ston pa'i bla ma rje/ /sa 'di nas rgyal khams kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /yid mos gus drag pos gsol ba 'debs/ /bu slob ma'i sems la byin gyis rlobs/ /lar rtsa bral rtogs par thugs rjes gzung / /pha byin rlabs can de'i bka' drin la/ /mi ngas kyang sems kyi gnas lugs mthong / /rje mkhyen pa can de'i bka' drin las/ /don nges pa'i gnas la thag chod byung / /yongs thugs rje can de'i bka' drin la/ /phyi dgra gnyen gyi rnam rtog zhi ba tsam/ mgon 'khrul zhig can de'i bka' drin la/ /nang 'dzin pa yal yul ngang du bud/ /nga rje la mos gus mi che sa /bka' drin la tshad gzung mi gda' 'o/ khyed 'dir 'dus kyi thugs la 'di ltar zhog /lar da res mi lus thob pa la/ /mdo don yod pa zhig gal re che/ /dam chos mi byed pa'i mi lus 'di/ /dud 'gro las zang ma zhig ma lags sam/ /mi rtag 'khor ba'i gnas tshul la/ /thugs nges par 'byung ba zhig cis kyang 'tshal/ /thar pa'i lam sna zin pa zhig gal re che/ /sngon 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /dus nyi ma de ring la thug gi bar/ /lus bya byed 'gro 'dug nyal dang langs/ /ngag smra brjod ngal dub rtsol ba'i lam/ /yid mno bsam 'gyu ba'i 'phrang la brdar//chos byed tshug byas kyang las su song / /lar sdig pa sdug bsngal gyi rgyu lags shing / /las —123—

lung ma bstan mi tshe stong zad yin/ /thar lam du ma song ba'i dge ba de/ /'khor ba bskyed pa'i thabs su gda'/ /phyag chen gyis ma zin pa'i spros bcas de/ /yid rnam rtog 'khrug pa'i rgyu zhig gda'/ /sgoms sems dang ma 'dres pa'i go yul de/ /don mdo don thug dus bslu ba zhig gda'/ /snying rjes ma zin pa'i stong rkyang de/ /legs kyang theg dman gyi rgyu zhig lags/ /las 'bras khyad gsod kyi lug gog de/ /dmyal bar 'gro ba'i rgyu zhig gda'/ /rang ngo ma shes pa'i lta ba de/ /blos byas spros pa'i ri mor gda'/ /rang so tshugs pa'i nyon mongs de/ /rtsub rtsub 'dra yang 'jam por gda'/ /rtsa bral la song ba'i 'char sgo de/ /snang snang 'dra yang yal yul du gda'/ /rtsol med ngo shes kyi rnam rtog de/ /'gyu 'gyu 'dra yang rang zhig tu gda'/ /lhag bsam gyis ma zin pa'i dge rtsa de/ /brel ba che la 'bras bu chung / /slong yangs su ma thengs pa'i kha ton de/ /sems tshab che la grub don chung / /byang sems kyis ma zin pa'i sgom bzlas de/ /bon chog dang khyad par mi gda' 'o/ /da lus gnad srang du gzhug tu 'tshal/ /ngag smra brjod spangs la lhug par zhog /sems bzo med hrig ge skyong bar zhu/ /pha bla ma chos skur mkhyen pa zhig 'tshal/ /dam tshig la zol zog med pa zhig 'tshal/ /dad gus la kha zhe med pa zhig 'tshal/ /nyon mongs gang skyes kyi ngo bo la/ /ma bcos so mar 'jog pa zhig zhu/ /sems rang bzhin so ma bskyangs tsa na/ /gang shar brjod bral du lam mer gda'/ /de gdod ma nas yod yod po zhig lags/ /yod par ma shes pa ya re cha/ /'di ma bcos lhug pa'i gdams ngag zer/ /'phral lus ngag spyod pa ci byed kyang / /rang so tshugs —124—

pa'i ngo bo la/ /dmigs gtad kun zhig pa'i ngang zhig nas/ /blang dor la mtshan mar ma 'dzin par/ /tho cho la bzang por ma ngom zhig /tshul 'chos kyi mdzes khrigs kyang mi 'tshal lo/ /gang shar gyi spyod pa lhug pa la/ /bcos ma ru ma song pa gnad du che/ /'di blang dor mnyam nyid kyi gdams ngag lags//sgom nyams kyi rtsi la zhen pa te/ dpe dar gyi srin bu ji bzhin du/ /rang rang gis 'ching ba'i mgo bskor lags/ /dus do nub tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dus//gnas rgyal po'i pho brang chen po na/ /ming tā ra nā tha skad pa yis/ /glu 'di ni gdams pa'i tshul du blangs/ /de mchod par 'bul lo bla ma rje// //zhes slob bu 'ga' zhig la ngo sprod kyi tshul du glur blangs pa/ nyin zhag 'ga' re 'bri ba ma byung bas/ ma brjed par dran tshod cig deng 'dus rnams kyis 'bri bar bskul nas bris pa ste/ gong dkar du'o/ /dge'o//༈ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las/ /ma gyur 'gro ba kun sgrol ba'i blo/ /skad cig tsam du ma re skyes tsa na/ /le lo'i 'khri ba tsho rtsad nas chod/ /lar byang chub sems 'di ma 'byongs na/ /de mkhas par rloms yang mdo med po/ /bzang por rdzu yang gzhan mgo bskor/ /btsun btsun 'dra yang mdzes chos su gda'/ /chos pa rnam dag yin thag chad/ khong sde byus kyi kha lo sgyur pa yi/ /bzhas gnyen kun la zhe nas khrel/ /chos dang rgyab 'gal gyi mdzad spyod la/ /dge bshes su re ba ha cang zhabrul/ /dpung bu rta'i ral rol mang po dang / /nor longs spyod zang zing lhur —125—

len pa/ /chos ka ri ka tsam yang mi shes par/ /'khor mang po 'dren pa ya re cha/ /'jig rten pa'i dpon g.yog gyu ru ste/ /las mthun tsam 'dus pa ma gtogs pa/ /dam chos kyi dri tsam mi gda' na/ /smin grol gyi gzhan don re thag sangs/ /ma byung dus 'khore tshogs g.yang ltar 'gu/gas/ /byung dus grags 'dod kyis phyogs bcur 'gyed/ /bya ba thongs thongs 'dra yang mi thongs pa'i/kha zhu ga ting 'khyags kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /stong nyid sgom pas chog dus su/ /spros bcas kyi skyabs shig tshol la rem//spros bcas ma dag cing ma tshang pa'i/ /skyon subs la stong skad gyi lud gog 'thag /gnyis med seng ge khyod 'dzin stangs re bzang / /'char ka dang gtam ngan byung gi dogs/ /rang gnod ri tsam khong du chug /ro snyoms kyi rnal 'byor gnam mtha' yar/ /skabs 'gar rang skyon yang gshong ba skad//rang ma mgu ba kun la thabs kyis smod/ /rang bzang por ngom pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ khyod smra ba mang yang gting nas khrel/ /yengs tshe 'di'i skyid sdug dang gtam/ /rlung la bskur nas ma gyur tsho/ /sgrol 'dod kyi snying rje zol med cig /byung na chos su 'gro lags pas/ /cis kyang 'bad pa'i dus la bab// //ces pa'ang rang gzhan da lta'i chos par rdzu ba mang po'i gnas tshul la yid nges par 'byung nas/ tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer gsum pa la'o/ /dge'o//༄༅/ /na mo gu sa bde chen chos sku'i rang nyams las/ /phyogs med kyi thugs rje'i 'gro don shar/ /pha rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs la 'dud/ /bdag —126—

'dir tshogs la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /gzhan don phyogs med du 'phel ba 'di/ /sems stong nyid snying rje shar ba'i rtags/ /gnas lugs kyi rang ngo 'phrod pa 'di/ /mos gus tshad du phyin pa'i rtags/ /nam yang yengs pa med pa 'di/ /rtsa bral gyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rtags/ /rnam rtog gi skye thag chod pa 'di/ /rtog med kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rtags/ /bde stong gi nyams myong rgyun chad med/ /rtsa thig rlung gsum dul ba'i rtags/ spyod pa bza' gtad dang bral ba 'di/ /chos brgyad kyi rlung dmar zhi ba'i rtags/ /thob 'dod kyi re dogs zhig pa 'di/ /rang sems sangs rgyas su nges pa'i rtags/ /rtags 'di bdun tshang ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sems bde zhing skyid pa'i rang so zin/ /blo mi bde mi gda' bde mor gda'/ /slar bde zhing skyid pa'i bkra shis shog/ //ces pa'ang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// zhus dag /bkra shis// //

gsal bar byed pa'i nyi ma bzhugs/ /na mo gu ru khyuX bud+dhā bo dhi sa te khyuX nges don mthar thug snying po'i rgyud/ dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa zab mo'i don mtha' dag gsal bar byed pa'i nyi ma zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//rnam dag rang bzhin sku bzhi'i bdag nyid dngos/ /bla ma'i zhabs la dngos po kun gyis 'dud/ /rnam kun dri bral stong pa'i yum gyis 'khyud/ /zung 'jug bde chen rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas 'gyur med ye shes sku//mtha' yas chos rnams kun gyi de nyid de/ /gang gis gsal bar byed pa'i rdo rje'i tshig/gzhung 'di la yang gus pas btud nas ni/ /shin tu rnyed dka'i chos 'di la//rang gi blo dang rjes mthun par/ /rnam par dbye la der zhugs te//gegs med phun sum tshogs par phe/ga /rnam bshad nu zhig tshig gi don la 'khrul/ kha cig man ngag dang bral rtog ges bslang / /nges med mu cor lhur len gzhan na ste/ /phal cher glegs bam mthong bas khengs pa tsam/ /de slad rdo rje'i lam don gnyer ba la/ /rmad byung zung 'jug 'gyur ba med pa'i gtam//dus gsum rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho'i bcud/ /'chi med dga' ston 'gyed la spro ba skyes//'dir dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pu pa/ 'phags pa rnams kyis nges par rtogs shing / dam la pa rnams kyis thob par bya ba ni/—128—

bden pa gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid can/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje chen po gnyis su med pa'i ye shes so/ /de nyid gang las rab tu gsal bar ston pa/dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa ba'i rgyud dang po'i sangs rgyas stong phrag bcu gnyis pa'i mdor bstan gyi skabs las brtsams nas/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin chen po'i lam gyi rim pa yongs su rdzogs shing gsal la gzhi dang 'bras bu'i gnas tshul dang bcas pa ston pa/ rgyud rgyal rgya mtsho lta bu'i zab don nges gsang gces pa mtha' dag ma tshang ba med par bsdus pa dum bu bkol ba'i rgyud dbang mdor bstan pa zhes bya ba 'di 'chad par byed pa la/ /dang por mtshan gyi don ni/ rgya gar skad du/ se ka ni dbang / uta de sha mdor bstan pa/ de nyid mtshams sbyar bas se ko ta de sha'o/ /de la gzhung 'di ji ltar na dbang bskur ba mdor bstan par 'gyur snyam na/ /dbang bcu gcig po rnams kyi dag bya dag byed gnad che ba rnams kyang gsal bar bstan la/ gtso bor dbang don gyi ye shes gang yin pa de nyid zhib mor bstan pa yin no/ /de yang chu dang cod pan la sogs pa rdzas dang o a i ṛ u le zhes sogs sngags dang /yum lnga rigs lnga'i lha'i rnam pa bskyed pa sogs bsam gtan gyi khyad par gang yin pas slob ma byin gyis rlob par byed pa de ni/ 'jig rten kun rdzob pa'i dbang gi cho ga yin la/ slob ma'i rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i khyad par las/rang rgyud kyi dri ma'i rnam grangs mang po nyams smad cing / dge ba'i sa bon khyad par can mang po gsos thebs pas/ lam sgom pa la nus pa mthu can du gyur pa ni rgyud 'gyur ba'i khyad par te dbang dngos so/ /cho ga des de byas pa la dbang thob —129—

pa'am dam tshig thob pa zhes bya ste/ cho gas sems rgyud kyi yon tan dge ba'i sa bon gsos btab pa'i cha de ni sngags kyi sdom pa dang dam tshig yin no/ /cho ga yang de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa kho na yin gyi/ gzhan las ni sdom pa thob par mi 'gyur te/ lha'i mchog rnams kyis byas pa'i cho ga las ni/ las dang 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub 'grub pa'i byin rlabs rjes su 'jug pa dang / de nyid kyi dbang dang dam tshig tsam yod srid kyang / sngags kyi sdom pa thob pa ni med de/cho ga las sdom pa thob pa ni chos 'di pa kho na'i khyad chos yin pa'i phyir ro/ /cho ga brdzun pa las ni 'jig rten las 'das pa lta zhog gi 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub kyi byin rlabs kyang 'jug par mi 'gyur te/ gzhan du na 'tsho ba'i don tsam du zad do/ /'jig rten las 'das pa don dam pa'i dbang du byas na/ yan lag drug la sogs pa'i man ngag gi sgrub pa'i tshul ni cho ga yin la/ de 'dras sgrub pa'i ye shes ni/ dbang dang dam tshig dang sdom pa yin te/ des de thob pa ni dbang bskur ba'o/ /yang dbang bcu gcig po rnams kyi rim pas rgyud 'gyur ba thob pa'i dge ba'i sa bon 'phel zhing gsos thebs zhes pa'i dge ba ni/ gtso bor sems kyi rang bzhin dge ba de yin la/ der ma zad/ lam rim pa gnyis kyi ye shes 'phral du skye ba'i nus pa yang gsos thebs pas rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs skyes pa'ang yin pas/ byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun gyi dbang don bskyed rim dang / dbang gong ma bzhi'i dbang don rdzogs rim du 'jog pa yin no/ /des na skabs 'dir mdor bstan rgyu'i dbang ni dbang chog kho na ma yin gyi gtso bor dbang don mdor bstan pa yin no/ /de'i phyir 'di ni dbang don ston byed kyi sgo nas dbang mdor —130—

bstan zhes btags gyi/ le'u lnga'i mdor bstan so so las/ dbang le'i mdor bstan khor nar 'chad pa don ma yin te/ phyi 'jig rten khams dang bskyed rim gyi phyogs su gtogs pa rnams bor ba'i lhag ma/ nang dang dbang dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i sgrub thabs dang ye shes sa lam dang 'bras bur bcas pa rnams mdor bstan pa'i tshul gyis gsal bar gsungs pa yin no/ /'gyur gyi phyag ni dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'o/ /gzhung dngos la/ zla ba bzang pos dri ba zhus pa dang / ston pas bshad par zhal gyi bzhes pa dang / bshad bya'i don rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/zla ba bzang pos gsol ba/ ston pa dbang bskur rnam bdun dang / /rnam gsum de bzhin bla na med/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i dngos grub phyir/ /mdor bsdus pa yis bdag la gsungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya seng ge la/ phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa rgyal po zla ba bzang pos gsol zhing zhus par gyur pa ni/ kyai 'gro ba thams cad kyi ston pa zhes bos nas/byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bskur ba rnam pa bdun dang / bum pa gsang ba shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ste/ 'jig rten pa'i dbang gong ma rnam pa gsum dang / de bzhin du bla na med pa 'jig rten las 'das pa bzhi pa'i dbang bskur ba ste/dbang bcu gcig po 'di rnams kyi dbang don gyi ye shes gang yin pa de bdag la gsungs shig ces pa spyir gsol ba 'debs pa yin la/ nyung ngu la mos pa'i gang zag rnams rjes su bzung ba'i don du/ tshig bzung sla zhing don rtogs sla ba'i phyir mdor bsdus pas gsungs shig ces pa dang / dgos pa gang gi phyir zhu ba ni/—131—

'jig rten 'das pa'i dngos grub phyir zhes pa ste/ grub pa brgyad la sogs pa nas 'og min gyi srid pa'i mthar thug pa'i bar gyi dngos grub ni/ dngos grub 'jig rten pa dang / phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ste/ skabs 'di'i rgya skad du/ lo ki ko ta ta ra ju ra tha zhes 'byung bas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa kho na ston pa ma yin par/ 'jig rten pa dang 'das pa zhes pa'i don du snang zhing / 'grel pa rnams kyis kyang de bzhin du bshad do/ /des na 'jig rten dang 'dis dngos grub phyir/ /zhes bsgyur na legs la/ 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das grub phyir/ /zhes 'bro 'gyur las 'byung ba/ rgya skad la dang gi skad dod dang / 'jig rten zhes pa lan gnyis med kyang don 'gyur gyi dbang du byas na mi 'gal te/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa ni don la rton pa yin pas don 'khrul so med cing go bde ba nyid gnad che ba yin no/ /'di ni gzhung 'di'i dgos 'brel gyi ngag dngos min kyang / dgos sogs chos bzhi ston par 'chad pa khog don nam 'phros don gyi tshul du byas na legs par 'gyur ro//'dir mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes don dam pa'i dbang bzhi pa ni brjod bya'i gtso bo yin zhing / de nyid sgrub par byed pa'i thabs rnams kyang brjod bya'o//gzhung tshig sho lo ka brgya dang bdun cu rtsa bzhi'i bdag nyid kyi rgyud 'di ni brjod byed do/ /gzhung 'di la brten nas dbang don sgrub thabs de nyid gsal bar rtogs shing bde blag tu rtogs pa ni dgos pa'o/ /de las phyag rgya chen tshodangos grub sangs rgyas nyid thob pa ni/ dgos pa'i yang dgos pa'o/ /dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes sgrub thabs dang bcas pa dang gzhung 'di nyid/ brjod bya brjod —132—

byed kyi 'brel pa can du gnas shing / gzhung 'di la brten nas dbang don ma nor bar go ba dang de ltar phyin ci ma log par go ba bzhin du nyams su bstar bas/mchog gi dngos grub thob pa rnams/ phyi ma phyi ma snga ma snga ma la bltos pa'i tshul gyi 'byung ba'i phyir/ phyi ma rnams snga ma la 'brel ba ni 'brel ba'o/ /dper na sa 'og na rin po che'i gter yod par gyur la/ de yod pas rno mthong mkhan pos phyogs 'di na gter gyi khyad par 'di dang 'di lta bu dag yod do/ /zhes pa'i ngag gi brjod pa de 'byung la brjod pa de las gter don gnyer 'ga' zhig la/ phyogs der gter gyi khyad par yod nges pa'i blo skye/ blo de skyes pas brko spyad la sogs pa'i bya bas gter lag tu 'ong bar 'gyur la/ snga ma snga ma ma byung bar phyi ma phyi ma mi 'byung ba bzhin no/ /skabs 'dir 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub thob pa dgos par 'chad pa ni/ dpal dri med 'od la brten par snang yang / de dang mi 'dra ste/bsdus pa'i rgyud chen po las ni/ 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub sgrub thabs yan lag dang bcas pa rgyas par gsung zhing / gzhung 'dir de ltar ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /tshig bcad dang po'i skabs 'dir nye bar mkho ba la/ 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub ni thun mong gi dngos grub yin la/ de yang ri lu mig sman la sogs pa dngos grub chung ngu dang / 'dod pa'i khams kyi lha'i lus su 'gyur ba'i rig 'dzin ni 'bring po dang / gzugs kyi khams kyi lus su 'gyur ba'i rig 'dzin ni chen lnga'o/ /de dag gi nang tshan 'dod khams kyi lha la rigs drug dang / gzugs khams la bcu drug yod cing / de'i bzang shos 'og min pa yin pas/ 'og min pa'i lha'i lus su 'gyur ba'i rig 'dzin ni/ thun mong gi dngos grub mthar thug —133—

pa yin pas/ 'og min gyi srid pa'i mthar thug pa'i 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub zhes 'byung ba yin no/ /yang gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu/ zhi sogs kyi las chung ngu dang / grub pa brgyad sogs 'bring po dang / gzugs kyi rig pa 'dzin pa chen por bshad pa'i skabs kyang yod de/ de ni las dang dngos grub so sor ma phye bar/sirnyi ces pa grub pa'i sgra 'bras bu tsam la 'jug par dgongs nas/ bskyed rim gyi grub pa ste 'bras bu rab 'bring / ma gsum du bshad pa'i skabs yin no//'jig rten pa ni khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa ma spangs pa'i don yin la/spangs pa ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'o/ /de'i nang nas sangs rgyas nyid ni nyon mongs pa'i sgrib par ma zad/ shes bya'i sgrib pa dang snyoms par 'jug pa'i sgrib pa yang spangs pa ste/ sgrib pa gsum las gro/la ba'o/ /sems can bsdus pa la mngon par dga' ba zhes pa ni/ nyon mongs pa dang / dus dang / sems can dang /lta ba dang / tshe'i snyigs ma ste/ snyigs ma lnga dang / ldan pa'i sems can gzhung rgya chen po mi rtogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nyon cig zla bzang dbang bskur don/ /rnam pa bdun dang rnam gsum mchog /rtsa yi kun spyod rtsol ba ni/ /mdor bstan pa yis khyod la bshad/ /bcom ldan 'das zhes pa la/ rgya gar gyi skad du bha ga wān zhes pa ste de ni/ skal ba dang ldan pa'am/ bcom pa dang ldan pa la yang 'jug pa las/ dang po'i dbang du byas nas rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ dbang phyug dang ni gzugs bzang dang / /grags dang dpal dang ye shes dang //brtson 'grus phun sum tsho gis pa ste/ /drug rnams bha ga zhes brjod do/ /rnam dag sum —134—

cu rtsa drug khams/ /sa sogs rdo rje btsun mo ste/ /de rnams dbang phyug sogs yon tan/ /drug po de rnams bha gar grags/ /zhes te bsam tan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'bras bu dbang phyug dang / bzod pa'i 'bras bu gzugs bzang dang /tshul khrims kyi snyan par grags pa dang / sbyin pa'i dpal 'byor dang shes rab kyi ye shes dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'bras bu brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa ste/ de la dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa ni zad par dang zil gnon la sogs pa'am dbang bcu dang ldan pa lta bu ste/ brtan g.yo thams cad la 'dod dgur sgyur ba'o/ /gzugs bzang ni mtshan dang dpe byad do/ /dpal ni yongs su dag pa'i zhing khams mchod pa'i yo byad dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa'o/ /grags pa ni 'gro ba mtha' dag gi mchod 'os su gyur pas bstod pa'o//ye shes ni stobs bcu dang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la sogs pa'o//brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa ni 'bad rtsol med cing rnam par rtog pa med par phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sems can rnams la gang la gang 'dul gyi 'gro don 'khrul pa med cing dus las ma yol bar 'jug pa ste/ 'di lta bu'i skal ba drug ni dngos sangs rgyas rnams kho na la mnga' la/ rjes mthun pa byang chub sems dpa' la yang yod cing / gzhan rnams la med do/ /gang tshangs pa dang dbang phyug la sogs pa de dag la ni/ dbang phyug drug yod par grags mod kyi/'khor ba nyid na 'phral gyi bya ba la cung zad dbang 'byor ba sogs/ dbang phyug dang lus dang dpal dang grags pa dang mngon shes dang / bya ba la 'jug pa'i brtson 'grus nyi tshe ba dang ldan pa kho na yin no/ /—135—

gnyis pa'i dbang du byas nas dgyes pa'i rdo rje las/ yang na nyon mongs la sogs bdud/ /'joms phyir bcom ldan 'das zhes bya/ /zhes pa ltar/bdud bzhi bcom pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ /de la bdud bzhi ni/ theg pa thun mong ltar na/ gang la ltos nas 'bras bu'i phyogs nye bar bzung ba'i/ nyer len gyi phung po lnga ni/ phung po'i bdud yin la/ rgyu'i phyogs bzung ba'i khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa ni nyon mongs pa'i bdud dang / phung po dang nyon mongs pa de rnams nyid kyi 'jig cing 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin can gyi mi rtag pa'i mtshan nyid ni 'chi bdag gi bdud dang / 'dod pa'i khams kyi lha'i gdon gyi gtso bo/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi bdag po/ gang gi mthu las 'dod pa'i khams kyi sems can rnams dge ba la g.yel zhing chags bral gyi lam las phyir zlog par byed pa ni lha'i bu'i bdud ste/ de rnams bdud bzhi dngos yin la/ phyogs mthun tsam sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi gzhom par byed pa'i dbang du byas na/ yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus dang / ma rig bag chags kyi sa dang/ bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i 'chi 'pho dang / dbang sgyur ba'i sred pa la sogs pa rnams kyang rim bzhin phung po'i bdud la sogs par sbyar ro/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i theg pa 'dir yang de dag khas len zhing lhag por bshad pa ni/ lus kyi thig le'i sgrib pa ni phung bo'i bdud dang / ngag gi thig le'i sgrib pa ni nyon mongs pa'i bdud dang / yid kyi thig le'i sgrib pa ni 'chi bdag gi bdud dang / /bzhi pa'i thig le'i sgrib pa ni lha'i bu'i bdud do/ /de dag kyang gnas skabs bzhi'i mtshan nyid can yin zhing / sad pa'i gnas skabs kyi snod bcud du snang ba ni/ lus kyi chos rnams phung sogs kyi —136—

dngos po rags shos yin pa'i phyir dang / gang nyon mongs ma rnams kyi dmigs pa'i yul ni/ yid ngor snang ba'i phung sogs phra ba yin zhing / de nyid rmi lam gyi gnas skabs dang 'brel ba dang / thig le rlung gis skyod pa las snang ba'am brjod 'dod kyi rtog pa dang 'brel ba'i phyir/ nyon mongs pa ni ngag gi chos su sbyor ba'i phyir dang / 'dus byas skye 'jig thams cad kyang rnam par rtog pa'i skye 'jig gi byed pa can yin zhing / yid kyi thig le'i dri ma yang rnam par rtog pa yin pas dang / tshogs drug rags pa 'gags pa rmongs pa'i gnas skabs ni gnyid 'thug po dang 'chi ba la sogs pa gnad gcig pa'i phyir dang / bzhi pa thig le 'pho ba la chags pa ni/ de thams cad kyi dpung gnyen yin zhing / 'dzag bde'i sred pa mngon gyur ni bdud sdig to can gyi byed las dngos kyang yin pa'i phyir rim pa bzhin du sbyar ro/ /bdud de thams cad kyang rang gi sems kyi dri ma yin zhing / spang bar bya rgyu bden pa'i dngos po can du med de/ sems 'khrul pa'i snang ba tsam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang ting nge 'dzin gyi sa bcu gnyis pa'i mthar/bdud bzhi dngos rnams bcom pa yin la/ bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i snga logs su bdud bzhi'i char gtogs thams cad kyang bcom pa yin te/ gang 'di'i 'khrul pa'i cha shas thams cad yongs su sangs pa ni bcom pa'o/ /de ltar skal ldan dang bcom ldan gyi yon tan gang la mnga' ba de ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das so/ /des bka' stsal pa ni/ legs par rab tu nyon la yid la bzung zhig dang / zhes pa'i tshul gyi snod kyi skyon gsum spangs nas nyan par gdams pa'o/ /de yang kyai zla ba bzang po zhes zhu ba po nyid yin pa'i phyir na/ dngos su zla —137—

bzang kho na smos kyang / shugs la 'khor thams cad la nyan par gdams pa'o//de ltar nyan par gdams nas/ mdor bstan pa'i sgo nas khyod la bshad par bya'o zhes bshad par zhal gyi bzhes pa'o/ /gang zhig bshad par bya ba ni/ byis 'jug gi dbang bdun dang / dbang gong ma las 'jig rten pa gsum dang / mchog ste 'jig rten las 'das pa bzhi pa ste/ dbang bcu gcig po rnams kyi don bshad par bya'o/ /zhes pa yin la/ rtsa yi kun spyod rtsol ba ni zhes pa la/ rtsa ni rtsa drug dang / 'khor lo drug la sogs pa ste/ gang las byang chub kyi sems 'bab pa'i rtsa dang rlung rnams so/ /de rnams kyi kun tu spyod pa ni/ bya ba dang byed pa'i dngos po ste/ rtsa rnams su rlung dang thig le rgyu zhing spyod pa'i tshul gzhi lam gyis bsdus pa dang / rnam par dag tshul 'bras bus bsdus pa rnams so/ /rtsol ba'i skad dod/ā ya ma ni 'gog pa la 'jug ste/ rtsa de rnams su kun tu spyod pa 'gog pa'o 'dir rtsol ba ni/ srog rtsol gyi yan lag gi rtsol ba la byed pa ni mi legs te/yan lag de dbang bzhi pa'i don dngos ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag tu las rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya 'gags pa mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po'i ye shes/ skad cig dang po nas brtsams te/ mthar phyin pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bar du/ las rlud 'gag bzhin pa dang / 'gags zin pa mngon du gyur pa'i ye shes rnams bstan pa yin no/ /skabs 'dir mkhas pa kha cig /rnam pa bdun dang rnam gsum mchog ni/ zhus pa'i lan yin la/ rtsa'i kun spyod rtsol ba ni ma zhus par gsungs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ni mi legs te/ de ni zhus pa'i don gyi gtso bo dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes kyi sgrub pa yin pa'i phyir —138—

ro//tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis ston pa bcom ldan 'das dang zhu ba po zla ba bzang po dang / chos dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes nges pa'i don rnams dngos su bstan zhing / gnas dang 'khor phun sum tshogs pa'ang shugs la bstan pa/ de'i phyir gleng gzhi'i tshul du bshad dgos so/ /snyam na/ rgyud 'di ni rgyud rgyas pa'i bar skabs nas phyung ba yin pa'i phyir/ tshigs bcad 'di dag gleng gzhi ni ma yin la/phun sum tshogs pa lnga dang sbyar ba ni spros te bshad pa yin mod kyang de ltar 'chad pa mi 'gal lo/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ ston pas bya ste phung po sa /shes rab pha rol phyin tshul bzhin/ /chos ston dpal ldan 'bras sbungs tu/ /de bzhin gsang sngags tshul rab gsungs/ /gang la gnas nas ston pa ni/ /su yis rgyud bstan ci zhig bstan/ /gnas ni gang du 'jig rten pa'i/ /'khor ni su yi rgyu ci yis//bya rgod phung po'i ri chen po/ /theg pa wo po bla na med/ khres rab pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bstan/ /de nas gcig tu mchod rten cher/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /byang chub sems dpa' sogs rnams kyis/ /thabs cig de bzhin ba/zhegs pa bzhugs/ /nam mkha' bem min shin tu dwangs/ /go skabs med par rab tu gsal/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i khang pa gnas/ /chos kyi dbyings dang yid 'ong par/ /rgyud bstan skyes bu rnams kyi ni//bsod nams ye shes dgos pa'o/ /e yig nam mkha'i snang ba che/ /chos kyi dbyings su rab tu grags/ /wa yig bde bar gshegs pa'i tshogs/ /e yig rnam par yang dag gnas/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di'i tshig bcad dang po'i don la/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rjes su gsang sngags bstan to zhes dus snga phyir —139—

'chad pa don min la/ bya rgod phung por shes rab pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan du gsungs pa bzhin du/ dpal ldan 'bras sbungs chos kyi dbyings kyi gnas su yang / gsang sngags kyi rgyud gsungs pa rnams phun sum tshogs pa lnga dang ldan no zhes dpe don du sbyar ba yin no/ /gang la gnas pa dang /gnas gang du zhes gnas phun sum tshogs pa'i dbye ba gnyis 'byung ba ni/ sems can spyi mthun gyi snang ba dang / dag pa'i 'khor rnams kyi snang wa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ 'bras sbungs kyi mchod rten la gnas nas/ e yig rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin gzhal med khang gi dbus na seng ge'i khri'i gnas su'o//ston pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa ste/ 'di la kha cig chags bral rab tu byung ba'i rnam pa kho nas so/ /zhes smra ba ni snying po med cing / sku rnam pa thams cad pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'ga' zhig la de ltar snang ba mi 'gal mod kyi/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor yang nas yang du gsungs pa'i phyir/ gtso bor 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi rnam pa nyid do/ /de lta bu'i ston pa ni wa yig bde ba chen po yin pas/ chos ni e yig la wa yig gnas pa'i don bde stong zung 'jug gi rgyud bstan pa yin zhing / bsdud pa po ni phyag na rdo rje ste/ thabs kyi phyogs las thugs kyi sems dpa'o/ /'khor ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang khro bo dang lha mo'i dkyil 'khor pa dang lha'i mchog dang klu sogs khams gsum gyi bdag po rnams dang thabs cig pa'o/ /dgos pa ni skye dgu rnams kyis bsod nams dang ye shes kyi 'bras bu bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i slad du'o/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /de ltar na zhus pa dang bshad par zhal gyi —140—

bzhes pa'i tshig bcad gnyis po 'di dag la 'grel chen don dam bsdus par/spros pa'i bshad pa du ma mdzad te/ spro na de nyid du blta bar bya'o/ /gsum pa la/ rgyud don phyin ci ma log pa rtogs pa'i thabs bshad/dbang rnam pa bcu gcig gi dag dbye mdor bstan/ mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ rgyud don tshang la ma nor bar ston pa'i rjod byed ngos bzung / phyin ci ma log pa'i nges don brjod byar bstan/brjod bya rjod byed gnyis 'dus kyi rim pa bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyud du mdor bstan rnam gsum dang / rgyas par bshad pa rnam gsum 'gyur/ /rab tu mdor bstan mdor bstan che/ /rab tu rgyas par bshad pa gzhan/ /mdor bstan rgyas par bshad pa nyid/ /rgyud don yang dag bsdus par brjod/ /rab tu mdor bstan rgyas bshad pa/ /dka' 'grel tshig ni 'byed pa'o/ /mdor bstan chen po rgyas bshad pa/ /rgyas 'grel thams cad don ston byed/ /de ni mngon shes thob rnams kyis/ /bya yi mkhas rnams kyis min nyid/ /de ltar mtha' drug rnams kyis dag/ces gsungs te tshig bcad 'di dag gi don la/ dus 'khor zhabs kyi mdzad par grags pa'i 'grel ba 'gyur rnying las/ mdor bstan e waX gi yi ge la bshad pa sogs dang / 'ga' zhig rgyud nyid kyi mdor bstan rgyas bshad sogs yin nam snyam du sems pa ni/ de ni mngon shes thob rnams kyis/ /bya yi mkhas rnams kyis min nyid/ /ces gsungs pas/ mngon shes med pa'i mkhas pas rgyud rtsom pa'i dogs pa med pa'i phyir/ shin tu mi 'brel lo/ /de ltar na bsdus pa'i rgyud dang 'brel ba la/ mdor bstan la sogs pa rnam pa gsum dang / rtsa rgyud dang 'brel —141—
