mkhyen pa ma thob pas/ 'gyur med las skyes the tshom ste/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar bde ste/rgya skad dang yang mthun no/ /de yang thams cad mkhyen pa'i gnas ma thob pas de 'gyur med las skyes ma skyes the tshom za bas/ 'dzag med kyi lam la mi gus so snyam na/ re zhig de zhog cig de ltar yang 'khor ba'i chags pa nyid las kyang / thig le ma 'phos pa ni/ dga' ba phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan la 'phos pa na yid bde ba min zhing / lang tsho la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa nyams par byed pa mngon sum gyis grub pa'i phyir na/ bde ba nyams pa'i chags bral nyid du mi bya'o/ /da ni de las 'phros pa'i tshul bshad pa/ gsum pa sgrib pa'i gtso bo 'pho ba'i nyes dmigs bstan pa ni/ 'phos pa las ni chags bral 'gyur/ /chags bral las ni sdug bsngal 'byung / /sdug bsngal skyes bu'i khams zad byed/ /zad pa las ni 'chi bar brjod/khre nas slar yang de rnams kyi/ /srid pa'o srid las slar 'chi 'pho/ /de ltar sems can gyi srid pa/ /chags bral las byung gzhan du min/ /de phyir 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /'pho ba'i chags pa rnam par spangs/ /gang gis 'gyur med bde bar 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor 'khor ba bcings pa yis/ /'dod ldan yang ni chags bral bar/ /'dod pa'i bstan bcos su mi 'dod/ /bdag gis brjod pa'i rgyud du slar//rnal 'byor pa zhes sdug bsngal 'dod/ /ces gsungs te/ de yang thig le 'phos pas/ tshad med bzhi nyams/ nyon mongs bzhi skye'o/ /'dod chags nyams pas sdig ste gang phyir shin tu sdug ma la ni zhe sdang skye/ /sdang las gti mug 'di las rang gi rdo rje lhung las sems ni rtag rmongs te/ /mchog min ma lus bza' dang btung ba la sogs yul gzhan dag la rab tu 'jug /de yis sems la co dris —291—

bde ba nyams shing skye ba drug tu 'khor bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de yang chags dga'i bde ba 'phel ba'i bdag nyid snying rje/ zhe sdang nyams pa'i bdag nyid byams pa/gti mug zad pa'i bdag nyid dga' ba/ mi 'gyur ba'i bdag nyid ni btang snyoms so/ /de yang thig le 'phos pa nyid na sdig pa ste snying rje zad pa dang / sdug ma la yid 'ong gi mdza' ba nyams pa'i zhe sdang dang / dga' ba nyams shing rmongs pas gti mug dang / bdag tu rmongs pa btang snyoms zad pa'i mtshan nyid can gzhan la sdang ba dang 'gyur ba la srid pa rnams rim pas 'gyung ngo / /de lta bu'i ma rig pa nyon mongs pa de las ni 'du byed sogs yan lag bcu gnyis kyi 'khor lo skor bar 'gyur ro//'dir 'khor ba 'jug pa'i tshul ni/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba bcu gnyis te/ de yang rtsa ba'i ma rig pa ni 'gyur bde'i bag chags bshad ma thag pa de yin la/ de'i dbang las byung ba nus pa bzhi dang / des skyed pa'i bsam pa bzhi'o/ /de dag kyang dngos po rnams gsal bar byed pa 'dod pa dang / yid 'jug par byed pa bya ba dang / don nges shing rtog pa dang yul gyi rnam pa 'dres par byed pa ye shes dang /de rang shugs kyi legs pa stong par byed pa ni bzhi pa'i nus pa ste/ bag chags gsar pa bskyed cing rnying pa gsos 'debs par byed pa'i sems so/ /'chi kha'i dus kyi dge ba'i bsam pa ni zhi ba'i bsam pa ste/ snying stobs kyi yon tan lha'i skye bar 'gro ba'i rgyu'o/ /de dus kyi mi dge ba'i bsam pa drag po ni mun pa'i bsam pa ste/mun pa'i yon tan dmyal ba dang / de dus kyi mi dge ba 'bring po ni rdul gyi bsam pa rdul gyi yon tan/ 'byung po dang / de dus kyi dge mi dge 'dres pa ni/ 'dres pa'i bsam pa ste yon tan gsum 'dres pa/ mi dang dud 'gro'i skye ba'i rgyu'o/ /de las —292—

'bras bu'i skye ba ni sad pa'i gnas skabs la gtso bor spyod pa dmyal ba lha min gnyis/ rmi lam la gtso bor spyod pa lha dang yi dwags gnyis/ gnyid 'thug la gtso bor spyod pa mi/ bzhi pa la gtso bor spyod pa dud 'gro ste/ gnas skabs bzhi la 'gro ba drug sbyar ba/ rgyu dang 'bras bu phan tshun rgyas btab kyi tshul lo/ /de lhar na skye ba snga ma'i nus pa bzhi dang bsam pa bzhi las/ 'chi gar stong pa la zhugs pa yan chad ni ma rig pa dang / mngal du nying 'tshams sbyor bzhin pa las kyis 'khrid pa ni 'du byed/ /nying mtshams sbyar ma thag pa'i shes pa ni rnam shes/ khams drug 'phel ba ni ming gzugs/ dbang po dod pa ni skye mched drug des yul phra mo 'dzin pa'i nus pa rnyed pa ni reg pa/ yul nyams su myong ba ni tshor ba ste/ mngal du zla ba bdun pa man chad do/ /srid pa'i longs spyod bde sdug la blang dor du sred pa ni sred pa/ yan lag g.yo ba ni len pa/ btsas pa'i gnas skabs su rlud rgyu ba ni srid pa/ de nas brtsams te byis pa dang lang tsho'i bar ni skye ba/ rgas pa dang 'chi ba'i gnas skabs ni rga shi ste/ rdo rje snying 'grel las/ 'chi bar ma rig 'jug pa yi/ /'du byed de nas skye bar 'byung / /zhes dang / mi bskyod la sogs gang zhugs pa/ de nas rnam shes srid pa'o/ /de nas ming dang gzugs 'gyur te/ khams drug bdag nyid de nas so/ /zhes dang / reg na mig la sogs pa dang / gzugs sogs lhan cig sbyor ba'o/ /de nas tshor ba skye 'gyur te/ /zhes dang / srid pa'i longs spyod bdag nyid ni/de las sred pa skye bar 'gyur/ /rkang dang lag pa rkyang ba ni/ /de nas nye bar len par brjod/ /byis pa srog dag 'byung ba ni/ /de nas srid pa skye bar 'gyur/ /byis pa rtag tu brjod pa ni/ /de bas skye ba'i 'du shes so/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di ni skye —293—

ba gnyis la sogs pas rdzogs pa'i lugs yin la/ mngal gyi zla ba dang po ma rig pa sogs/ zla ba re rten 'brel re la sbyar ba ni/ skye ba gcig la bcu gnyis ka tshang ba'i dbang du mdzad pa ste/ zhib par gzhan du rtogs par bya'o/ /de yang byang chub kyi sems 'phos pa las ni chags pa ste dga' ba'i bde ba dang bral bar 'gyur la/chags bral las ni sems sdug bsngal du 'byung zhing / sdug bsngal gyis skyes bu'i lus kyi khams zad par byed la/ khams zad las ni rga ba dang / na ba dang tha mar 'chi bar brjod do/ /shi ba las slar yang de rnams kyi bar do'i srid pa rgyud nas skye ba'i srid par mtshams sbyor ro/ /srid pa skye ba bzung ba las slar yang 'chi 'pho ba sogs/ 'khor lo ltar 'khor ba ste/ de ltar sems can rnams kyi srid pa 'khor ba ni/ rtsa ba 'dzag bde khams 'phos pa'i chags bral las 'byung bas/ 'dzag bde las gzhan du rgyu'i gtso bo yod pa min no/ /de'i phyir rnal 'byor pa lam la brtson pa dang po'i las can nyid nas kyang / thabs 'bad pa thams cad kyis 'pho ba'i chags pa rnam par spangs te/ thig le 'gyur med kyi sgrub pa la brtson par bya'o//rnal 'byor pa gang zhig 'khor ba'i rgyu 'dzag bde bkag cing bcings pa yis te/ 'di lta bu'i thabs gang gi sgrub na 'gyur med kyi bde ba thob par 'gyur ro/ /theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pas de ltar bya dgos par ma zad/ 'dod ldan 'jig rten pa'i bde ba tsam don du gnyer ba nyon mongs kyi gnyen po'i chos khas mi len pa mu stegs byed la sogs pa rnams kyang ni/ dbang phyug la sogs pas byas pa'i 'dod pa'i bstan bcos su yang / rdzas dang sngags dang byed bcings dang / yi ge sogs thabs sna tshogs kyi/ bde ba ma nyams pa don du gnyer gyi/ bde ba nyams pa'i chags bral mi —294—

'dod cing don du mi gnyer na/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag gis brjod pa ste gsungs pa'i rgyud du lta smos kyang ci dgos pa las/ slar yang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos la brten pa/ nyon mongs las grol bar byed pa'i chos la zhugs pa dang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i lam sgom pa dang / sangs rgyas par khas 'che ba'i rnal 'byor pa dag sdug bsngal gyi rgyu 'pho ba'i bde ba ci'i phyir 'dod par byed ces drag tu bkyon pa'o/ /bzhi pa nyes dmigs can gyi 'gyur bde 'gags mtshams ni/ khu ba mi 'gyur rang bzhin gyis mchog tu mi 'gyur sgrub par bya/ brten ni 'pho ba thob pa na/rten pa 'dod chags bral ba nyid/ /ces pa la/ brten khu ba mi 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin te thabs kyi dngos pos/ mthar thug mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba bsgrub par bya dgos te/ de las bzlog ste/ brten khu ba 'pho ba'i gnas skabs thob pa na/rten pa'i sems kyang dga' ba'i 'dod chags dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /rten dang brten pa legs rdzogs pa/ /ji srid 'gyur med nyid du 'gro/ /sems kyi 'gyur med nyid thob na/ /rten dang brten pa'i mtshan nyid med/ /ces pa la/ ji srid de ji tsam du/ brten thig le dkar dmar legs par yongs su rdzogs par mi 'gyur ba'i thig ler gyur pa dang / rten pa sems mi 'gyur ba'i skad cig legs par rdzogs pa de srid na/ lus ngag yid gsum thams cad 'gyur med gcig pu kho na nyid du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /sems kyi gnas lugs 'gyur med kyi go 'phang nyid thob pa na/sngar bshad pa ltar lus kyi chos rnams kyang sems la thim pa'i phyir/ brten lus dang rten pa sems kyi mtshan nyid so sor nges pa'i dbye ba med ste/ sku dang ye shes —295—

zung du 'jug par gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /rten brten pa 'gags tshul ni/ rnam pa thams cad rang bzhin 'dzin zhes pa'i skabs su bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa zung 'jug gnyis med kyi mtshan nyid rgyas par bshad pa la/ gnyis med ye shes kyi sku'i dkyil 'khor ngos bzung ba/ de'i khyad chos la mtha' bcad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'gyur med las byung sku yi ni/ /mdzod sbu'i 'khor lo son pa'i yang / /ā li kā li mnyam sbyor ba/ /hūX yig mi 'dod mi yi bdag /ces pa ste/ de yang 'gyur med kyi bde ba rdzogs pa las byung ba'i zung 'jug sku ste/ phung khams so drug thams cad sgrib bral dkyil ge rgor gyi ge rgor lor gyur pa ni/ dus kyi ge rgor lo dang / dgyes pa rdo rje dang /'khor lo sdom pa dang / gsang ba 'dus pa dang / sgyu 'phrul drwa ba la sogs pa du mas bsnyad pa ste/ sku 'di'i rgyu la rtog pas sgom pa'i ā li las byung ba zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / kā li las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam par sbyor ba dang / hūX yig la sogs pa sa bon nam phyag mtshan dang gcig tu 'dres pa las skyed pa ni mi 'dod de/ mdzod sbu'i 'khor lor son pa'i byang chub kyi sems spyi bor gang ba las/dkar cha mi 'gyur ba'i thig ler rim pa'i zla ba dang / dmar cha yang der thim pa'am nor bur thim pa'i nyi ma dang / las rlung dang yid sogs rnam shes 'gags pa'i sa bon phyag mtshan dang gcig tu 'dres pa ste/ 'gyur ba med pa'i mngon byang lnga las byung zhing 'khrungs pa'o/ /'dir 'gyur med ces pa las 'phros nas 'gyur med lnga'am drug gi rang bzhin e baX zung 'jug gi don rgyas par bshad na legs por 'gyur la/ gzhan yang don 'di rgyas par mtha' chod pa dang bcas pa mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes grub pa las blta zhing / rgyud sde gzhan rnams las 'byung ba —296—

mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa las mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa spro ba dang /ā li kā li nye rgyu mngon byang lnga la sogs pa yang / don 'di nyid gsal bar byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa de'i khyad chos la mtha' bcad pa la bzhi ste/ rgyu 'bras zung 'jug tu bstan pa dang / mtha' gnyis dang bral bar bstan pa dang / rgyas btab spangs pa bstan pa dang / gnyis med ye shes kyi sku'i khyad par gsal por bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ stong pa las byung gzugs brnyan rgyu/ /mi 'gyur las skyes bde ba 'bras rgyu ni 'bras bus rgyas btab cing / /'bras bu rgyu yis rgyas btang pa'o/ /stong nyid gzugs brnyan 'dzin pa rgyu/ /snying rje 'gyur med 'dzin pa 'bras/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /byang chub sems de mi 'pho ba'o/ /zhes pa la bde stong zung 'jug tu bstan pa dang / stong pa dang bde ba rgyu 'bras kyi gzugs su gzhag par rtogs te/spros pa'i mtshan ma thams cad dang bral ba'i stong pa las byung ba ste stong pa'i rang bzhin gyi gzugs brnyan stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po ni rgyu'i tshul yin la/ thig le mi 'gyur ba las skyes pa ste mi 'gyur ba las grub pa'i bde ba ni 'bras bu zhes bya ste/ rgyu stong nyid de nyid 'bras bu bde ba r+ṣa po'i ngo bor gyur pa'i phyir/ rgyu la 'bras bu'i rgyas btab pa dang / 'bras bu bde chen de nyid rgyu stong gzugs rnam pa thams cad par 'char ba'i phyir/ 'bras bu la rgyu yis rgyas btab pa'o/ /yang stong nyid snying rje dbyer med (〈〈lbo〉〉rdo pa )rgyu 'bras zung 'jug ni yang dag pa'i stong nyid gzugs brnyan gyi mtshan nyid 'dzin pa ste gzugs brnyan gyi rnam par 'char ba de rgyu yin la/ snying rje chen po thig le 'gyur med kyi bde ba'i mtshan nyid 'dzin pa ni —297—

'bras bu ste/ de lta bu'i stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa ni/ don dam byang chub kyi sems zhes bya ste/ de ni gdod ma'i chos dbyings yin pa'i phyir/ rang gi ngo bo 'pho 'gyur med pas mi 'pho ba'o/ /de 'dra ba'i stong nyid snying rje dbyer med de ni gdod ma nas grub pa'i mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba yin yang / rnal 'byor pas ji srid mi 'gyur ba'i thig le ma grub kyi bar du/ rnal 'byor pa de nyid kyis mngon du ma gyur zhing ma rtogs la/ mngon du gyur pa na de thob pa'o/ /stong nyid de la mnyam par ba 'ag pas mi 'gyur ba de/ mngon sum du thob par snang ba'i phyir/ stong nyid kyi cha la rgyu dang bde ba'i cha la 'bras bur bshad pa yin gyi/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba med pas rgyu 'bras kyi dngos por gzhag tu med do/ /des na stong nyid rgyur byas nas bde ba 'bras bur dngos su byas pa min yang / stong nyid rtogs pa'i lam bden las bde ba rtogs pa'i lam bden skye ste/ dper na/ dung gi mdog dbyibs rags pa mthong ba la dmigs nas/ yun srings te zhib mor bltas pa las/ khyad par mtha' dag phyi nas rtogs pa na/ dung gi mdog dbyibs la mi 'dra ba gnyis rgyu 'bras su med kyang / dung mthong ba'i shes pa skad cig ma dang po rags pa'i rnam pa tsam 'dzin pa de las/ shes pa skad cig ma phyi ma phra ba'i rnam pa 'dzin pa skye ba na/ yul la'ang snga phyi rgyu 'bras su ming btags bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ mya ngan 'das pa bral ba'i gzugs/ /'khor ba las 'das mi 'gyur ba/ /de dag sbyor ba gnyis med mchog /rtag dang chad las nges par grol/ /zhes pa la/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' dang bral bar byed pa'i chos ni stong gzugs yin te/ sku sna tshogs pa ston pas chad pa'i myang 'das la mi gnas pa'i —298—

phyir ro/ /'khor ba'i mtha' las 'das par byed pa ni mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba ste/spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i rnam pa nyid dang / 'khor ba'i rgyu 'gyur bde ba log pa'i mtshan nyid kyi phyir ro/ /stong gzugs ni rnam pa thams cad pa dang /dngos po spangs pa'i phyir rtag mtha' las nges par grol zhing bde ba ni ngo bo mi 'gyur bas rtag cing / nyams su myong bar yod pas chad mtha' las grol ba ste/ rgyu mtshan mtshungs pa'i phyir gzugs kyis kyang rtag mtha' dang mi 'gyur bas kyang chad mtha' yang gnon te/ gzugs dang bde ba de dag mnyam par sbyor ba ni/ gnyis med zung 'jug mchog ste/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /dngos med las byung mtshan nyid phyir/ /gzugs ni dngos po med pa min/ /dngos po las byung mtshan nyid phyir/ /'gyur ba med pa dngos po min/ /zhes pa la/ stong gzugs ni rdul phra rab spangs pas/ dngos por med kyang dngos po med pa'i dbyings las rang byung rang shar ba'i ye shes kyi gzugs kyi mtshan nyid can gyi phyir te byung ba dang shar bas na/dngos po med pa yang min no/ /'gyur med kyi bde ba ni/ dmigs pa med pa'i phyir dang / dngos po thig le rnams 'gags pa las byung ba'i mtshan nyid kyi phyir/ dngos po min la bde ba chen po nyid du rtag par yod pa'i phyir dngos med kyang min no//dngos po dngos med yang dag sbyor/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gnyis med mchog/gzugs dang gzugs min rnam par grol/ /pra phab me long la bzhin no/ /zhes pa la/ dngos po dngos med las grol ba'i stong gzugs don dam pa'i dngos po dang bde ba don dam pa'i dngos med gnyis bde stong yang dag par spyor ba ste/ nam yang dbye ba med pa'i phyir/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor zung 'jug gnyis su med pa'i mchog go/—299—

de bzhin du rdul phra rab sogs 'dus byas kyi chos med pas gzugs kyi chos las rnam par grol ba dang / ye shes 'dus byas kyi snang ba rab 'byams kyi phyir/gzugs min las rnam par grol ba ste/ pra phab pa'i me long la rkun po'i gzugs brnyan shar na/ sha rus la sogs pa med pas gzugs min zhing / mdog dbyibs kyi rnam par gnas pas gzugs min min pa bzhin no/ /gzugs ni srid par mi 'ong ste/ /'gyur med mya ngan 'das mi 'gro /phan tshun 'khyud pa zhi ba ste/ /ma ning gi ni go 'phang mchog /ces pa la/ stong gzugs ni 'khor ba'i lus ngag yid gsum las 'das pa'i phyir dang / stong nyid yin pa'i phyir 'dis srid par mi 'ong la/'gyur med ni bde ba chen po dang thams cad rig pa yin pa'i phyir/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i mthar mi 'gro ba'o/ /gong du mya ngan 'das pa bral ba'i gzugs sogs dang / 'dir bshad pa gnyis sbyor tshul go bzlog pa ste/ des na stong ga /zugs kyi ldog cha nas kyang 'khor 'das kyi mtha' gnyis ka gnon la/ bde ba'i ldog chas kyang mtha' gnyis ka gnon no/ /de lta bu'i phyir na/ gzugs dang 'gyur med gnyis ka la gnyis ka phan tshun 'khyud pa ste/ 'bral mi shes pa ni spros pa thams cad zhi zhing / thabs kyang yin la shes rab kyang yin pa'i phyir/ rdo rje sems dpa' ma ning gi go 'phang mchog go /'dir 'khor 'das dang rtag chad dang yod med gzugs dang gzugs min te/ spros pa'i mtha' brgyad spangs pa/ rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i sku rnam pa thams cad pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / rnam pa thams cad pa'i sgra dbyengs su 'char ba gsung dang / chos nyid bde ba chen po'i ye shes 'gyur ba med pa ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i thugs rnams ming 'dogs dang ldog chas dbye ba ma —300—

gtogs ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba med pa'i ye shes ni zung 'jug go /de ltar yang /lus ni dwangs shing rdul phran nyams pa nam mkha' dang mtshungs mtshan la sogs pa rnams kyis rab rdzogs 'gyur/ /sna tshogs 'jig rten gsum po nyid ni dngas zhing sgrib pa rnam par bral ba rmi lam bzhin du snang / /skad ni kun nas chad pa med cing du ma'i skad gzhan dag gis g.yin gyi snying la 'jug pa ste/ /sems ni dam pa'i bde bas gang zhing mi g.yo thams cad dus su lhan cig skyes pas 'khyud pa'o/ /zhes so//de lta ba'i zung 'jug de la spros pa med cing gnyis chos rnams spangs pa yang zung 'jug gi don phyogs gcig go /gsum pa ni/ shes rab rgyu las ma byung zhing / /shes rab rgyu las byung ba 'bras/ khres rab rgyu las ma skyes phyir/ khres rab las skyes rgyu skyes min/ /de phyir ye shes rgyu skyes min/ khres rab ye shes bla na med/ /ces pa la/ las dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i shes rab kyi rgyu las ma byung zhing / stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo'i shes rab kyi rgyu las byung ba'i 'bras bu'i phyir/ stong gzugs kyi shes rab ma de yang rgyu las ma skyes pa'i phyir/ stong gzugs kyi shes rab ma la snyoms par zhugs pa las skyes pa'i bde ba de yang / rgyu las skyes pa min pas/ don dam pa'i shes rab ye shes de ni/ shes rab ye shes bla na med pa yin te/ rgyu las skyes pa min par rang byung gdod ma'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir stong gzugs dang bde chen gyi gzhi mthun pa la/ stong gzugs las byung ba'i bde ba zhes zer ba ni/ gser dang bum pa'i gzhi mthun pa la gser las byung ba'i bum pa dang / seng ldeng dang phur bu'i gzhi mthun pa la/ seng ldeng las skyes pa'i phur bu zer ba bzhin du/ byung ba dang —301—

skyes pa ni de'i bdag nyid du yod pa'i ming ngo / /'on kyang rnam gzhag tsam gyi rgyu 'bras su yang 'jog ste/ gser gyi rgyu las bum pa sgrubs so zer ba bzhin dang / rgyu bu ram las byung ba'i ro mngar ba zhes pa bzhin no/ /stong gzugs la rgyu med par bshad pa ni 'jig rten kun rdzob tu na/ du snang la bud shing la sogs pa du ba'i rgyu med pa lta bu yin la/ don dam par na rang byung gdod ma'i stong nyid yin pa'i phyir/skyed pa'i rgyud gtan nas yod pa ma yin pas/ stong gzugs ngo bos kyang dngos por ma grub pa'o/ /'bras bu rgyu yis gzhan dang gzhan/ /phan tshun du ni rgyas btab med//ces pa la/ de bas na zung 'jug 'di ni rgyu 'bras rten 'brel thams cad las 'das pa'o/ /de don dam par 'bras bu bde ba dang rgyu stong gzugs gnyis po la rgyu 'bras kyi dbye ba med par ma zad/ yul yul can dang lus dang sems sogs rnam gzhag gzhan dang gzhan gyis kyang phan tshun du rgyas btab pa med do/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu thams cad gang / /de ni rten cing 'brel bar 'byung / /phan tshun rgya yis btab pa'i gzugs/ /skye min mya ngan 'das pa min/ /zhes pa la/ gang rgyu dang 'bras bu la sogs pa rgyas btab pa ste phan tshun bsre bar byed nus pa'i chos gang yin pa de ni/rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/ skye 'jig gi rang bzhin can kun rdzob bden pa yin la/ don la phan tshun rgya yis btab rgyu med kyang / 'khor 'das dbyer med rgyu 'bras dbyer med/ yul yul can dbyer med sogs gdod ma nas gnyis su med pa la/rgyas btab pa ltar tha snyad byas pa ni rgyas btab pa'i gzugs brnyan can te/ zung 'jug 'di ni rten 'brel dngos ma yin la/ don dam pa'i rang bzhin gyi phyir skye ba min zhing 'jig pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'ang min no/ /de ltar na kun rdzob 'khor —302—

ba'i skye 'gag med cing / don dam pa rtag tu skye ba dang / rtag tu mya ngan las 'das pa'ang yin te/ shes rab kun nas mya ngan 'das/ /skye ba mchog tu 'gyur ba med//rgyu dang 'bras bu rnam nges grol/ /phan tshun du ni rgyas btab med/ /ces pa la/ shes rab stong gzugs ni dngos po thams cad spangs pa'i phyir/ kun nas rtag tu zhig cing mya ngan las 'das pa'ang yin la/ mchog tu 'gyur ba med pa'i bde ba ni/ so sor rang gis rig cing / don dam srid gsum rnam pa thams cad pa 'dzin pa'i phyir/rtag par skye ba yang yin pas/ 'dus byas kyi rgyu dang 'bras bu las nges par rnam par grol ba'i phyir/ phan tshun du ni rgyas btab med de/ gnyis su ma grub pa'i phyir rgyas gdab bya 'debs byed so sor med pas so/ /ma skyes pa dang ma 'gags pa'i/khres bya gang zhig 'dir mthong ba/ /de ni rang sems gzhan ma yin/ /phyi yi shes bya rnam 'byed phyir/ /zhes pa la/ ma skyes pa dang ma 'gags pa'i rang bzhin gyi/shes bya stong gzugs gang zhig rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyis skabs 'dir mthong ba ni rang gi sems las ga kha phyi rol kyi don ma yin te/ 'di yis las snang phyi rol kyi don du shar ba'i shes bya rnams/ rnam par yed cing 'joms pa'i phyir/ dgyes pa'i rdo rje las kyang / mtho ris mi yul sa 'og rnams/ /skad cig gis ni gzugs gcig 'gyur/ /rang g.yin cha yi rnam rtog gis/ /gnon pa nyid ni nus pa min/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de phyir bdag gi bdag nyid la/ /'gar yang rgyas btab nus ma yin//ral gri chen po bdag nyid la/ /bdag nyid so yis gcod dam ci/ zhes pa la/don dam pa'i rgyu 'bras de gnyis sems nyid kyi ngo bor gcig pa de'i phyir/ bdag gis bdag nyid la rgyas btab par nus pa gnas skabs 'gar yang yod pa ma yin —303—

te/ gzhan du na/ ral gri chen po bdag nyid la/ ral gri bdag nyid kyi so yis gcod dam ci ste/ gcod par thal ba las mi gcod do/ /'o na phyag rgya chen po ni skye ba med pa yin pa'i phyir/ de'i bde ba sus kyang myong ba med do snyam na/ mo gzham bu mo dang 'grogs pas/ /rmi lam du ni bde 'gyur ltar/ /nam mkha' las byung gzugs brnyan ni/ /brten pas bdag la de bzhin no/ /rmi lam du mo gsham gyi bu mo dang 'grogs pa las/ bde ba thob pa 'gyur ba na/ mo gsham gyi bu mo med cing /de las bde ba skyes pa med kyang myong ba ltar/ nam mkha' ste spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i stong nyid las byung ba ste stong nyid las grub pa'i gzugs brnyan ni ston pas/ bdag la mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba 'byung ba yang skyes pa med kyang myong ba de bzhin no/ /rmi lam du mo gsham gyi bu mo dang 'grogs pa'i bde ba ni/ rgyu rkyen med kyang nyams su myong ba'i dper blangs kyi snang yang bden pas stong pa'i dper byas pa ni ma yin no/ /don 'di yang rgyas par mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes grub pa las 'gyung ngo / /de ltar na 'di dag gi bskyed bya skyed byed dang / rtogs bya rtogs byed sogs so so ba bkag pa yin gyi/ bod 'ga' zhig 'di dag gis rang rig bkag par sems pa ni/ grub mtha' ngan pa'i gdon gyis bslab pa'i rnam 'gyur tsam las phyogs su 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan tsam yang med do/ /bzhi pa ni/ shes rab ma yin thabs kyang min/ /'di ni lhan skyes shes rab bcas/ /kun nas bde ba rdzogs pa las/ /sgrib pa thams cad spangs pa ste/ /nam mkha' bzhin du gos pa med/ /yul dang dbang po spangs pa ni/ /kun nas 'byung po kun la gnas/ /bcad du med pa dbye ba spangs/ /zhes gsungs te/ zung 'jug gi —304—

ngo bo ni/ shes rab rkyang pa min la thabs rkyang pa yang min zhes pa dang / lhan skyes shes rab bcas shes pas thabs yin la shes rab yang yin zhes par 'gyur bas/'dir thabs shes kyi gtso bo gong du bshad pa ltar yin yang / thabs shes kyi rnam grangs mtha' dag kyang 'dir sbyar bar bya ste/ mdor bsdu na/ shes rab spros bral gyi stong nyid kho na rtogs pa'i ye shes kyang min la/ thabs dmigs bcas kyi snying rje kho na yang min te/ 'di ni lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba chen po stong gzugs kyi shes rab ma dang bcas pa ste ngo bo dbye ba med pa'o/ /bde ba chen pos ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes te/ sgrib pa dang bral bas bde ba (〈〈0zi〉chadang)rang gi rnam pa rdzogs pa'i rang snang las stobs bcu la sogs pa'i yon tan thams cad kun nas yongs su rdzogs pa'i rang bzhin te de yang bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs pas 'khor ba ji srid par gzhan don rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs pas ye shes dag pa'i zhing dang / 'khor dang / mchod pa dang / mtshan dpe can gyi sku dang rgyan dang / chos 'byung dang gzhal med khang la sogs pas 'gyur zhing / tshul khrims kyi tshogs rdzogs pas kha spyor gyi sku dang rang snang gi chos thams cad bde bar shar ba dang / rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyis shes bya thams cad rig pa'o/ /nyon mongs pa dang shes bya dang / snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa thams cad bral zhing spangs pa dang / nam mkha' ni sa la sogs pas gos pa med pa bzhin du/ rang snang du ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad sangs shing / kun rdzob gnyis snang gi chos gang gis kyang gos pa med pa dang / ye shes kyi zhing dang mchod pa rab 'byams rnams kyang /gzugs sogs skye mched drug gi yul spangs shing / sku rnam pa thams cad pa mtshan —305—

dang dpe byad kyis brgyan yang mig sogs dbang po spangs pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes nyid kyi mthu las/ yul dus kun nas 'byung po dngos po kun la/don dam par chos nyid kyi tshul gyis gnas shing / kun rdzob tu yang cig car lhun gyis grub par 'gro ba'i don mdzad pas khyab par gnas pa/ gcad cing bzhig tu med la/ gzung 'dzin sogs gnyis chos kyi dbye ba spangs pa/ sku dang ye shes dang zhing khams dang yon tan dang / longs spyod dang mdzad pa thams cad ngo bo gcig tu gnas pa'o/ /gsum pa rang bzhin 'gyur med kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas par bstan pa la gnyis te/ rang bzhin mchod pa chen po drug zhib mor bshad pa dang / don dam pa rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po rgyas par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rang byung rdo rje sems dpa' 'di/ /don chen mchog tu mi 'gyur ba/ /zhes mdor bstan pa'i don rgyas par bshad pa ni/ rdo rje mi phyed zhes par brjod/ /'dir ni don wo bcom ldan 'das/ /sems dpa' srid gsum gcig pa nyid/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur brjod par bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ skye 'gags thams cad dang bral zhing / yang dag pa'i gnas lugs la zhugs pa'i ye shes ni/ rgyu rkyen spangs pa'i phyir rang byung ste/ don dam pa mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs yin la/ phun sum tshogs pa yang yin zhing / nam du yang nyams par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir na don chen po ste/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum kun khyab kyi sems nyid bde ba chen po 'di ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ste/ bde ba chen po de nyid 'dus ma byas pa'i phyir gzhig tu med la/ rnam par rtog pas mi byed pa'i phyir rdo rje zhes par brjod de/—306—

de nyid bdud bzhi gdod ma nas bcom pa ste/ bdud bzhi'i dri mas kyang ma gos pas gnas lugs nyams pa med la/ skal pa drug gi bdag nyid phun sum tshogs pa'ang yin pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das te/ 'dir ni don chen po yang de nyid do/ /sems dpa' ni don dam pa'i 'dod pa dang / gzugs khams dang / gzugs med ces pa srid pa gsum mam/ sku gsung thugs gsum gyi srid pa'i snang ba rab 'byams te/stong gzugs rnam pa thams cad pa rnams ngo bo bde ba chen por ro gcig pa nyid do//gdod ma'i bde ba dang stong gzugs zung du 'jug pa ni/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de yang stong gzugs kyi srid gsum la/ sems dpa'i sgra don ji ltar 'jug snyam na/ bde ba chen po stong gzugs la sems pa'i phyir/sems pa'i yul gyi don yang yin zhing / satwa zhes pa bcud dam khu ba la yang 'jug pas/ don dam srid gsum 'di kun rdzob srid gsum gyi bcud du yod par yang dgongs so/ /'di ni mtshan brjod las/ 'dod pa chen po bde ba che/ /dga' ba chen po mgu ba che/ /zhes gsungs pas/ mchod chen bde ba'am 'dod pa chen po'o//'dir 'dod pa ni khu ba ste don dam pa'i thig le'o/ /bde ba ni mi 'gyur ba dang / dga' ba ni lhan cig skyes pa dang / mgu ba ni kun la khyab pa'i phyir te/brtan g.yo thams cad mgu bar byed pas so/ /'dod chags chen po sems dpa' che/ /sems can thams cad dga' bar byed/ /ces mdor bstan nas/ rgyas par bshad pa ni/ mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba rdzogs/ /sa rnams yongs su rdzogs pa yis//'dod chags chen po sems dpa' che/ /sems can thams cad dga' bar byed/ /de la sems dpa' chen po ni/ gsung rdo rje'i bdag nyid de/ srid pa gsum —307—

gyi 'dod chags sems rbon thams cad kyi rgyud la gnas pa/ de thams cad kyi chos nyid yin pa'i phyir chen po'o/ /'dod chags rgya mtsho'i chos nyid des ni/ dri ma'i cha las gzhi 'khor ba'i dus su/ ma grol ba'i sems can thams cad la 'dod yon rnams kyi dga' ba bskyed pa byed pa yin la/ dri ma spangs pa na rang snang thams cad bde ba chen por 'gyur bas rnam par grol ba'i sems can thams cad dga' bar byed pa'o/ /rang snang thams cad ji ltar bde bar 'gyur snyam na/ gong du bstan pa ltar sa bcu gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa yis/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba'i skad cig rdzogs pas so/ /de ltar na thig le dag pa gnyis ldan du byas pa ni sems dpa' yin la/ de nyid 'dod chags chen po'o/ /sems can thams cad dga' bar byed pa'i phyir/ chen po zhes bya ste/ de ltar na sems dpa' chen lnga'o/ /de bas na rdo rje sems dpa' ni zung 'jug gi bde ba'i ngo bo sems dpa' chen pos myong bya yin la/ sems dpa' chen po ni bde ba de la sems dpa' pa dang chags pa po'i ldog cha yin no/ /'dod chags ni rdul gyi chos yin pas/ gsung rdo rje'o/ /masno brjod las/ mchod pa chen po 'dod chags che/ /sems can thams cad dga' bar byed//ces so/ /byang chub sems dpa' zhe sdang che/ /nyon mongs zad pa dgra chen po//zhes mdor bstan nas rgyas par bshad pa ni/ byang chub la gnas sems dpa' ni/ /mi g.yo de phyir byang chub sems/ /nyon mongs la sogs zhe sdang tshogs/ /zhe sdang chen po dgra che ba/ /zhes gsungs te/ sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang ni zhe sdang gi rgya mtsho ste/ zhe sdang rgya mtsho'i chen po chos nyid ni/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ste/ chos nyid de dang mthun pa'i lam sgom pa'i ye shes ni/ gzung 'dzin gyi —308—

snang ba dang / rgyu ro rkyang gi rlung sogs 'gag par byed pas/ nyon mongs pa zad par byed cing bdud kyi dgra chen po'o/ /de yang spros bral dang rnam pa thams cad pa zung du 'jug pa'i stong nyid ni byang chub ste/ de la sems mnyam par gnas pa'i sems dpa' thig le'i bde ba ni zhu bde yin la/ zhu bde'i sems stong pa nyid du thims pas/ 'dzin cha 'gags pa'i spros bral de ni/ thugs rdo rje'i lam yin pas/ bde ba rgyu yin kyang / thugs kyi ldog cha ni spros bral gyi stong nyid do/ /'dis ni gzhi dus kyi thugs rdo rje spros pas nam yang mi g.yo ba de mngon du 'gyur la/ des na byang chub la sems dpa' thim pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya'o/ /des ni dug gsum la sogs pa nyon mongs pa thams cad dang / sogs pa'i sgras bdud bzhi rnams te rang gzhan la gnod cing zhe sdang ba'i tshogs de thams cad dbyings su 'joms pa'i phyir/ zhe sdang chen po dang bdud kyi dgra chen po zhes kyang bya'o/ /zhe sdang ni sdang byed de mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyi ming yin pas nyon mongs la sogs sdang ba'i tshogs/zhes sbyar na go bde'o/ /rlung ni sems kyi chos yin la/ zhu bde stong par ro mnyam pa ro rkyang gi rlung rtag tu 'gags par byas pas/ mngon du gyur pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir thugs dang / gsal stong gi ldog pa ni zhe sdang ste/ mtshan brjod las/ mchod pa chen po zhe sdang che/ /nyon mongs kun gyi dgra che ba/ /zhes so/ /dam tshig sems dpa' gti mug che/ /gti mug blo ste gti mug sel/ /zhes mdor bstan nas/ de nyid rgyas par bshad pa ni/ /dam tshig zla ba bdud rtsi yi/ khu ba 'pho med de za ba//dam tshig sems dpa'o rigs pa 'dis/ /gti mug blo ste gti mug sel/ /gti mug rgya mtsho'i chos nyid ni gti mug chen po ste/ de nyid rang dang rnam pa mtshungs pa'i —309—

lam dang bcas pa ni/ dam tshig sems dpa'o/ /gti mug rnam par mi rtog pa'i blo ye shes ni de lta bu ste/ chos rnams la rab tu rmongs pa'i cha dang / thig le 'pho ba'i gti mug mtha' dag sel bar byed do/ /zla ba bdud rtsi yi khu ba ni/ sems dpa' yin la/ dam tshig ni 'dus pa dang 'da' bar mi bya ba'i don gnyis ka la 'jug pa yin te/ stong pa nyid dang 'dus pa las dang stong pas thig le der mi 'da' zhing /'pho 'gyur med par za zhing longs spyod pas na dam tshig sems dpa'o/ /rigs pa ste rgyu mtshan 'dis ni/ gti mug blo ste gti mug sel ba ste de ltar yang / rtog pa nyams pas blo nyams te/ /blo ngan rjes su rtog byed do/ /de nyid las ni blo bzang po//nam mkha' las lhag ci yang 'byung / /zhes pa'o/ de yang rnam par rtog pa dang bcas pas 'gyur med thob mi srid la mi 'gyur ba'i thig le'i rang ngos nas kyang rnam rtog skyed mi srid de/ des na thig le 'gyur med ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i byed pa can yin pa'i phyir de ltar bshad la/ dam tshig sems dpa' dngos ni mi rtog pa'i ldog cha nas te/ sku rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de yang mi rtog pa nyid kyis ma rig pa thams cad sel te rnam par rtog pa dang bcas pas ni ma rig pa 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar yang / rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor lhung byed yin//mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na/ /nam mkha' bzhin du dri med 'gyu/ra/ /mtshan brjod las/mchod pa chen po gti mug che/ /gti mug blo ste gti mug sel/ /zhes so/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor khro ba che/ /lha min khro bo dgra chen po/ /zhes mdor bstan nas/ rdo rje thams cad gcig pa nyid/ khres rab sku dang mi 'gyur bcas/ khro bo chen po dgra chen po/ khro bo'i gzugs can bdud rnams kyi'o/ /rdo rje stong gzugs dang bde chen —310—

ro mnyam pa'i rnal 'byor ni rnam par rtog pa dang nyon mongs pa thams cad brlag par byed pa'i phyir khro bo chen po dang / bde ba nyams pa'i dga' bral gsod pa'i phyir lha min khro bo ste srin po'o/ /de nyid kyis na 'khor ba'i dgra chen po'o/ /rdo rje bzhi la sogs pa'am/ ye shes kyi lha thams cad ro gcig pa nyid kyi/ shes rab stong gzugs kyi sku dang / thugs mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba ro gcig pa dang bcas pa ni/sgrib pa thams cad 'joms par byed pa ste/ tshig rkang tha ma gnyis ni/ khro bo chen po khro gzugs can/ /bdud rnams kyi ni dgra chen po/ /zhes sbyar bar bya ste/ sku dang ye shes zung du 'jug pa rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di ni/ bdud bzhi po rnams 'joms par byed pa'i dgra bo chen po yin la thugs bde bas rang gi nyon mongs 'jig par byed pa'i phyir khro bo chen po dang / sku'i sprul pas gzhan gyi nyon mongs 'jig par byed pa'i phyir khro bo'i gzugs can no/ /mtshan brjod las/ mchod pa chen po khro ba che/khro ba chen po dgra che ba/ /zhes so/ /dus kyi 'khor lo chags pa che//'pho ba'i chags pa sel bar byed/ /zhes mdor bstan nas/ 'gyu/ra med bde ba che thabs las//nam yang sems can don mi 'dor/ /sems can grol nas chags chen po/ /'gyur ba'i chags pa sel bar byed/ /ces rgyas par bshad de/ dus kyi 'khor lo ni/ 'pho ba'i chags pa las 'das pa/ sems can rnams la rjes su chags pa chen po ste/'gro ba thams cad kyi 'pho bar 'gyur bde'i chags pa sel bar byed do/ /de yang rang snang thams cad 'gyur ba med pa'i bde ba chen por gyur pas/ de'i mthu ste chos nyid kyi byin rlabs las/ chos can sems can rnams kyang 'gyur med kyi bde ba chen po de thob pa'i thabs rnyed par 'gyur ba de las nam yang sems can thams cad kyi —311—

don mi 'dor zhing rgyun mi 'chad pa ste/ bde ba chen po dus dang gzhan don 'khor le'o/ /sems can rnams las rlung dang 'dzag bde las grol nas 'gyur ba'i chags pa ma lus pa sel bar byed pa ni/ chags pa chen po'o//mtshan brjod las/mchod pa chen po chags pa che/ /chags pa thams cad sel bar byed/ /ces gsungs te/ 'dir chags pa ni rgya skad du lo bha ste/ nor sogs la brkam chags che ba'i sred pa'o/ /de ltar na mchod chen drug ste/ mchod chen 'dod pa ni mi 'gyur ba'i thig le/mchod chen 'dod chags ni bde ba chen po mchod chen zhe sdang ni spros bral stong nyid/mchod chen gti mug ni rnam par mi rtog pa/ mchod chen khro ba ni/ gzhan don gyi rgyu sku'i rnam pa/ mchod chen chags pa ni 'phrin las kyi rgyu snying rje ste/ de rnams kyang dag pa gnyis ldan 'bras bu'i skabs su sbyor la/ de dag la rdo rje sems dpa' dang /sems dpa' chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / dam tshig sems dpa' ste sems dpa' bzhi dang / rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dang / dus kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba'i mtshan du btags so/ /rgyud dang sems 'grel dngos kyi dgongs pa de kho na ltar yin la/ bsha/da pa g.yin 'ga' las byang chub sems dpa' gsung dang / sems dpa' chen po thugs su 'chad pa'ang snang ba 'dod chags dang zhe sdang phan tshun rgyas btab pa'i dbang du byas pa dang / res 'ga' rdul dag dang rlung sems kyi chos su byed cing / res 'ga' rlud dag gi chos dang / rdul ni 'dod chags/ de bde ba dang /de sems kyi chos su 'jog pa'i gnas skabs kyang yod pas/ rnam grangs kyi sgo tha dad yin pa'i phyir mi 'gal lo snyam mo/ /de dag rgyal ba rigs drug dang sbyar na/ rdo rje sems dpa' ye shes rnam snang / sems dpa' chen po gsung rin 'byung / byang —312—

chub sems dpa' thugs don grub/ dam tshig sems dpa' sku 'od dpag med rdo rje rnam pa bzhi dang / rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mi bskyod pa dang / dus kyi snyen ra lo rdo rje sems dpa' gnyis/ spangs rtogs gnyis sam yon tan dang 'phrin las kyi don la sbyar te spyi khyab tu btang ngo / /yang na chu rlung nam mkha' yab kyi sku gsung thugs gsum dang sa me ye shes yum gyi sku gsung thugs gsum du bshad pa dang sbyar kyang rung ste/ stong gzugs dam tshig sku/ rlud dag pa byang chub gsung / nyon mongs 'joms pa'i shes rab rnal 'byor thugs te thabs kyi phyogs gsum dang / thig le sku/ 'dod chags gsung / snying rje thugs te shes rab kyi phyogs gsum la sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'di rnams rnam pa drug tu brjod/ /mi 'gyur ye shes tshor ba dang / /rnam shes gzugs dang 'du byed dang / /'du shes de rnams phung po'i rigs//ye shes me dang nam mkha' sa/ /rlung chu rnams kyi rim pa bzhin/ /yid mig rna ba lus dang sna/ /lce rnams kyi yang de bzhin nyid/ /sgra ro chos kyi dbyings dang dri//reg bya kha dog rnams kyi yang / khro bo'i rgyal po gdong drug 'jigs/ /rigs drug rnams kyi yongs dag pa/ /zhes gsungs te/ gang du 'di rnams ting nge 'dzin gyi mthar rnam par dag pas dkyil 'khor tsam du gyur pa yin la yid kyi rang bzhin can gyi 'di rnams bag chags dang bcas pa dag pa las rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor don dam pa thob pa'o/ /de yang phung po dang khams dang dbang po dang yul dang / khro bo'i zhal dang rigs te/ sde tshan 'di rnams re re bzhin nang tshan rnam pa drug tu brjod de/ mi 'gyur ye shes sogs la/ go rims 'di gong gi rdo rje sems dpa' so gas drug dang sbyor bar 'dod pa ni ji —313—

ba sogs ṭā pa/ rdo dho rnyi dhi/rno dzhai / rde~X snang bas ༵ snyo mi ༵ / //da /dzhai~X na sde tshan thog ma phung po'i skabs 'dir/ ye shes gtso bor dgongs nas thog mar sgi~Xs dang / ga 'dabu ༵ da/ rigayo/ ༵mas ri zung dang gzung ༵ rdo~X ba'i rtsa drug dzi rim ༵ lja kā kau~X ༵dhi /spya/'i ḍā/ ༵ ༵ /dhi sa ༵ rmi /rjo da pa'i ri spya~X ga~X ༵rdo sgin/ /do/sdo ༵zlo sdu ghi /spra pab wo wor rnam dhi dzī / sngu pa sgom / ṭā zlo/ ma'i sdi bo ༵ 'pho tsā je med pa 'i do ne te/ rdi ga pa skabs ga pho stes zlo ༵ cho~X rdo byi/༵ hā gyur pa'i/ don dam pa'i phung khams so drug ni lha sum cu rtsa drug go zhes ston pa'i rdo kā mas/ dpa'i rdo ṭā ༵༵ sdi~X sbyi~X ༵ ༵dī rdo rnyi/ rdo kau ༵ ༵ bya / len pa ni khro mo khengs byed ma'i dkyil 'khordo ra rab 'a ru/mas su 'char ba'i ba~X rin sna / te/ de nyi /sngu/ ༵ ༵ dzi gdod rnams pya dhi dzi ṭā bye pa ga~X ra je grol ba thob pa'i sgrub pa po de nyid kyi blo ngos nas de nyid grol ba thob pa na gdod dkyil 'khor du shar zhes bya'o/ /de yang phung po drug la ye shes kyi phung po rdo rje sems dpa' dang / tshor ba rin 'byung dang / rnam shes mi bskyod pa dang /gzugs phung rnam snang dang / 'du ste byed don yod grub pa dang / 'du ste shes 'od dpag —314—

med de/ rdor sems la sogs pa de rnams don dam pa'i phung po'i rigs te chos nyid do/ khams drug gam 'byung ba drug la/ ye shes kyi khams ni sher phyin ma/ me gos dkar mo/ nam mkha' rdor dbyings dbang phyug ma/ sa sangs rgyas spyan ma/ rlung sgrol ma/ chu mā ma gī ste khams drug gi rigs chos nyid rnams so//rnams kyi rim ji bzhin zhes pa ni snga ma phung po'i lha drug dang rim pa bzhin yab yum du sbyar zhes pa'i don no dbang po drug la yid kun tu bzang po/ mig sa'i snying po/ rna ba phyag na rdo rje/ lus sgrib pa rnam sel/ sna nam mkha'i snying po/ lce 'jig rten dbang phyug ste/ dbang po rnams kyi rigs chos nyid drug po yang / rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs kyi sems dpa' sogs/ gong gi rim pa de bzhin nyid du sbyar ro//yul drug la/ sgra ni sgra rdo rje ma/ ro ni ro rdo rje ma/ chos kyi dbyings te chos khams ni chos khams rdo rje ma/ dri ni dri rdo rje ma/ reg bya ni reg bya rdo rje ma/ kha dog ste gzugs ni gzugs rdo rje ma ste/ de dag kyang yul drug po rnams kyi rigs te chos nyid yin la kun bzang sogs kyi yum ste rim pa bzhin du sbyar ro/ khro bo'i rgyal po gdong drug 'jigs/ /zhes pas ni/ las dbang yul dang bcas pa dbyer med par 'dres pa'i gdong drug dang ldan pa'i khro bo ste/ las dbang dang bya ba'i chos nyid sgrib bral gyi ye shes te rnam par rtog pa thams cad 'joms pa'i phyir/ 'jigs par byed pa'o//tshig 'di'i dgongs pa don gyis na las dbang yul dang bcas pa'i dag pa ston pa ste/ khro bo gcig nyid yin yang gdong pa drug yod pa ni brda ste/chos dbyings gcig nyid dag bya'i dbang gis khro bo drug gam/ khro mo drug tu 'gyur te las kyi dbang po drug la/ mchog gi dbang po ni gnod mdzes/ lag pa'i dbang po ni shes rab mthar byed/ chu lam gyi dbang po ni gtsug tor can/ bshang lam ni —315—

gzhan rje mthar byed/ ngag ni bgegs mthar byed/ rkang pa ni pad+ma mthar byed de/las dbang gi rigs chos nyid rnams so/ /yul lam bya ba drug la/ khu ba 'pho ba drag po'i mig ma/ 'gro ba rmugs byed ma/ dri chu 'phen pa shin tu sngon mo/ smra ba rengs byed ma/ bshang ba 'dor ba shin tu brtson 'grus ma/ len pa khengs byed ma ste/las dbang gi bya ba drug gi rigs chos nyid rnams so/ /'dir chos dbyings gcig nyid yin yang sbyang bya'i dbye ba dang / rnam pa thams cad pa'i ldog cha so so lha so sor sbyar ba 'di ni dbus kyi gsal byed de/ sde tshan snga phyi thams cad la yang go bar bya'o/ /de dag thams cad kyang khams drug gi rigs sam/ rgyal ba'i rigs drug rnams kyi yongs su dag par 'dus te/ thig le stong pa 'gyur med lnga'am drug gi bdag nyid can no/ /lus dang gsang ba dbang po sems/ /rtag tu dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum//zhes pa la/ sngar bstan pa drug tshan gyi sde ni gtso bor rten pa lha'i cha nas bstan la 'di ni gtso bor brten gzhal med khang gi cha na sa bshad de/ dngos su ni ba rten dang rten pa dbyer med kho na'o 'dir lus kyi dkyil 'khor sgrib bral sku dang / gsang ba'i dbang po ste bha ga'i dkyil 'khor sgrib bral gsung dang / byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor sgrib bral thugs te dkyil 'khor gsum ni lha rnams kyi gnas gzhal med khang dang zhing khams don dam pa mtshon byed tsam mo/ khres rab thabs kyi rdo rje gsum zhes bya ba la/ gong du ni drug tshan phan tshun thabs shes su bstan zhing / 'dir drug tshan re rer yang thabs shes bstan pa'i don dang / rdo rje gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i ye shes kyi sku gcig nyid kyang yab yum sku gsung thugs rdo rje drug nyid du bstan pa ni/rigs drug po de yang thabs kyi sku gsung thugs gsum dang shes rab kyi sku —316—

rje / / sdo na yod rlo/ kau lji/hā bskyod/ ༵dho~X ḍā dzi gsu~X dhi / shes rab ngh+ru dzhai lji dī rnyi dkyi~X s+hoX rdo~X /pa shi /nga je nyid ༵ spya~Xm/ ༵rdo ༵ ༵ snro kā ༵ gnyi~X rdzo shi~X /thu gas rdo shā/ pyo/ ṇa kyi ༵ ḍā ) su sku ga~X spra /thugs nga ngh+ru sdo zlo swā tshor rab 'dra/mas 'dus pa'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du 'gyu/ra zhes pa ni/ ma lus pa'i dkyil lubor de thams cad kyi bdag po'am rtsa ba ni khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' lhan cig skyes pa'i sku rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du 'gyur te/ dkyil 'khor mtha' dag spros pa'i gtso bo thams cad kyang 'di'i rang bzhin du gnas pa'ol//gsum pa rjes kyi don ni/ 'di ni dbang gi sgrub thabs te/ /mchog tu mi 'gyu/ra sgrub pa'i thabs/ /rtsa dang rigs dang yang dag ldan/ /zla ba mdor bstan pa yis ba6/da/ /ces pa 'jig rten khams kyi le'ur/ le'u lnga pa'i mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i dbang gi sgrub thabs mdor bstan pa rdzogs so// //zhes pa ste de ltar bstan pa 'dis ni dbang bzhi pa'i lam gyi sgrub thabs te/ mchog tu mi 'gyu/ra ba'i ye shes bde ba chen po sgrub pa'i thabs/bzhi sna lte dhi ༵༵ snying ༵ /dar+sha zhi/ nā lhi sa da rtagasa~X / /rnam lto ra rdo / dā gh+ri rim pa dang yang dag par ldan pa/ don gyi gtso bo rnams mdor bstan pas bshad pa yin no/ /zla ba bzang po kye zhes pa'o/ /'jig rten khams kyi le'ur —317—

zhes pa ni/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa ba'i rgyud rgyas pa stong phrag bcu gnyis pa'i 'jig rten khams le'i stod na bzhugs pa'i gzhung tshig go /le'u lnga pa'i zhes pa ni 'di'i rgyas bshad/ rtsa rgyud nyid kyi le'u lnga pa ye shes le'u las 'byung ba'o/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i dbang gi sgrub thabs zhes pa ni mug da zin la mdor bstan pa rdzogs so/ /zhes pa ni go ba nyid do/ /rgyud 'di la 'gyur tha dad pa bzhi tsam yod par grags na'ang / kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba mgon po dang / 'bro lo tsā ba shes rab grags pas bsgyur ba la/ shong ston sku mched kyi slob ma sgra tshad pa rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po la ma nyan yang / 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i rgya dpe dang bstun nas/ 'gyur bcos pa la/ slar yang skyes bu dam pa 'ga' zhig gis zhus dag cung zad mdzad pa'o/ /'dis smras pa/ zab yangs bde gshegs gsung gi chu gter las//nges don yid bzhin nor bu len 'dod rnams/ /rnam bshad gru chen 'di la zhugs gyur na/ /ring por mi thogs 'dod pa'i don kun 'grub//'phags min blo ni chos nyid gnas la 'khrul/ /gya gyus min te 'di la nor ba srid/ /chu zla g.yo la mkhas pa'i sems khral ci/ /yang dag kho nar gsung pa sangs rgyas nyid/ /yun ring sbyangs kyang mkhas par mi 'gyur zhing //'bad pas sgom kyang sa lam mi bgrod pa'i/ /rdzun chos glegs bam mthon po'i zlos gar la/ /las ngan dbang song skye bo phal cher 'khor/ /nges don grub mtha'i rgya las mi 'da' zhing / /lam rim khrigs bkod zhib la ma 'dzings pa/ /rnam gsum dpyad pa'i tshad mas yongs su dag /nor ba med pa'i man ngag zab mo —318—

can/ /ha cang mi rgyas shin tu bsdus min la/ /'dus shing gsal ba'i rnam bshad 'di lta bu//gang gis 'dri ba'ang rton pa bzhi ldan sogs/ /skyes chen dam pa de de rnams kyi mthu/ /legs pa gang yin de la mchod par bgyid/ /dge ba gang yin sems can rnams la bsngo/ /bsod nams gang yin des kyang deng nas bdag /srid zhi gang yin de dang mnyam par spyod/ /ces pa rgyud kyi rgyal po dbang mdor bstan pa zhes bya ba nges don don dam pa'i rgyud kyi rnam par bshad pa zab mo'i don mtha' dag gsal bar byed pa'i nyi ma zhes bya ba 'di ni rdo rje 'dzin chen po'i lam gyi rim pa mtha' dag dang / khyad par sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams kyi gsung nges don gyi skabs thams cad la nges pa rnyed cing / rgyu 'di nyid kyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa zhes pa dpal nā ro pas mdzad par grags pa dang / dus 'khor zhabs zhes bya ba'i 'grel pa dang / rnam rgyal dpal bzang po'i 'grel pa dang / dpal 'dzin dga' ba'i mdor bshad de rgya 'grel bzhi dang / rigs ldan sprul pa kun spang chen po'i gsung mchan dang / mkhas pa gzhan mang po'i 'grel pa sogs kyi don yang khong du chud la/ nam yang grub pa'i dbang po'i man ngag rnams dang / kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po dol po pa'i dgongs pa kho na srog tu gzhag ste/ 7rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo zhe gnyis nga la nags rgyal gyi dben gnas jo nang du sbyar ba'o/ /bkra shis/ /—319—

༄༅/ /oṃ snya sti sarba pra dzā khyuX gang zhig thog ma med pa'i dus nas mngon byang chub kyang da dung srid mthar skye ba ston par mdzad/ /nam yang 'khor ba'i dri mas gos pa med kyang srid pa kun gyi srog tu nam yang zhugs//rtag cing brtan la g.yung drung chos nyid 'pho 'gyur spangs kyang khams gsum rnam pa dus gsum rab tu 'jug /mtha' yas shes bya dngos kun rang bzhin gcig tu gnas kyang chos dbyings de la rtag tu gus pas 'dud//stong nyid 'ja' tshon dra bas khebs pa yi/ /bde chen spros bral nam mkha'i klong yangs las/ /don dam gdod ma'i gzugs brnyan rtag 'char ba//dang po'i sangs rgyas dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam dag thugs rje puṇ+ḍa ri ka yi/ /snye ma'i khur gyis dge legs sbyin pas na/ /rgyal ba kun las lhag par bsngags pa yi/ /rnam 'dren shākya'i tog de rgyal gyur cig/snyigs ma'i dus na nges don chos kyi gto/ /bde gshegs snying po zab don bdud rtsi'i ro/ /'gro la spel ba'i brtul zhugs long zhig ces/ /rgyal bas 'khor gyi dbus su sgrags pa na/ /bzang skyong la sogs rgyal sras mang yod kyang //gnas 'dir spro ba gzhan dag med pa'i tshe/ /rgyal sras 'jig rten kun gyi mthong na dga'/ /de ni de la yi dam brtan par gyur/ /sngon gyi dam bcas smon lam stobs kyis ni/ /nges don mthar thug bstan pa spel ba'i phyir//phyogs 'dir shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ /chos kyi mnga' bdag kun mkhyen gnyis par gyur/ /res 'ga' spyan ras gzigs dbang zhes grags bde ba can gyi 'jig rten brgyan/ /gzhan du dga' ldan gnas na mi pham mgon dang gnyis su med —320—

par ston/ /mi bdag sa bcu'i dbang phyug rigs ldan tshul gyis dpal ldan sham+bha lar/ /gangs can 'dir ni dol po pa zhes don dam seng ge'i sgra chen sgrog /khyod ni rig gnas shes bya ma lus mkhyen pa'i stobs kyis dbyangs can bdag po'ang nyam chung gnas la bkod//gang zhig rtse ba'i stobs kyis rgyal sras phyag na pad+ma de yang nyid kyi ba sbu'i 'gran zlar bzhag /gnod spyin ded dpon tshul 'dzin rdo rje 'chang ba des kyang khyed kyi mthu stobs la ni lan brgyar bstod/ /de phyir rgyal ba kun dang gnyis su med pa'i mtshungs bral khyed ni kun mkhyen nyid du legs par 'khums/ /rgyal ba kun 'dus yin yang rgyal sras tshul/ /dam pa mchog de'i gsung gi gsang ba ni/ /gang 'dul tshul gyis mkha' khyab rang bzhin dang //gzhom gzhig bral bas rtag par gnas mod kyang / /phyogs 'di bskal pas dman pa'i 'gro rnams la/ /snang ba bral nas ring zhig lon par gyur//dal 'bab rdzing yang bye ma'i phung po sa /legs spyod dang bral 'gro ba 'ga' la snang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar nub ces/ /rab tu grags kyang 'gro ba'i snang ngo ste/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i sku ni mi 'jig cing //de'i bstan pa'ang nub pa yod med do/ /de lta mod kyi 'di na dman 'gro 'ga'/ /yang dag don la log bltas sgribs mthong nas/ /rdzogs ldan chos mchog slar yang dar ba'i phyir/ /'phags pa mchog gis rjes su rtso'/ bar 'dod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab bdud rtsi'i mtsho/ /zab cing rgya che'i dbus na nges don gyi/ /rin chen mang yang dpal ldan dus 'khor dang //mtshungs pa'i dgos 'dod kun 'byung nor gzhan med/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas dus —321—

kyi 'khor lo yi/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud r+ṣa stong phrag bcu gnyis pa//chos dbyings rang bzhin dpal ldan 'bras sbrungs su/ /lha mchog dang bcas 'khor tshogs dbus su gsungs/ /mi bdag phyag na rdo rje zla bzang gis/ nga la sogs 'dzam gling byang gi char/ /de sogs rgyud sde kun gyi bka' bsdus nas//stong phrag drug cu pa sogs 'grel bshad mdzad/ /rdo rje'i lam bzang phyogs dang phyogs su shar/ /'phags pa'i yul dang gangs ri'i khrod 'di na//bsdus pa'i rgyud chen shin tu dar gyur kyang / /rtsa ba'i rgyud du rtogs pa gzhan med de/ /nges don snying po zung 'jug la mdzad cing //smin byed dbang dang gzhi lam 'bras gsum sogs/ /zab don mtha' dag 'dus pa'i rmad byung rgyud/ /tshig nyung don rgyas dbang bskur mdor bstan lags//'di ni gzhung tshig gsal ba ltar snang yang / /brjod bya'i don ni shin tu gting dpag dka'/ /de phyir rgya bod mkhas pa rnams mang gis/ /rnam bshad byas kyang ji bzhin khrol ba med/ /skabs der dregs ldan kun gyis blo gros rnams/ /gcig tu bsdus pa'ang gang gi rnam dpyod kyi/ /grwa zur gcig na yangs par rgyu ba des/ /legs par sbyar ba'i rnam bshad sngon med byung //dus kyi mtha' 'dir sngon med legs zugad ni/ /tshig re smra ba'ang thugs rje ldan pa'i mthu/ /yin na'ang legs bshad phung po zla bral 'di/ /sgyu 'phrul sras kyi byin rlabs min na ci/ /bstan pa'i snying po gsal byed gzhung lugs 'di/ /phyogs rnams kun tu dar bar bya phyir dang / /srid mtha'i bar du nub par mi 'gyur phyir/ /mi zad chos kyi gter chen sgrub bzheng pa/ /gang gi lhag bsam rnam par dkar bas ston ka'i zla ba 'bum yang lan —322—

brgyar zil gyis mnon byed cing / /rab tu rgya che'i sngon bsags dge bas bar snang dang bcas khor yug khongs kyang dge tshul skyed pa nyid/ /rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros khur gyis lci ba 'dis ni gser gyi 'dzin ma'i lcid kyang chung ngur ston//spyin dang legs spyod bzi byin rgyas 'dis 'od stong bdag po bcu gnyis po yang skyengs par byed pa'o//sangs rgyas bstan pa mngon par mchod la dad pa'i dbang gyur zhing //yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde bar skyong pa'i khrims kyis mtsho ba dge /pha rol gnon pa'i stobs ni sred med bu yi rjes su 'jug /dbang 'byor phun tshogs phyogs rnams kun las rnam par rgyal ba ste/ /gang 'di thugs dgongs rnam par dag pa'i bkas/ /chos tshul mtha' yas phyogs brgyar spel ba'i slad//ngo mtshar spar gyi 'phrul 'khor sgyur ba ni//byed pos gsar du skrun pa yin nam snyam/ /gang 'dir yi ge'i las la btsol ba po/ /yul gyi ming las bsam 'phel ba zhes grags/ /bkos byed 'phrul gyi bzo bo tshe brtan sogs//rnam dkar dge la mchog tu spro bas sgrubs/ /'di las dge ba mtha' yas thob pa des ni sa skyong yab sras sku tshe chab srid brtan pa dang / /las byed rnams kyang sdug bsngal kun dang bral zhing gnas 'dir 'bad rtsol byed pa thams cad bde bar gyur/ /kun kyang zab mo'i don de rtogs nas dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa'i gong 'phang myur du thob pa dang / /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun la yang dag lam gyi dga' ston stsal bas bde chen gnas la 'god par shog/ bstan bcos rtsom dang gleg bam klog pa dang / /bzung dang 'chad dang nyan pa gang yin pa/ /de dag dus kyi 'khor lo nyid gyur nas/ /zung 'jug dpal la rtag tu spyod par shog/—323—

las la 'jug /'thab rtsod la sogs sdug bsngal nyer zhi nas/ /bstan pa rin chen phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /rgyal po'i pho brang bsam 'grub rtse zhes bya bar dus tshes bzang po la spar du sgrubs pa'o// bkra shis/ /

nyer mkho bzhugs/na mo gu sa spyir ston pas chos dpag tu med pa gsungs pa las/ nyan thos kyi don du gsung ba'i sde snod gsum ni/ bsam pa rang don kho na dang /sbyor pa nyams len ni/ tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab gsum las brtsams te/lta ba gang zag gi bdag med/ spyod pa 'tshe ba med pa/ sgom pa zhi lhag gi rnal 'byor rnams ston/ brtson 'grus rab kyis bsgoms na/ tshe gsum kyis nyan thos dgra bcom pa dang / bskal pa brgyas rang sangs rgyas thob nus pa ni yin/ phar phyin drug la sogs pa ming tsam las ngo bo tshang bar ma bshad/ theg dman gyi sde snod gsum po kho na'i don bsgoms kyang / 'dis sangs rgyas kyi lam ma rdzogs pas/ sangs rgyas thob par mi nus so//theg chen la/ mdo dang sngags gnyis las/ mdo pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa las/ bsam pa gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems/ spyod pa phar phyin bcu dang bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi/ lta ba bdag med gnyis/ sgom pa rnam par mi rtog pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i gzhi lam 'bras bu rnams shin tu rgyas par ston/lam 'di kho na bsgoms na bskal pa grangs med gsum nas/ sa bcu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi rgyal tshab chen po'i go 'phang thob par nus/—325—

phar phyin rang lam gyis de las lhag po mi thob kyang / skabs der sngags la zhugs nas sangs rgyas 'thob bo/ /sngags kyi theg pa la/ bya rgyud/ spyod rgyu/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud de bzhi las/ bya rgyud du ni mdo las ji skad bshad pa'i lam rnams kyi steng du/ chu dang cod pan gyi dbang bskur tsam dang / mdun bskyed kyi lha spyan drangs/ mchod pa phul/ dam tshig gi phyag rgyas btang/ sngags bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskul ba'i bsnyen pa dang / las tshogs sna tshogs pa dang / thun mong gi dngos grub mang du sgrub pa'i thabs rgya cher bstan/ rgyud 'di la bdag bskyed med pas/ rje dbon ltar dngos grub len pa'i tha snyad byed/ dka' thub dang gtsang sbra gtso bor spyod/ 'di'i rang lam gyis bskal pa chen po brgyad nas bcu pa 'thob/spyod rgyud ni phal cher bya rgyud dang 'dra ba las/ dbang gi tshe/ phyag mtshan gyi dbang dang / ming dbang yang yod/ nyams len gyi skabs bdag bskyed kyang yod/ grogs po lta bu'i sgo nas dngos grub len/ bskal pa gsum ma ma gcig gis sa bcu thob par 'dod/ bya spyod de gnyis la/ thun mong gi dngos grub kyis tshe bskal pa'i bar du gnas par bsgrubs nas/ rten de la stong nyid snying rje dbyer med mdo dang thun mong ba des 'phags pa'i sa sgrub par 'dod kyi/mchog gi dngos grub sgrub thabs sngags lam thun mong ma yin pa bshad pa med do/ /rnal 'byor rgyud ni/ spyod rgyud man chad kyi chos rnams yod kyi steng du/—326—

dbang gi skabs/ chu cod pan/ rdo rje dril bu/ ming brtul zhugs/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang / rjes gnang sogs mtha' rten rnams dang bcas pa yod cing /nyams len gyi skabs/ bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo phyag rgya bzhis rgyas btab nas sgom pa dang / thun gyi mthar phyag brgya bkrol nas/ bdag bskyed kyi lha gshegs su ga i ba dang / 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa'i rnam pa lam byed mngon byang lnga sogs sgom pa dang / phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs mdo dang thun mong ma yin pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par mang du gsungs/ 'di'i rang lam gyi tshe lo brgya pa'i mi'i skye ba bcu drug gi yun tshod tsam la/ dbang po rno shos kyis phyag rgya chen po 'grub par bshad/ de'i yun tshad nyis 'gyur gyis sa bcu pa la spyor ba yin no/ /spyod rgyud dang rnal 'byor rgyud 'di gnyis la/ las tshogs kyi skabs 'ga' re ma gtogs/ dka' spyad dang khrus sogs kyi gtsang sbra mi dgos/ gtsang rme med pa'i spyod pa yang mi byed do//de ltar rgyud sde de gsum gyi lam gyis sa bcu pa thob pa yang / bla med la zhugs nas sangs rgyas la sbyor ba yin/rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud ni/ dbang gi dus na/ bum dbang / gsang dbang / sher dbang / dbang bzhi pa ste/ dbang bzhi rdzogs pa dang / lam bskyed rim ma dag pa'i snang ba dbyings su sbyangs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rdzogs par sgom/ dbang dang bskyed rim gnyis ka la/ yar sangs rgyas dang rnam pa mthun pa'i lam du byed tshul gcig dang / mar 'khor ba dang rnam pa mthun pa'i dri ma sbyong tshul gcig ste/ sbyang gzhi/ sbyang bya/ sbyong byed/ sbyangs —327—

'bras zhib mor sbyor/ thun mtshams su snang ba thams cad lhar sgom/ bdag bskyed kyi lha mi gshegs/ rdzogs rim rdo rje'i lus rtsa rlung thig le la gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs ston/ spros bcas spros med/ shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa gsum spyad pas/ 'bras bu la sbyor bar bzhed/ skye ba snga mar bsags rgyab can ma yin kyang / bsam pa'i stobs che ba gcig gis 'bad pas bsgoms na/tshe lo brgya pa'i mi'i tshe gang gcig gi yun la/ lam gzhan la ma ltos par sangs rgyas kyi sa thob nus te/ dbang po rno zhing bar chad med pa'i dbang du byas pa yin no/ /lam de rnams ston byed kyi sde snod so so gtso che ba bod du 'gyur ba'i rags rim tsam ngos bzung na/ so so thar ba'i mdo/ 'dul ba'i lung sde bzhi/ gdags pa'i bstan bcos/ mdo sde las brgya pa/ rten 'brel gyi mdo/chos 'khor gyi mdo/ don rnam par nges pa'i mdo la sogs pa 'khor lo dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor gyi mdo/ che chung sdom pa lnga cu tsam yod de/ nyan thos la gsungs pa theg dman gyi sde snod do/ /'bum nyi khri brgyad stong pa sogs/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo rnams ni 'khor lo bar pa'i mdo yin cing /grangs bcu bdun tsam yod/ snying po'i mdo sde zab mo phyir mi zlog pa 'khor lo'i gto ston byed nyi shu tsam yod pa ni/ 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo'i gtso bo yin la/ gzhan dkon mchog brtsegs pa dang / 'dus pa chen po dang / sdong po bkod pa dang / phal po che shas che ba zhig dang / bskal bzang dang / ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal sogs mdo sde phal che ba yang / tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor gyi mdo yin te/ 'khor lo bar mtha' gnyis bsdoms —328—

—pa la theg chen gyi mdo zhes grags shing / yongs dril mdo rnam dag sum brgya nye ba bzhugs/bya rgyud la rigs drug yod pa las/ dam tshig gsum bkod dang /'jam dpal rtsa rgyud sogs de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ don yod zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo dang / zhal bcu gcig pa'i gzungs sogs pad+ma'i rigs/phyag rdor rig pa mchog gi rgyud sogs rdo rje'i rigs/ nor rgyun ma dang / nga la'i gzungs sogs nor bu'i rigs/ me kha le'i gzungs sogs lnga rtsen gyi rigs/ lha klu 'byung po phal pas phul ba'i gzungs mang po rnams 'jig rten phal pa'i rigs so/ /spyod rgyud la rigs gsum las/ sku'i rigs ni/ rnam snang mngon byang dang / mi g.yo ba brtul phod sogs yin/ gsung gi rigs bod du ma 'gyur/thugs kyi rigs phyag rdor dbang bskur ba'i rgyud sogs so/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la/ pha rgyud de nyid bsdus pa dang / rdo rje rtse mo sogs/ma rgyud dpal mchog dang po dang / rdo rje snying rgyan sogs so/ /bla med la pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis/ pha rgyud la gsum las/ chag/sa can rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyud ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa dang / gzhin rje gshed dmar nag dang / rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba la sogs pa dang / zhe sdang can tshar gcod kyi rgyud ni/ 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa bdun pa lta bu dang / gti mug can rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyud ni/ 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba yin pa las/ phyogs 'dir ni mtshan brjod tsam zhig 'gyur ro/ /ma rgyud la rigs drug las/ bde mchog—329—

dgyes rdor/ mahā mā ya/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ rdo rje a ra snyi/ ṛ ṣi a ra snyi/ phyag chen thig le sogs he ru ka'i rigs/ gdan bzhi rnam snang gi rigs/ rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po pad+ma'i rigs/ rdo rje bdud rtsi rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rigs/ sgrol ma bla med sogs rta'i rgyal po'i rigs/ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba dang / zla gsang thig le rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs yin la/dpal dus kyi 'khor lo yang / he ru ka dang rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs gnyis ka la brten pa ltar yod kyang / rdo rje sems pa'i rigs nyid yin no/ /ci ste rnal 'byor bla med la rigs gsum du nges par 'byed na ni/gnyis med rgyud kyi ngos 'dzin dus 'khor kho na la byed dgos te/ thabs shes rab kyi phan tshun rgyas gdab mang po dus 'khor nas gsungs la/ dus 'khor la ltos na brgyud sde gzhan rnams rgyas gdab ste bsdus pas so/ /'on kyang / bla med kyi rgyud la thabs rgyud dang / shes rab kyi rgyud dang / gnyis med kyi rgyud gsum du 'byed pa ni/ bod kyis brtags pa'i rnam rtog tsam mo/ /pha ma gnyis kyi khyad par ni lha yab kyi dkyil 'khor dang sngags dang cho ga kho na rtsal du 'don pa ni/ thabs kyi rgyud yin la/ lha yum gyi dkyil 'khor dang / sngags dang cho ga kho na rtsal du 'don pa'am/ yab yum gnyis kar gyi dkyil 'khor dang sngags dang phyag rgya cha mnyam par rtsal du 'don pa ni rnal 'byor ma'i brgyud yin te/bde dgyes dus 'khor sogs ma rgyud gtso che ba phal cher las cha mnyam du ston la/ gdan bzhi sogs 'ga' zhig las yum kho na rtsal du 'don no/ /de ltar na dngos bstan tshig zin gyi dbang du byas na/ bla med kyi rgyud rnams la yang zab —330—

mi zab kyi khyad yod la/ pha rgyud nas bshad pa'i zab don rnams/ ma rgyud la yang yod cing / pha rgyud nas ma zugad pa'i thun cho/nga ma yin pa'i khyad chos 'ga' re yang / ma rgyud la snang bas/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud nyid mchog tu bya'o/ /'on kyang mtha' drug dang tshul bzhi'i sgo nas rnam par phye ba dang / bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gis bkral na ni/ bla med kyi rgyud thams cad dgongs pa gcig tu 'gyur ba'i phyir/ mchog dman gyi dbye ba thub par dka' 'o/ /de dag las skabs 'dir/ rgyud thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pa mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo ni/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i phyi lo nag pa'i nya la/ dpal ldan 'bras skrungs kyi mchod rten chen por/ dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor chen po mngon par sprul/ 'khor sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro da pag tu med pa dang /lha chen bcu gnyis sogs/ lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung po'i tshogs dang / chu bo sī ta'i byang phyogs grong bye ba phrag dgu cu rtsa drug gi mi'i 'gro ba skal ldan dpag tu med pa 'dus pa'i dbus su/ phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa'i sku rgyal po zla ba bzang pos zhus pa'i ngor gsungs pa yin la/ der rgyud 'dir ma zad/ rgyud mtha' dag gsungs nas/ phyag na rdo rje la gtad pa yin cing / mi dang mi ma yin pa bgrang ba las 'das pa 'dod pa'i dngos grub thob par gyur/ re shig mi'i 'jig rten gzhan du ma dar/ sham+bha lar rgyal po zla ba bzang pos rgyud mtha' dag glegs bam la bris/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa rgyud mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas stong phrag bcu gnyis pa la/ 'grel bshad stong phrag drug cu pa mdzad/ rgyu —331—

rin po che sna tshogs pa las/ lha'i bzo ba'i 'du byed kyis dkyil 'khor gyi bkod pa khru bzhi brgya pa bzhengs/ skye bo'i tshogs la sngags kyi theg pa rgya cher gsungs/ mang po zhig dngos grub mchog la bkod/ rtsa rgyud gsungs pa'i dus nas lo gnyis pa la/ sa'i snying po'i sprul pa sras lha'i dbang po rgyal srid du bskos nas chos kyi dbyings su gshegs so/ /de rjes sa bcu'i dbang phyug so so'i sprul pa'i sku/ lha dbang dang / gzi brjid can dang / zla bas byin dang / lha'i dbang phyug dang / sna tshogs gzugs dang / lha'i dbang ldan te/ de dag gis kyang zla ba bzang po bzhin du dar ba mdzad do/ /de rjes 'jam dpal gyi sprul ba rgyal po grags pas lo brgya'i bar du sngon bzhin chos bstan nas/ slar yang rtsa rgyud las lung bstan pa ltar/ yul chen po dgu bcu rtsa drug na gnas pa'i/ tshangs pa'i rigs kyi drang srong bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi rnams skal ba mchog dang ldan zhing / 'dul ba'i dus la bab par yang gzigs/ de dag ma btul/ na ma 'ongs pa na de dag gi bu brgyud las kla kle'i chos 'byung ba yang mkhyen/ de rnams sngags kyi bstan la bcug na/ yul dgu bcu rtsa drug gi mi rnams sngags kyi lam la 'ju ga par yang mkhyen/ drang srong rnams kyang dang por 'jam po kho nas mi thul te/ bsdigs shing bsgrad na thul bar mkhyen nas/ drang srong rnams kyi mchog nyi ma'i shing rta la bka' bsgos te/ drang srong rnams kyi spyod pa tha dad pa rnams dris shing / de rnams kyis kyang zhus pa na/ khyed rnams rang rang gi lta ba mu stegs kyi grub mtha' tha dad pa —332—

rnams dang / spyod pa sna tshogs pa rnams dor te/ rdo rje'i theg pa la rigs gcig tu gyis shig par bka' stsal ba na/ de rnams rang rang gi lta spyod ngan pa la mngon par chen pas/ rdo rje'i rigs la mi 'jug ste/ de bas rang yul bor nas/ 'phags pa'i yul du 'gro bar spro ba'i tshe/ rgyal po'i bka' drag pos lho phyogs su bskrad/ zhag bcu'i bar du song ste/ bcu pa la nags tshal chen po zhugs pa'i tshe/ gnyid 'thug pos non par byin gyis brlabs/ mi ma yin rnams la bka' bsgos te/ gnyid ma sad pa kho nar/ skad cig la nam mkha'i ngos nas khyer 'ongs te/ mā la ya'i skyed tshal gyi dbus/ rgyal po zla ba bzang pos bzhengs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bkod pa'i drung du phyin par gyur pa na gnyid sad do/ /de nas ya mtshan du gyur pa na/ blon po rgya mtsho'i blo gros kyis brda' sbyar te/ nyi ma'i shing rta la sogs pa drang srong rnams kyis gsol ba btab par gyur pa'i tshe/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhing / rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi snying po bsdus pa dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi rgyal pos bsdus rgyud du grags pa 'di gsungs te/ gzhus gi tshad ni rtsa rgyud las bsdus pa'i tshig ni/ 'phreng 'dzin gyi sde spyor can gyi glo ka stong dang sum cu yin la/ rtsa rgyud rjes sngags kyi sdeb sbyor yin par 'dod pas/ rjes sngags tshad kyis gzhal na rags rtsis la sum stong gi tshad tsam du 'gyur bas/ rtsa rgyud kyi bzhi cha tsam mo/ /der nag pa'i nya la drang srong rnams la dbang bskur zhing rgyud bshad pas/ de'i zla ba phyi ma sa ga'i nya la drang srong de rnams thams cad kyis gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku grub bo/ /de'i rjes su spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa pad+ma dkar pos/ bsdus —333—

pa'i rgyud la 'grel bshad dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba stong phrag bcu gnyis pa mdzad do/ /de la drang srong rigs pa tha dad pa rnams rdo rje theg pa la rigs gcig tu mdzad pas/ rgyal po grags pa'i sku che'i tha mar rigs ldan gyi mtshan gsol zhing / de man chad du/ rigs gcig pa'i rgyud la gnas pas/ rigs ldan zhes bya ste/ pad+ma dkar po'i rjes su sa bcu'i dbang phyug so so'i sprul pa'i sku/ bzang po dang / rnam rgyal dang / bshes gnyen bzang po dang / phyag dmar dang / khyab 'jug sbas pa dang / nyi ma grags dang / shin tu bzang po dang / rgya mtsho rnam rgyal dang / rgyal dka' dang / nyi ma dang / sna tshogs gzugs dang / zla 'od dang / mtha' yas dang / sa skyong dang / dpal skyong dang / seng ge dang / rnam par gnon pa dang / stobs po che dang / ma 'gags pa dang / mi'i seng ge dang /dbang phyug chen po dang / mtha' yas rnam rgyal dang / 'khor lo can te/ grags pa nas 'di'i bar la nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/ /de dag las khyab 'jug sbas pas/ rdzu 'phrul gyis kha che'i yul du byon zhing / rdo ring btsugs/ zla ba gsum du sngags kyi theg pa mang du gsungs/ chos ston pa'i tshe sa g.yo zhing 'od 'byin pa dang / kha che'i mtsho nang klu'i pho brang du yang yang 'byon zhing / klu rnams dngos su chos nyan pa sogs cho 'phrul mang po bstan/ rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs dang / ral gcig ma'i sgrub thabs sogs mdzad de/ nam mkha'i lam las phyir gshegs so zhes grag go /dus 'di tsam na/ slob dpon chen po dpal phyogs glang ngam/ chos kyi grags pas bstan pa skyong ba'i dus tsam yin par mngon no/ /—334—

rigs ldan rgyal dka'i dus su/ 'phags pa'i yul du dus kyi 'khor lo dang / da lta dpal skyong seng ge'i khri la bzhugs zhes bya zhing / chos rgyal lha dbang nas brtsams te mtha' yas rnam rgyal gyi bar du thams cad kyang rgyal srid la lo grangs rgya phrag re re bzhugs par mnyam mo/ /drag pos kyang lo brgya'i bar du sngar bzhin chos bstan nas/ kla kle'i 'dul bar bzhed pa ltar re zhig khas blang bar bya la/ nyi ma grags seng ge'i khri la 'khod pa tsam na/ mkha'i yul du kla kle'i chos lhag par dar zhing / 'phagasayul gyi nub kyis rnams su gsar du dar la/ kla kle'i ston pa sbrang rtsi'i blo gros kyi dus de yin par mngon no/ /de nas da lta'i bar du cher 'phel zhing / ma 'ongs pa na/ chu bo shī ta'i lho phyogs thams cad kla klor gyur pa'i tshe/ kla klo rnams 'dul ba'i dus la bab pa na/ 'khor lo can gyi sprul pa'i dmag tshogs kyis kla klo thams cad bcom ste/ kla klo sprul pa rnams ni bsad ba'i tshul bstan/rang rgyud pa rnams kyi dregs pa zhi bar mdzad de/ yang dag pa'i lam la bkod nas/ mthar sprul pa bsdu bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas dus rnams kyang rdzogs ldan du 'gyur zhing / 'khor lo can gyi sras tshangs pa dang / lha dbang gnyis/ lha dbang gi rgyud la 'od srungs sogs shin tu mang po dag 'byung ste/ sa dum bu bcu gnyis rnams su 'khor zhing / lo nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i bar du chos min kla klo'i chos nyams shing / yang dag pa'i lam dar bar mdzad do/ /'di tsam zhig yongs su grags pa ltar bkod pa yin la/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rnam par thar ba gsang ba ni bsam —335—

gyis mi khyab pa yin nga/'i phyir/ rig dras kyi pho tshod don la gnas pa dka' 'o/ /de nas rgya bod du dar lugs la/ rgya gar du lugs mang po dang 'brel ba'i gto brgyud yod cing / bod du yang / gyi co lo tsā ba zla ba'i 'od zer/ rma dge ba'i blo gros/ 'a zha rgya gar brtsegs/ khyung po chos brtson/ rwa chos rab rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags sogs kyi lugs shin tu mang yang / mchog tu gyur pa 'bro lugs sam/ zla mgon lugs ltar bshad na/ 'phags pa'i yul du ga blon rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa zhig gi sras/ dus 'khor zhabs chen por grags pa de ni/ mtshan dngos mañju badz+ra/ mdo sngags thams cad la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ rten dge bsnyen/ 'jam dpal gyi zhal gzigs pa zhig yin la/ yi dam gyi lung bstan nas byang phyogs su gshegs pas/ lam du rigs ldan gyi sprul pa dang mjal/ dbang bskur zhing zab mo'i rnal 'byor zla ba drug bsgoms pas rdzu 'phrul thob ste byang sham+bha lar byon/ rigs ldan dngos dang mjal/ dus kyi 'khor lo sogs rgyud sde mang po dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel ba skor gsum sogs/ 'ga' zhig thugs la gzung / 'ga' zhig glegang/bam spyan drangs te 'phags yul du byon/ phal cher sgom pa gtso bor mdzad/ mu stegs kyi dpungs lta stangs kyis gnon pa sogs rdzu 'phrul mang du bstan/ mthar 'ja' lus su gshegs/ 'di la slob ma bcu gnyis tsam byung na'ang / thams cad rnal 'byor pa sha stag tu gyur cing / grub pa'i rtags dang cho 'phrul mang du bsten nas/ 'ja' lus su gshegs pas/ bshad rgyun la phan pa tsam ma byung /dus zhabs pa chung pa kho nas chos 'di dar bar mdzad de/ mtshan dngos —336—

ni shrī bha dra/ rigs ni rje rigs/ rten dge bsnyen/ theg pa mtha' dag la shin tu mkhas pa/ mngon shes thogs med du mnga'/ chu la mi 'bying / rtsig pa dang ri la thogs med du gzhud/ 'dis dpal nā la sder paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya dang 'bel gtam byas pas/ de thams cad smra bas zil gyis mnan/ ngag dbang grags pa dang / shes rab 'byung gnas ma gtogs thams cad kyis zhabs la gshugs/chos 'dis sa steng thams cad khyab par mdzad de/ rgyal po dang / blon po dang /tshong dpon chen po rnams kyis kyang / glegs bam bzheng ba dang / bag chags 'jog pa byung / rgya gar du dus 'khor ma phebs gong phar bzhag de phyin chad dus 'khor gyi grub thob phyogs gcig tu gzhag chos gzhan gyi grub thob thams cad phyogs gcig tu gzhag kyang / dus 'khor gyi grub thob mang ngo /dus zhabs pa chung ba de nyid kyi sras nā len+d+ra pa ni/ mtshan dngos bo dhi bha dra/ nā len+d+ra zhes bya ba'i gnas gzhi'i bdag po mdzad/ las bzhi gang sgrub kyang rlung gi rnal 'byor kho nas 'grub bo/ /de la slob ma mang yang phyogs 'dir phrin las che ba kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba mgon po ni/ dbugs theng re la glo ka bcu drug tsam re zin pa'i shes rab mnga'/ bla ma bram ze bzang po'i zhabs zhes bya ba cig bsten/ kha che'i yul gyi chos thams cad mkhyen/ slar yul dbus su byon nas nā len+d+ra pa la dus 'khor sogs sngags kyi zab don dpag tu med pa gsan/ bsgoms pas srog rtsol dang 'dzin pa mthar phyin/ sku la bshang gci'i rgyu ba chad/ chom rkun la sdigs mdzub mdzad pas rengs pa sogs nus pa mnga'/ bod du lan gsum byon/—337—

sgron gsal dang / rig tshogs dang / sa sde sogs chos mang du gsungs/ khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo shin tu dar bar mdzad/ man ngag la bka' dog ste/ phal cher la sor spong tsam las ma gnang / gdams ngag yongs rdzogs gnang pa gsum yod kyang / lo ro ba yin pa cig ni/ grum bus zin nas sgom long ma byung bar 'das/ pu rangs ba'i dge slong gcig gis yer par bsgoms pas 'ja' lus su song / chos kyi brgyud pa la phan pa lha rje sgom pa yin/de la 'bro lo tsā ba shes rab grags kyi rgyud 'grel gzhung 'grel mang po dang bcas pa bsgyur paṇ+ḍi ta'i lo tsā ba mdzad/ lha rje sgom pa'i yang bla ma yin pas shin tu sku drin che/ 'di 'khrungs yul la stod lho'i gnyan rtse ba yin/ paṇa chen zla mgon rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog tu 'khur/ gzhan paṇa grub kyi bla ma mang / sku che'i smad la kha che nyid du bzhugs/ bla ma lha rje sgom pas/ paṇa chen zla mgon la dbang rgyud bshad man ngag mtha' dag rdzogs par gsan/ bla ma sgro ston gyis paṇa chen la dbang dang rgyud bshad rdzogs par thob/ grub chen yu mos chos 'brel tsam gsan/de la lha rje sgom pa ni/ 'khrungs yul 'phan yul grab/ mtshan dkon mchog bsrungs/ rten dge bsnyen/ sngags pa tshangs spyod/ sman dpyad dang /mngon pa dang / sngags rnying ma gsum la mkhas pa gcig yin pa/ yo byad ma cad dril bas gser srang drug dang / dar yug gcig byung ba paṇa chen la phul/ sgyu lus kyi zhabs tog byed par zhus nas/ gdams ngag zhus te bsgoms pas/ nyams rtogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'khrungs/ bran ka dang / 'o de gung —338—

rgyal sogs dam la brtags/ bram pa skam po las chu ba༈zhe/ gzhan sems shes pa sogs yon tan dpag tu med do/ /bla ma sgro ston ni/ rus sgro/ 'khrungs yul 'phan yul spras pa/ bzhugs sa snor bzang / rten sngags pa dkar po/ mtshan gnam la brtsegs/ chos mngon pa/ sa sde/ dbu ma rig tshogs/ gsang 'dus sgron gsal/ yo ga sman dpyad sogs la mkhas pa zhig yin/ paṇa chen zla mgon la dus kyi 'khor sku'i dbang zhus/ rgyud bshad mkhas par nyan/ sbyor drug gi man ngag rnams lha rje sgom pa la zhus/ phyis paṇa chen nyid la yang bka'i gnang ba thob/ nyams rtogs mthar phyin pa brnyes te/ yi dam gyi lha mang po zhal gzigs/ mngon shes thogs med mnga'/ bzhed don thams cad mkha' 'gro la bka' bsgos pa tsam gyi 'grub bo/ /grub chen yu mo ni/ gdung rus rngam/ 'khrungs yul gangs ti se'i 'gram/phyis rab tu byung ba'i mtshan dad pa rgyal po/ gsang mtshan mi bskyod rdo rje zhes bya/ dbus gtsang du bla ma mang du bsten/ sog 'dul 'dzin tshul khrims bla ma'i thugs zin gyi slob mar gyur/ phyis gsang sngags la mos nas sngags chos mang du gsan/ rdo rje snying 'grel gyi mtshan gsan pas kyang dga' ba dpag tu med pa skyes/ bla ma sgro ston lo tswa'i bar du bsten nas/ khod la bzhugs pa'i dbang rgyud man ngag mtha' dag thob/ bdag po'i dbang dang / bdag po chen po'i dbang rgyud 'grel las ji skad gsungs pa bla ma'i kyang gnang / phyis 'u yug gi rgya la gnas su bzhugs/ bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad/ sngags kyi gzhan —339—

stong grub mtha'i srol ka phye/ mngon shes thogs pa med pa mnga'/ skya ka dang bya rog tu sprul pa sogs/ yul sna tshogs su sprul sgyur mang du mdzad pa'i lo rgyus yod/ grub thob gyi snyan grags kyang shin tu che bas sa steng khyab bo/ /de nyid kyi sras dharme shwa ra chos kyi dbang phyug yin te/ mkhyen rab shin tu che/ dgung lo bcu gnyis pa la yang / dbang mdor bstan gyi rgyud la thugs bshad mdzad/ bcu drug pa la rgyud 'grel chen mo thugs nas gsungs/ grub chen la mnga' ba'i gzhung gdams ngag thams cad dgung lo nyi shu tshun la thugs su chud/ mkhas pa mang du bsten pas/ mdo sngags kyi chos la mi mkhyen bya ba med/ khyad par dbu tshad gnyis dang / gsang 'dus dus 'khor rnams la rtsal du thon/ sa chen kun dga' snying po dang / dpyal lo kun dga' rdo rje dang / rngog zhe sdang rdo rje sogs kyang 'bel gtam gyis zil gyis mnan/ thog mnyam gyi jo sras gcig la 'di las mkhas pa med/ 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa yang grags skad/de'i bu chen mkhas pa nam mkha' 'od zer ni/ 'khrungs yul dang bzhugs sa khang gsar yin/ rten dge bsnyen dkar po/ chos dbu tshad/ phar phyin/ mngon pa/ sa sde/ sems 'grel skor gsum/ gsang 'dus 'phags skor sogs la mkhas/ rdo rje phag mo dang / rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i zhal gzigs/'od zer 'phreng ba sogs bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad do/ /sras mchog chos kyi dbang phyug la sras lcam sring gsum byon pa las/'gro don can gnyis te/ lcam lha rje jo 'bum ni/ in+t+ra bo dhi'i lcam lak+ṣa ka ra'i la —340—

sprul pa'i sku yin par grags shing / mkhyen pa che bas dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel yongs rdzogs thugs la bzhugs/ gzhon nu'i dus na spyod pa nges med cig yod pa/ dar bab kyi dus na yum gyis bskul te/ gshin rje gshed phyag rgya zil gnon sgrub pas zhal gzigs/ tshe bdag dang lha chen dpal 'bar phran du 'khol/ srog mthu/ cho 'phrul ser ba sogs zhag dus theb pa kho na byung ste/drag sngags kyi mthu shin tu che/ dgung lo sum cu so drug pa la snyung gzhi drag po byung bas thugs bskul te/ gnas lugs ma rtogs na cis kyang dgos pa med pa mkhyen/ yab la gsan pa'i sbyor ba yan lag drug bsgoms pas/ zhag gcig la rtags bcu rdzogs/ bdun la rlung dbu mar thim/ grub thob chen mor gyur te/ dben par zla phyed tsam/ zla re tsam mi zas ye ma gsol kyang / nyam stobs ches bzang ba dang / srin po ri'i brag gi skyibs mis mi thar ba rnams su 'gro 'ong mdzad cing sgom/ nad yam la bden stobs brjod pa tsam gyis chad pa dang / nad pa la phyag gi reg pa tsam gyis nad las grol ba sogs rtags mngon gyur mnga'o/ /de nyid kyi ming por gyur pa/ grub thob se mo che ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan yin te/ dang po spyan rab rib/ snyan mi bsang / ljags kyang mi bde ba zhig byung bas/ re chen po med kyang sbyor ba yan lag drug pa bsgoms pas nyams rtogs dang mkhyen rab nang nas rdol te/ mkhas pa nam mkha' 'od zer gyi drung du/ dus 'khor gyi rgyud 'grel la sbyangs pas mkhas par mkhyen/ sprul sku jo 'bum la dbang mdor bstan dang bka' 'grel pad+ma can gsan/ bla ma —341—

gzhan la/ bde mchog /kyai rdor/ nā ro chos drug sogs kyang gsan/ lcam jo 'bum sku 'das nas/ phyis lo mchod kyi dus su zhag bco lnga ting nge 'dzin thun gcig la song / de rjes sngon gyi skye ba thams cad dran/ phyis skye ba re la sa re dgrod nas/ skye ba bcu bzhi nas sangs rgya ba'i gnas tshul thams cad gzigs/ des mtshon te/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi skye ba snga phyi dang tshe 'di'i bde sdug thams cad sgrib med du mkhyen/ ma sbas pa mang du yang gsungs/gtsang po la ji ltar gshegs cha med par chu pha khar zang gi gshegs pa mang du byung / grub thob kyi mtshan grags shin tu che/ rten dge slong yin/ sku che'i smad la gtsang 'o lung se mo che'i dgon pa btab ste/ der shas cher bzhugs/chos rje 'jam dbyangs gsar ma ni/ mtshan shes rab 'od zer/'khrungs yul nyang stod/ sngags rnying ma ba'i rgyud du 'khrungs/ gzhon nu nas rab tu byung ste/ 'u mtshan nyid kyi grwa mang por byon/ khyad par gsang phur gnyal zhig gi slob ma'i gtso bor gyur/ bar skabs su bsnyung mdze byung / lo phyed dang gnyis phyag na rdo rje'i sgom bzlas mdzad rmes snyung ba gdangs/ mi gzhan gdon gyi zin pa la sngags btab pa tsam gyis phan pa byung / 'jam dbyangs zhal gzigs pa la lung bstan zhus pas/ grub thob se mo che pa dang las 'brel yod par lung bstan te/ 'u yug la mjal du phebs pa'i lam du/ lha 'dre cho 'phrul mi bzad pa byung yang mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang du bzhag se mo che ba la dus 'khor gyi dbang gsan pa'i tshe/ bla ma dus 'khor dngos su gzigs/ bsgoms pas nyams rtogs mthar phyir/ rkyang 'dur gyi 'chad nyan kyang mdzad de/ rgya nag ri —342—

bo rtse lngar sgrub pa mdzad na 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes rgyu yin pas/ de ltar bzhed pa la slob ma rnams kyis bsho/la btab ste ma thon pas/ bshad sgrub spel ma'i ngang la bzhugs so/ /grub thob se mo che ba yan chad/ dus 'khor la shin tu bka' dog gnyan cha che ba yin/ chos rje 'jam gsar nas gzung cung zad bka' yangs su song /kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer ni/ gser sdings pa gzhon nu 'od kyi sras yin/ mtshan dngos chos kyi 'od zer yin pa la/ bla wo 'phags pa rin po ches/ khyed chos kyi sku'i rang bzhin du 'dug pas/ chos sku 'od zer du thogs gsung / mdo sngags thams cad la shin tu mkhyen pa che/ khyad par gsang 'dus 'phags skor dang / kyai rdor dpyal rngog gnyis 'dus la mkhas pa/ gsang 'dus rim lnga'i nyams rtogs kyang tshad du phyin pa zhig 'jam dbyangs gsar ma la dus 'khor gyi dbang rgyud man ngag thams cad rdzogs par gsan pas/ nyams rtogs brgya 'gyur du 'phel/ dbang gi ye shes dbab pa'i skabs bla ma rdo rje shugs su gzigs/ ye shes phebs nas nyi ma phyed tsam phebs pa ma btang / gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud yongs su rdzogs pa rgya skad du sangs kyis bton/ bla ma gsung nas/'di kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī'i skye ba yin te/ de'i tshe gsang 'dus la mkhas par sbyangs pa'i bag chags yin gsung / mnal thams cad 'od gsal du chug nas/ gzigs rtog dang / chos gsan pa dang / sgom bzlas thams cad mnal gyi ngang nas grub par mdzad/ sgrub khang du 'dag sbyang la bzhugs pa dang /—343—
