'bum pa la bskor ba mdzad pa dus gcig tu 'byung ba sogs/ sku lus kyi bkod pa yang mang du bstan to/ /chos rje kun spangs wo po zhang thugs rje brtson 'grus ni/ mdog gi dab phyar du sku 'khrungs/ sa skya dang mdar sogs dbus gtsang gi grwa sa phal cher du phebs/ mdo sngags thams cad la mkhyen pa shin tu rgyas/ chu mig pa seng ge dpal sogs mkhas mchog thams cad zil gyis mnan/ mdar dang don mo rir zur chos kyang mdzad/ de nas 'jam gsar gyi gdan sa rkyang 'dur gyi chos dpon mdzad cing / kun mkhyen chos sku ba la mnga' ba'i gzhung gdams ngag thams cad gsan/ khyad par dus 'khor ra lugs sngar nas mkhyen cing / kun mkhyen chos sku ba la 'bro lugs kyi dbang rgyud bshad dang / sbyor drug nyams khrid du gsan pas/ nyams rtogs kyi klong brdol/ spyi sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i gdams pa mi 'dra ba bcu bdun tsam gsan cing nyams su myong bar mdzad/srog rtsol bsgoms pas/ 'byung ba lnga'i rlung stobs su gyur te/ thugs nyams 'ur langs/ phyag ya re mi bcu bcus mi thub dang / gzims khang na yod pa rnams res 'ga' 'khyags te mi tshugs pa dang / res 'ga' tshad pas gdungs te mi tshugs pa dang / gzims khang yom yom du g.yo ba dang / bug sgo rtsig pa la thogs med du gshegs pa rnams byung / lan gcig srog gegs cung zad byung ba/ kun mkhyen chos sku bas mngon shes kyis mkhyen nas phebs te bsal/ der nyams rtogs mthar phyin nas/ spyan ras gzigs zhal bcu gcig pa sogs yi dam dpag tu med pa'i zhal gzigs/ de nas 'chad nyan bor te kun spangs —344—

mdzad/ ri khrod nges med la thegs/ lha sa'i jo bo bcu gcig zhal la sogs gsol ba yun ring du btab pas/ spyan ras gzigs smar khrid kyi bka' rgya grol ba'i lung bstan byung / se mkhar chung du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi snying po bsdu bar dgongs nas gsol ba btab pas/ chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams dus gcig tu zhal gzigs nas bkas gnang / 'di la dge mtshan lan gsum byung / de dus nags sman rgyal mos spyan 'dren byung yang /cung zad dus la ma bab par mkhyen te/ lo gsum nas 'byor par zhal gyis bzhes/ phyis phebs nas mkha' spyod bde ldan du rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i man ngag snyan brgyud du bzhugs pa rnams yi ger 'god pa mdzad pa na/ dus kyi 'khor lo nyid zhal gzigs nas lung bstan thob/ 'di sbyor drug gi 'khrid yig rgyas pa bod du byung ba'i snga shos yin/ phyis skyid phug bde ldan du phebs/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug birlu pa zhal gzigs/ lam 'bras la 'khrugs sdebs kyi yig cha mdzad/gsang sngags gsar rnying sgo mtha' dag nas chos kyi sgo spel/ phyogs rigs med pa nas 'dus pa'i sgom chen drug brgya re rtag tu 'tshogs/ nyams rtogs bzang po ma skyes pa gcig kyang med/ sbyor drug la nyams len gyi mthil du mdzad/ rgyud 'grel chen mo yang mang du gsungs/ rgyud snyidza lo re bzhin lan gnyis gnyis gsungs/ byams sems chen po gdan sar bskos nas/ zhing 'di na gdul bya med pas gzhan du 'gro zhes sku 'da' bar dgongs pa na/ byang sems chen po bsnyung bas/ zla ba shas shig sku tshe bsrings/ yang gshegs par —345—

bzhed pa la slob ma rnams kyis gsol ba btab pas zla ba phyed bzhugs/ de nas bsnyung bar med par sku 'das/byang sems chen po rgyal ba ye shes ni/ 'khrungs yul mdo khams/ chung ja'i dus su karma pag shi'i grwa pa yin/ rje pag shi de sku 'khor pa thams cad la bka' drag tu skyon pa zhig yod pas/ shin tu 'jigs pa zhig yod pa la/ shing khur zhig bsnams nas byon pas/ nags bseb gcig tu bla ma sku rkyang byon pa dang thug gis mjal/ skrag ste bros pas/ bla ma na re/ de tshugs ma byed/ da lta bla ma la bros na bar dor yang 'bros/ tshur shog gsung / de nas 'jigs pa sangs/ lo mang du bsten/ khong la mnga' ba'i gdams ngag thams cad gsan cing bsgoms/ 'on kyang de skabs nyams myong rtsal che ba tsam ma byung / de nas bla ma pa'i zhal nas/ ri khrod nges med 'grims/ chos la phyogs ris ma byed/ bla ma bzang po gcig dang mjal bar 'dug gi gsungs pas de bzhin du mdzad/shar ba 'jam dbyangs chen po'i sku gzhogs su yun ring du bzhugs/ mdo sngags kyi chos mang du gsan/ chos rje kun spangs chen po dang mjal nas shin tu dad pa thob/ rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa gsan pas nyams rtogs mthar phyin/ gzhung gdams ngag thams cad bum pa gang byor gnang / gnas nges med du gshegs par bzhed pa la/ 'jam dbyangs chen po'i bka' ma chogs te/bde chen gyi dgon pa btab/ sgrub pa'i ngang nas chos kyang mang du gsungs/thugs snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin du bzhugs pas/ byang sems chen po'i mtshan thogs/ kun spangs chen po'i bka' gnang ba la rten/ jo nang gi gdan —346—

sar phebs/ dgon gnyis kar du sgrub grwa rgya cher bskyangs/ zhabs la gtugs tshad gnas lugs kyi rang zhal lta shes pa kho na byung / mthar phug mo chos rjong gi ri khrod du sku gshegs/mkhas btsun chen po yon tan rgya mtsho ni/ byang sems chen po de nyid kyi mched grogs dang / slob ma dang / rgyal tshab gsum ka yin/ mdog gi mkhar rnying du sngags rnying ma ba'i rgyud du 'khrungs/ grwa sa mang du bsten pa las/ gtso bor mdar du sbyangs pa mdzad/ gsang sngags phyogs kyi bla ma mang du bsten/khyad par shar pa 'jam dbyangs chen po'i bu chen dang zur chos pa'i gtso bo yin/khong pa'i bka' nan gyis thugs blos mi longs bzhin du/ rgya nag du yang phebs dgos byung / chos rje yab sras gnyis dang sngar nas dpon slob du gyur pa yin cing / de skabs jo nang du phebs/ kun spangs chen po la zab lam gyi 'khrid gsan/ mtshan ma'i rnal 'byor zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig la rtags bcu rdzogs par mthar phyin/ nyin mo'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs/ 'phar g.yo'i nyams cher byung ste/mda' rgyang tsam dang rdo rgyang tsam du 'phar ba'i 'phar g.yos jo nang gi ri klungs med par byon pa zhag bdun gyi bar du byung / de sangs nas mnyam nyid chen po gcig gi ngang du gyur/ mngon mkhyen thogs pa med par mnga'/ chos la 'di ma gsan dang 'di mi mkhyen med pa tsam yin/ sku btsun pa rab kyi mthar thug pas/ tshul khrims kyi dri bsrung rgya cher 'phro ba zhig ste/ dang por kun spangs chos rje bla ma bsten tshul rgyud nas bshad pa ltar bsten/ de rjes byang sems chen po gdan sar phebs pa la'ang / kun spangs chen po dang khyad med du bsten/ byang —347—

sems chen po sku 'das nas jo nang gi gdan sar phebs/ sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa rgya cher bskyangs te/ lo bdun lhag tsam nas kun mkhyen chen po gdan sar bskyos/ de rjes lo gnyis tsam nas sku 'das so/ /chos rje kun mkhyen chen po dus gsum sangs rgyas ni/ 'khrungs yul dol po pan tshang ba/ rus sngags rnying ma yin/ yul du bla ma skyi stengs pa sogs bla ma mang rab bsten/ chos kyang rnying ma dang / dbu ma rig tshogs sogs dang /rig gnas dang bzo gnas phra mo mang po chung ja'i dus nas tshegs med du mkhyen/ dgung lo bcu bzhi bco lnga tsam la dgon pa'i bya ba than thun mdzad dgos byung / phyis gsung las/ bar der don med yun ring du 'das gsung /dgung lo bcu bdun pa la skyi ston 'jam dbyangs grags pa rgyal mtshan ya rtser phebs pa'i lam zhor la/ glo bo steng du phebs pa dang mjal/ 'phreng ba skor gsum sogs kyi lag len dang chos kyang mang du gsan/ de rjes mar phebs dang yang mjal nas/ gsang sngags kyi chos sna mang po dang / tshad ma bsdus pa mkhyen pa mdzad/ de rjes kyi ston 'jam dbyangs kyi drung du phebs par bzhed nas/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gcig pa la gcig por bros nas phebs/ sngar yang rab sa 'byor pa can yin pa dang / lam du 'brog pa'i khyis zhal ras la rmugs pa dang / 'dul thag ring ba sogs kyi shin tu 'o brgyal bar byung yang / thugs kyi brtan pa ma zhum/ ngal dub che ba yab yum gyi bka' bcag pas lan dgongs te/ la kha cig nas/ yab yum bzhugs pa'i phyogs su phyag dang bshags pa mang po mdzad pas de phyin chad bde bar byung / de nas sa skyar kyi —348—

ston 'jam dbyangs kyi drung du phar tshad mngon pa gsum dus gcig tu bslabs pas/ grogs rnams kyi gcig la dril ba 'thad zer yang / ma gsan par gsum po'i steng du spyod 'jug sngags chos 'ga' yang bsnan/ lo phyed gnyis nas/ gzhung bzhi char 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i tshig don mtha' dag thugs su chud nas/ bshad gsar mdzad pa'i chas sgrub pa la rta nag tu phebs/ slob dpon rin ye'i drung du zla ba gsum tsam bzhugs/ rde'u'i bcud len sogs kha zas rgyud gcod kyi gdams ngag spyod bzhin du/ byams pa'i chos lnga'i bshad pa tshar gcig gsan/ de rjes bshad gsar mdzad/ bka' rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sogs sher phyin gyi mdo rnams yud tsam gsan pas thams cad thugs su chud/ dbus gtsang gi sde phal cher du grwa skor la phebs pas/ mkhyen rab kyi rtsal dang / rig pa'i rnam 'gyur bzang zhing / sher phyin 'bum pa sogs mdo sde du ma'i tshig mtha' dag thugs la byang bar bzhugs pa dang / gzhung che chung gang la yang thogs pa med par mkhyen pa rgyas pas/ thams cad kyis kun mkhyen rang du 'dug ces bsngags pas/ kun mkhyen gyi mtshan de dus nas kyang thogs/spyir mdo sngags kyi chos gsan pa'i bla ma sum cu lhag cig mnga' mchog tu kyi ston 'jam dbyangs la/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung che chung dpag tu med pa dang /dbang bskur rang yang zur bka' bdun cu tsam gsan/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i phyogs la yang / dang por bla ma 'di'i drung du dbang rgyud man ngag thams cad la shin tu mkhas par mdzad pa yin/ 'chad nyan zur chos pa yang lo shas mdzad/ chos lung tshogs pa'i mkhan chen byang sems bsod nams grags pa la —349—

bsnyen rdzogs zhus shing / 'dul ba mdo rtsa gzhung 'grel dang bcas pa ma lus pa gsan cing mkhyen nas/ sku btsun pa'i mthar thug par bzhugs/ bar skabs der yul du phebs/ yab yum sogs dang mjal/ sngon bka' bcag nas dbus gtsang du phebs pa la bzod gsol byas/ mi dgyes med par mdzad/ lo gcig tsam bzhugs/ slar sa skyar phebs/ dgung lo sum cu pa la jo nang du don gcod gcig la phebs pas/ sgrub tshugs la thugs dad song / de nas lha sa dang 'tshur phu sogs su phebs/ chos rje rang byung pa dang chos kyi gsung gleng mang du mdzad/ rang byung pas rje 'di'i lung rig gi zhal ya ma thegs kyang / mngon shes bzang po mnga' bas/ khyed la lta grub dang chos skad da lta'i 'di bas kyang ches bzang ba cig myur du 'ong / zhes lung bstan/ dgung lo so gcig pa la jo nang du phebs/ mkhas btsun chen po la spyir dbang dang gdam pa mang du gsan/sbyor drug la nyams 'khrid mdzad/ dmigs pa zhu ba'i skabs ma gtogs su dang yang mi 'phrad par mkha' spyod bde ldan du bzhugs/ sor sdud bsam gtan gyi nyams rtogs mthar phyin pas/ bla ma'i gsung nas mgyogs khrid bya gsung ba la/ gol le skyong bar zhu zhus te sgom par mdzad pas/ srog rtsol mthar phyin pa'i rtags rgyud nas bshad pa bzhin mnga'/ de nas lha sar smon lam mdzad cing / yer bar thog gcig thugs dam pa la bzhugs/ yang yar phebs te/skyid phug du bla ma kun spangs chos grags pa la/ 'grel chen tshar gcig gsan nas gsungs/ mkhas btsun chen po'i gsung gnang bas/ dge bshes lnga cu tsam la rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa rgyas pa tshar gcig gsungs/ de nas bla ma'i —350—

bka' nan chen pos gdan sar phebs/ mkhas btsun chen po shin tu dges nas/ lo gnyis su nye ba zhig nyin mtshan med par/ dbang lung 'khrid bshad pa sogs/ bla ma nyid la mnga' ba'i chos thams cad stsal/ spyir kyi ston 'jam dbyangs dang / mkhas btsun chen po la chos gsan pa ni mtha' yas te/ mi tsam 'dzin pa yang dka'o/ /gzhan stong gi lta sgom khyad par can ni/ mkha' spyod bde ldan du bzhugs pa'i tshe thugs la 'khrungs pa yin kyang / lo shas shig gzhan la ma gsungs/ gdan sar phebs nas lo shas nas/ sku 'bum chen mo'i rmang 'dings pa dang / bzang ldan gong gi chos khrir bzhugs/ bshes gnyen dam pa bcu lhag la/ snying po'i mdo bcu'i bshad pa rang bzhed rtsal du ston nas rgyas par gsungs/ g.yin stong ston pa'i gsung rab than thun kyang mang du mdzad/dpe rnams dang chos skad phyogs thams cad du khyab pas/ mkhas pa phal gyi blor ma shong / dngos su 'bel gtam rtsod pa zhus pa rnams/ rgya mtsho la kha ba babs pa bzhin du song bas/ dngos su mjal ba rnams grub mtha' la nges shes dang /bla ma la dad pa thob pa sha stag byung / ring nas ngag lon dang rtsod yig bskur ba rnams la chos dang mthun pa'i lan mdzad pas/ nges pa rnyed/ phyis grub mtha' de rtsod bral du song nas/ phyogs bzhi'i dge bshes du mas bskul nas/ nges don rgya mtsho sogs yig cha che ba rnams mdzad pa yin/ mchod rten chen mo bzheng pa'i tshe/ srog chags shin tu mang ba la ljags sngags mdzad/ se gol rtog pas/srog chags gcig kyang med par song zhing / nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyi khengs/—351—

chu med pa la/ bca' lung gi phu chu nar gyis thon/ gzhal yas khang gi thog phubs dang / gdugs kyi thog phubs kyang nyi ma re re kho na la khel/ rlung shin tu che ba dang / char zhong che ba byung res la bden stobs brjod pas/ 'phral nyid du zhi ba kho na byung / chos khri'i khar chos gsung ba dang / bzo bo rnams kyi sar bkod pa mdzad pa dang / gzims chung du thugs dam la bzhugs pa sogs/ sku lus kyi bkod pa gsum gsum dus gcig tu 'byung ba ni mang pos yang yang mthong / sku'i bkod pa brgyad dus gcig tu 'gyung ba yang 'ga' res mthong /snga phyir jo nang dang / phug mo chos rdzong dang / spyi bar phug gi brag gi ngos mis ye mi thar pa mang por yud kyis phebs nas/ mchod rten mang po bzhengs/ la la da lta yang snang / thog ma jo nang du phebs pa'i skabs nyid na mda' nas yar phebs pas/ nam mkha' la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gzigs/ de nas bzung yi dam zhal gzigs pa ni grangs las 'das te cher cher yang mi mdzad/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang mi lab pa bzhin yod la/ gur gyi mgon po dang / rnam thos sras bran bzhin 'khol/ phyag mchod thugs dam mdzad res kyi/ rigs gsum mgon pa dang / 'phags ma sgrol ma dang / sman bla dang / byams pa rnams re mos kyi 'byon/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang / sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dang / sdom pa che chung dang / rdo rje phag mo dang / rdo rje dbyings la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gzigs pa yang grangs las 'das/ bde ba can gyi smon lam mdzad pa'i tshe/ bde ba can gyi zhing khams dngos su gzigs pa dang / gzims khang bde ba can du gu dra'i tshes bcu'i mchod pa —352—

mdzad pa'i tshe/ slob dpon pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa mngon sum du byon nas shis brjod mdzad pa dang / mchong rten bzheng pa'i las la zhugs tshad bde ba can du 'gro ba'i mtshan ma gzigs/ sbun gsum du bzhugs skabs/thugs dam gyi lha jo bo bhu gla la rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe/ 'ja' 'od la bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi gzugs shin tu gsal ba nub phyogs nas byung ba dang /me tog gi tshogs kha dog sna tshogs pa mang po snyon med du babs/ nam phyed sku 'bum nang du chu shor ba sogs 'phran bu rnams kyang 'phral 'phral mkhyen cing /gong ma yon mchod kyi mnga' thang 'gyur ldog dang / rgyal khams kyi 'gyur ldog rnams kyang ji skad gsungs pa bzhin thog tu khel/ hor gyi spyan 'dren 'byung ba yang snga mo nas dgongs/ spyan 'dren byung ba'i tshe/ nying ro dang / phar phug dang /na dum sogs su dben pa kho na bsten pa lo bzhi tsam mdzad/ phyis rgyal pos lung bzang po gnang ste/ phebs mi dgos par byung nas/ shin tu dgyes te dgon par phebs/ de la rje 'dis jo nang gi gdan sa lo bcu bdun mdzad ring / gtso bor jo nang nyid du bzhugs shing / sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa rgya cher spel/ sku 'bum bzheng pa dang / gsung sgrogs dang / mchod pa 'bul ba dang /mkhas pa du ma 'dus pa la/ mdo sngags kyi dbang dang gzhud bshad rgya cher stsal/ tshogs pa yang sgrub pa snying por byed pa kho na rang yang nyung dus ga stong tsam re 'tshog cing / spyir tshogs pa nyung dus su yang nyis stong tsam re 'du ba byung / mang ba la tshad med/ mchod rten bzheng pa'i las ka su rem pa dang / rgyu tshogs gtong phod su che ba la dge sbyor yang lhan tu bzang bar byung / chos rje —353—

'di la zab lam gyi 'khrid zhus pa la/ dge sbyor gyi sne ma zin pa ni gcig kyang med/ mu ge byung ba'i skabs/ slob ma kun la dka' thub rigs mang du gnang /dpon slob kun gyis mi zas spangs/ gsol chas thams cad 'phongs pa rnams la gnang / phyis chos rje thugs sras klu bas lo tsā ba dang / rje phyogs las rnam rgyal bas gdan sa mdzad pa'i ring / dben gnas nges med kyi ri khrod mang por phebs shing / phal cher ni thugs dam la bzhugs pa dang / zab lam gyi 'khrid 'debs pa'i 'gro don nyid gtso bor mdzad bar bar du chos gsung ba dang /rten bzheng pa dang / yul so so'i lha khang la zhig gsos mdzad pa yang shin tu mang / ngam rings su chos sde btab ste bshad nyan gyi grwa btsugs/ der snyung ba zhig gis rkyen byas/ zhag bcu gnyis kyi ring sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams dang /yi dam kyi lha bgrang bar mi dpyod pa zhal gzigs/ rin chen sding gi lcags zam 'dre gdug pa zhugs pa zhig thugs rtog mi mdzad na bsnoms par zhu zhes bdag pos phul ba la/ 'dren thag btang mcha mis/ lcags kyi tshu kha nas bka' shog bsgrags pa tsam gyis/ pha phyogs kyi lcags thag rang chad la song ste/tshur phyogs kyi zam rngur du phung gi byung ba sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas mang /dbus dmag yod pa'i skabs shig zhag shas blo sbyong kho na'i chos gsungs shing / bzod pa'i bsngags pa 'ba' zhig mdzad/ chos rang bzhugs thog dmag rgya tsam slebs/ sku la mda' rdo mtsho ni cha sna tshogs 'phangs kyang / cung zad kyang ma skyon cing g.yo med du bzhugs/ de nas dad pa skyes te bshags pa phul/ sku tshe'i smad la nub chos lung / 'u yug snye mo/ gnam stong lung —354—

sogs rim pas brgyud nas/ khyad par lha sar phebs nas zla ba bcu gcig bzhugs/ dbus phyogs kyi bla ma slob dpon dge bshes dpon skya skye bo thams cad kyi zhabs la gshugs/ gang phebs thams cad du zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi 'khrid dang / skye bo'i tshogs la sems bskyed dang / yig drug gi chos kho na gnang / lha sar bzhugs ring gdon gyi gnod pa la bka' shog bsgrags pa tsam gyis phan pas/ bka' shog zhu ba nyin re bzhin shin tu mang ste/ mang dus brgya brgya tsam byung skad/ zab lam gyi 'khrid lan bdun gnang ba la/'khrid grwa snga ma rnams la brgya tsam/ nyis brgya tsam/ lnga bcu tsam ci rigs pa yod cing / 'khrid rting ma 'khrid mo cher grags pa la/ dam po 'debs pa stong dang brgyad brgya lhag tsam byung / grangs su ma bcad pa la zab lam sgom mkhan dpag tu med de/ sprang po tshun chad kyang chos la dad pa skyes nas/ las srang rnams su dben gsum sgom pa dang / skye bo stong phrag mang po la mchog dbang gong ma gnang bas/ mi rnams la lta ci smos srang ga'i khyi tshun chad la ye shes phebs pa'i rnam 'gyur mang du byung / gzhan yang dus 'khor gyi rgyud 'grel chen mo tshar gcig 'bum gyi bshad pa tshar gcig dbang mdor bstan tshar gnyis/ nā ro 'grel chen dang / sems 'grel chung ba tshar gnyis/ dbu ma bstod tshogs tshar gsum/ snying po'i mdo bcu dang / nges don rgya mtsho sogs mang du gsungs/ snye mo nas 'di'i bar la srog rtsol gnang bas nyams rtogs tshad du phyin pa yang nyis brgya lhag tsam byung / phyir phebs pa'i tshe/ phyag 'bul bar 'ongs pa'i rta khrom mi khrom rkyang thang sgang la mi shong ba tsam byung / de nas kyi —355—

smad dang / yar 'brog dang / nyang stod sogs su rims gyis phebs nas/ de kun du yang zab lam gyi 'khrid mang du gsungs/ sham po rtse lnga la bde gshegs snying po don rtogs pa mang du 'byung zhes lung bstan/ thams cad mkhyen nga gnyis pa bu ston chen po dang 'bel gtam mdzad par bzhed na'ang / bu ston chen pos rtsod pa mdzad ma nus zhes grags pa yang don la gnas/ snga dus bu ston chen pos jo nang gi sku 'bum gzigs par bzhed nas/ mnal lam gzung ste phebs pas/ jo mdar phebs pa na/ kun mkhyen chen pos phaṭa ces gsungs pas mnal sad de gzigs ma thub sogs kyi lo rgyus yod/ gang phebs thams cad du sems bskyed dang / yig drug gi lung zhu ba dang / dge bsnyen pho mo zhu ba/rab byung bsnyen rdzogs zhu ba sogs kyang rgyun mi 'chad par byung / de nas jo mo nang du phyag phab nas lo gnyis su nye ba na/ gzugs sku dbyings su bsdu bar mdzad de/ theg bdun du thugs dam ma grol ba'i skabs/ bar phug nas 'jad kyi bar gtsang po nyis ldab du bri/ thugs dam grol ba'i tshe byang chub kyi sems dbu gtsug nas lud pa'i skabs/ jo mdar ja sbyor gcig tsam gyi yun gtsang po gyen du log nas chad/ de bar la mi 'ga' res 'gro 'ong byas/ sku mi 'da' ba'i sngon lo lnga dang tsam nas bshang gci rgyun chad pa dang / snga mo nas gtum mo'i bde drod kyi 'ur langs pa la nyin mtshan dang thun thun mtshams med/ ma zos bkres med zos kyang 'as zhes pa'i tshul gyis/ res 'ga' zhag grangs mang por gsol ba mi gsol ba nyung ngu tsam gsol ba yang mdzad/ nub chos lung du skya ser mang po la bsnyung gnas dkar po phyogs brgyad 'bogs ba mdzad —356—

skabs/ gug pa re'i bar du gsol ja sun re gsol ba tsam ma gtogs/ zla ba phyed la gsol ba kham gcig kyang ma gsol te/ sku nyams stobs gzhan pas bzang bar byung / mtshal gung thang du phebs nas/ zhag bdun bzhugs pa'i skabs/ nyin re'i nang du tsha dro mchod pa zhu mkhan mang dus bcu bcu tsam dang /bdun brgyad re 'khor mor byung ba kun la yang / de kun gyi blo kha tshim pa'i phyir gzhan pas lhag par gsol ba mdzad pas/ res 'ga' mi nyi shu tsam re'i zas kyi tshad tsam gsol/ yang ma 'byongs pa'i rnam pa ye ma byung ba dang / sa skya'i sgog rar dbang bskur mdzad pa'i ye shes dbab pa'i rol mo phyi rol gyang 'chag pa'i mis tshor ba la yang ye shes phebs pa dang / dbang bskur mdzad tshad la ye shes phebs pa dang / sha grag seng sogs skyes bu dam pa du ma zhal mthun par rigs ldan gyi sprul par lung bstan pa dang / 'chims blo bzang grags pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi skur dngos su gzigs pa yang yang byung ba dang / nye gnas nam mkha' byang chub kyis 'jam dbyangs dngos su mthong ba dang / bcom ldan rdo rje snying po dang / snang ba dag pa'i sgrub pa pho mo mang pos sku la mtshan dpe rdzogs par mthong ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa mngon gyur du mnga'/ don du ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa yin pas/ rigs ldan pad+ma dkar po dang gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo nyid yin pas/ dam pa so rbe'i gzigs snang la byung ba yang de snang zhing / rnam pa gcig tu na/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ rnga bo che'i mdo dang / sprin chen po'i mdor lung bstan pa/ li tsā bi gzhon nu 'jig rten —357—

kun gyi mthong na dga' ba zhes bya ba/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ ka yo ri'i rgyud du ston pa'i mtshan 'chang ba la dge slong du gyur ste/ mdo sde du ma gsal bar byed ces ston pa'i mtshan ni/ kun mkhyen ces yongs su grags pa ste/ chos rje 'di nyid lung bstan par dngos slob rnams bzhed pa yang / don la gnas pa yin zhing / chos rje nyid kyis kyang don gyi zhal gyi bzhes par mngon no/ /de'i phyir/sku gsung thugs dang mdzad pa gsang ba mtha' dag de bzhin gshegs pa kho na'i spyod yul lo/ /chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa 'di la/ rigs ldan kyi sprul pa yin pa'i snyan grags che ba dang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos kyi mnga' bdag chen por mngon sum du bzhugs pa la rten/ dus mnyam gyi dge bzhes phal mo che zhig gis/ chos 'di dang 'brel ba'i man ngag ci rigs pa ma gsan pa med pa lta bu yin/ dbang rgyud man ngag rdzogs par gsan pa yang stong phrag mang po dang / dbang dang 'khrid cha tshang ba thob pa khri phrag brgal ba dang / mchog dbang gong ma dang / so sor sdud pa'i 'khrid gsan cing nyams myong skyes pa ni bgrang bar mi spogs pa tsam yod par grags shing / spyir bstan pa sgo thams cad nas rgyas par mdzad/ sgos su bod kyi ri sul thams cad rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi sgrub pa pos khyab pa dang / bshad nyan gyi grwa thams cad du/ snying po'i mdo dang rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos las brtsams/ phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i gtam/ bde gshegs snying po seng ge'i sgras khyab par mdzad der/ rnga bo che'i mdo las lung bstan pa bzhin du/ lo brgyad cu lhag gi bar du de lta bu'i rgyun gnas par gyur la/ de rjes lta ba mtho ru re zhing drang don kun rdzob la lhag par —358—

chen pa'i ngang tshul can/ snyan grags dang / dbang thang dang / 'khor tshogs bsdu ba'i bgo skal can mang du byon pa la rten/ sngon bzhin gsal bar ma gyur kyang /dus kyi tha ma'i tha ma da lta'i bar du yang / rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sgom pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i gtam srol kha ma nub tsam yod cing / bar skabs su mang du byung ba ni dam pa 'di kho na'i drin no/ /yang dam pa 'dis dang po sa skyar 'chad nyan la thugs gzhol ba'i tshe/ ka chen bzhi dang / rigs tshogs lnga/ dbu ma 'ju ga pa/ byams chos phyi ma bzhi rnams lan mang du gsungs/ snga phyir gzhung 'phran mi gcig pa yang bcu tsam gsungs/ phyis sgrub pa la thegs nas/ star chags du skyong ba'i 'chad nyan gyi grwa 'dzugs pa ni ye mi mdzad/ don gnyer mkhas pa mang po 'dus pa la/ byams chos sde lnga dang / dbu ma bstod tshogs dang / 'bum dang / snying po'i mdo rnams dang / 'grel chen dri ma med pa'i 'od sogs sems 'grel skor gsum dang / dbang mdor bstan kyai rdo rje nā ro 'grel chen rnams yang dang yang du gsungs/ dbu ma rtsa ba dang /spyod 'jug bslab btus/ kyai rdor rgyud gsum/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'phreng ba/ gsang 'dus sgrol gsal/ dmar nag 'jigs gsum sogs kyang /lan re re gnyis gnyis gsungs/ so so'i 'dod pa dang mthun par/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang rnams dang / bde dgyes gsang 'dus gshin rje gshed/ rdo rje dbyings dang / rta mgrin phur pa sogs gsang sngags gsar rnying gi dbang zur bka' yang mang du gnang / gdams ngag 'khrid tshul tha dad pa yang mang du gsung mod kyi/ gtso bor sher phyin gyi mdo dang / mngon —359—

rtogs rgyan/ snying po'i mdo dang rgyud bla ma/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang khrid/sems 'grel skor gsum gyi bshad pa dang bcas pa rnams rtag tu gsung ba lta bu yin zhing / theg pa mtha' dag gi nges pa'i don yang de dag las brtsams te gsung ngo / /'on kyang res 'ga' ni sgrub pa kho na la thugs gzhol bar yang mdzad/ chos gsung ba'i dus na yang / gzigs rtog bshar sbyang / thugs bsam sogs mdzad mi dgos te/ chos grwar phebs pa'i dus dang / zhal bkod sogs gang dgos pa'i dus de ka ma gtogs/ zab mo'i rnal 'byor kho na la bzhugs so/ /sngon bka' dang bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal rdzogs par nan tan dang bcas pas tshar gcig gzigs/ de kas don thams cad ma 'dres par thugs su chud/ sku 'khor 'ga' zhig gis/ bla ma pa'i mkhyen rlabs 'di la/ mkhan chen bu ston pa'i gzigs rtog gi thugs rtsol dang / 'chad nyan la thugs gzhol ba 'di yod na/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa lta bu gcig yong brur gda' zhus pas/ spyir chos 'di rnams bslabs pas go ba kho na rang yang smen/ tshogs sgor du ma nas bsog cing / bsgoms na go ba lags/ da lta snying po bsdu ba'i skabasi 'dir/ sgrub pa kho na phan yon che ba yin mod gsung ngo //de ltar na dam pa 'di la spyir slob ma'i tshogs mtha' yas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dgongs pa skyong ba'i slob ma rang yang shin tu mang / gtso bor gyur pa/lo tsā ba blo gros dpal dang / sa bzang lo tsā ba ma ti paṇa chen gnyis la thugs sras rnam gnyis su grags/ kun spangs chen po chos grags dpal bzang zhabs —360—

tog shin tu che/ 'dis kyang lo tsā tshad du phyin pa mkhyen/ chos rgyal phyogs las rnam rgyal/ mkhan chen rin chen tshul khrims/ zhang ston bsod nams grags pa/mkhas grub dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ yar lung pa chos dpal mgon po rnams/'phrin las kyi rgyun rgya cher skyong mkhan yin zhing / de dag las/chos rgyal phyogs las rnam rgyal ni/ ya tshe rgyal po'i bla mchod bla chen zhig gi sras su 'tshar ka'i rong du sku 'khrungs/ lo shas gsang ba'i tshul du bzhugs/ de rjes blo bor byon/ yab dang khu bo sogs las sngags chos mang po dang / dbu ma rtsa 'jug gnyis spyod 'jug dang bcas pa mkhas par sbyangs/gzhon nu'i dus de nyid du tshogs pa rnams la bshad pas/ ngo mtshar du gyur/ de nas dbus gtsang du 'byon par bzhed pa la/ re zhig bla mas bkas ma gnang yang / yid kyis yang yang gsol ba btab ste/ gcig pur bros nas byon/ gung thang du dpang lo chen po dang mjal/ sa skyar byon te/ de lo 'chad nyan rkang tshugs par mi 'dug nas/ brag ram du byon/ lo gcig phar tshad dbu gsum la sbyangs pa mdzad pas mkhas par mkhyen/ de nas dbus kyi gung thang du byon/ lo gnyis kyi ring sbyangs pa cher mdzad/ gzhung lugs thams cad la mkhyen brgyas/dgung lo nyer gcig pa la dbus gtsang gi grwa sa thams cad du grwa bskor mdzad/sku gzhon nu gzhung lugs thams cad la mkhyen pa rgyas shing / thugs gsal ba dang / brjod pa gtsang ba dang / rtsod pa bzang ba la 'gran gyi do med du grags/'tshal pa'i dpon dga' bdes/ phyogs las rnam rgyal du mtshan gsol/'tshal gung thang gi zur chos kyang mdzad/ slar yang brag ram du byon pa zhig la/—361—

jo nang du kun mkhyen chen po dang mjal nas/ gzhan stong gi grub mtha' la lung rigs kyi brtag dpyad byed dgos dgongs te phebs pas/ kun mkhyen sku 'bum la bskor ba mdzad pa dang mjal/ 'bel gtam mdzad par zhus pas shin tu dgyes te/ bla brang du zhag bdun tsam gyi ring la 'bel gtam shin tu 'phel bar mdzad pas/ g.yin stong gi grub mtha' sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa/ chos thams cad kyi chos nyid du nges pa rnyed/ gzhan stong gi 'gog byed kyi rtsod pa rnams ni/ rnam par rtog pa'i ri mo tsam las don la mi gnas par mkhyen/ kun mkhyen chen po la mi phyed pa'i dad pa 'khrungs/ de skabs chos 'brel ci rigs pa gsan nas thegs/ slar dus kyi 'khor lo rgyud sogs thugs la bzung nas jo nang du phebs/ dus kyi snyen ra lo'i dbang zhus/ zab lam gyi 'khrid bskyangs pas/ nyams rtogs phun sum tshogs par 'khrungs/ rgyud 'grel la sbyangs pas tshegs med par mkhyen/ kun mkhyen chen po la dbang dang mdo sngags kyi bshad pa dpag tu med pa gsan/ lo mang por mchod g.yog kyang mdzad/ bu ston chen po la yang / phar phyin dang mtshan brjod gsan/ shug phug tu bshad sgrub kyi grwa chung du skyong zhing lo shas bzhugs/ ngam ring gi chos dpon mdzad nas phar tshad la bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad/ 'chad nyan 'phel bar bzhugs skabs/ lo tsā ba blo gros dpal sku 'das nas/ jo nang gi gdan sa lo drug mdzad/ ngam ring gi chos dpon dang jo nang gi gdan sa lhan cig tu ba6ga nas/ se mkhar chung du gtso bor thugs dam la bzhugs/ de nas log 'ga' nas kun mkhyen chen po gshegs/ de rjes mi ring bar/ 'tshal gung —362—

thang dang / yar klungs sogs dbus kyi phyogs rnams su dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos rgya cher spel/ phyis sku tshe'i smad kyi dus su/ slar yang jo mo nang gi gdan sa mdzad/ mngon mkhyen thogs med mnga'/ gtsang nas se khar chung du phebs pa zhig la/ nam srod khyer ba la mdog chu'i 'gram du phebs/ 'khor g.yog rnams kyi gnas tshad du bzhugs par zhus pa la/ 'phral du thegs pa'i zhal ta mdzad de/ de 'phral ko ba sogs gang yang med par sku rkyang chu'i pha khar phebs/ de rjes 'khor g.yog rnams kyang nam phyed de khar ko ba la rten nas yongs pas/nam langs ma theg bltas dus/ chu'i pha kha thams cad dmag gis khengs/ de 'dra ba'i lo rgyus mang / dgung lo bdun du don gsum pa la/ thams cad kyi sku dog che zer zhing / sku khams bag tsam bsnyung ba la/ rim gro mdzad par zhus pas/ de yang rung ste/ lo brgyad cu gya gcig gi bar bsdad pas chog gsung ba dang / bdun cu don dgu pa'i gzhug la/ sku khams shin tu bsnyel ba'i skabs/da lo mi 'chi ba'i rang dbang yod gsung / brgyad cu pa la sku khams shin tu bzang ba la/ da kun sku khams bzang bar gda'/ lo shas blo bde zhus pas/ da lo khams bzang ste/ da bzod nges par 'gro dgos pa yin gsung / thams cad thogs tu khel/ de sogs yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga'o/ /de la zhal slob 'gro don can shin tu mang yang /nya dbon kun dga' dpal ni/ khams pa'i dge bshes nya dar ma rin chen zhes bya ba'i dbon po yin/ chung ngu nas mkhyen rab shin tu che/ chos rje kun mkhyen chen po dang yang yang mjal/ dgongs don thugs su chud cing / mos —363—

gus chen po zhig yin pa/ dgung lo nyi shu skor la/ phyag zhabs gong ste 'byon ma thub/ klu gdon gyi rtog pa byung / kun mkhyen chen po sa skyar phebs pa zhig la/grogs kyi khur nas byin rlabs zhu ru byon/ byin rlabs gnang / ljags btab tsam gyis bsnyung gzhi las 'phral du grol/ phyis mdo sngags kyi gzhung thams cad la mkhyen pa rgyas shing rig pa'i dbang phyug chen por gyur/ rje phyogs las rnam rgyal yun ring du bsten/ nyams rtogs kyang mthar phyin pa brnyes/ dus 'khor sogs mdo sngags kyi chos mang po gsan/ sa skyar 'chad nyan yun ring du mdzad/ sku tshe'i smad la blo gsal drug brgya tsam gyis bskor nas/ rtse chen gyi chos sde btab/ bshad sgrub gnyis ka shin tu 'phel bar mdzad do/ /grub chen kun blo ni/ shar kha ba'i sku rus su 'khrungs/ phar tshad/ mngon pa/ 'dul ba/ dbu ma sogs mdo phyogs rnams dang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bshad sgrub rnams nya dbon chen po kho na la gsan/ gzhan bla ma dam pa mang du bsten cing / dbang gdams ngag mtha' yas pa la mnga' brnyes/ rgyal po'i rigs su 'khrungs kyang srid la ma chags pas/ spa gro la sogs pa yul theg ring po dang / bas mtha' rnams su sgrub pa kho na la thugs gzhol/ rang gi dpon rigs rtse shar nub gnyis kyi 'khrug par dus mi bde ba la/ phan bde'i bkas khyad par mdzad/ sku che'i smad la 'khrul zhig chen por bzhugs shing / bu ston chen po'i skye ba yin par grags so/ /'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po ni/ gzungs sa la stod byang pa/rtsa ba'i grwa sa bzang ldan yin/ sa skya sogs grwa sa grags che ba phal cher du byon/—364—

mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal pa las sa skya pa'i chos rnams gsan/ grub chen kun dga' blo gros la dus kyi 'khor lo sogs zab don mtha' dag gsan/si tu rab brtan kun bzang 'phags kyi bla mar bkur/ nyang stod kyi chos sde gsar ba'i chos dpon mdzad/ jo nang pa'i grwa tshang gsar du btsugs/ phyis rtse shar nub gnyis kar gyis gus pas bshud/ chos sde gnyis char dang jo nang gi gdan sa yang mdzad/ grub mtha'i chags sdang las/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang dpon slob kyis byad kha byas pa yang bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems dang / rdo rje'i bzlas pa spel bas/ byad kha phyir log ste/ mkhas grub dge legs dpon slob rnams mi ring bar gro nges/ lha chen bzang ra dam la btags/ de sogs ya mtshan ba'i lo rgyus mang / bla ma sa skya ba chen po'i sprul pa grags so/ /mkhas grub nam mkha' chos skyong ni/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mdzad sa dang / rtsa ba'i grwa sa grwa tshang chen mo yin/ kun mkhyen nam bsod chen mo la mtshan nyid kyi gzhung rnams mkhas par sbyangs/ slar 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po'i chos grwar byon/ chos dang gang zag thams cad la dad mos 'khrungs/ mtshan nyid kyi gzhung rnams la mkhas nyan mdzad/ gzhan stong gi grub mtha' rnams la nges pa gting nas tshugs/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa zhus te nyams rtogs kyang shin tu bzang / dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud gzhung la yang mkhas par sbyangs/ ngam ring 'tshal gung sogs 'chad nyan chang chung 'ga' re'i sar phebs/ rtse shar nub gnyis dang / khyad par seng ge rtse bas yon bdag gi —365—

mthil byas/ rtse chen dang jo nang gi gdan sa yun ring du mdzad/ bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa gnyis kar bzung / sku 'bum chen mo'i chos 'khor bcu gsum gser zangs kyi g.yog par mdzad do/ /paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang ni/ grub mtha' rtsa ba sa skya ba yin/mus pa rab 'byams pa thugs rje dpal bzang gi grwa sar slob gnyer mdzad/brgya sder 'chad nyan yang lo shas tshugs pa byung / bdag chen rnam rgyal grags pa'i slob ma shangs ston pa bya ba la/ lhun sdings su dus 'khor byang lugs de shin tu mkhas par sbyangs/ rgyal ba nam mkha'i mtshan can la sbyor drug gi man ngag jo nang ba'i rang lugs 'di snga dus cig gsan pas nyams rtogs bzang por 'khrungs pa yin/ 'bras spung gi dgon pa btab nas 'gro don cung zad mdzad do/ /de la lo chen rat+na bha dras zhus/ de la rje btsun grol mchog gis gsan/de la mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtshos gsan/ de'i drung du dngos kyis thob ste/'di man ngag kho na'i brgyud pa yin na'ang / nyams rtogs kyi rgyun ma chad pa yin pas rtsis su byas la/ yang dbang rgyud man ngag gsum kar bka' cig pa'i dbang du byas na/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po la/ 'jam dbyangs chos dbang gis gsan te/ mkhas pa de ni/ spyir mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs thams cad la mkhas shing / khyad par phar phyin jo nang kun mkhyen chen po'i rang lugs thun mong ma yin pa 'di dang / dus kyi 'khor lo la shin tu mkhas/ sbyor drug la nyams rtogs bzang po mnga'/ gur gyi mgon po zhal gzigs/ bzang —366—

ra sogs 'jig rten gyi lha 'dre dregs pa mang pos zhabs la btud/ dang por khang gsar gi 'chad nyan mdzad cing / phyis chos sde chen po'i gdan sa yun ring du mdzad do/ /de la dbon chen chos seng ge gi zhus/ de la mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes kyi zhus/ de la mkhas grub byams pa lhun grub kyis gsan/ dngos kyis mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes la ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang tsam mnos/ byams pa'i mtshan can la/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la rten dbang yongs su rdzogs pa dang / rim pa gnyis kyi bshad pa rgyud 'grel dang bcas pa thob bo/ /yang 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs chos dbang / mkhan chen kun dga' dpal 'byor/ mkhan chen dkon mchog rin chen rnams brgyud nas/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho'i drung du/ mngon rtogs dpag bsam ljon shing dang / dkyil chog ye shes rgya mtsho klags chog gi steng nas dbang rdzogs par zhus/ gzhan yang sbyor drug gi lung sogs than thun zhus pa'i bla ma 'ga' re yod de/ brgyud pa de rnams ni jo nang ba'i lugs yin la/bu ston rin po che'i lugs kyi dbang rnams yongs su rdzogs par/ rdo rje slob dpon chen po dpal ldan chos bzang la mnos shing / yan lag drug pa'i gdams pa grub thob zhi ba sbas pa'i lugs dang / rnal 'byor ma rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang dang / lha nyi rtsa lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang rnams/ slob dpon pu rna badz+ra las kyang thob bo/ /zhes pa dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos skor gyi byung khungs nyer mkho bsdus pa 'di yang / rgyan la khams pa tā ra nā thas chos lung byang rtser sbyar ba'o/ /dge legs 'phel//—367—

dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ tshangs po/mdun shog ma rjes 'god pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/spi5 gu ni/rde/sul/'an ni/la5/deb zhe lnga pa/༄tsho1/ /jo nang tā ra na tha'i gsung 'bum/( 3(45)dang la brtsegs bo da yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug bang sis bsgrigs/:krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang gis bskrun te bkram/pe cin ma'o rin tshon khra par 'debs kung sis dpar btab/spyi lo2008lo'i zla4par par sa zhing nga ngo bsgrisasaspyi'o20 8lo'i zla4par par thengs dang po btabadapar grang ba ༷001—— rde15༷0152ma978—7— 80253—013—3sko2 5/— ————rderde———rderde —dzi — ———snye—rderderderdegasung 'bum cha tshang ( deb 1—45yod ) la rin sgor/ 9 10 00

nged dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gi las sgrub mi snar lo bstud mar 'tsho ba'i yon sbyor gnang mkhan mchog sprul pad+ma dbang rgyal rin po che la snying thag pa nas thugs rje zhu ba dang /krung rga'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma par skrun thad la rgyab skyor dang mnyam las gnang bar snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu ba yin/dpar yon zhal 'debs gnang mkhan/rang re'i sbun zla rnams kyi mtshan tho/ ka mad kyi go rim ltar lags/gdung sras phrin las nor bu rin po che/ bla ma mthar phyin rin po che/ bla ma yon tan/sman pa rig 'dzin lags/ las rab gling pa rin po che/ bsod nams bde skyid/
